rgan po'i ma bcos drang gtam/
rgan mo'i ma mecos drang gtam/rtsom pa po/tho bzang bkra shis/bod kyai dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa/chab srid mecon pa'i lo gyus deb phreng / 12
rgan po'i ma bcos drang gtam/rtsom pa po/zlo bzang bkra shis/thod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa/chab grid bcon pa'i lo gyus deb phreng / 12

༷/ spya sgo / ༵ 0༷༷ shaṃ/ // 1༷ ༷t+t+waṃ rteshaṃ /sgol4 62 5 ༄ba ༄ nga 7(nazhu4 ched brjod/ gu 0 5 rgya /la/gangs can bod kyi lo rgyus nang sngar ma grags pa'i dza drag gnyan 'phrang dus skas suja mi mas la mnar/'daka' ma ji ltar myangs pa'i lorgyus baja kyis mi lang bayo 4 nas da lam byatho mo tshang sgrol galo 'dzoms kyi lo ma rgan lo ma bcos drang gtam/ zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di'i nang rang thog dngos su myangs pa'i /da' sdug gis mtshon spyir btang bod mi rnams nas slob ga/ cen po gsum zer ba dang /rig gnas gsar brje zer ba'i skabs bod mi grangs las 'das pa mnar gcod 'og 'das grongs dang rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba/lhag par rig gnas gsar brje'i byung rabs mas ga4 /de labarten ja kyi miral rjes ma rnamasadang /༄ tho jog thugs snangayod rigs nas skabasade'i bod mi rnams la dakha sdus/ ji byung gi lo rgyus po rtogasadang sa bsam se4 sas mjug 4dayong rgyur 3 thogs nges mayong nges spotobadagadangadapar bskrun 4nawār gnang mingaphoyod tshang mar bsas bathodang thugs rje che zhudang 'pho lorgyus deba'adilang jaja bden 4'a gsal ba'i cha rkyen du 'gyur ba'i yid ches dang sgon 'dun bcas/bod gzhung bde srung las khungs nas/phyi lo 2༷06 tshes 2 la//

'o/(tso( na3trī laphya.u (/ cas ṭ+wāṃ sdi sme4ba 0sta/chinywarngo/shā hārga/ tshi0ciḍā|sduchiyādzekro rdo shukhriXrdosmo ༷༷⑪9'aX d+kuge larkatestulku rkyagu—7(r+shaṭa9 ched brjod/ dwo/sbyablo tshodṛ 5༄༄༄/gangs can bod kyi lo rgyus nang sngar ma grags pa'i dza drag gnyan 'phrang dus skabs gyathod mirnams la mnarabacudadaka' sdug ji ltar myangs pa'i lorgyus bcad kyis mi lang b.lod gras nas da lam gyathengasna mo tshang blol gachos 'dzoms kyi lo rgyus rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di'i nang rang sgog dngos su myangs pa'i nga/ka' sdug gis mtshon spyir btang bod mi rnams nas slob gso chen po gsum zer ba dang /rig gnas gsar brje zer ba'i skabs bod mi grangs las 'das pa mnar gcod 'og 'das grongs dang rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba/lhag par rig gnas gsar brje'i byung rabs sogs gsal 'khod lasparten thod kyi mirabs rjes ma rnamasadang /cad don jog zugs snangayod rigs nas skabasade'i bod mi rnams la da/'a sdurga/ ji byung gi lo rgyus shes rtogasadang lhag bsam sems shugs mjug mthudayong rgyur phan jogs nges g.yong nges spotospadagadangadapar bskrun mthuna'agyur gnang mi'ibrelayod tshang mar bsas bsgodang thugs rje che zhudang 'brel lorgyus dega'adisprang jadon bden ཿ'a gsal ba'i cha rkyen du 'gyur ba'i yid ches dang smon 'dun bcas/bod gzhung bde srung las khungs nas/phyi lo 2༷༷cazla snyotshes zha la ri

dkar chagadapal ldan bde srung las khungs nas stsal ba'i ched brdzod/rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/ gcigapar skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/letshanadangaso/ smar khams gling gi sa cha/ 1letshanabanyisapa/ rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 8le zhegasumapa/ phyos khang gi bu mo/ 27letshanarazhipa/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug 33le gasngal/ byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/ 42le0na drugapa/ rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 46letshan skunapa/ bod kyi nyi ma lhor bzhud/ 60le gabargyadaspa/ skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo/ 66

dkar chagadapal ldan bde srung las khungs nas ༅ ba'i ched brjod/rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/ gcigapar skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/sunadangabo/ smar khams gling gi sa cha/ 17nab sapa/ rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 8le gagasumapa/ tshos khang gi bu mo/ 277nargapa/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug 33ye gapo/ byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/ 42nge na drugapa/ rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 46sgon rwanapa/ bod kyi nyi ma ltor bzhud/ 60be+e brgyadapa/ skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo/ 66

letshanadagupa/ nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 75le zhe༄ba/ bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 88le zhe༄ga ga gnas chung gi nang rten/ 104le zhe༄bas / dad pa'i mig chu sa la lhang / 11༷le zhe༄gsum/ slob gso chen po gsum gyi chag sgo/ 123le zhe༄rga/ rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 131thogalosnga/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang /dmar srung dmag 145le rna༄rūg rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 154le zhe༄༄na/ lha 'dre gdon 'gegs dang /yig chen tshags par/ 166le zhebacobargyad/ gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 182le ga༄dgu/ 1969 d+ku bod mi'i drag shugs ngo rgol/ 195

༄dgupa/ nyam thung khrims rar 'tshud/ 75༄༄pa/ bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 88༄༄r+yā gnas zung gi nang rten/ 104༄༄྾/ dad pa'i mig zu sa la lhung / 110༄༄gsum/ grob gso chen po gsum gyi chag sgo/ 123༄༄rga/ rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 131༄losnga/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang /dmar srung dmag 145༄༄drug rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 154༄༄༄na/ lha 'dre gdon 'gegs dang /yig chen tshags par/ 166stolobargyad/ gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 182༄༄dgu/ 1969 r+yā bod mi'i drag shugs ngo rgol/ 195

be+e gnyi shu/ stag 'dzum drug ma rgyas rngon pa'i lag tu 'tshud/ 206le gar+ṣag sgu tshab tshogs pa dang bod rang btsan gyi skad 'bod/ 216le r+ṣage la/ nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 224༄steragasum/ mi drag gcig gi mtha' mjug 237le gar+ṣa'/ 'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 243masa'asnga/ srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang /'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin 257'i steradrug a pho thug 'phrad dang bu mo spebs pa/ 274sgon༄༄na/ mi tshe don ldan gyi tshe mjug 286le tshanaster brgyad pa/ rgya dmar gyi btsan gnon 'og tshe srog shor ba'i bod mi/ 299le tshan radagu pa/ bsod nams bag gros btsan byol gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ 304

le zhenyi shu/ stag 'dzum drug ma rgyas rdzon pa'i lag tu 'tshud/ 206le zhenyerabakheg sku tshab mogs pa dang bod rang btsan gyi skad 'bod/ 216le gnyerab la/ nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 224le zheteragasum/ mi drag gcig gi mtha' mjug 237le ninyerabazhi/ 'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 243le zher+ṣasnga/ srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang /'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin 257letshanateratāg a pho thug 'phrad dang bu mo slebs pa/ 274letshananyer༄na/ mi tshe don ldan gyi tshe mjug 28snyole tshanaster brgyad pa/ rgya dmar gyi btsan gnon 'og tshe srog shor ba'i bod mi/ 299le tshananyeradagu pa/ bsod nams bag hros btsan gyol gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ 304

rtsom sgrig pa'i smeng brdzod/ gcigartsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad cing / byas pa chud mi 'dza' bas/skye ro/ kun la rang gi las kyis skyed pa'i bde sdug gi tshor ba sna cho gas shig dbang med mabo lnga ga tu babs shing / de las kyang phyi rkyen rgyal cadar bran g.yog tu gyur pa'i mi rnams/ lung pa chus 'khyer na/ rdo leb skam po mi lhag pa'i dpe bzhin shin tu nas skyoste snang gis khyab pa'i mi che'i brgyud rim re 'grims dgos/ mi bye brag pa'i mi tshe'i brgyud rim de ni skabs de dang de'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi bde sdug lta ba'i g.ya' bral gyi me 'o/nga zhig skusgon/da lta'i lhasnal ma chodas 'alnga mas lags kyis rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam gsungs skabs kyang / mig snga'i las ka tsam min par bdag la bsams gzhigs kyi bo skabs du ma byin byung / bdag gi lnga sa nas bshad na / lo rgyus kyi bdag po rnams ni bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'dra bar shes bya gsar pa du ma zhig bdag la phangs med skyes su bstar/

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/ gcigartsom sgrig pa'i gleng brdod/las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad cing / byas pa thud mi 'dza' bas/skye bo kun la rang gi las kyis skyed pa'i bde sdug gi tshor ba sna tshogs shig dbang med mgo thog tu babs shing / de las kyang phyi rkyen rgyal shor bran g.yog tu gyur pa'i mi rnams/ lung pa thus 'khyer na/ rdo leb skam po mi lhag pa'i dpe bzhin shin tu nas skyo snang gis khyab pa'i mi che'i brgyud rim re 'grims dgos/ mi bye brag pa'i mi che'i brgyud rim de ni skabs de dang de'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi bde sdug lta ba'i g.ya' bral gye me long zhig yin/da lta'i sgrol ma chos 'dzoms lags kyis rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam gsungs skabs kyang / mig snga'i las ka tsam min par bdag la bsams gzhigs kyi go skabs du ma byin byung / bdag gi ngos nas bshad na / lo rgyus kyi bdag po rnams ni bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'dra bar shes bya gsar pa du ma zhig bdag la phangs med skyes su bstar/

gnyis/ rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brdzod/bcar 'dri byed ring khong gi mi tshe'i dus mod phal che ba khong gi bu tshe ring dbang phyug lags da nga mnyam gshib yin pa shes byung bas/ bdag gi re zhus bzhin bgres mo'i thugs kyi yol go ra ma chud pa'i dodan gnad 'ga' dang / ma zin la dag bcos/ lhag par rig gsar skabs kyi gnas tshul rgyas pa bcas bka' drung las 'phar sku zhabs tshe ring dbang phyug lags kyis bris shing / 'di nas re bskul zhus min la ma ltos par bar skabs tshigs bcad khag kyang gnang byung bas/ deb kyi rgyu cha je legs su gyur/ 'di ga tshogs pas mthun rkyen sbyar zhing khong ma bu gnyis nga/nga phran bcas mthun pa'i rgyu cho gas pa las/ rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam wa da kyi 'o/ rgyus kyi deb khongs 'ardzog thub pa byung yang / phran blo ༷ sa kyi na tsho da ches phra bas 'di la sna ra 'khrul ci mchis basbradzid gsol dang / legs pa'i cha mchis na 'o1 rgyus kyi bdag po'i dbosnangs pa bzhin rgya che'i spyodag pa sngo rnams kyis snyig dor bcud len mdzad pa'i re ba zhu/chod bzang bkra shis kyis wa da rgyal 'o/ 2133 sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs sgyu gas pa gnyis pa/ spyi 'ege 200snyo zla snyo tshes snyo nyin/

gnyis/ rtsom sgrig pa'i sleng brjod/bcar 'dri byed ring khong gi mi tshe'i dus tshod phal che ba khong gi bu tshe ring dbang phyug lags da nga mnyam gshib yin pa shes byung bas/ bdag gi re zhus bzhin bgres mo'i thugs kyi yol gor ma thud pa'i don gnad 'ga' dang / ma zin la dag bcos/ lhag par rig gsar skabs kyi gnas tshul rgyas pa bcas bka' drung las 'phar sku zhabs tshe ring dbang phyug lags kyis bris shing / 'di nas re bskul zhus min la ma ltos par bar skabs tshigs bcad khag kyang gnang byung bas/ deb kyi rgyu cha je legs su gyur/ 'di ga tshogs pas mthun rkyen sbyar zhing khong ma bu gnyis ngang phran bcas mthun pa'i rgyu chogs pa las/ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam bod kyi lo rgyus kyi deb khongs 'jog thub pa byung yang / phran blo gros kyi na chod ches phra bas 'di la nor 'khrul ci mchis bzod gsol dang / legs pa'i cha mchis na lo rgyus kyi bdag po dgongs pa bzhin rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis snyig dor bcud len mdzad pa'i re ba zhu/slo bzang bkra shis kyis bod rgyal lo 2133 sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa/ spyi lo 2006 zla 6 tshes 6 nyin/

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/dpar skrun gsal bshad/rgya nag mi rigs kyis ches snga mo zhig nas bod 'di nyid rgya'i dbang sgrur 'og khyur mid gtang rgyu'i re ngan rab dang rim pa spel yod rung /dngos su spyi zhwo 1949 nas 'bo tshugs kyis mthar/ 1959 lor rgya dmar gzhung nas zhi bde snying 'jags su gnas pa'i chodas ldan gyi bod sa gang sar drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyis gtor bcom 'arngo ga gsum gyi sgo nas bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus nang byung ma myong ba'i khrag gi 'khor lo balha ra te/ bod mi rnams gzhis byes gnyis su gyes te skabs de nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar rol rgyu lta ci/ 'jig rten mi yul 'dir dmyal ba mun nag gi sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa myangs dgos byung ba red/rgya dmar gyis bod nang btsan 'dzul byas pa des cadad kyi chos shes dpal gsum dang / yul goms gshis lugs/ rang byung skye dngos rtsi shing dang / gter rigs khag ming gi lhag mar btang ste/ bod mi 'bum bcu gnyis lhag dus min rkyen 'das su btang ba dang shul lhag bod mi tshor rig gnas gsar brje zer ba sogs/ ming sna chodags

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/dpar skrun gsal bshad/rgya nag mi rigs kyis ches snga mo zhig nas bod 'di nyid rgya'i dbang sgyur 'og khyur mid gtang rgyu'i re ngan rab dang rim pa spel yod rung /dngos su spyi 'o 1949 nas 'go tshugs kyis mthar/ 1959 lor rgya dmar gzhung nas zhi bde lhing 'jags su gnas pa'i chos ldan gyi bod sa gang sar drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyes gtor bcom 'phrog gsum gyi sgo nas bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus nang byung ma myong ba'i khrag gi 'khor lo bsgor te/ bod mi rnams gzhis byes gnyis su gyes te skabs de nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar rol rgyu lta ci/ 'jig rten mi yul 'dir dmyal ba mun nag gi sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa myangs dgos byung ba red/rgya dmar gyes bod nang btsan 'dzul byas pa des bod kyi chos shes dpal gsum dang / yul goms gshis lugs/ rang byung skye dngos rtsi shing dang / gter rigs khag ming gi lhag mar btang ste/ bod mi 'bum bcu gnyis lhag dus min rkyen 'das su btang ba dang shul lhag bod mi chor rig gnas gsar brje zer ba sogs/ ming sna tshogs

bzhi/ dpar skrun gsal bshad/btags nas btson bcug dang do dam/ 'thab rtsod dang slob gso sogs kyis nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i lo zla de dus deng sang yang myong bzhin yod/de lta bu'i dka' sdug 'og gzhis lus bod mi ༅sa rgya gzhung gi btsan gnon drag rtsub la dpa' ma zhum par bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi la rgya dam por bzung nas 'thab rtsod rab dang rim par bstud nas spel yod/ rgyal gces dpa' bo da pa' mo rnams pa'i snying stobs dang dka' sdug ji ltar myangs tshul khag rgyal rabs 'o/ rgyus nang gnas rgyu tsam ma zad/ phyi rabs bod mi chodas shes rtogs yong slad dang / de bzhin bod nang gi yid skyo'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan dang / bod don thog rgyab skyor gnang mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs phan sku sa re/ bod nang gzhi rtsa'i smra brjod rang dbang tsam yang med stabs rang so so'i lo rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig thog 'god rgyu shin tu dka' bas/ skyid sdug mi 'dra ba brgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos myong dngos byung gi lo rgyus rnams/ dang thodag rang gi skad yig thodag gsog bskrub bya rgyu gal cher dmigs pa dang /lhag don mgon 1/ gang gi dbo ngas gzhi dgongs pa rlabs po che bskrubs thub pa tsam ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid bathe na pa'i 'o/ rgyus ce ma sgrig gi kha bskangs thub pa sku gas la dmigs te/ 'di ga chodags pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis

bzhi/ dpar skrun gsal bshad/btags nas brtsan bcug dang do dam/ 'thab rtsod dang sgob gso sogs kyis nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i lo zla de dus deng sang yang myong bzhin yod/de lta bu'i dka' sdug 'og gzhis lus bod mi tshos rgya gzhung gi btsan gnon drag rtsub la dpa' ma zhum par bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi la rgya dam por bzung nas 'thab rtsod rab dang rim par bstud nas spel yod/ rgyal gces dpa' bo da pa' mo rnams pa'i snying stobs dang dka' sdug ji ltar myangs tshul khag rgyal rabs lo rgyus nang gnas rgyu tsam ma zad/ phyi rabs bod mi tshos shes rtogs yong slad dang / de bzhin bod nang gi yid skyo'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan dang / bod don thog rgyab skyor gnang mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs phan sos re/ bod nang gzhi rtsa'i smra brjod rang dbang tsam yang med stabs rang so so'i lo rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig thog 'god rgyu shin tu dka' bas/ skyid sdug mi 'dra ba brgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos myong dngos byung gi lo rgyus rnams/ dang sgog rang gi skad yig thog gsog bskrub bya rgyu gal cher dmigs pa dang /lhag don mgon po gang gi dgongs gzhi dgongs pa rlabs po che bsgrubs thub pa tsam ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus rtsom sgrig gi kha bskangs thub pa sogs la dmigs te/ 'di ga tshogs pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ lnga /las gzhi 'di ched btsugs kyis 'go 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid bcon pa'i lo rgyus deb breng bcu gcig par skrun zin pa dang / da dung yang par skrun zhu 'char mang dag cig yod khongs nas da lan deb breng bcu gnyis pa bcon zur sgol ma chos 'dzoms kyi lo rgyus 〈〈rgan mo'i ma ba drang gtam 〉〉dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis/ bod phyi nang gnyis su gnas pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams kyis khong sogs gzhis lus bod mi tshos rgya nag gung khran tang gi btsan gnon gdug rtsub 'og bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad min gsal rtogs kyis bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du legs skyes gang thub 'jog thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/ da lan deb phreng bcu gnyis pa 'dir bod gzhung bde srung las khungs nas ched brjod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lhag par lo rgyus kyi bdag po dang rtsom sgrig pa/ 'di ga'i las byed yongs nas phyar gru ra/nyam 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun zin par bcos min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa'i tshogs gco/ka tsha ngag dbang 'od 'bar nas/spyi lo 2006 zla 6 tshes 10 nyin/

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ lnga /las gzhi 'di ched btsugs kyis 'go 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i 'o/ rgyus deb phreng bcu gcig par skrun zin pa dang / da dung yang par skrun zhu 'char mang dag cig yod khongs nas da lan deb phreng bcu gnyis pa btson zur sgrol ma chos 'dzoms kyi lo rgyus 〈du〈durgan tsho'i ma bcome drang gtam 〉〉dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis/ bod phyi nang gnyis su gnas pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams kyis khong sku gas gzhis lus lnga da mi tshos rgya nag gung khran tang gi btsan galha na gdug rtsub so/ga lnga da rgyal khab dang mi rigs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad min gsal rtogs kyis bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du legs skyes gang thub 'jog thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/ da lan deb phreng bcu gnyis pa 'dir bod gzhung bde srung las khungs nas ched brjod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lhag par lo rgyus kyi bdag po dang rtsom sgrig pa/ 'di ga'i las byed yongs nas phyar gru cha/nyam 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun zin par bcos min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa'i dza gas gtso/ka tsha ngag dbang cadad 'bar nas/spyi lo 2006 zla 6 tshes 10 nyin/

smar khams gling gi sa cha/ 1zadang rngos/smar khams glib gi sa cha/sngon goms thugs bskyed chu klung tshad med pas//bya dka' spyod pa'i sdong po sgyed sring rtser//tshogs gnyis smin pa'i 'bras du yongs dud pa//'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs ba gsol ba 'debs//zhes 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la gus pas btud de/skabs don gleng bar bya ba/ nga'i skyes yul ni/ rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma'i gdul zhing / mdo stod chu bzhi'i nang tshan 'bri chu dang / zla chu gnyis shar nub khag so sor rgyugs shing / sgang drug tu grags pa'i nang gses smar khams sgang dang sgang de'i sa'i thig le sgar thog tu grags pa de'i gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pa/ no man tan 'od zer spru 'a/ sku rim byon gyi gzhis dgon mkhas grub bye ba'i 1

smar khams gling gi sa cha/ 1dzodadzod ces/smar khams gling gi sa cha/sngon bo mas thugs bskyed chu klung tshad med pas//bya dka' spyod pa'i sdong po skyed sring rtser//tshogs gnyis smin pa'i 'bras gu yongs dud pa//'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs pa gsol ba 'debs//zhes 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la gus pas btud de/skabs don sleng bar bya ba/ nga'i skyes yul ni/ rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog phyag na padre'i gdul zhing / mdo stod chu bzhi'i nang tshan 'bri chu dang / zla chu gnyis shar nub khag so sor rgyugs shing / sgang drug tu grags pa'i nang gses smar khams sgang dang sgang de'i sa'i thig le sgar thog tu grags pa de'i gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pa/ no man han 'od zer spru lī sku rim byon gyi gzhis dgon mkhas grub bye ba'i 1

2 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/'byung gnas kun mkhyen 'od zer gling dgon gyi mchod gzhis su gtogs pa'i bu rdzong dang khyim gyi ming la grong 'bo tshang zhes brjod/gzhis dgon 'od zer bla brang chags yul nas smar khams mthil zhes yul grong rgya che tsam zhig yod par sngar gu bri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal nas sa der sgar btab pas/ sgar thog ces ming chags pa dang / de'i nye 'dabs spang ljongs thang chen du dmag rta rgyu ba dang mda' rtsed 'gran pas mda' rwa zhes ming sgogs/ smar khams yul de lung tshan bco brgyad du bgos te 'go byed dpon re bsko ba la dpon 'go bco brgyad ces grags/7rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i skabs gu bri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dang sde srid bsod nams rab brtan gnyis zung sprel gyis sde pa gtsang pa chams la phab nas/ gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po dbu brnyes rjes smar khams khul la bzhugs te/ khong gi gcung por dmigs bsal tha'i ji'i go ming bstsal/ dus phyis su'ang bod gzhung nas smar khams rdzong dpon shod drung dkyus mar bsko na'ang / lha mthong shan kha'i gru thon nas rim bzhi'i las zhwa las gos gyon rte ming la'ang smar khams tha'i ji'i zhes 'bod/sgar thog tu bod dmag mda' shog gcig gi dmag sgar gyi sgang phab yod pas yongs grags su mda' rdzong gnyis zhes ming btags yod/dmag sgar chags sa nas rta lam nyin phyed kyi sa stag lung zu khug 2

2 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'byung gnas kun mkhyen cadad zer gling dbo na gyi mchod gzhis su galta gas pa'i bu rdzong dang khyim gyi ming la grong 'bo/ tshang zhes brjod/gzhis dbo na cadad zer bla brang chags yul nas smar khams mthil zhes yul spyodang rgya che tsam zhig sku da par sngar gu bri bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal nas sa der sgar btab pas/ sgar thog ces ming chags pa dang / de'i nye 'dabs spang ljongs thang chen du dmag rta rgyu ba dang mda' rtsed 'gran pas mda' rwa zhes ming thodags/ smar khams yul de lung tshan bco brgyad du bgos te 'go byed dpon re bsko ba la dngo na 'go bco brgyad ces grags/7rgyal maḥsteg lnga pa chen po'i skabs gu shri bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal dang sde srid bsod nams rab brtan gnyis zung sbrel gyis sde pa gtsang pa chams la phab nas/ gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po dbu brnyes rjes smar khams khul la bzhugs te/ kho nga gi gcung wa ra dmigs bsal tha'i ji'i go ming bstsal/ dus phyis su'ang bod gzhung nas smar khams rdzong dpon shodad drung dkyus mar bsko na'ang / lha mthe nga shan kha'i gru thon nas rim bzhi'i las zhwa las thosnes khyodan te ming la'ang smar khams tha'i ji'i zhes 'ango da/sgar thodag tu wa da dmag mda' shodag gcig gi dmag sgar gyi sgangari phab yod pas yongs grags su mda' rdzong gnyis zhes ming btags sku da/dmag sgar chags sa nas rta lam nyin phyed kyi sa stag lung chu khug 2

smar khams gling gi sa cha/ 3nas 'brog gog bar shod lung / rtogs khang sdings/ lcags thag sdings/la nag sgang bcas khul de rnams rtswa chu 'dzoms shing / rim pas gnas sgang sdings dang / rwa rig phug sogs sdod khul de rnams mi phyugs 'phel che bas/ dus skabs ji yin cha ma rtogs kyang smar khams sgar the ga jo nga gi ya gyal zhig tu gyur te bu rdzong zhes ming thogs/ bu rdzong gi dud tshang rnams sa ma 'a〈snag dang / cadad zer bla brang gi mchodad gzhis yin pas gzhung khral rgyug mi dasgotshes par brten/ sgar thog sgyu nga kho ngas kyi gzhung khral rgyug mkhan chosas/ soged zer bla brang gi mi ser rnams khral rgyug mi dgothos par/za nyal brgyab nas rkang mthil la spru skye yi red zer shod mkhan yang ye da/nga'i khyim tshang la sa zhing khag lnga tsam yod la bu rdzong dud tshang bcu grangs gnyis kyi stod du khang pa gsum thog 'bur thon du yod stabs hrong 'go tshang zhes brjod kyang / skyes ma rin chen lha mo chung dus nas chodas la dad smadas che zhing / sems pa bzang ba/ galta nga sngo da che ba bcas la brten/dud tshang mi phyugs dar zhing lam 'aspyod che ba byung / skyes ma 'o/ 79 so/na skabs dung so/ skyes pa yul du grags/ cadad zer dathodan gyi bla grwa rnams kyis rten 'byung tshul du hrong 'go tshang zhes pa lha mo tshang zhes ming bsgrur/spyir smar khams khul de sgang sa phal mosna cher nags tshal gyi sman ljongs dang / dri bsung ldang ba'i me tog rnam par bkra ba'i rtswa thang spel 3

smar khams sping gi sa cha/ nas 'brog gog bar shod lung / rtogs khang sdings/ lcags thag sdings/la nag sgang bcas khul de rnams rtswa chu 'dzoms shing / rim pas gnas sgang sdings dang / rwa rig phug sogs sdod khul de rnams mi phyugs 'phel che bas/ dus skabs ji yin cha ma rtogs kyang smar khams sgar sgog rdzong gi ya gyal zhig tu gyur te bu rdzong zhes ming thogs/ bu rdzong gi dud tshang rnams sa ma 'brog dang / 'od zer bla brang gi mchod gzhis yin pas gzhung khral rgyug mi dgos par brten/ sgar thog rdzong khongs kyi gzhung khral rgyug mkhan chos/ 'od zer bla brang gi mi ser rnams khral rgyug mi dgos par/za nyal brgyab nas rkang mthil la spu skye yi red zer god mkhan yang yod/nga'i khyim tshang la sa zhing khag lnga tsam yod la bu rdzong dud tshang bcu grangs gnyis kyi stod du khang pa gsum thog 'bur thon du yod stabs grong 'go tshang zhes brjod kyang / skyes ma rin chen lha mo chung dus nas chos la dad mos che zhing / sems pa bzang ba/ gtong phod che ba bcas la brten/dud tshang mi phyugs dar zhing lam 'gro che ba byung / skyes ma lo 79 son skabs dung so skyes pa yul du grags/ 'od zer dgon gyi bla grwa rnams kyis rten 'byung tshul du grong 'go tshang zhes pa lha mo tshang zhes ming bsgyur/spyir smar khams khyal de sgang sa phal mo cher nags tshal gyi sman ljongs dang / dri bsung ldang ba'i me tog rnam par bkra ba'i rtswa thang spel 3

༄ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/ma'i tshul du yod/ nags ri dang / spang gi ri de dag kyang ha cang mtho la g.yang gzar can min pas gyen thur du bgrod par dka' ba'i ngal ba de tsam mi yong / shang shang dal gyes rgyugs pa'i zu rgyun che zung sna tshogs kun nas 'babs shing / zhing sa rnams gshin la phal mo che sad kyi nyen kha med/'brog sa'i rtswa thang rnams kyang yangs shing rtswa kha bzang bas/ sgo phyugs sems can 'phel che la/ sgang sa'i shar nub kyi rong sa rnams su ston 'bras zengs gnyis re smin cing / de dag tu rgun 'brum dkar nag dang li/ ku shu/ star kha/ kham bu/ se 'bru mngar skyur sogs shing 'bras rigs mang ba bcas/ mdor na/ yul gyi bkod pa legs shing mdzes la/gro nas sran gsum sogs 'bru rigs sne kha mang / sha mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bal rtsi dkar nag rtsa che'i sman rigs/ lcags gter/ shing sna rigs thon khungs gzhan las lhag pa'i dbang gis smar zhes pa rin chen dang gnyis la go zhing legs pa'i dodan la gnas pa smar khams zhes grags/sngar bod sil bu'i skabs kyi gling rje ge sar rgyal po sku dus su/smar khams 'di bzhin gling chung rgyud 'bum pa'i mnga' 'bangs 'khrul bral zhig yin pa gna' gtam la yond pa ma zad/ kha rgyun du smar khams gling yul khra mo 'am gling gi sa cha zhes brjod/4

4 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ma'i tshul du yod/ nags ri dang / spang gi ri de dag kyang ha cang masgo la g.yang gzar can min pas gyen thur du bgrod par dka' ba'i ngal ba de tsam mi yong / shang shang dal gyis rgyugs pa'i chu rgyun che chung sna chodags kun nas 'babs shing / zhing sa rnams gshin la phal mo che sad kyi nyen kha med/'brog sa'i rtswa thang rnams kyang yangs shing rtswa kha bzang bas/ sgo phyugs sems can 'phel che la/ sgang sa'i shar nub kyi mo nga sa rnams su ston 'bras thengs gnyis re smin cing / de dag tu rgun 'byum dkar nag dang li/ ku shu/ star kha/ kham bu/ se 'byu mngar skyur sogs shing 'bras rigs mang ba bcas/ mdor na/ yul gyi bkod pa legs shing mdzes la/gro nas sran gsum sogs 'bru rigs sne kha mang / sha mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bal rtsi dkar nag rtsa che'i sman rigs/ lcags gter/ shing sna rigs thon khungs gzhan las lhag pa'i dbang gis smar zhes pa rin chen dang gnyis la bosgo zhing legs pa'i the na la gnas pa smar khams zhes grags/sngar bod sil bu'i skabs kyi gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sku dus su/smar khams 'di bzhin gling chung rgyud 'bum pa'i mnga' 'bangs 'khrul bral zhig yin pa gna' gtam la sku da pa ma zad/ kha rgyun du smar khams gling yul khra mo 'am gling gi sa cha zhes brdzod/4

smar khams rming gi sa cha/ 5nga'i khyim tshang gi thag nyer a myes 'das lung zer ba'i rdza ri skyes bo'i phrag pa gnyis dang lto ba'i gzugs dang 'dra ba shar la gtad cing / nub phyogs su 'das lung gnya' zhes pa'i ri rtswa dang shing nags kyis khyab pa/ lho phyogs su dpa' chen rdzong zhes pa zhig yod/ dpa' chen rdzong de sku sger yig tshang gi bdag 'dzin gnang ba dang de'i rdzong dpon la go ba bla gnyer zhes mi rnams kyis 'ange da/ a myes 'das lung sku sger yig tshang nas dbyar dzadas dgun cho sa lo gsar bcas thengs gsum gso/la/ ge sar dgra 'dul la phebs dus a myes kyis ngus pas ge sar gyis ngas khyed galhanal bar btang chodag ces ri de gasku la ched dpa' chen sgyu nga brtsigs zhes rgan rabs rnams kyis gleng /a myes ri gsham gyi byang du sa ma rmad g.yu lung gsum mdor ngos 'dzin pa deng dus dngul lung du 'bod par stag ma'i me tog tshon sna lnga ldan shing gis khyab pa'i ri zhig yod/ nga chung ngu'i skabs kyi dbyar kha'i nyin zhig a myes kyi ri sged dam/ 'das lung phrag pa zhes pa'i spang thodag nga tsho phyug rdzi ba mi lnga phyug bzhi brgya tsam ded nas ri ldebs bkrams te bzhag skabs dngul lung thod kyi stag ma dang ber to/ su dkar su nag thang shing bcas kyi shing nags su bdag med kyi dud 'gro gzugs dbyibs dang skad mdzo mo 'dra bar spru mdog dkar por dmar thig sna tshogs yod pa/ rwa 5

smar khams rming gi sa cha/ 5nga'i khyim tshang gi thag nyer a byes 'das lung zer ba'i rdza ri skyes bo'i phrag pa gnyis dang lto ba'i gzugs dang 'dra ba shar la gtad cing / nub phyogs su 'das lung gnya' zhes pa'i ri rtswa dang shing nags kyis khyab pa/ lto phyogs su dpa' chen rdzong zhes pa zhig yod/ dpa' chen rdzong de sku sger yig tshang gi bdag 'dzin gnang ba dang de'i rdzong dpon la go ba bla gnyer zhes mi rnams kyis 'bod/ a byes 'das lung sku sger yig tshang nas dbyar chos dgun chos lo gsar bcas thengs gsum gsol/ ge sar dgra 'dul la phebs dus a byes kyis ngus pas ge sar gyis ngas khyed gso/la bar btang chog ces ri de gsol ched dpa' chen rdzong brtsigs zhes rgan rabs rnams kyis gleng /a myes ri gsham gyi byang du sa ma rmad g.yu lung gsum mdor ngos 'dzin pa deng dus dngul lung du 'bod par stag ma'i me tog tshon sna lnga ldan shing gis khyab pa'i ri zhig yod/ nga chung ngu'i skabs kyi dbyar kha'i nyin zhig a byes kyi ri sked dam/ 'das lung phrag pa zhes pa'i spang bog nga tshor phyug rdzi ba mi lnga phyug bzhi brgya tsam ded nas ri sdebs bkrams te bzhag skabs dngul lung thod kyi stag ma dang ber to/ su dkar su nag thang shing bcas kyi shing nags su bdag med kyi dud 'gro gzugs dbyibs dang skad mdzo mo 'dra bar spu mdog dkar por dmar thig sna tshogs yod pa/ ra 5

snyo rgan lngarware ma bce sa drang gtam/co dang / rkang lag gi sug mthil/ mig rtsa/ mchu bcas dmar ba/ mjug ma med pa zhig rtsa za bzhin phyugs dang nye bar 'gyor/ phyugs rdzi bas dud 'gro'i dkyil ded skabs phyugs dang mnyam nyin rtswa bzas te sdod kyang dgong dro stag ma'i gseb tu shor/nga'i lung pa ra/sa rgyang mi ring ba'i sa dngul lung ge sar gyi 'khrungs khang yin pa'i kha sgrung du ma shod rgyun yod/ de yang ma 'gog bza' lha mor rdzo ru 'khrungs rgyu yod pa a khu khro thung gis shes te phra dog ngan sems kyis ma 'gog bza' lha mo sa ma rmad g.yu lung gsum mdor phud/ sa cha de ni lha 'dre yang 'tshang gas 'dzoms pa'i shin tu skyid pa zhig yin rkyen lha dang lha ma yin gyis ge sar yin pa shes te mi yul nas gdan drang na/ gling gi rgyal sa khro thung gi bu la 'thob pa'i re ba 'char/ nyin zhig sa de gar ge sar grosgod thum nang 'khrungs pa/ lha rnams kyis nam mkhar bkyag skabs a khu spyi dawa na gyis ma ne+e ne+e la gso/la ba btab ste ge sar bar mi yul du nag wa bdud kyi kha gnon dang mgo nag mi yi dpung gnyen la ched du gyon pas lha yul du gdan drang ma bcugasngon ge sar 'khrungs yul red ces phyis su yang khang pa zhig ral zhig dang / de'i phar tsam na ge sar 'khrungs pa dang ma brag srin zhig la ge sar gyi 'gran zla bdud phrug cig skyes pa ge sar gyis dgung grangs bdun 6

6 gen mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/co dang / rkang lag gi sug mthil/ mig rtsa/ mchu bcas dmar ba/ mjug ma med pa zhig rtsa za bzhin phyugs dang nye bar 'byor/ phyugs rdzi bas dud 'gro'i dkyil ded skabs phyugs dang mnyam nyin rtswa bzas te sdod kyang dgong dro stag ma'i gseb tu shor/nga'i lung pa ras rgyang mi ring ba'i sa dngul lung ge sar gye 'khrungs khang yin pa'i kha skrung du ma shod rgyun yod/ de yang ma 'gog bza' lha mor jo ru 'khrungs rgyu yod pa a khu khro thung gis shes te phra dog ngan sems kyis ma 'gog bza' lha mo sa ma rmad g.yu lung gsum mdor phud/ sa cha de ni lha 'dre yang 'tshang gas 'dzoms pa'i shin tu skyid pa zhig yin rkyen lha dang lha ma yin gyis ge sar yin pa shes te mi yul nas gdan drang na/ gling gi rgyal sa khro thung gi bu la 'thob pa'i re ba 'char/ nyin zhig sa de gar ge sar grod thum nang 'khrungs pa/ lha rnams kyis nam mkhar bkyag skabs a khu spyi dpon gyis ma ne+e ne+e la gsonal ba btab ste ge sar bar mi yul du nag po bdud kyi kha gnon dang mgo nag mi yi dpung gnyen la ched du byon pas lha yul du gdan drang ma bcugasngon ge sar 'khrungs yul red ces phyim su yang khang pa zhig ral zhig dang / de'i phar tsam na ge sar 'khrungs pa dang ma brag srin zhig la ge sar gyi 'gran zla bdud phrug cig skyes pa ge sar gyes dgung grangs bdun 6

8 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/gahaṃs pa/rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/bod kyi lung pa gzhan dang 'dra bar nga'i lung par rgan pas gzhon par byams skyodang dang gasnyadan pas rgan par brtsi 'jo ga che/ pha mas phrug gu chung nas gso skyong byed pa smos med khar/ gnyen sgrig byed pa'i dus la slebs kyang pha ma'i bka' bzhin mdun ༷ gas btsal dbostes pa las rang mo sa kyis gnyen sgrig byas na pha ma'i bka' la ma brtsis pa dang / mi rgyud chud jo sa par brtsi/ de las dog ste bu mo rnams ni gnas la 'bo rgyur 'tsher snang chen wa byed/ nga'i sru mo zhig kyang mna' mar ster khar dzadas nas lha sar gnas bcas/ lha sa ni nga tshotsware pha yul mi rnams kyi sems kyi dag zhing gcig pu dang / lha sa'i jo bo yid bzhin nor bu dang gdan sa se 'bras dge gsum mjal na phyi ma mi lus 'thosnab rgyur yid ches byed/ chung nas grogs mo dang mnyam du dngos dang rtog btags kyi lha sa'i gnas tshul du ma zhig gleng res byed pa dang rang nyid kyi sems dbus su yul de 'dra zhig 8

8 gan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/gnyes pa/thi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zheng lha sa/bod kyi lung pa gzhan dang 'dra bar nga'i lung par rgan pas gzhon par byams skyong dang gzhon pas rgan par brtsi 'jog che/ pha mas phrug gu zung nas gso skyong byed pa spos med khar/ gnyen sgrig byed pa'i dus la slebs kyang pha ma'i bka' bzhin mdun grogs btsal dgos pa las rang mos kyis gnyen sgrig byas na pha ma'i bka' la ma brtsis pa dang / mi rgyud chud zos par brtsi/ de las ldog ste bu mo rnams ni gnas la 'gro rgyur 'tsher snang chen po byed/ nga'i sru mo zhig kyang mna' mar ster khar bros nas lha sar gnas bcas/ lha sa ni nga tsho'i pha yul mi rnams kyi sems kyi dag zhing gcig pu dang / lha sa'i jo bo yid bzhin nor bu dang gdan sa se 'bras dge gsum mjal na phyi ma mi lus 'thob rgyur yid ches byed/ chung nas grogs mo dang mnyam du dngos dang rtog btags kyi lha sa'i gnas tshul du ma zhig gleng res byed pa dang rang nyid kyi sems dbus su yul de 'dra zhig 8

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 9la spebs na ci ma rung / snyam pa'i re smon mtshan gyi rmi lam tshun la'ang skyes/thengs shig sa ga zla ba'i skabs la ye shes chos 'dzoms dang / bkra g.yang / nga cho gsum mkhan pa lung dgon par phyin te jo bo yid bzhin nor bu mjal bar lha sar 'gro thub pa bya rgyu'i mna' skyel dam bca' bzhag pa yin/ der a ma dang nga tsho brag g.yab rtogs ldan rin po che'i sku mdun nas lam rim gsung chos zhus te grub rjes khas len zhig zhu dgos pa ngas chang mi 'thung ba dang / gcen mo rgan pas srog mi gcod pa/ gcen mon 'bring bas phyi nas ma byin par mi len pa'i dam bca' bzhag pas/ rin po nache bzhad tshan bzhad nas a lho ga (brag g.yab pa'i yul skad phru gu zhes pa'i don/)khyedad de 'dra'i mgo bo bde ba la ang zhes gsungs/nga lo bcu gsum la spebs skabs grogs mo chos 'dzoms dang /bkra g.yang / gnas la sbyin pa'i ye shes chos 'dzoms bcas lha sar gsang bros bya rgyu dang / phan tshun sa thag cung ring yang kha dgon dgon gyi gyang hrul zhig tu sgo rengs byi'us skad brgyag dus 'dzoms rgyu byas/ ngas gla pags kyi rtsam khug nang gro khal gcig dang / mar srang bcu tsam/ phyu ra cung / ltag 'dzar g.yu cong sked par bsdams/ sle'u gcig phyu pa gnyis rtseg nas gyon/ thab tshang nang rtsam pa blang bar phyin pas rje btsun 9

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 9la slebs na ci ma rung / snyam pa'i re smon mtshan gyi rmi lam tshun la'ang skyes/thengs shig sa ga zla ba'i skabs la ye shes chodas 'alnga mas dang / bkra g.yang / nga tsho gsum mkhan pa lung dgon par phyin te jo wa yid bzhin ce ra bu mjal bar lha sar 'gro thub pa bya rgyu'i mna' skyel dam bca' bzhag pa yin/ der a ma dang nga tsho brag g.yab rtogs ldan rin po che'i sku mdun nas lam rim gsung chodas zhus te grub rjes khas len zhig zhu dbo sa pa ngas chang mi 'thung ba dang / gcen mo rgan pas 10ga mi gce da pa/ gcen mosna 'bring bas phyi nas ma byin par mi len pa'i dam bca' bzhag pas/ rin sngo che bzhad 31 bzhad nas a ྅tog (brag g.yab pa'i yul skad phru gu zhes pa'i don/)khyedad de 'dra'i maswo bo bde ba la ang zhes gsungs/nga 'o/ bcu gsum la slebs skabs grogs mo chodas 'dzodams dang /bkra g.yang / gnas la sbyin pa'i ye shes chodas 'alngarams bcas lha sar gsang bros bya rgyu dang / phan tshun sa thag cung ring yang kha dgon dgon gyi gyang hrul zhig tu tho rengs byi'us skad brgyag dus 'dzoms rgyu byas/ ngas gla pags kyi rtsam khug nang hro khal gcig dang / mar srang bcu tsam/ phyu ra cung / ltag 'dzar g.yu cong sked par bsdams/ sle'u gcig phyu pa gnyis rtseg nas rgyadan/ thab tshang nang rtsam pa blang bar phyin pas rje btsun 9

10 rgan mo'i ma bcetes drang gtam/sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gyi mdun du phul ba'i rag kong chen po'i mar me'i 'od kyis khang pa de nyin ltar gsal bas 'khyer ma thub/lnga rengs khyim nas gsang 〈snan byas te 〈snags motho bkra g.yang gi khyim gyi lha dal bur rdung bzhin stod seng rmes bltas pas 'dodags khyi nag po chen wa zhig gis 'ung / 'ung / zhes 'ab/ bkra g.yang gi gcen wa phyu pa sbo lhag mar sgo dbye ru yong / nga bros te cung rgyang ring pa'i ye shes chos 'dzodams skad gto/nga bar 'gro skabs ye shes chodas 'alnga mas kyi a ma de lnga ga khar thon 'dug pa bya thabs ma rnyed/ de nas dgon pa'i gyang srul du phyin pas chos 'dzoms kyis rtsam pa khug ma chung ngu gang 'khyer nas skug 'dugang gnyis rong chen la'i shing nags brgyud/ tsha rting la nga'i a ma'i lung pa rdzi pa ru bar 'gyor/ sprun mched rnams kyis nga ngo shes kyi red snyam ste/shing nags dkyil gab nas 'grul thag gro da mtshams la chen ldebs kyi shing nags stug po'i khrodad thig skud bskyangs pa lta bu'i lam chung ded nas bskyodad ring / snang byed gter dal bur nub phyogs mal du gzims shing / sa gzhi chen wa ra mun pa'i gosnas nag rim gyis bkab/ shing nags snyug pas yal ga'i seng nas zla casnad kyi dkar thig re tsam las mi gsal bar lam chung skya mo rim gyis mi mngon la / de sngon shing nags de'i dkyil stag sku da ces the sa cadang bas khyi zhig chu la ma thar ba bzhin nga gnyis phar rgyug 10

1༷ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/sgol ma'i sku brnyan gyi mdun du phul ba'i rag kong chen po'i mar me'i 'od kyis khang pa de nyin ltar gsal bas 'khyer ma thub/tho rengs khyim nas gsang thon byas te grogs mo bkra g.yang gi khyim gyi sgo dal bur rdung bzhin sgo seng nas bltas pas 'dogs khyi nag po chen po zhig gis 'ung / 'ung / zhes 'ab/ bkra g.yang gi gcen po phyu pa sgo lhug mar sgo dbye ru yong / nga bros te cung rgyang ring pa'i ye shes chos 'dzoms skad gtong bar 'gro skabs ye shes chos 'dzoms kyi a ma de thog khar thon 'dug pa bya thabs ma rnyed/ de nas dgon pa'i gyang drul du phyin pas chos 'dzoms kyis rtsam pa khug ma chung ngu gang 'khyer nas sgug 'dugang gnyis rong chen la'i shing nags brgyud/ tsha rting la nga'i a ma'i lung pa rdzi pa ru bar 'byor/ spun mched rnams kyis nga ngo shes kyi red snyam ste/shing nags dkyil gab nas 'grul thag chod mtshams la chen sdebs kyi shing nags stug po'i khrod thig skud bskyangs pa lta bu'i lam chung ded nas bskyod ring / snang byed gter dal bur nub phyogs mal du gzims shing / sa gzhi chen por mun pa'i gos nag rim gyes bkab/ shing nags snyug pas yal ga'i seng nas zla 'od kyi dkar thig re tsam las mi gsal bar lam chung skya mo rim gyis mi mngon la 1 de sdon shing nags de'i dkyil stag yod ces thos myong bas khyi zhig chu la ma thar ba bzhin nga gnyis phar rgyug 10

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 11tshur rgyug lam btsal yang ma rnyed pas zhed de gnyis ka ngu bzhin/ de nas ltag lo ga gis la rtser 'dzegs skabs/ char shugs chen babs te lus mo ngas brlan pas thang shing chen po zhig gi 'o/ga gab ste spags shig bzas te nyal/sang nyin phyu pa nyi mar skam nas yang bskyar lha sa'i lam ded de rdzi ba ru bar spebs skabs skam 'phror lus pa'i phyu pa skam zhing / lam gzhan gye ri mtho po zhig 'dzegs te ri rtse nas lha sar 'gro sa'i lam la blta skabs grong gi sde dang g.yu yi gzhongs pa'i bang rim brtsegs pa lta bu'i skas zhing mthong / de nas spang gzhongs chen po zhig tu skad gsang mthon pos rdzi glu gtong bzhin lug khyu ded pa'i rdzi bo zhig 'ongs te/ gang du 'gro 'am/la 'og gi khyim der 'gro zhes brjod/ lha sar bros mi yin na thar gyi ma red ces brjod kyang nga gnyis mu mthud lam du zhugs te mun rub pa dang shing nags dkyil mal bcas/sang nyin zhe gas pa nam ma langs tsam la thon skabs dom nag gnyis thug pas tshur bros nas ri khug cig tu yib/ dom nag de gnyis shing nags dkyil phyin yang nga gnyis gar 'gro 'di 'gro med cing rtsam pa yang zad/ khyim du log par ngo tshas ma bzod pas rdzi pa ru ba'i phyogs nas mi zhig gis bzung ste khyim du 'khrid na snyam ste ltag log brgyab nas/ lam 11

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 11tshur rgyug lam btsal yang ma rnyed pas zhed de gnyis ka ngu bzhin/ de nas ltag sku/ga gis la rtser 'dzegs skabs/ char shugs chen babs te lus sku/ngas brlan pas thang shing chen 〈sna zhig gi soteg gab ste spags shig bzas te nyal/sang nyin phyu pa nyi mar skam nas yang bskyar lha sa'i lam ded de rdzi ba ru bar slebs skabs skam 'phredar lus pa'i phyu pa skam zhing / lam gzhan gyi ri mtho po zhig 'dzegs te ri rtse nas lha sar 'gro sa'i lam la blta skabs grong gi sde dang g.yu yi gzhongs pa'i bang rim brtsegs pa lta bu'i skas zhing mthong / de nas spang gzhongs chen po zhig tu skad gsang mthon pos rdzi glu gtong bzhin lug khyu ded pa'i rdzi bo zhig 'ongs te/ gang du 'ahro 'am/la cadag gi khyim der 'ahro zhes brdzod/ lha sar bros mi yin na thar gyi ma red ces brjod kyang nga gnyis mu mthud lam du zhugs te mun rub pa dang shing nags dkyil mal bcas/sang nyin r+shastegs pa nam ma langs tsam la thesgon skabs dodam nag gnyis thug pas tshur bros nas ri khug cig tu yib/ dom nag de gnyis shing nags dkyil phyin yang nga gnyis gar 'gro 'di 'gro med cing rtsam pa yang zad/ khyim du log par ngo tshas ma bzod pas rdzi pa ru ba'i phyogs nas mi zhig gis bzung ste khyim du 'khrid na snyam ste ltag 'o/ga brgyab nas/ lam 11

12 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/chen zhig tu phyu pa skam nas nyal ma phred la bsdad/ mi rgan zhig yong ste gang du 'gro 'am zer/ ngas lha sar 'gro gi yin zhes bshad/ mi rgan des khyed mkhur tshos dmar ba der bltas na rin chen lha mo'i bu mo yin 'dra zhes/ mar phyin te a zhang gi bu a pho yar 'phel 'khrid nas slebs/ yar 'phel gyis nga la khyed kyi a mas bu mo thon 'dug pas bkag rogs gyis/zhes lan bskur byung zhes bshad de ru bar khrid/yar 'phel gye a mas sbra gur nang nga la zas sgod skabs mtha' skor sbra nag gis bskor ba'i ru 'dzoms rgyag sa'i dbus nas lus la na bza' ser po mnabs pa'i ser mo ba zhig yong / khong ni nga'i a zhang mtshan dngos rdzi pa tshang gi rgan ngag dbang chos grags sam/ ngas ming bsdus a mgon bla ma zhes 'bod pa khong red/ lam seng nga sbra nag gi zur zhig tu yib pas nga'i grogs mo chos 'dzoms la a mgon bla mas khyed sprang 'khyams phyin pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i bu mo yang khrid nas ci byed ces tshig rtsub smras/ yar 'phel gyi a mas nga gnyis la gshe gshe ma gtong / bu mo zhed nas sbra gur nang yib bo/ zhes nga mar bton/sang nyin a mgon bla ma dang rgan chos lu gnyis rta bzhon zhing / nga dang grogs mo chos 'dzoms la sdug gtong ched mar ltang bsgur nas lung dkar la brga' nas 'khrid pas dka' ngal ha cang chen po byung / maban 12

12 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/chen zhig tu phyu pa skam nas nyal ma phred la bsdad/ mi rgan zhig yong ste gang du 'gro 'am zer/ ngas lha sar 'gro gi yin zhes bshad/ mi rgan des khyed mkhur tshos dmar ba der bltas na rin chen lha mo'i bu mo yin 'dra zhes/ mar phyin te a zhang gi bu a 'o/ yar 'phel 'khrid nas slebs/ yar 'phel gyis nga la khyed kyi a mas bu mo thon 'dug pas bkag mo gas gyis/zhes lan bskur byung zhes bshad de ru bar khrid/yar 'phel gyi a mas sbra gur nang nga la zas sprodad skabs mtha' skor sbra nag gis bskor ba'iriru 'dzoms rgyag sa'i dbus nas lus la na bza' ser sngo mnabs pa'i ser mo ba zhig sku nga / khong ni nga'i a zhang mtshan dngos rdzi pa tshang gi rgan ngag dbang chodzis grags sam/ ngas ming bsdus a mgon bla ma zhes 'bod pa khong red/ lam seng nga sbra nag gi zur zhig tu yib pas nga'i sku gas mo/ chos 'a17mas la a mthodan bla mas khyed sprang 'khyams phyin pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i bu mo yang khrid nas ci byed ces tshig rtsub smras/ yar 'phel gyi a mas nga gnyis la gshe gshe ma gto/nga / bu mo zhed nas sbra gur nang yib ngo / zhes nga mar blta na/sang nyin a mgon bla ma dang rgan chos lu gnyis rta bzhon zhing / nga dang grogs mo chos 'dzoms la sdug gtong ched mar ltang bskur nas lung dkar la brgal nas 'khrid pas dka' ngal ha cang chen po byung // mal/ na 12

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 13pa lung dgon pa'i zu mig 'gram 'byor skabs grwa pa rnams tshogs grol ba dang dus khel bas/ grwa pa kha cig gis/ a mgon bla ma dang rgan chos lur dka' e thal/ zhes 'tshams 'dri zhus/ rgan chos lus dka' ma byung /kho gnyis lha sa nas 'byor bas byin rlabs yod brjod/ grwa pa rnams kyes nga gnyis la lha sa'i lam bar dka' e thal/ lha sa'i byin rlabs sgod dang /zhes ku re byed/ ngas am phrag nas phyur ba sprad pas bu mo khyed dran rgyu rgod pa la zhes bzhad bgad zeg ger rim pas dgon nang 'dzul/a dgon bla mas grogs mo chos 'dzoms spun mched grwa pa zhig la rtsis sprad pa dang / nga tsho'i lung par 'gro ba'i mi zhig la nga 'khrid yong chog ces lan bskur/ dgong mo de sru mo rab byung ma ku yon lha mo'i khyim du nyal te zhogs pa a mgon bla ma'i shag tu yong nas thon rtsis skabs thag ring nas nga'i khyim gyi rta'i dril brda thos/ sru mor khyim gyi rta'i dril bu grags kyi 'dug brjod de rdo skas babs pas gcen mo mag pas rta gnyes khrid nas rngul nag 'dzub 'tshub 'byor/ a kong bla mas 'da' dgong bsu bar ma yong zhes lan bskur yod/ yong nas ci byed/ bu mo ngas 'khrid yong gi red ces bshad/ a mas u tshugs kyis bsu bar btang byung zhes mag pas rngul nag 'phyi bzhin brjod/ de nas nga dang gcen mo'i mag pa rta re bzhon nas sngon du bskyod/ chos 'dzoms ri gsham gye lam khrung brgyud rang 13

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 13pa lung dgon pa'i chu mig 'gram 'byor skabs grwa pa rnams chodags bo la ba dang dus khel bas/ grwa pa kha cig gis/ a mabo na bla ma dang rgan chodas lur dka' e thal/ zhes 'tshams 'dri zhus/ rgan chodas lus dka' ma byung /kho gnyis lha sa nas 'byedar bas byin rlabs sku da brtsodad/ grwa pa rnams kyis nga gnyis la lha sa'i lam bar dka' e thal/ lha sa'i byin rlabs sprodad dang /zhes ku re byed/ ngas am phrag nas phyur ba sprad pas bu mo khyed dran rgyu rgod pa la zhes bzhad bgad theg ger rim pas dgon nang 'dzul/a dasku na bla mas lhasnags mo chodas 'arngesams spun mched grwa pa zhig la rtsis sprad pa dang / nga tsho'i lung par 'gro ba'i mi zhig la nga 'khrid yong chog ces lan bskur/ dgong mo de sru mo rab byung ma ku yodan lha mo'i khyim du nyal te zhogs pa a mgon bla ma'i shag tu sku nga nas sngo na rtsis skabs thag ring nas nga'i khyim gyi rta'i dril brda thos/ sru mor khyim gyi rta'i dril bu grags kyi 'dug bathegad de rdo skas babs pas gcen mo'i mag pas rta gnyes khrid nas rngul nag 'tshub 'tshub 'byor/ a kong bla mas 'da' dgong bsu bar ma yong zhes lan bskur yod/ yong nas ci byed/ bu mo ngas 'khrid yong gi red ces bshad/ a mas ༷/ tshugs kyis bsu bar btang byung zhes mag pas rngul nag 'phyi bzhin brdzod/ de nas nga dang gcen mo'i mag pa rta re bzhon nas spon du bskyod/ chos 'dzoms ri gsham gyi lam chung brgyud rang 13

14 rgan mo'i ma bca sa drang gtam/khyim gyi phyogs la bskyo da pa ngas mig gis skyel ma byas/nga tsho khyim du 'gyor skabs a ma mdzo mo bzho bzhin pa nas yar langs bzhin bu mo / mu ge'i dka' ngal 'phrad e thal/ a kong bla ma ci 'dra byas nas thug gam zhes bshad/ ngas a mar 'awa ga sar a 'o/ yar 'phel mdun phyin pas mu ge'i dka' ngal gang yang 'phrad ma byung zhes zer/nga'i pa pha mig chu 'chor grabs ngang khyed tsho na chung dran rgyu rgod pa la ang /gtang dang zer na/ gtang gi red ces brjod/de'i phyi lor yang tshong pa dang gnas sgor ba du ma zhig lha sar 'gro bzhin pa ngas 〈snags mo 'ga' dang / yang bskyar ༷ sa gyol 'asgru ba'i gra sgrig thengs gnyis byas pas pha mas/ khyim du gro sa bsdur byas te lha sar yod pa'i sru mo'i bu gcig pu rab tu byung bas phrug tshab bu mo gcig gtang shog ces sru mo sa yi ge 'gyor ba dang / sgrol chodas 'gro 'dod pa gnyis stabs 'grig kyang / bzang ngan ji yodang lha bla mar thugs rtags 'bul rgyu byas/sang nyin a mas nga mkhan pa lung dgon du 'khrid de bzhin ras sgor zhing rgyas la/ spyan dkyus ring ba/ sku gzugs che zhing dbu skra'i mtshams dkar tsam sku da pa'i rgan khri par sku phyag btsal/ ngas kyang a ma'i gazlothogs nas sku phyag btsal/ de nas a mas lus ha cang gus pa'i 〈sna nas dkar gtsang gi mjal dar zhig phul te skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ rgan khri 14

15 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khyim gyi phyogs la bskyod pa ngas mig gis skyel ma byas/nga tsho khyim du 'byor skabs a ma mdzo mo bzho bzhin pa nas yar langs bzhin bu mo/ mu ge'i dka' ngal 'phrad e thal/ a kong bla ma ci 'dra byas nas thug gam zhes bshad/ ngas a mar 'brog sar a pho yar 'phel mdun phyin pas mu ge'i dka' ngal gang yang 'phrad ma byung zhes zer/nga'i pa pha mig chu 'chor grabs ngang khyed tsho na chung dran rgyu rgod pa la ang /gtang dang zer na/ gtang gi red ces brjod/de'i phyi lor yang tshong pa dang gnas sgor ba du ma zhig lha sar 'gro bzhin pa ngas grogs mo 'ga' dang / yang bskyar bros byol 'gro ba'i gra sgrig zengs gnyis byas pas pha mas/ khyim du gros bsdur byas te lha sar yod pa'i sru mo'i bu gcig pu rab tu byung bas phrug tshab bu mo gcig gtang shog ces sru mos yi ge 'gror ba dang / sgrol chos 'gro 'dod pa gnyis stabs 'grig kyang / bzang ngan ji yong lha bla mar thugs rtags 'bul rgyu byas/sang nyin a mas nga mkhan pa lung dgon du 'khrid de bzhin ras sgor zhing rgyas la/ spyan dkyus ring ba/ sku gzugs che zhing dbu skra'i mtshams dkar tsam yod pa'i rgan khri par sku phyag btsal/ ngas kyang a ma'i gzhogs nas sku phyag btsal/ de nas a mas lus ha cang gus pa'i sgo nas dkar gtsang gi mjal dar zhig phul te skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ rgan khri 14

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 15pas nga'i mabo la byil byil gnang zhing lung rtags bzang bas thongs zhes gsungs/yang mkhan pa lung dgo na du brag g.yab rtogs ldan rin po ches lam rim gsungs pa'i skabs shig nga mjal khar khrid de nga gnyis kyis sku phyag dang dad gus sngon du 'gro ba'i ngang nas mas lam rim rin po che mkhyen/nga'i bu mo 'di lha sa mjal bar 'gro rgyur sems thag bcad 'dug pas thugs dzadas nyid ngang las ma gasku sa par thugs dam brtag pa zhig ci nas mkhyen zhes/ dri med dar dkar dang skyabs rten ṭam dkar zhig phul/rtogs lngan rin po ches dgongs par yud tsam bzhugs rjes phyag g.yon ha cang ring ba'i e ga chodam dkar ngo ra byil tsam gnang zhing thugs dam dgongs don gsungs pa/ lha sar bu mo'i 'dod pa bzhin gtang na bsam don 'grub yod zhes dang / nga la khong gis /byed bsdudad nams che/ rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bu dang jo bo yid bzhin nor bu mjal nges red/ ces lung bstan gnang / a mas yang bskyar nged la bu mo/ mi yul du 'gro ba'i lam bar za 'thung gang thob las gdam ga bya rgyu med pas chang btung chog pa'i gnang ba zhu dgos bshad/ ngas rin wa cher chang btung chog pa'i skyabs 'jug gnang rogs zhus pas/ rin po ches 'thung ma dgos na ma 'thung / ci ste 'thung dgos na btung chog ces gnang ba bstsal/15

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 15pas nga'i mgo la byil byil gnang zhing lung rtags bzang bas sgongs zhes gsungs/yang mkhan pa lung dgon du brag g.yab rtogs ldan rin po ches lam rim gsungs pa'i skabs shig nga mjal khar khrid de nga gnyis kyis sku phyag dang dad gus sdon du 'gro ba'i ngang nas mas lam rim rin po che mkhyen/nga'i bu mo 'di lha sa mjal bar 'gro rgyur sems thag bcad 'dug pas thugs chos nyid ngang las ma g.yonas par thugs dam brtag pa zhig ci nas mkhyen zhes/ dri med dar dkar dang skyabs rten ṭam dkar zhig phul/rtogs lan rin po ches dgongs par yud tsam bzhugs rjes phyag g.yon ha cang ring ba'i yog tshom dkar por byil tsam gnang zhing thugs dam dgongs don gsungs pa/ lha sar bu mo'i 'dod pa bzhin gtang na bsam don 'grub bo zhes dang / nga la khong gis byed bsod nams che/ rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bu dang jo bo yid bzhin nor bu mjal nges red/ ces lung bstan gnang / a mas yang bskyar nged la bu mo/ mi yul du 'gro ba'i lam bar za 'thung gang thob las gdam ga bya rgyu med pas chang btung chog pa'i gnang ba zhu dgos bshad/ ngas rin po cher chang btung chog pa'i skyabs 'jug gnang rogs zhus pas/ rin po ches 'thung ma dgos na ma 'thung / ci ste 'thung dgos na btung chog ces gnang ba bstsal/15

1snyo rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/lcags sgrul spyi lo 1941 'e ra cadad dbo na du yod pa'i grwa mang nang bod dbus lha ldan du rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che gnas skabs srid skyong dgongs zhu gnang zhing / stag brag sprul sku ngag dbang gsung rab khrir 'khod pa'i gnas tshul gleng slong byed kyang nga tshor de tsam do snang med/ lo der wa da dmag cog skal bzang dang / khong gi bza' zla skal bzang chodas ma /btsun ma tag sku na ma dang / 〉te gazlo na bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ lnga/ gazlo na ti yon ma bcas dbus su 'bo rgyu'i grabs gcadam byed pa / nga yang kho chod dang mnyam du dag pa'i gnas mchodag lha sar chas pa'i sta bo na bgyis/a mas nga'i rgyag phyer rtsam pa dang phyur zhib/ mar khu/ bu ram/shel ka ra bcas mnyam du bsres nas phye ras phad nang khal gnyis dang phyed dang / khyim gyi rta zhig btsong nas bod dngul srang gsum sgor mo sum brgya lnga bcu phyu par lhan pa glan te sbas shing / lag tu slo pad dngul srang drug cu tsam lam cadan du bskur/ lha sar ja daspo na lnga sku da pas sru mo ra lag rtags ja bcas the ga chas brgyab cing mag pas nga bskyal rgyu bgyis/ khyim nas nga la khal ma bung bu gcig dang rta gcig sprad pa dang / ce ga skal bzang la khal ma nge nga bu brgyad yod/nga tsho'i pha yul gyi lugs srol ltar nga dngos su h+phon nyin rten 'brel ched snam bu'i phyu pa dang zhwa mo phying zhwa dkar po zhig gyon zhing / thog steng 16

15 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/lcags sprul spyi lo 1941 lor 'od dgon du yod pa'i grwa mang nang bod dbus lha ldan du rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che gnas skabs blud skyong dgongs zhu gnang zhing / stag brag sprul sku ngag dbang gsung rab khrir 'khod pa'i gnas tshul gleng grong byed kyang nga tshor de tsam do snang med/ lo der bod dmag cog skal bzang dang / khong gi bza' zla skal bzang chos mtsho/btsun ma tag yonan ma dang / pho gzhon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ mo gzhon ti yon ma bcas dbus su 'gro rgyu'i grabs gshom byed pa / nga yang kho tsho dang mnyam du dag pa'i gnas mchog lha sar chas pa'i sta gon bgyes/a mas nga'i rgyag phyer rtsam pa dang phyur zhib/ mar khu/ bu ram/shel ka ra bcas mnyam du bsres nas phye ras phad nang khal gnyis dang phyed dang / khyim gyi rta zhig bcong nas bod dngul srang gsum sgor mo sum brgya lnga bcu phyu par lhan pa glan te sbas shing / lag tu zho pad dngul srang drug cu tsam lam gron du bskur/ lha sar ja dkon po yod pas sru mor lag rtags ja bcas dog chas brgyab cing mag pas nga bskyal rgyu bgyis/ khyim nas nga la khal ma bung bu gcig dang rta gcig sprad pa dang / cog skal bzang la khal ma bong bu brgyad yod/nga tsho'i pha yul gyi lugs srol ltar nga dngos su thon nyin rten 'brel ched snam bu'i phyu pa dang zhwa mo phying zhwa dkar po zhig gyon zhing / sgog steng 16

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 17dang thab nang bsang btang nas sgyu na lam btab/ pha ma gnyis gas nga la kha btab/sa g.yogs rjes a mas bral mi phod pa'i ngang nas skyel bar yong nga tsho khyim gyi thad ri ldebs kyi lam bgrod skabs ngas mar khyim la bltas pas pha yis zangag kha nas nga la rgyang lta byed/de nas a mas mig chu gtong bzhin nga'i mgo bor byel byil byas te bu mo khyed rang lo bcu drug la son pas rang mgo rang gis thon pa dang /mi yul du bcags po dgos pa'i bslab bya mang dag brgyab ste khyim du logangs a mar phyir bltas shig slog 'dod rung sems nang skyo snang gis khengs pas mig chu 'chor grabs byed pa sdug rus kyis mdun du bskyod/ mi yi las dbang btsan che bas de nas bzung pha ma'i zhal mjal ba'i mtha' ma yin pa nga'i sems la ga la 'char/nyin ga sa dang phyed nas bsam pa breng du 'byor/ de nas gcen mo'i mag pa phyir log pa ngas zho pad gang tsam bskur te rdog khres yang du btang ba dang dngul rnams gsang nyar byed khul yang phyu pa'i phyi nas dngul gyi rjes 'bur du thon/ bsam pa breng zhes pa'i ri shur der rgyug pa'i rdza thu sgrol byed shing gru 'dug kyang dbyar kha shin tu rgyas shing rlabs rgod pas mi phyug zog gsum tshang ma gnam thag la 'khril nas bskyod dgos/ nga tsho yang gnam mkhar dpyang pa'i breng par mthud nas 'gro 17

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 17dang thab nang bsang btang nas 〈snan lam btab/ pha ma gnyis kas nga la kha btab/sa gasku gas rjes a mas bral mi 'o/da pa'i ngang nas skyel bar sku nga nga tsho khyim gyi thad ri ldebs kyi lam balhasned skabs ngas mar khyim la bltas pas pha yis 〈snag kha nas nga la rgyang lta byed/de nas a mas mig chu galta nga bzhin nga'i mgo thosner byil byil byas te bu mo khyed rang lo bcu drug la son pas rang mgo rang gis thon pa dang /mi yul du bcags wa dgo sa pa'i bslab bya mang dag brgyab ste khyim du 'o/gangs a mar phyir bltas shig slog 'dod rung sems nang skyo snang gis khengs pas mig chu 'chodar grabs byed pa sdug rus kyis mdun du bskyod/ mi yi las dbang btsan che bas de nas bzung pha ma'i zhal mjal ba'i mtha' ma yin pa nga'i sems la ga la 'char/nyin gnyis dang phyed nas bsam pa breng du 'byedar/ de nas gcen mo'i mag pa phyir 'o/ga pa ngas zho pad gang tsam bskur te rdog khres yang du btang ba dang dngul rnams gsang nya/ra byed khul yang phyu pa'i phyi nas dngul gyi rjes 'bur du thon/ bsam pa breng zhes pa'i ri shur der rgyug pa'i rdza chu sgrol byed shing gru 'dug kyang dbyar kha shin tu rgyas shing rlabs rgodad pas mi phyug zog gsum tshang ma gnam thag la 'khril nas bskyod dgo sa/ nga che yang gnam mkhar dpyang pa'i breng par mthud nas 'gro 17

18 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/skabs 'og nas rba rlabs lang long du 'phyur ba'i zu bo'i 'jigs rngangs kyis bred sha thon pa'i mig bgrad du bcug khal ma 'gro myong ba rnams zhed snang med par pha rol 'byor skabs rkang lag lam seng btsugs kyang khal ma gsar pa rnams btsan gyis brdzangs shing pha rol 'byor skabs rkang lag la brdab skyon ha cang che/khal ma rnams la sman bcos byas te jo la dang / smar khams kyi sa mtha' ma dung zla bcas brgyud/ mdzo sgang thang du nyin lnga khal ma rnams rtswar gsos skabs rtswa des khal ma rnams nad kyis langs mi thub kyang smyug ma'i pags pa me la bdug na drag skyed yong / sa der tsha ba mchod rten nas yin pa 'i pho gzhon zhig dang mo gzhon dpal yon zhes pa'i bza' tshang gnyis thug byung / kho gnyis la brtse gdungs kyi lo rgyus snyan zhing gdung sems skye dgos pa mang po bshad rgyu 'dug cing / mthar rang mos gnyen sgrig ched rang yul spangs te nga tsho dang mnyam dbus gtsang dab pa'i gnas su chas/nga tsho tsha ba than thog tu spebs skabs jo bo mjal bar 'gro ba'i tsha kha sto pa'i bud med lo na nyer bdun tsam son pa gnyis thug pa nga tsho 'grul pa'i tshogs chen por gyur/de nas tsha ba gos chen thang dang / shing sna gcig kyang med pa'i thang chen tsha ba sgom mda'/ tsha ba spo shod/ dpag shod/ ri mtho zhing 18

18 gin mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/skabs 'og nas rba rlabs lang long du 'phyur ba'i chu bo'i 'jigs rngangs kyis bred sha thodan pa'i mig bgrad du bcug khal ma 'gro snu nga ba rnams zhed snang med par pha ro/la 'byor skabs rkang lag lam seng btsugs kyang khal ma gsar pa rnams btsan gyis brdzangs shing pha gro la 'byor skabs rkang lag la brdab skyodan ha cang che/khal ma rnams la sman bsgu sa byas te jo la dang / smar khams kyi sa mtha' ma dung zla bcas brgyud/ mdzo sgang thang du nyin lnga khal ma rnams rtswar gaskudzis skabs rtswa des khal ma rnams nad kyis langs mi thub kyang smyug ma'i pags pa me la bdug na drag skyed sku nga / sa der tsha ba mchodad rten nas yin pa 'i sgyu gcadan zhig dang mo gachodan dpal sku na zhes pa'i bza' tshang gnyis thugo byung / kho gnyis la brtse gdungs kyi lo rgyus snyan zhing gdung sems skye dgos pa mang po bshad rgyu 'dug cing / mthar rang mos gnyen sgrig ched rang yul spangs te nga tsho dang mnyam dbus gtsang das pa'i gnas su chas/nga chod tsha ba than thodag tu slebs skabs josgo wa mjal bar 'aspyod ba'i tsha kha lha pa'i bud med 'o/ na nyer bdun tsam son pa gnyis thug pa nga tsho 'grul pa'i chodzigs chen por gyur/de nas tsha ba gos chen thang dang / shing sna gcig kyang med pa'i thang chen tsha ba spe ma mda'/ tsha ba spo shod/ dpag shod/ ri mtho zhing 18

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 19g.yas gasku/na mya ngam thang yin pa'i yi dwags la sku/gas 'boto lam ha cang nyen 'gan chen ngo du ma zhig brgyud/ nge da gzhung gis bdag 'dzin gnang ba'i zha yul zam par 'byor/ nga tsho mi res zam gla ṭam dkar re sprad de rta drel ded nas bgrod skabs zam pa lang ma ling byed/nga pho shar gangs lha'i la gsham du 'gyor skabs bod dmag cog skal bzang gis dpral pa nas nar nar bzhur yong ba'i rngul chu phyu pa'i phu thung g.yas kyis 'phyi bzhin/ ri rtse gangs kyis bkab cing gangs na bun gyis bsgribs pa'i shar gangs lha'i ri ldebs la bltas te/ dbugs ring 'byin bzhin/ nga tsho 'gyul gsar rnams la ri 'di brgal skabs 'grul pa'i rta drel rnams shi thodad ha cang che bas/ tshang mas rems shig ang / zhes bskul lcags btang /nga tshos 'bad brtson chen pos shar gangs lha'i rtse mor 'dzegs te sngar srol bzhin ri rtser bsang gsol btang zhing lha sa'i jo bo yid bzhin nor bu mjal ba'i smon lam btab/ de nas chu tsho da la brgal dgos pa dang chu tshod lar chu med pas shar gangs lha nas chu 'khyer te chu tshod la rtse'i spang gazlo ngas steng dbo nga gcig tshugs babs/sang nyin chu zod la nas g.yas gasku na brag ri dang shing nags stug pos bkab ste nam mkha' yang mi mthong ba'i 'phrang ring ha cang 19

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 19g.yas g.yonan mya ngam thang yin pa'i yi dwags la so/gas 'asgo lam ha cang nyen 'gan chen po du ma zhig brgyud/ bod gzhung gis bdag 'dzin gnang ba'i zha yul zam par 'byor/ nga tsho mi res zam gla ṭam dkar re sprad de rta drel ded nas bgrod skabs zam pa lang ma ling byed/nga tsho shar gangs lha'i la gsham du 'byor skabs bod dmag cog skal bzang gis dpral pa nas nar nar bzhur yong ba'i rngul khru phyu pa'i phu thung g.yas kyis 'phyi bzhin/ ri rtse gangs kyis bkab cing gangs na bun gyis bsgribs pa'i shar gangs lha'i ri ldebs la bltas te/ dbugs ring 'byin bzhin/ nga tsho 'grul gsar rnams la ri 'di brgal skabs 'grul pa'i rta drel rnams shi god ha cang che bas/ tshang mas rems shig ang / zhes bskul lcags btang /nga tshos 'bad brtson chen pos shar gangs lha'i rtse mor 'dzegs te sngar sgol bzhin ri rtser bsang gsol btang zhing lha sa'i jo bo yid bzhin nor bu mjal ba'i smon lam btab/ de nas chu tshod la brgal dgos pa dang chu tshod lar chu med pas shar gangs lha nas chu 'khyer te chu tshod la rtse'i spang gzhongs steng dgong gcig tshugs babs/sang nyin zu tshod la nas g.yas g.yon brag ri dang shing nags snyug pos bkab ste nam mkha' yang mi mthong ba'i 'phrang ring ha cang 19

2༷ rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/dogs po zhig brgyud skabs/ rta drel rnams ngal dub dang slo sbug dog pa'i ya nga ba'i 'tsher skad lhang lhang 'don/ la gsham du slebs skabs gzhi nas nam mkha' mjosgong bas mi phyugs rnams la sems bag phebs pa'i bde ba zhig ster/ de nas lho rdzong du 'gyor te phyu pa 'angol zhing sged rags ring po bcings pa'i mi 'ga' mthong ba bod dmag cog skal bzang gis sde pa gzhung gi sku drag yin pa'i ngo sprodad byas/ sa cha de'i skye dman chod pang gdan bcings pa'i srol med/rim pas 'ban rda khro la brgyud skabs la rtser tshong dpon nor bu bzang po tshugs sa dang khong gis bzos pa'i rdo ring gsum ke rer bslangs yod pa dang / rgyab ri'i shing nags dkyil thog sa bdun tsam ldan pa'i rdzong rnying dgra rdzong zhes pa sku da/ de nas nub gangs la dang / kong po rgya mda'/kong po/ mtsho mo rag bcas brgyud mal gro'i phu pad ma zi phug tu 'gyor/khul de'i zhing pa rnams g.yul las 'dodan pa'i las mjug la rems shing 'dug pad ma zi phug nas lha sa thag nye zhing nga tsho'i lam gyi dka' ngal sel tshar ba dang 11 galo/na bkra shis rgyal mtshan mal spo ra pha thug par 'thod rgyu yin pas/ nga tsho pad ma zi phug gi mdo'i cadang pa zhig gi 'khris la tshugs bab nas zur zhig tu kho tsho'i do po rnams dang rang nyid kyi bu ram dang / ja/ sbrang rtsi bcas yodad pa'i sgro khug mnyam du brtsigs/ sha nyos 20

22 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/chos mtshos ngus te zang zing tshugs skabs cog skal bzang bung bu rtswa khar 'tshad bar phyin yin/ zhes yong nas ha las ngang mig chu btang / tshang mas phyogs bzhir nyul yang rkun ma'i rjes shul tsam ma rnyed/a cag ti yon gyis khyed kyis khur rtsa gang 'dra byas sam zer byung ba/a mas nga thon khar sku1nga gi 'khris la dza(gas babs skabs rdog khres kyi thag pa lus la btags dgos pa dang dngul lus nas bral mi rung / dgong mo rkun jag gi gnas tshul byung na mgo nge bkyag mi rung zhes mngags byung /zhes bshad pas khyod kyi ma de rgod pa la ang zer/ nyi ma shar ba dang bkra shis rgyol mtshan ca dngos gang yang 'khyer rgyu med par mi rkyang rta rkyang pha thug par than / nga tso yang thon yong skabs nga la khur rtsa gcig yod pa las gzhan rnams lag stong ngang dga' ldan lha shod bar mnyam du yong ste sang nyin de 'ga' shas dga' ldan mjal bar phyin/ nga dang tsha ba mchodad rten nas yin pa'i bza' tsho gnyis mnyam du tshal gung thang du 'grul pa tshugs babs sa mi tshang chen po zhig gi lha rar gnas tshang g.yar/mi tshang de'i a ma lo na bzhi bcu tsam son pa'i bud med tshon po skal bzang sil g.yab gyon pa zhig gi mdun tsha ba mchod rten gyi dpal g.yang bza' 'tsho gnyis ston gla rgyugs te bsdad rgyu'i re ba bto/na pa dang /22

22 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/chos mtshos ngus te zang zing tshugs skabs cog skal bzang bung bu rtswa khar 'tsho bar phyin yin/ zhes yong nas ha las ngang mig chu btang / tshang mas phyogs bzhir nyul yang rkun ma'i rjes shul tsam ma rnyed/a cag nyi yon gyis khyed kyis khur rtsa gang 'dra byas sam zer byung ba/a mas nga sgon khar grong gi 'khris la tshugs babs skabs rdog khres kyi thag pa lus la btags dgos pa dang dngul lus nas bral mi rung / dgong mo rkun jag gi gnas tshul byung na mgo bo bkyag mi rung zhes mngags byung /zhes bshad pas khyod kyi ma de rgod pa la ang zer/ nyi ma shar ba dang bkra shis rgyal mtshan ca dngos gang yang 'khyer rgyu med par mi rkyang rta rkyang pha thug par thon nga cho yang thon yong skabs nga la khur rtsa gcig yod pa las gzhan rnams lag stong ngang dga' ldan lha shod bar mnyam du yong ste sang nyin de 'ga' shas dga' ldan mjal bar phyin/ nga dang tsha ba mchod rten nas yin pa'i bza' cho gnyis mnyam du tshal gung thang du 'grul pa tshugs babs sa mi tshang chen po zhig gi sgo rar gnas tshang g.yar/mi tshang de'i a ma lo na bzhi bcu tsam son pa'i bud med tshon po skal bzang sil g.yab gyon pa zhig gi mdun tsha ba mchod rten gyi dpal g.yang bza' 'tsho gnyis ston gla rgyugs te bsdad rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang /22

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 23nga yang sdod min dris pa ngas bsdad rgyu byas/nga chodar sle po dang phyag ma bskur nas drel gyi ong ril 'phyag par btang byung bas g.yog mor sdod 'dod ma byung zhing cung ngo shes pa'i drel pa zhig gis khyed de 'dra byed mi dgos/ sru mo'i skyid sdug yag po yod ces bshad/ ngas g.yog mosgo brgyud a ma der dgongs pa zhus/ a ma des nga 'bod de shin tu byams pa'i ngang nas kham bu dang star kha 'ga' sprad de gasku ga mo ra bsdad na/ ngan las bskul mi yong zhes bshad kyang khas len ma byas par ce ga skal bzang bza' chod gnyis dang mnyam du tshal gung thang nas thosnen/pha yul du rgan rabs rnams kyis bshad pa bzhin tshal gung thang mchodad rten nas gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang 'dren byed lam du khra lham mer 'char bas/ a ma'i ngag bkodad bzhin sa de nas 〈sna brang phyogs la phyag 'tshal zhing yid rtse gcig tu smon lam btab/lha mthong shan khar 'byor rjes ko ba'i nang gtsang po bsgral te ma drin chen gyis mngags bya bzhin ko grib dag ched pha ri nas mgo bor chu thengs gsum byugs pa dang / phyu pa dkar po brjes nas gsar pa dmar smug de gyon te bskyod mur/ lha sa'i 'bi na rar zhes pa'i mi tshang chen po zhig tu 'gyor/23

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 2 nga yang sdod min dris pa ngas bsdad rgyu byas/nga chor sre po dang phyag ma bskur nas drel gyi yong ril 'phyag par btang byung bas g.yog mor sdod 'dod ma byung zhing cung ngo shes pa'i drel pa zhig gis khyed de 'dra byed mi dgos/ sru mo skyid sdug yag po yod ces bshad/ ngas g.yog mo brgyud a ma der dgongs pa zhus/ a ma des nga 'bod de shin tu byams pa'i ngang nas kham bu dang star kha 'ga' sprad de g.yog mor bsdad na/ ngan las bskul mi yong zhes bshad kyang khas len ma byas par cog skal bzang bza' tsho gnyis dang mnyam du tshal gung thang nas thon/pha yul du rgan rabs rnams kyis bshad pa bzhin tshal gung thang mchod rten nas gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang 'dren byed lam du khra lham mer 'char bas/ a ma'i ngag bkod bzhin sa de nas pho brang phyogs la phyag 'tshal zhing yid rtse gcig tu spon lam btab/lha mthong shan khar 'byor rjes ko ba'i nang gtsang po bsgral te ma drin chen gyis mngags bya bzhin ko grib dag ched pha ri nas mgo bor thu zengs gsum byugs pa dang / phyu pa dkar po brjes nas gsar pa dmar spug de gyon te bskyod mur/ lha sa'i 'bi na rar zhes pa'i mi tshang chen po zhig tu 'gyor/23

24 na mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/pha yul nas thon nas bzung ngas dus yun ji song mdzub mor rtsis skabs lam bar zla ba gnyis dang nyin bcu 'das/ ('grul bzhud skabs sngar srol bzhin zhogs pa sgo rengs nas nyin phyed bar bskyod dgos pa dang / nyin phyed nas rta drel rtswa khar btang nas ngal gsos pa las 'grul zhud mi byed/ nyin bcu nas tshugs zhag ces rtswa kha bzang sar ngal gsos nas drel pas g.yag lug nyos te bshas btang nas za 'thung la rol zhing ltod por sdod/) 'bi ra na'i ma rgan der ngas sru mo bsod nams lha mo mdun 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad pas ngas rogs pa byas chog ces/ phru gu zhig la ṭam ka gcig sprad de skad gtong rtsis skabs/ yang nga'i sems nang slo bur de sngon sru mo mig mthong tsam yang med pas 'gro mi 'dod pa zhig byung ste de las sngon du nga tsho'i nang sdod myong ba'i a cag 'jam dpal sgrol ma'i mdun 'gro 'dod byung ba bzhin de don bshad/ a cag khong lha sar rgya mi zhig gi bza' zla yin pa dang phyug bdag tu gyur yod ces pha yul la skad grags yod/phru gu zhig gis klu sbug la 'gro dbo sa zhes lam rgyus byas te bar skor brgyud khrid nas skam slog gtong mkhan skyes pa zhig la gnyen nye 'jam dpal lags bzhugs sa gang du red dam/ zhes dris/ mi des nga 'jam dpal gyi bza' zla yin zhes dbus skad brgyab nas bshad byung ba dang / rang nyid kyi sems su mi der 'dzin pa'i ngos 'dzin las ldog ste kho pa ni bod pa dang gcig mtshungs red/ mi de dang mnyam du a cag 'jam dpal gyi 24

24 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/pha yul nas sgon nas bzung ngas dus yun ji song mdzub mor rtsis skabs lam bar zla ba gnyis dang nyin bcu 'das/ ('gyul bzhud skabs sngar srol bzhin zhogs pa tho rengs nas nyin phyed bar bskyod dgos pa dang / nyin phyed nas rta drel rtswa khar btang nas ngal gso/sa pa las 'grul zhud mi byed/ nyin bcu nas tshugs zhag ces rtswa kha bzang sar ngal gamo sa nas drel pas g.yag lug nyos te bshas btang nas za 'thung la rol zhing ltod por sdod/) 'thi ra na'i ma rgan der ngas sru mo bse da nams lha mo'i mdun 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad pas ngas zodags pa byas dzadag ces/ phru gu zhig la ṭam ka gcig sprad de skad gto/nga rtsis skabs/ yang nga'i sems nang slo bur de sngon sru mo mig mthong tsam yang med pas 'aspro mi 'dod pa zhig byung ste de las sngon du nga tsho'i nang sdod myong ba'i a cag 'jam dpal sgrol ma'i mdun 'gro 'dod byung ba bzhin de 〈snan bshad/ a cag kho nga lha sar rgya mi zhig gi bza' zla yin pa dang phyug bdag tu gyur yod ces pha yul la skad grags yod/phru gu zhig gis klu ji/ga la 'a1ste dbo sa zhes lam rgyus byas te bar lha ra brgyud khrid nas skam 10ga galtasteng mkhan skyes pa zhig la gnyen nye 'jam dpal lags bzhugs sa gang du red dam/ zhes dris/ mi des nga 'jam dpal gyi bza' zla yin zhes dbus skad brgyab nas bshad byung ba dang / rang nyid kyi sems su mi der 'dzin pa'i ngos 'dzin las dog ste kho pa ni bod pa dang gcig mtshungs red/ mi de dang mnyam du a cag 'jam dpal gyi 24

me+e lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 25khyim du phyin/ a cag 'jam dpal thug pa dang phan tshun mtshams 'dri byas shing nga la ja thang blugs nas phor mar brgyab/ nga tsho'i pha yul la ja thang 'thung ba'i lugs srol med pas ser sna tsha ba la bsams byung /yun tsam nas bu tsho zhig lam mkhan du btang nas mi tshang zhig gi sgo ra'i nang 'dzul skabs khre'u zhig gi thog skal bzang bsil g.yab gyon pa'i a cag rgyag pa zhig ma ṇi'i 'khor lo bskor zhing 'dug pa/ nga mthong ba dang yar langs nas pha yul nas bu mo gcig yong gi yod pa gdong la bltas na 'di yin pa 'dra/ dka' las khag ma byung ngam/ ngas dka' ma thal/ sru mos nga'i phyu par lta bzhin gzhan rnams lha sar 'byor skabs sprang por 'byor yang khyod zab mchor spras nas 'byor byung zhes 'gram pa dang dpral pa gtugs nas nang du 'khrid/ nga'i rta gcig dang bung bu phyed cog skal bzang gis btsong nas mtsho smon gling nye 'gram rdo chos zam pa'i sru mo'i khyim du bskyal bar 'byor/ cog skal bzang nyin shas lha sar bsdad de skal bzang chos mtsho'i spun mched rgyud stod dge bshes dbang rgyal gyi mdun sgrum ldan skal bzang chos mcho la 'bras dang / gro zhib/ rtsam pa bcas do po re re nyos te lto khar 'gro gi yin zhes thon/ nyam thung gi bud med skal bzang chos mchor grwa rkyang dge bshes dbang rgyal gyis ci thub rogs ram byas te cos/ skal bzang gi 25

rmi lam du 'khor ba'i dag zhing lha sa/ 25khyim du phyin/ a cag 'jam dpal thug pa dang phan tshun mtshams 'dri byas shing nga la ja thang blugs nas phor mar brgyab/ nga tsho'i pha yul la ja thang 'thung ba'i lugs srodal med pas ser sna tsha ba la bsams byung /yun tsam nas bu mo zhig lam mkhan du btang nas mi tshang zhig gi lha ra'i nang 'dzul skabs khre'u zhig gi thog skal bzang bsil g.yab gyon pa'i a cag rgyag pa zhig ma ṇi'i 'khor lo balha ra zhing 'dug pa/ nga mthong ba dang yar langs nas pha yul nas bu mo gcig yong gi sku da pa gdong la bltas na 'di yin pa 'dra/ dka' las khag ma byung ngam/ ngas dka' ma thal/ sru mo sa nga'i phyu par lta bzhin gzhan rnams lha sar 'byedar skabs sprang por 'gyor yang khyod zab mchodar spras nas 'byedar byung zhes 'gram pa dang dpral pa gtugs nas nang du 'khrid/nga'i rta gcig dang bung bu phyed cog skal bzang gis btsong nas mtsho smon gling nye 'gram rdo chos zam pa'i sru mo'i khyim du bskyal bar 'byor/ cog skal bzang nyin shas lha sar bsdad de skal bzang chos mtsho'i spun mched rgyud stod dge bshes dbang rgyal gyi mdun sbum ldan skal bzang chodas mchod la 'bras dang / hro zhib/ rtsam pa bcas do po re re nyos te lho khar 'gro gi yin zhes thon/ nyam chung gi bud med skal bzang chodas mchodar grwa rkyang dge bshes dbang rgyal gyis ci thub ro/gas ram byas te cadas/ skal bzang gi 25

2snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/phru gu skyes shing 'tshar longs byung yang cog skal bzang ni de nas bzung mig mthong lta snyadag rna thos tsam yang med/sngon bsags las kyi 'bras bu//bdams pa'i rang dbang yod na//skyid pa'i rang yul bzhag ste//gzhan yul bsgrim pa gang sku nga //26

26 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/phru gu skyes shing 'tshar longs byung yang cog skal bzang ni de nas bzung mig mabong lta zhog rna thos tsam yang med/sdon bsags las kyi 'bras bu//bdams pa'i rang dbang yod na//skyid pa'i rang yul bzhag ste//gzhan yul bsgrim pa gang yong //26

sno sa khang bi bu mo/ 27gas/ma pa/tshos khang gi ci mo/nga'i sru mo'i las ka gatho wa chojas las red/ khyim gyi cho sa khang nang snam bu 'doms pa bco lnga tsam yod pa'i bug bzhi lnga gshongs pa'i rdza chen po drug re phyogs gnyis su bang bsgrigs te khyon rdza bcu gnyis yod/ gzhan zhig tu rgya gar nas thodan pa'i zangs chen bug bcu gnyis tsam gcadang pa gnyis yod/ gcig nang choms nag po dang gcig nang dmar snga brgyab/ choms rgya gar nas lnga na pa caste 'dra ba zhig dang / 'brug nas 〈snan pa'i shing tshos dmar po zhig 'dug nga la su mo dang mi tshang de'i bu slo gros/ g.yog po bcas kyis tshos rgyag stangs bslabs byung /sru mo'i lo rgyus bshad na/ pha yul nas bros te lha sar ngo shes pa su yang med pas pe cing za khang zhes pa'i rgya mi'i za khang nang g.yog rgyugs nas gla mtho po thob cing / rjes su rgya mi'i za khang gi sbyin bdag sras de dang mdza' mthun du gyur/ dus shig rgya bod gnyis lha sar 'thab 'khrug cig 27

tshos khang bi bu mo/ 27gsum pa/tshos khang ge bu tho/nga'i sru mo'i las ka gtso bo tshos las red/ khyim gyi chos khang nang snam bu 'doms pa bco lnga tsam yod pa'i bug bzhi lnga gshongs pa'i rdza chen po drug re phyogs gnyis su bang bsgrigs te khyon rdza bcu gnyis yod/ gzhan zhig tu rgya gar nas thon pa'i zangs chen bug bcu gnyis tsam gshong pa gnyis yod/ gcig nang chos nag po dang gcig nang dmar po brgyab/ tshos rgya gar nas thon pa sho 'dra ba zhig dang / 'brug nas thon pa'i shing tshos dmar po zhig 'dug nga la sru mo dang mi tshang de'i bu slo gros/ g.yog po bcas kyis chos rgyag stangs bslabs byung /sru mo'i lo rgyus bshad na/ pha yul nas bros te lha sar ngo shes pa su yang med pas pe cing za khang zhes pa'i rgya mi'i za khang nang g.yog rgyugs nas gla mas po thob cing / rjes su rgya mi'i za khang gi sbyin bdag sras de dang mdza' mthun du gyur/ dus shig rgya bod gnyis lha sar 'thab 'khrug cig 27

2 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/byung ste sras des bod kyi phyogs byas pas rgya am ban gyes sbyin bdag sras bsad/ sras de'i byas pa rjes 'brel la brten sde pa gzhung nas sru mor dmigs bsal gzigs skyong chen po 'dugade'i rjes la rgya bod gnyis kyi skad sgyur yun ring byed skabs gzhung zhabs rgyal rong nang so mi ngo zhig dang sru mo mdza' mthun chags te / bu slo bzang 'jam dpal skyes pa se ra dgon du rab tu byung nas dge 'dun 'dus tshogs nas mkhas pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur kyang dge bshes btang tshar ba dang grongs/ slo bzang 'jam dpal dge bshes gtong skabs spyi 'bul la sru mos thog sa gsum can gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thang ga zhig bzhengs te ser smad 'du khang du phul/rgyal rong nang so'i sku ngo de tshos khang gi bdag po yin nam/ gang ltar sru mos tshos khang bzung ste rim pas 'byor ldan du gyur/ da dung rgya gar la tshong bskur nas nyo chong byed/nga 'byor dus sku ngo 'das kyang sru mo dang sku po snga 'dzar bu blo gros la g.yog po drug 'dug nga rang ni phrug tshab dang gcig mtshungs red/ nga la sru mos bu blo gros dang mnyam du chang sa brgyag dgos brjod kyang las med pa 'dra nga'i snang bar 'gro yi med/ yang bu slo gros la 'phan po rgyal rong nang so ma khang gi sku ngo gshegs khar bshul lus phru gu dang 28

28 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/byung ste sras des 11da kyi phyogs byas pas rgya am ban gyis sbyin bdag sras bsad/ sras de'i byas pa rjes 'brel la brten sde pa gzhung nas sru mor dmigs bsal gzigs skyong chen 11 'dugade'i rjes la rgya bod gnyis kyi skad sgyur yun ring byed skabs gzhung zhabs rgyal mo nga nang so'i mi lnga zhig dang sru mo mdza' mthun chags te / bu slo bzang 'jam dpal skyes pa se ra dgon du rab tu byung nas dge 'dun 'dus cho gas nas mkhas pa'i khyu mchodag tu gyur kyang dge bshes btang tshar ba dang grongs/ slo bzang 'jam dpal dge bshes gtong skabs spyi 'bul la sru mo sa lnga ga sa gsum can gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thang ga zhig bzhengs te ser smad 'du khang du phul/rgyal mo nga nang so'i sku ngo de tshos khang gi bdag wa yin nam/ gang ltar sru mos tshos khang bzung ste rim pas 'gyor ldan du gyur/ da dung rgya gar la tshong bskur nas nyo tshong byed/nga 'gyor dus sku ngo 'das kyang sru mo dang sku ngo'i snga 'dzar bu slo bo sa la g.yog wa drug 'dug nga rang ni phrug tshab dang gcig mtshungs red/ nga la sru mos bu slo gros dang mnyam du chang sa brgyag dgos brjod kyang las med pa 'dra nga'i snang bar 'gro yi med/ yang bu slo gros la 'phan po rgyal moring nang so'i ma khang gi sku ngo gshegs khar bshul lus phru gu dang 28

tshos khang gi bu mo/ 29bcas kyi 'tsho skyong ched sku ngo yi lcam dang mnyam khyim skyong byas te sdod dgos zhes kha chems bzhag 'dug pa/ bu slo gros gnas skabs 'phan por khyim skyong byas te rjes su mar spebs/ bu slo gros dang nga gnyis kyi mdun lam la phyogs gnyis/kyi slob ston mi mthun pa gnyis kyi 'og gnas dgos/ byung bas ngas sru mo'i ngo ma ldog par phyi tshul nas bu slo gros dang yin mdog byed kyi yod/sru mo gshis ka ni/ nam rgyun snang ba gang skyid dang lha chos mi chos gnyis gar dang zhen che bas mtho rim bla ma sku drag nas dma' phal pa bar 'brel lam ha cang bzang / rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor gyi gra pa dbul po dge bshes gtong mkhan rnams kyi sbyin bdag byed/ sru mo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma ra sgreng rin po che dang / phur lcogs byams mgon rin po che yin/ sru mos nga mnyam du mjal khar 'khrid skabs phur lcogs byams mgon rin po che'i bla brang gi a pho ne+e cos mgron por/ khyed ga par 'gro'am/ phyag mdzod sku zhabs bzhugs med/ ces bya yi mi skad brgyag pa der nga zung dus ya mtshan chen po skye yi yond/me phag spyi lo 1947 sde pa gzhung nas bod dmag kha dang grwa bzhi dmag btang nas rwa sgreng rin po che 'dzin bzung byas rjes se ra dgon dang grwa bzhi dmag zing 'khrug byung ste bod zla 3 tshes 17 nyin rgyal 29
