dzadas khang gi bu mo / 29bcas kyi 'tsho skyong ched sku ngo yi lcam dang mnyam khyim skyong byas te sdod dbostes zhes kha chems bzhag 'dug pa/ bu blo ༷tes gnas skabs 'phan lnga ra khyim skyong byas te rjes su mar slebs/ bu blo gros dang nga gnyis kyi mdun lam la chu gas gnyisarnyikyi slob ston mi mthun pa gnyis kyi cadag gnas dbo sa/ byung bas ngas sru mo'i ngo ma ldog par phyi tshul nas bu blo gros dang yin mdog byed kyi yod/sru mo'i gshis ka ni/ nam rgyun snang ba gang skyid dang lha chodas mi chodas gnyis kar dang zhen che bas mthod rim bla ma sku drag nas dma' phal pa bar 'brel lam ha cang bzang / rang nyid kyi dpal 'gyor gyi grwa pa dbul po dge bshes gtong mkhan rnams kyi sbyin bdag byed/ sru mo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rwa sgreng rin po che dang / phur lcogs byams mgon rin po che yin/ sru mos nga mnyam du mjal khar 'khrid skabs phur cu gas byams mgon rin po che'i bla brang gi a pho ne+e tsos mahron por/ khyed ga par 'ahro'am/ phyag mdzod sku zhabs bzhugs med/ ces bya yi mi skad brgyag pa der nga chung dus ya mtshan chen 1sna skye yi sku/da/me phag spyi lo 1947 sde pa gzhung nas 〈snad dmag kha dang grwa bzhi dmag btang nas rwa sgreng rin po che 'dzin bzung byas rjes se ra dgon dang grwa bzhi dmag zing 'khrug byung ste bod zla 3 tshes 17 nyin rgyal 29

0 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/po rwa sgreng la dbu nyes byung nas shar chen lcogs la bcug pa'i gnas tshul ngan pa go thos byung 'phral/ sru mo sems khral chen po byed/ mi mang phal che bas stag lung brag rin po cher kha zer/dus gang mtshams nas rgyal po ra sgreng shar chen stogs la slo bur grongs nas sku pur bla brang gi sgo khang nang gdan drangs/ nga dang sru mo mjal bar 'gro skabs bla brang du mna' g.yag gnyis yod pa gnyis gas mig zu phrum phrum btang / sru mos sku gdung rin po che'i sku mdun phyag gsum btsal nas smon lam shub bur 'don mur dran med du brgyal/ khyim bar mi bzhis bkyag nas dbor dgos byung /rang gi phru gu dang rwa sgreng rin po che gnyis snga rjes su 'das pas de nas bzung lo gcig tsam sru mo nad kyis zin nas mthar 'da' khar/ kho tsho'i lha mo skyid sdug gi mi rgan pa zhig dang smar mda' sa gsum gyi rgan po dam chos skad btang ste sgol ma chos 'dzoms lha sar 'bod nas lo gsum phyin yang mdzod sbugs la mi bogs zhu rgyu ma byung bas lha mo skyid sdug nas bu tshab yin pa'i dpang rtags dang / rgan po phyag mdzod dam chos kyis mdzod sbug gi lag khyer bzos te shul lus ca dngos rnams sgrol ma chos 'dzoms la bdag thabs yong ba zhes re ba bton pas/ shog bu zhig la sru mos mdzub zel dang rgan pos sa yig brgyab/30

rki0 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/po rwa sgreng la dbu nyes byung nas shar chen cogs la bcug pa'i gnas tshul ngan pa go thodas byung 'phral/ sru mo sems khral chen lnga byed/ mi mang phal che bas stag lung brag rin po cher kha zer/dus gang mtshams nas rgyal po rwa sgreng shar chen lcogs la slo bur grongs nas sku pur bla brang gi spro khang nang gdan drangs/ nga dang sru mo mjal bar 'bo skabs bla brang du mna' g.yag gnyis yodad pa gnyis kas mig chu phrum phrum btang / sru mos sku gdung rin po che'i sku mdun phyag gsum btsal nas smon lam shub bur 'aro/na mur dran med du brgyal/ khyim bar mi bzhis bkyag nas dnge ra dgos byung /rang gi phru gu dang rwa sgreng rin po che gnyis snga rjes su 'das pas de nas bzung 'o/ gcig tsam sru mo nad kyis zin nas mthar 'da' khar/ kho tsho'i lha mo'i skyid sdug gi mi rgan pa zhig dang smar mda' sa gsum gyi rgan lnga dam chos skad btang ste lha la ma chos 'dzoms lha sar 'awa da nas lo gsum phyin yang mdzod sbugs la mi wa gas zhu rgyu ma byung bas lha mo'i skyid sdug nas bu tshab yin pa'i dpang rtags dang / rgan po phyag mdzod dam chos kyis mjo da sbug gi lag khyer bakhrodas te shul lus ca dalnga sa rnams sgrol ma chos 'dzoms la bdag thabs sku nga ba zhes re ba bto/na pas/ shog bu zhig la sru mo sa mdzub thel dang rgan 〈snas sa yig brgyab/30

tshos khang gi bu mo/ 31da dung nged nyal khri'i 'gram sdod bcug nas 'dar bzhin pa'i lag g.yas mgo bor byil byil byed bzhin/ gzi mdangs nyam pa'i mig 'bur ga ler bltas te ngas 'tsho ba'i ched tshos khang bzung nas da bar sdig pa chen po bsags/ me shing la 'bu dkar po zhig yod pa mes 'tshigs pa dang /thu tsha pos yur po'i nang gi 'bu mang po'i srog 'phrog gi 'dug nga shi rjes sdig bshags ched tshos khang 'di nges par med pa bzo dgos/ zhes dang /yig cha zhig nga la sprad de 'di khang tshan dang / mi tshan/ grwa pa sger bcas la dngul g.yar ba'i 'dzin red/ ma rtsa mu mthud skyed ka btang dgos pa dang slad tshos khang med pa bzos rjes 'tsho bar dka' ngal byung na/ dngul skyed bza' dgos/ rang nyid 'tsho bar skyon med tsam byung tshe skyed ka rnams mchod 'bul byed dgos zhes nan pos mngags byung / de nas nyin gsum gyi rjes nga'i bka' drin can gyi sru mo 'jig rten phyi mar gshegs so//sru mo 'das mchod rnams nga dang bu lags kyis gcos 'brel yod rnams kyis 'bad pas bsgrubs shing lhag par ngas zhe dgur khungs so sor gan rgya'i yig cha bstan nas bun skyed rnams kyis mchod 'bul byas/dus gang tsam nas nga'i gcen mo yang lha sar 'byor te nga tsho dang yun ring gshibs pa'i nang bu blo gros dang gcen mo gnyis mdza' brtses bcings te bza' chor gyur/31

tsha sa khang gi bu mo/ 31da dung nged nyal khri'i 'gram sdod bcug nas 'dar bzhin pa'i lag g.yas mgo bor byil byil byed bzhin/ gzi mdangs nyam pa'i mig 'bur ga ler bltas te ngas 'tsho ba'i ched tshos khang bzung nas da bar sdig pa chen po bsags/ me shing la 'bu dkar lnga zhig yod pa mes 'tshigs pa dang /chu tsha pos yur po'i nang gi 'bu mang po'i srog 'phrog gi 'dug nga shi rjes sdig bshags ched tshos khang 'di nges par med pa bzo dgos/ zhes dang /yig cha 'i/ga/ nga la sprad de 'di khang tshan dang / mi tshan/ grwa pa sger bcas la dngul g.yar ba'i 'dzin red/ ma rtsa mu mthud skyed ka btang dgos pa dang slad tshos khang med pa bzos rjes 'cho bar dka' ngal byung na/ dngul skyed bza' dgos/ rang nyid 'tsho bar skyon med tsam byung tshe skyed ka rnams mchod 'bul byed dgos zhes nan pos mngags byung / de nas nyin gsum gyi rjes nga'i bka' drin can gyi sru mo 'jig rten phyi mar gshegs so//sru mo'i 'das mchodad rnams nga dang bu lags kyis gce sa 'brel yod rnams kyis 'bad pas bskrubs shing lhag par ngas zhe dgur khungs mo sor gan rgya'i yig cha bstan nas bun skyed rnams kyis mchod 'bul byas/dus gang tsam nas nga'i gcen mo yang lha sar 'byor te nga tsho dang yun ring gshibs pa'i nang bu blo gros dang gcen mo gnyis mdza' brtses bcings te bza' tshor gyur/31

32 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nga la rgyun nas rdo choges zam pa'i mi tshang gi ming brlags dodags sems ngal zhig yod kyang kho gnyis bza' mor gyur pas nga'i sems nad bsangs/ bu blo 〈snas rgyun nas gasku ga la byams skyodang che zhing babs chags ya rabs can zhig yin pas khote gnyis bza' ces yin pa mi rnams kyis shes rjes nga la bsod nams chung zhes sleng phyogs che/32

32 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nga la rgyun nas rdo chos zam pa'i mi tshang gi ming brlags dogs sems ngal zhig yod kyang kho gnyis bza' tshor gyur pas nga'i sems nad bsangs/ bu slo gros rgyun nas g.yog la byams skyong che zhing babs chags ya rabs can zhig yin pas kho gnyis bza' tsho yin pa mi rnams kyis shes rjes nga la bsod nams zung zhes gleng phyogs che/32

'jig rten mthun 'jug 33mezhi pa/'j-ig rten mabun 'dugang chung dus pha yul la dbyar kha zhing nang rtswa 'thu ba dang / skabs re ru bar 'brog las byed kyi yod/ lha sar slebs nas bzung lo gsum ring tshos rgyag stangs sbyangs pa las gzhan gang yang mi shes pa'i 'tsho thabs kyi 'kho sa ka chung ngu red/ sru mo'i kha chems bzhin lam seng tshos khang med par bzos na 'asnur ba'i kha phyogs ci yang mi shes pas dus yun cung cho sa khang gnyer/ gus mo rang lo nyer gnyis la son skabs rdo chos zam pa'i bu slo gros kyi spun nye lo nyer brgyad la son pa'i bsod nams bag gro dang mdza' mthun du gyur/ bsod nams bag bo chung dus 'bras spungs kyi chos grwar zhugs te dpe cha gang legs yodad kyang rjes chos mgo ma thon par nga tsho'i khyim mtshes gzim shag phun khang gi khang pa g.yar nas gzi byur gyi tshong las gnyer nas 'tsho ba skyel/33

'jig rten mthun jug 33bzhi pa/'jig rten mjun 'jugang chung dus pha yul la dbyar kha zhing nang rtswa 'thu ba dang / skabs re ru bar 'brog las byed kyi yod/ lha sar spebs nas bzung lo gsum ring tshos rgyag stangs sbyangs pa las gzhan gang yang mi shes pa'i 'tsho thabs kyi 'khos ka chung ngu red/ sru mo'i kha chems bzhin lam seng tshos khang med par bzos na 'tsho ba'i kha phyogs ci yang mi shes pas dus yun cung chos khang gnyer/ gus mo rang lo nyer gnyis la son skabs rdo chos zam pa'i bu slo gros kyi spun nye lo nyer brgyad la son pa'i bsod nams bag gro dang mdza' mthun du gyur/ bsod nams bag gro chung dus 'bras spungs kyi chos grwar zhugs te dpe cha gang legs yod kyang rjes chos mgo ma thon par nga tsho'i khyim mtshes gzim shag phun khang gi khang pa g.yar nas gzi byur gyi tshong las gnyer nas 'tsho ba skyel/33

zha4 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ngas tshadas khang med pa bakhrodas rjes bza' zlas nga ja tshong bcug pa dang / khong gis rgyun du gzi phyur mu mthud btsong zhing / nam zla dbyar khar rgya gar nas thon pa'i ldig dang ha yang gi khog sdir/ bod smad nas thodan pa'i ja bcas 'khyer nas byang du chodang la bskyod pas tshong lam 'gro ha cang che/ khyim thab bcas nas lo gsum pa ste rang lo nyer lngar bu tshe ring dbang phyug btsas/spyi 'o/ 1950 'o/ra lha sar sa sku ma shugs che brgyab/ de rjes byang phyogs kyi nam mkha'i mthongs nas rim gyis bya skyag ri phyogs su sding sgra zhig grags pa mi rnams kyis dus 'gyur gyi macasnan brda lha dmag 'khrug gi yod zer/ da dung jo khang gi 'o thang mchod nas gla ba zhig thodan pa dang /gtsug lag khang gi rgya phigs kyi chu srin kha nas chu 'dzags pa/ ra mo che'i rgya phigs steng sga da babs pa bcas ltas ngan rim gyis byung bas/ cadad gzhung gis ldog thabs klu ji ga tu galtasner rgyag 'phen pa sogs gnang /lo de'i zla 10 nang rgya dmag gis chab mdod btsan 'dzul byas te mdo spyi nga phod rgya lag shor ba'i gtam ngan lha sar thos pa dang / phal cher spyi lo 1951 lo'i dbyar stod du rgya dmag lha sar 'gyor skabs ngo da gzhung gis rgya mi la bsnyun mkhas kyis bakha/'a btang ste nga chod bsu bar btang byung / rgya dmag rnams kyi sgal par nyal chas re dang sked par sprodar 34

34 gon mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ngas tshos khang med pa bzos rjes bza' zlas nga ja tshong bcug pa dang / khong gis rgyun du gzi byur mu mthud bcong zhing / nam zla dbyar khar rgya gar nas thon pa'i sdig dang ha yang gi khog ldir/ bod smad nas thon pa'i ja bcas 'khyer nas byang du tshong la bskyod pas tshong lam 'gro ha cang che/ khyim thab bcas nas lo gsum pa ste rang lo nyer lngar bu tshe ring dbang phyug btsas/spyi lo 1950 lor lha sar sa yom shugs che brgyab/ de rjes byang phyogs kyi nam mkha'i mthongs nas rim gyis bya skyag ri phyogs su sding sgra zhig grags pa mi rnams kyis dus 'gyur gyi malnga/na brda lha dmag 'khrug gi yod zer/ da dung jo khang gi 'o thang mtsho nas gla ba zhig thon pa dang /gtsug lag khang gi rgya phigs kyi zu srin kha nas zu 'dzags pa/ ra mo che'i rgya phigs steng rgod babs pa bcas ltas ngan rim gyes byung bas/ bod gzhung gis ldog thabs klu sbug tu gtor rgyag 'phen pa sogs gnang /lo de'i zla 10 nang rgya dmag gis chab mdo btsan 'dzul byas te mdo spyi nga phod rgya lag shor ba'i gtam ngan lha sar thos pa dang / phal cher spyi lo 3951 lo'i dbyar stod du rgya dmag lha sar 'byor skabs bod gzhung gis rgya mi la bstun mkhas kyis bga' btang ste nga tsho bsu bar btang byung / rgya dmag rnams kyi sgal par nyal chas re dang sked par phor 34

'jig rten mthun 'jug 35pa re btags pa las gzhan ca dngos gang yang med pa'i dbul po mchu gas pa sha stag red/kho pa tsho lha sar gnas gzhi bcas rjes nga tshos kong po nas shing dbor te 'dam ra'i rgya dmag la bcong pa rin par rda yang len gyi yod/dmag sgar gye tshong las gtso bo rgya dmag sna rtse gug gug gcig dang skad sgyur 'ba' pa rgya mtsho yin/ de skabs lha sa'i chong pa mang che ba'i tshong gi kha phyogs rgya dmag la gtad yod/ de'i nang nas a mdo 'jam dbyangs kyis rgyun tsho nga la yid ma tshims par 'do/da rngams chen po/sa yab gzhis a khu lags khas rgyag la bzhag ste/ nga tsho'i pang leb dang lcam shing sogs rdo tshad khri gcig re ba'i ca dngos dang / rwa sgreng bla brang / gro mo bla brang /sde drug bla brang / gsang ba sman stod pa bcas mi tshang bcu gnyis nas khyon rdo tshad 'bum gnyis tsam gyi ca dngos snga g.yar byas te rgya mir brtsang ste/zong dngul de dag gis rta drel brgya phrag dang / rnga mong bcu tsam nyos te rgyab cha dang bcas dza nga zodag rgya nag la btang /nyin zhig yang bskyar a mdo 'jam dbyangs kyis nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag gro khas rgyag la bzhag ste sman stod pa nas rdo tshad khri gcig lhag tsam gyi ca dngos snga g.yar 'khur/ rang nyid la bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms skyes nas zla ba gcig tsam rjes yab gzhis a khu yong ste/ dpe 35

'jig rten mthun 'jug zha5pa re btags pa las sa/zhan ca dngos gang yang med pa'i dbul po mchu gas pa sha stag red/kho pa che lha sar gnas gzhi bcas rjes nga chodas skadang lnga nas shing dbor te 'dam ra'i rgya dmag la btsong pa rin par rda yang len gyi yod/dmag sgar gyi mo nga las gasgu wa rgya dmag sna rtse gug gug gcig dang skad sgrur 'ba' pa rgya mchod yin/ de skabs lha sa'i tsho nga pa mang che ba'i tshong gi kha phyogs rgya dmag la gtad yod/ de'i nang nas a masnga 'jam dbyangs kyis rgyun dzadang la yid ma cinams par 'dod rngams chen 〈snas yab gzhis a khu lags khas rgyag la bzhag ste/ nga tsho'i pang leb dang lcam shing sogs rdo tshad khri gcig re ba'i ca dngos dang / rwa sgreng bla brang / gro mo bla brang /sde drug bla brang / gsang ba sman stod pa bcas mi tshang bcu gnyis nas khyodan rdo tshad 'bum gnyis tsam gyi ca dngos snga g.yar byas te rgya mir btsong ste/hrūng dngul de dag gis rta drel brgya phrag dang / rnga mong bcu tsam nyos te rgyab cha dang bcas cho nga rwateg rgya nag la btang /nyin zhig yang bskyar a mdod 'jam dbyangs kyis nga'i bza' zla bsku(da nams bag gro khas rgyag la bzhag ste sman stod pa nas rdo tshad khri gcig lhag tsam gyi ca dngos snga g.yar 'khur/ rang nyid la bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'joḍams skyes nas zla ba gcig tsam rjes yab gzhis a khu yong ste/ dpe 35

36 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bsags 'dug rgya mis 'jam dbyangs kyi dza nga khro ga rnams khrims 'gal red ces/ lam bar tshong zog dang rta drel tshang ma 'phrog pa ma zad/ 'jam dbyangs bzung bar yong bas lha sar nyen gasku la ched gab yod pa dang /'jam dbyangs kyis bskur ba'i me mda' sgo rag gcig dang rda yang lnga brgya nga tshor sprad de bu lon sprod thabs med pas 'jam dbyangs kyi khyim na rta drel kha shas yodad pa blang bar nog bshad de nga'i bza' zla khrid/dgong dro bza' zla tshur sku nga nas bshad don/ bun bdag tshang ma bstodang pa'i dbus 'jam dbyangs kyi bza' zla sems sdug gis brgyal grabs byed bzhin/ rta drel rgan gog brgyad tsam dang phan mi thodags pa'i ca dngos mang po zhig sdeb spung brgyab nas bgo bsha' sgyu bas bshad kyang / nga chog bun bdag tshang mas gros bsdur byas nas skad sgyur glas te si ling pu'u la zhu gtugs brgyag rgyu byas pa yin zer/nyin shas nas skad sgyur bud med bkra g.yang khrid nas si ling pu'u gi cad 'gram dmag dalnga na zhig dang sku srung ba zhig thug nas bun bdag rnams kyis de'i skor dris/ dmag dpon gyis nga tshos ca dngos nyos pa las 'phrog med pa ma zad/ rin bab kyang cha tshang sprad zin/ zhes bshad/ bun bdag rnams kyis u tshugs kyis dngul slog dgos pa'i rtsod gleng byas pas/dmag dasnga na des kha ya ma byas par 'o/ga phyin/36

ca rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bsags 'dug rgya mis 'jam dbyangs kyi tshongang zog rnams khrims 'gal red ces/ lam bar tshong zog dang rta drel tshang ma 'phrog pa ma zad/ 'jam dbyangs bzung bar yong bas lha sar nyen g.yol ched gab yod pa dang /'jam dbyangs kyis bskur ba'i me mda' sgo rag gcig dang rda yang lnga brgya nga tshor sprad de bu lon sprod thabs med pas 'jam dbyangs kyi khyim na rta drel kha shas yod pa blang bar shog bshad de nga'i bza' zla khrid/dgong dro bza' zla tshur yong nas bshad don/ bun bdag tshang ma bskong pa'i dbus 'jam dbyangs kyi bza' zla sems sdug gis brgyal grabs byed bzhin/ rta drel rgan gog brgyad tsam dang phan mi thogs pa'i ca dngos mang po zhig sdeb spung brgyab nas bgo bsha' rgyobs bshad kyang / nga cho bun bdag tshang mas gros bsdur byas nas skad sgyur glas te si ling bu'u la zhu gtugs brgyag rgyu byas pa yin zer/nyin shas nas skad sgyur bud med bkra g.yang khrid nas si ling pu'u gi sgo 'gram dmag dpon zhig dang sku srung ba zhig thug nas bun bdag rnams kyis de'i skor dris/ dmag dpon gyis nga tshos ca dngos nyos pa las 'phrog med pa ma zad/ rin bab kyang cha tshang sprad zin/ zhes bshad/ bun bdag rnams kyis u tshugs kyis dngul sgog dgos pa'i rtsod gleng byas pas/dmag dpon des kha ya ma byas par 'o/ga phyin/36

'jig rten mthun 'jug 7zla ba gnyis tsam rjes a mdo gnyis kyis 'jam dbyangs bu lon sgod thabs med pas dug btung nas rang shi brgyab 'dug phung po klu sbug rgya sgo'i 'gram yod pa bun bdag tshang ma yid ches pa'i ched yong rogs zhes khungs so sor lan bskyal bas/ bun bdag rnams g.yas su 'dzoms pa dang g.yon du 'jam dbyangs kyis nye 'brel rnams 'dzoms/ de'i dbus ras dkar po zhig gis bkab pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi phung po dbor yong /nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag gros mnyam du khrid pa'i bkra g.yang gis khebs ras cung phye skabs 'jam dbyangs dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gags med pa mthong bas 'drogs/ tshul de bza' zla bsod nams bag gros mthong ste bkra g.yang la gsang dgos pa'i brda sprad/ gzhan rnams la dogs pa tsam ma byung bar gdong nag rog ger rang khyim so sor mi log thabs med red/bza' zla dang bkra g.yang khyim du 'byor te bkra g.yang gis tang sang pa'i sgo nas 'jam dbyangs kyis shi rdzu btab 'dug ces dang / bza' zla bsod nam/sa bag gros bkra g.yang la khyed kyis yun tsam ma gtogs zing chen po zhig basbangs so/ lar 'jam dbyangs gson po yin yang bun rag rgyu med pa gsal po red ces kho gnyis rtsod gleng byas/ bun bdag tshos bun btang ba'i rdo tshad re nas srang gang re bsdus te gnad don de rgya bod zung sbrel la kha mazu btsugs/37

'jig rten mthun 'jug zha7zla ba gnyis tsam rjes a mdo gnyis kyis 'jam dbyangs bu lo na sprod thabs med pas dug btung nas rang shi brgyab 'dug phung po klu sbug rgya sgo'i 'gram sku da pa bun bdag tshang ma yid ches pa'i ched sku/nga mo gas zhes khungs so sor lan bskyal bas/ bun bdag rnams g.yas su 'jomams pa dang g.yodan du 'jam dbyangs kyis nye 'brel rnams 'dzoms/ de'i dbus ras dkar po zhig gis bkab pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi phung po dbor yong /nga'i bza' zla bamo da nams bag blo sa mnyam du khrid pa'i bkra g.yang gis khebs ras cung phye skabs 'jam dbyangs dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gags med pa mthodang bas 'aX gas/ tshul de bza' zla bso/da nams bag bo sa mthodang ste bkra g.yang la gsang dbosgos pa'i brda sprad/ gzhan rnams la nge gas pa tsam ma byung bar gdong nag rog ger rang khyim so sor mi log thabs med red/bza' zla dang bkra g.yang khyim du 'byor te bkra g.yang gis hang sang pa'i stod nas 'jam dbyangs kyis shi rdzu btab 'dug ces dang / bza' zla bseged nam/sa bag 〈snas bkra g.yang la khyed kyis yun tsam ma galta gas zing chen wa zhig bslangs so// lar 'jam dbyangs gso/na wa yin yang bun rag rgyu med pa gsal po red ces kho gnyis rtsod gleng byas/ bun bdag tshos bun btang ba'i rdo tshad re nas srang gang re bsdus te gnad don de rgya bod zung sbrel la kha mchu btsugs/37

38 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nga tsho'i rdo tshad khri gcig lhag tsam a mdo 'jam dbyangs la kha bslus cadar zhing / mu ge'i steng la zla lhag ces pa'i dpe ltar/ sman stod pa'i jo lags kyis nga tshor 'jam dbyangs la btang ba'i bun nas dum bu gsum la btang ba'i cha gcig sprad dbo sa zer/ ngas jo lags thugs rjes gzigs/ nga tsho ra dngul kha gang skar ma gcig med par yang bskyar khyed tsho'i bun ji ltar sprad dbo sa sam/ zhes bshad pas/ bza' zla bsod nams bag 〈snas khas rgyag ma yin/ thegan rgyag yin/ nges par sprad kyi yin zhes lo shas ring cung zad re 'jal te dum bu gsum gyi cha gcig sprad/a mardeste 'jam dbyangs kyi che nga khro ga rgya mis 'asgyusgog pa yin nam/rkyen des 'jam dbyangs rang shi brgyab pa yin nam/ skabs de nas wa da kyi gnas bab nyin re las ma 'das par zang zing dza drag je cher gyur pas gnad dodan der gsal kha ci yang ma byung / gang ltar yang nga'i khyim gyi rgyu nor yod rgu stong la nye ba bzos te 'tsho ba'i rten gzhi ci yang med/dzamang las gnyer ba'i gnyen nye 'brel rnams kyis ma rtsa bun btang ste sngar bzhin tshong las gnyer dgos brjod kyang nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag spyod yid thang chad nas khas len ma byas par nyin ma gang 'khyol byed/tshabs che'i kha bslus cadar ba'i gnad dogen de se ra byes kyi mkhan sngo/ gtsang pa lhan grub thabs mkhas mchogeg gis mkhyen te/ dbang 'dus khang gsar 38

3 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nga tsho'i rdo tshad khri gcig lhag tsam a mdo 'jam dbyangs la kha bslus shor zhing / mu ge'i steng la zla lhag ces pa'i dpe ltar/ sman stod pa'i jo lags kyis nga tshor 'jam dbyangs la btang ba'i bun nas dum bu gsum la btang ba'i cha gcig sprad dgos zer/ ngas jo lags thugs rjes gzigs/ nga tshor dngul kha gang skar ma gcig med par yang bskyar khyed tsho'i bun ji ltar sprad dgos sam/ zhes bshad pas/ bza' zla bsod nams bag gro/sa khas rgyag ma yin/ do/na rgyag yin/ nges par sprad kyi yin zhes lo shas ring cung zad re 'jal te dum bu gsum gyi cha gcig sprad/a mdo 'jam dbyangs kyi tshong zog rgya mis 'phrog pa yin nam/rkyen des 'jam dbyangs rang shi brgyab pa yin nam/ skabs de nas bod kyi gnas bab nyin re las ma 'das par zang zing dza drag je cher gyur pas gnad don der gsal kha ci yang ma byung / gang ltar yang nga'i khyim gyi rgyu nor yod rgu stong la nye ba bzos te 'tsho ba'i rten gzhi ci yang med/tshong las gnyer ba'i gnyen nye 'brel rnams kyis ma rtsa bun btang ste sngar bzhin tshong las gnyer dgos brjod kyang nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag gro yid thang chad nas khas len ma byas par nyin ma gang 'khyol byed/tshabs che'i kha bsgus shor ba'i gnad don de se ra byes kyi mkhan po gtsang pa lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog gis mkhyen te/ dbang 'dus khang gsar 38

'jig rten mthun 'jug 39nas se ra byes kyi khang pa zhig g.yar zhing tshong las tsag tsig gnyer dgos pa'i lam ston gnang / ngas khang pa der chong rdzas yang la dang ja bag cung zad kyis 'tsho rten bzung /gnyen nye tshos bza' zlar slob gso rim pas brgyab cing lhag par grags pa bla brang phyag mdzod kyis tshong las mu mthud gnyer dgos shing khe bzang po byung na bgo rgyu dang / khe cung las med na ma rtsa gcig pu byung na chog ces rda yang do po stong sgam gnyis g.yar/ gzhi nas bza' zlas rgya gar gyi sdig rigs nyos pa dang / sa 'du tshang nas rdo tshad nyis brgya'i ja snga g.yar byas te dpyid dus shig byang phyogs su chong la thon/rab byung shing rta spyi lo 1954 zla 7 tshes 25 dbyar khar 7skyabs mgon rin po che rgya nag tu phebs te rgyal yongs mi mang mthus mi tsho gas chen la zhugs tshul rgya mis lha sa'i sgud yond rgyang grags btsugs te yang yang bshad/nga'i bza' zla tshong la thon nas bzung zla ba brgyad tsam go rgyu tshor rgyu med/ der brten spyi tshogs gang sar gleng phyogs shin tu chen po byung ba nas grags che ba ni/ shi ba dang / jag pas bcom pa/ dngul 'khyer nas bros pa red zer/ ngas mchog gsum la gsol ba smon lam btab cing nyin rtag par me+e ru rnying pa dang / dpal lha mor mjal skyems phul nas 39

'jig rten mthun 'jug 39nas se ra byes kyi khang pa zhig g.yar zhing cho nga las tsag tsig gnyer dbo sa pa'i lam ston gnang / ngas khang pa der chong rdzas yang la dang ja bag cung zad kyis 'tsho rten bzung /gnyen nye tshos bza' zlar slob gso rim pas brgyab cing lhag par grags pa bla brang phyag malnga da kyis chodang las mu mthud gnyer dathodas shing khe bzang po byung na bgo rgyu dang / khe cung las med na ma rtsa gcig pu byung na chodag ces rda yang dod wa stong sgam gnyis g.yar/ gzhi nas bza' zlas rgya gar gyi sdig rigs nyos pa dang / sa 'du tshang nas rdo tshad nyis brgya'i ja snga g.yar byas te dpyid dus shig byang phyogs su tshong la thodan/rab byung shing rta spyi lo 1954 zla 7 tshes 25 dbyar khar 7skyabs mabosten rin lnga che rgya nag tu phebs te rgyal sku(ngas mi mang mthus mi tshogs chen la zhugs tshul rgya mis lha sa'i skud sku1da rgyang grags btsugs te yang yang bshad/nga'i bza' zla chodang la thodan nas bzung zla ba brgyad tsam bo rgyu cho ra rgyu med/ der brten spyi tsho gas gang sar gleng phyo gas shin tu chen po byung ba nas grags che ba ni/ shi ba dang / jag pas bce ma pa/ dngul 'khyer nas snga sa pa red zer/ ngas mtshadag gsum la gamo la ba smon lam btab cing nyin rtag par rme ru rnying pa dang / dpal lha mor mjal skyems phul nas 39

40 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bza' zla'i ched 'phrin bcol dang smon lam bton/gnyen nye 'gas nga'i 'tsho thabs la sems 'khur gyis tshong khang thung ngu der ja khang bzung zhes bshad pa bzhin/ bzung yang mo gum par mi 'khyams rnams kyis ja btung bar bsnyad de phyi po bar sdod pa dka' ngal che/ de nas ngas ja khang slod de sngar bzhin tsag tsig gi tshong khang bzung /rang nyid kyi khyim tshang la slo bur god chags shugs chen po de 'dra ba byung ba ni ngan pa'i las byas pa min yang slo bur nyam thag pa'i gnas stangs der gzhan la ngo tsha zhing / gyon gos ci 'dra zhig gyon yang skyo ba'i snang ba 'char/nyin zhig nga skyid chu'i nye 'gram me+e ru gling kha'i bab tshugs su chab mdor 'gro mkhan yod min blta bar bskyod pas/ se ra byes kyi phyag mdzod sa 'du slo 'jigs med chab mdor phebs rtsis byed pa/ ngas a phor khyed rang gi gcung mo slong bar 'gro yi 'dug ces brjod rogs zhes bshad pas/ā bkra sha ma de 'dra ma rabs ma lab zer/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam rjes kyi nyin gung zhig nga sgog khar 'gro skabs mdun ngos nas mi skra zhug dmar po can zhig dang / gos ser po can zhig nga'i khyim gyi phyogs yong / sgug pas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang dang / drel dpon zhig red/khong gnyis nang du bsus te sne len byas/ a phos bsod nams bag gro ga par phyin nam zer/ byang la tshong rgyag par phyin nas zla ba dgu 40

40 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bza' zla'i ched 'phrin bce la dang smon lam bto/na/gnyen nye 'gas nga'i 'tsham thabs la sems 'khur gyis cho nga khang chung ngu der ja khang bzung zhes bshad pa bzhin/ bzung yang mo gum par mi 'khyams rnams kyis ja btung bar bsnyad de phyi po bar sdod pa dka' ngal che/ de nas ngas ja khang slod de sngar bzhin tsag tsig gi zong khang bzung /rang nyid kyi khyim tshang la slo bur god chags shugs chen po de 'dra ba byung ba ni ngan pa'i las byas pa min yang blo bur nyam thag pa'i gnas stangs der gzhan la ngo tsha zhing / gyodan gos ci 'dra zhig gyon yang skyo ba'i snang ba 'char/nyin zhig nga skyid chu'i nye 'gram rme ru gling kha'i bab tshugs su chab mdor 'gro mkhan sku da min blta bar bskyod pas/ se ra byes kyi phyag mdzod sa 'du blo 'jigs med chab mdor phebs rtsis byed pa/ ngas a phor khyed rang gi gcung mo slong bar 'gro yi 'dug ces brjod rogs zhes bshad pas/ā bkra sha ma de 'dra ma rabs ma lab zer/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam rjes kyi nyin gung zhig nga the ga khar 'gro skabs mdun lnga sa nas mi skra zhug dmar lnga can zhig dang / bo sa ser wa can zhig nga'i khyim gyi phyogs yong / sgug pas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang dang / drel dpon zhig red/kho nga gnyis nang du bsus te sne len byas/ a 'o/sa bse da nams bag gro ga par phyin nam zer/ byang la tshatsheng rgyag par phyin nas zla ba dgu 40

'jig rten mthun 'jug 41tsam 'das kyang bo rgyu mi 'dug bshad/ yi ge dang kha lan tsam yang ma 'acadar ram zer/ ma byung bshad pas/ ya ya da shi song le ma red dam/ bu lon ga chodad yod dam zer/ rdo tshad nyis brgya lhag tsam yodad kyang rdo tshad stodang phrag gnyis yod bshad/ nga da lta rgya gar la 'bo dgo sa pas dngul dmar lag tu thogs kyi red/ bun bdag gis phin dang ja blang na sprodad rgyu dang / ma blang yang rjes su bu 'o/na tshang ma ngas sprad chodag sems khral byed mi dbo sa zer/ de'i sang nyin gcen ngo rgya gar la thodan/41

'jig rten mthun 'jug 41tsam 'das kyang go rgyu mi 'dug bshad/ yi ge dang kha lan tsam yang ma 'byor ram zer/ ma byung bshad pas/ ya ya da shi song le ma red dam/ bu lon ga tshod yod dam zer/ rdo tshad nyis brgya lhag tsam yod kyang rdo tshad stong phrag gnyis yod bshad/ nga da lta rgya gar la 'gro dgos pas dngul dmar lag tu thogs kyi red/ bun bdag gis phin dang ja blang na sgod rgyu dang / ma blang yang rjes su bu lon tshang ma ngas sprad chog sems khral byed mi dgos zer/ de'i sang nyin gcen po rgya gar la thon/41

42 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/lja pa /byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/grags pa bla brang phyag mdzod kyis nga'i bza' zla btsal bar 'gro rgyu yin brjod pa ngas 'bri gung du a mgon bla brang dang sog sprul bla brang gi phyag mdzod gnyis la dri dgos pa'i re ba bzhin bskyod/ bza' zla 'ba' kha zer ba'i sa char kong po nas shing dbor rtsis kyi bsdad yod pa kho gnyis kyis shes kyang mi shes zhes bshad de/ gsang ba'i sgog bza' zla bsod nams bag gro'i mdun grwa pa gcig btang ste khyed rtsad gcod mkhan zhig 'byor ba bzang ngan ci yin mi shes stabs/ nga chos gsang ba byas yin bshad/ nga'i bza' zlas grwa pa der nga'i gnyen nye yin pas gsang ba byed mi dgos/mgyogs myur phar phyin nas sne len yag po zhu sogs zer/ grwa pa des rjes zin par phyin nas bsod nams bag gro 'ba' khar yod tshul dang khyim la sprod byed mar bskur byung zhes mar ril zhig sprad cing nyin shas sne len 42

42 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/:sdi pa/ byang nas 'khor me'i bza' zla/grags pa bla brang phyag malhungad kyis nga'i bza' zla btsal bar 'gro rgyu yin brdzod pa ngas 'bri gung du a mgon bla brang dang sog sprul bla brang gi phyag mdzod gnyis la dri dgos pa'i re ba bzhin bskyod/ bza' zla 'ba' kha zer ba'i sa char kong po nas shing dbor rtsis kyi bsdad yod pa kho gnyis kyis shes kyang mi shes zhes bshad de/ gsang ba'i thog bza' zla bsod nams bag gro'i mdun grwa pa gcig btang ste khyed rtsad gcadad mkhan zhig 'byedar ba bzang ngan ci yin mi shes stabs/ nga snuras gsang ba byas yin bshad/ nga'i bza' zlas grwa pa der nga'i gnyen nye yin pas gsang ba byed mi dgos/mkhyodags myur phar phyin nas sne len yag ngo zhu zodags zer/ grwa pa des rjes zin par phyin nas bsod nams bag 1ste 'ba' khar yod tshul dang khyim la sprod byed mar bskur byung zhes mar ril zhig sprad cing nyin shas sne len 42

byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/ 43gzab par byas/ zla ba phyed tsam gyi rjes grags pa bla brang gi phyag mdzod nga'i mdun yong ste bza' zla bde po yin sgor bshad byung ba sems dbus nas dga' zhing dus nam zhig 11ga gam snyam/nyin zhig gi phyi dro'i nyi ma la khar ma bzhud tsam la nga'i bza' zla dang bza' zla'i gnyen nye cog lu gu gnyis rta bzhon nas dga' spro'i ngang tshong lam 'gro byung ba'i gtam bzang dang bcas khyim du 'byor/ bza' zla byang nas 'khor nas nyin shas rjes kyi gung tshigs skabs a pho ngag dbang skal bzang rgya gar nas rta lcag sked par gzer bzhin khyim du slebs/ a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gis bza' zlar chong yag po byung ngam/ zhes dris/ ngas lam seng tshong yag po byung mi 'dug bshad/ a phos 'dis bun 'jal rogs zhes dngul blugs pa'i ras khug gcig sprad byung / ngas de tshur blangs nas yun tsam nyar rjes phar sprad nas bun tshang ma 'jal ba yin zhes bshad pas/ a 11sa nga la skyag rdzun bshad nas nyams chosad len pa yin nam zer/ nga'i a pho dngos gnas yin min brtag pas da ni dngos gnas yin pa ra 'phrod byung zhes bshad pas/ bgad cing 'o na yag po byung zhes brjod/bu tshe ring dbang phyug bde chen rab rgyas su bla phyag phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis btsugs pa'i slob grwar btang ste yon tan gyi gzhi ma yi ge sbyong ba'i 'go tshugs/ 'od zer dgon pa'i grwa pa nga'i gcung po chung ming bu 'brug 43

byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/ 43gzab par byas/ zla ba phyed tsam gyi rjes grags pa bla brang gi phyag malnga da nga'i mdun yodang ste bza' zla bde po yin skor bshad byung ba sems dbus nas dga' zhing dus nam zhig 'e1ga gam snyam/nyin zhig gi phyi dro'i nyi ma la khar ma bzhud tsam la nga'i bza' zla dang bza' zla'i gnyen nye cog lu gu gnyis rta bzhon nas dga' spro'i ngang tshong lam 'gro byung ba'i gtam bzang dang bcas khyim du 'byedar/ bza' zla byang nas 'kho ra nas nyin shas rjes kyi gung tshigs skabs a 'o/ ngag dbang skal bzang rgya gar nas rta lcag sked par gzer bzhin khyim du slebs/ a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gis bza' zlar tshong yag po byung ngam/ zhes dris/ ngas lam seng chodang yag po byung mi 'dug bshad/ a lha sa 'dis bun 'jal rogs zhes dngul blugs pa'i ras khug gcig sprad byung / ngas de tshur blangs nas yun tsam nyar rjes phar sprad nas bun tshang ma 'jal ba yin zhes bshad pas/ a 11sa nga la skyag rdzun bshad nas nyams snurd len pa yin nam zer/ nga'i a sngo dalnga sa gnas yin min brtag pas da ni dasnga sa gnas yin pa ra 'phrod byung zhes bshad pas/ bgad cing 'o na yag po byung zhes brjod/bu tshe ring dbang phyug bde chen rab rgyas su bla phyag phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis btsugs pa'i slob grwar btang ste sku na tan gyi gzhi ma yi ge lho nga ba'i 'go tshugs/ 'od zer dgon pa'i grwa pa nga'i gcung po chung ming bu 'brug 43

44 gon mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/g.yong ngam ming ngo mar blo bzang tshe ring lha sar 'byor te dpe cha shes kyi mi 'dug pas/ ser byes rgan a mchog gis kong po spo bor tshong rgyag par 'khrid pa'i khas len byas byung zhes/ nga tsho'i mdun nas rda yang do po gcig g.yar te tshong la thon te dus ring po zhig 'gor/ nyin zhig a pho ngag dbang skal bzang yar 'brog nas tshur yong skabs bu 'brug g.yong spebs sam zer/ ma song brjod pas/ mgo spar bar bkab nas dpe mi srid/ bu tha thung brlags nas zla ba bzhi tsam phyin/ shi zer na ro mi mthong ba dang /gson yod na rna thos med pa pha ma la ci bshad dgos sam zer/ sgo bor jag pa sdang zhing dug gis mi gsod skor grags che bas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang sems khral chen po byung ba red/nyin zhig bu 'brug g.yong dang kong po sgo stod nas khyo ga gcig dang a long chen po btags pa'i bud med gnyis bcas mnyam du 'byor/ a phos kong po ba der khyed tsho dug ster mkhan dang / yar btub mar btub kyi lung pa yin pas bu 'brug g.yong la nga sems khral chen po byung / zhes bshad/ mi des nga rdzong gcig gi sding dpon bkra shis yin/ yar btub mar btub ngas byed bcug mi yong / tshul min gyi spyod pa bgyis na ngas mi shes zhes bshad/ khong cho nga'i khyim du gnas tshang la bsdad de lha sar mchod 'bul rgya cher byas te rang yul du log bu 'brug g.yong yang 44

44 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/g.yong ngam ming ngo mar slo bzang tshe ring lha sar 'byor te dpe cha shes kyi mi 'dug pas/ ser byes rgan a mchodag gis bo nga lnga spo wa ra cho nga rgyag par 'khrid pa'i khas len byas byung zhes/ nga tsho'i mdun nas rda yang de ngo gcig g.yar te tshong la thon te dus ring po zhig 'gor/ nyin zhig a pho ngag dbang skal bzang yar 'awa ga nas tshur yodang skabs bu 'brug g.yong slebs sam zer/ ma song brjod pas/ mgo spar bar bkab nas dpe mi srid/ bu tha chung brlags nas zla ba bzhi tsam phyin/ shi zer na ro mi mthong ba dang /gse na yod na rna thodas med pa pha ma la ci bshad dgo sa sam zer/ spo wa ra jag pa sdang zhing dug gis mi gasku da sa ra grags che bas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang sems khral chen wa byung ba red/nyin zhig bu 'byug gasku nga dang kong po sgo stod nas khyo ga gcig dang a 'o/nga chen wa btags pa'i bud med gnyis bcas mnyam du 'byedar/ a phos kong po ba der khyed tsho dug ster mkhan dang / yar btub mar btub kyi lung pa yin pas bu 'byug gaspongang la nga sems khral chen rngege byung / zhes bshad/ mi des nga rtsodang gcig gi sding dawa na bkra shis yin/ yar btub mar btub ngas byed bcug mi yong / tshul min gyi spyodad pa bgyis na ngas mi shes zhes bshad/ lta nga tsho nga'i khyim du gnas tshang la bsdad de lha sar mchod 'bul rgya cher byas te rang yul du log bu 'brug g.yong yang 44

byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/ 45bskyar smar khams su tshong la gan nas yar gcung mo chos g.yang yang jo bo mjal bar 'khrid byung / nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag gros tshong g.yog grwa sa khag gi rdob rdob 'khrid nas 'bri gung dang / nag zu/ smar pa sogs byang phyogs 'brog yul la baspyod pa dang / spun nye'i bza' zla byams pa rnam rgyal rgya gar la bskyod rgyur ma rtsa mnyam bskur byas/ spyi lo 1955 zla 9 tshes 15 nyin bod mi mang gi spyi 'thus 'bum thang drung yig pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ a lo chos mdzad tshe ring rdo rje/ lhab phyug grags pa 'phrin las gsum gyes bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod nang sngar nas rang gi chab srid skyong tshul zhig yod pas/ rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig lhan tshogs mi dgos zhes sogs bod rgya gzhung gnyis shar yi ge phul ba dang / spyi lo 1956lha ldan spon lam chen mo'i skabs lha sa'i grong khyer nang sbyar yig dang /yig skyur du ma thon rkyen rgya dmar nas bka' shag tu zhu bskul gyis mi mang 'thus mi gong gsal gsum la dogs pa byas te/ khong gsum phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab dang lag sbrel yod tshul snyad 'dogs kyis bod gzhung skor srung ba'i dmag sgar du do dam btson bcug byas/ lhab phyug can btson nang 'das pa dang / gzhan gnyis gdan sa gsum nas rgyab gnyer snyan zhu gnang ste slod bkrol gnang /45

byang nas 'khor ba'i bza' zla/ 45bskyar smar khams su tshadang la thon nas yar gcung mo chodas g.yang yang rdzo bo mjal bar 'khrid byung / nga'i bza' zla bamo da nams bag bostos chodang g.yog grwa sa khag gi rdob shodab 'khrid nas 'bri gung dang / nag chu/ smar pa sogs byang phyogs 'brog yul la bskyod pa dang / spun nye'i bza' zla byams pa rnam rgyal rgya gar la bskyod rgyur ma rtsa mnyam bskur byas/ spyi 'o/ 1955 zla 9 tshes 15 nyin bod mi mang gi spyi 'thus 'bum thang drung yig pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ a lo chos mdzad tshe ring rdo rje/ lhab phyug grags pa 'phrin las gsum gyis wa da kyi rgyal sa lha sar wa da nang sngar nas rang gi chab srid skyong tshul zhig sku da pas/ rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig lhan tshogs mi dgo sa zhes sogs nge da rgya gzhung gnyis kar yi ge phul ba dang / spyi 'o/ 1956lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs lha sa'i hrong khyer nang sbyar yig dang /yig skyur du ma sgyu na rkyen rgya dmar nas bka' shag tu zhu bskul gyis mi mang 'thus mi gong gsal gsum la ro/gas pa byas te/ kho nga gsum phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab dang lag sbrel mo da tshul snyad 'awa gas kyis bod gzhung skor srung ba'i dmag sgar du do dam btson bcug byas/ lhab phyug can btson nang 'das pa dang / gzhan gnyis gdan sa gsum nas rgyab gnyer snyan zhu gnang ste glo da bkre la gnang /45

45 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/drug pa /rgyal spung g.yul 'gyed /rje btsun phun tshogs sgrol dkar//bco lnga'i dung zla 'dra yang //phyag la reg dgos byung na//lcags kyi lab rdar 'dra byung //zhes pa'i gzhas tshig de ni nga'i grogs mo phun tshogs sgol dkar la tshe spon gling grwa pas brtsams pa'i zur za'i gzhas tshig red/ phun tshogs sgol dkar gye pha tshe smon gling grwa log chos mdzad lags yin pa dang khong gi bu mo rgan par mtshams gcod zer/ khong tsho'i khyim tshang gi tshos khang bzung yod pas phun chogs sgrol dkar mtshar sdug bkra ba lha mo bzhin yin yang tshos las byed dgos pas gzhas tshig de byung ba red/ chos mdzad lags dang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis gnyis sbag rogs kyi 'brel ba zab 46

4snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/drug pa/rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/rje btsun phun tshogs sgrol dkar//bco lnga'i dung zla 'dra yang //phyag la reg dgos byung na//lcags kyi lab rdar 'dra byung //zhes pa'i gzhas tshig de ni ngaci'i grogs mo phun tshogs sgrol dkar la tshe smon gling grwa pas brtsams pa'i zur za'i gzhas tshig red/ phun tshogs sgrol dkar gyi pha tshe smon gling grwa 'o/ga chothos mdzad lags yin pa dang kho nga gi bu mo rgan par mtshams gcod zer/ khong tsho'i khyim tshang gi chodas khang bzung sku da pas phun tshogs sgrol dkar mtshar sdug bkra ba lha mo bzhin yin yang cho sa las byed dgos pas gzhas tshig de byung ba red/ chodas mdzad lags dang a 'brug mabothon 〈sna bkra shis gnyis sbag gro gas kyi 'brel ba zab 46

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 47pas rjes su lo khyad nyi shu tsam yod pa'i phun tshogs sgol dkar dang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis gnyis bza' tshor gyur/ nga'i khyim tshang dang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis bar gyi 'brel ba yong stangs kyang de 'dra zhig red/'dzam gling spyi bsang skabs nga gnyis nyin gcig spa phrug sogs btags te dbus chas rgya na/ yang nyin zhig khams chas spras nas 'gro yi yod/ nga yang thung nas lha sar 'byor bas mi rnams kyis skyes khungs ji yin mi shes par kha shas kyis nga gnyis khams pa yin pa dang / kha shas kyi dbus pa red zer/ skabs der nga'i a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gis chab mdor tshong gi rten gzhi bzung nas tshong g.yog pad+ma thang dang / blo bzang gnyis la kha che sha skam dang / zu tshod wa si krin dang ro dmar sogs bskur nas rgya nag tu tshong la 'gro skabs rgya mis nag tshorang red ces 'dzin bzung byas/dang po tshong bdag su yin ngos len byas med kyang mjug tu chab mdor a pho ngag dbang skal bzang la kha par btang ste 'brel ba byas pas a pho yang chab mdor bkag nyar byas par brten/ chab mdo u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid 'phags pa lha'i gcen po sras po dbang 'dus dang / sde dge sras cha dang mda' dpon skal bzang dbang 'dus/ zhi ba lha/ sgom mda' stobs rgyal bcas kyis a pho btson khang nas slod dgos zhes btson 47

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 47pas rjes su lo khyad nyi shu tsam yod pa'i phun tshogs sgrol dkar dang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis gnyis bza' cho ra gyur/ nga'i khyim tshang dang a 'byug mgon po bkra shis bar gyi 'brel ba yong stangs kyang de 'dra zhig red/'dzam gling spyi bsang skabs nga gnyis nyin gcig spa phrug sogs btags te dbus chas gyodan/ yang nyin zhig khams chas spras nas 'bo yi yod/ nga yang chung nas lha sar 'byedar bas mi rnams kyis skyes khungs ji yin mi shes par kha shas kyis nga gnyis khams pa yin pa dang / kha shas kyi dbus pa red zer/ skabs der nga'i a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gis chab mdor tshong gi rten gzhi bzung nas mong g.yog pad+ma thang dang / blo bzang gnyis la kha che sha skam dang / chu phyod wa si krin dang ro dmar sogs bskur nas rgya nag tu cesang la 'alhatho skabs rgya mis nag ce nga red ces 'dzin bzung byas/dang po chong bdag su yin ngos len byas med kyang mjug tu chab mdor a pho ngag dbang skal bzang la kha par btang ste 'brel ba byas pas a pho yang chab mdor bkag nyar byas par brten/ chab mdod u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid 'phags pa lha'i gcen po sras po dbang 'dus dang / sde dge sras cha dang mda' dpon skal bzang dbang 'dus/ zhi ba lha/ spom mda' lha bas rgyal bcas kyis a pho btson khang nas glod dgos zhes btson 47

48 na mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khang sgo 'gram nyin bzhi ngo rgol byas/ rgya mis kha che sha skam dug yin pa dang zu tshod la khral brgyab mi 'dug ces bshad par khong tshos ngag dbang skal bzang las ngan byed pa'i mi min yang / gnad don yod tshe lha sar rgya bod zung 'brel la gtugs dgos/ zhes bshad de nyin bco lnga nas slod/me bya spyi lo 1957 zla 5 tshes 20 nyin a 'brug mgon po bkra rishis kyis gtsos khams rigs chos 7gong sa mchog la gser khri phul ba dang lha sar bstan srung dang blang dmag gsar 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa 'dra/skyes pa rnams la brel zing zhig tshugs shing / nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag gro sbag rtse bar 'gro yi yin zhes phyi 'gro yang yang byed/ 'od zer rin po che yang rgya gar nas tshur phebs byung ba dbu skra sor gsum tsam bzhag pa dang skya chas bzhes kyang / skyabs rje yongs 'dzin khri byang rin po che'i sku mdun bcar skabs dbu skra breg cing grwa chas bzhes nas phebs kyi 'dugade rjes dus yun gang mtshams nas bza' zla bsod nams bag gros nga la rgya rgol ched dmag la chas dgos skor bshad nas mal gro chum zla nas nga tsho'i rta drel bsgong/ zla ba gcig gi rjes gcung po 'brug g.yong dang nga gnyis kyis a pho ngag dbang skal bzang la kha par btang ste khams bde dris shing / gcung pos a pho bsod nams bag gro dang nga tsho 'grul pa thon grabs yod ces bshad/ kho gnyis ma thug par lo gnyis phyin pas a pho ngag dbang 48

48 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khang sgo 'gram nyin bzhi lnga lha la byas/ rgya mis kha che sha skam dug yin pa dang chu chodad la khral brgyab mi 'dug ces bshad par khong cho sa ngag dbang skal bzang las ngan byed pa'i mi min yang / gnad don sku da tshe lha sar rgya bod zung 'brel la gtugs dgo sa/ zhes bshad de nyin bco lnga nas slod/me bya spyi 'o/ 1957 zla 5 tshes 20 nyan a 'brug mabo na wa bkra shis kyis gcesas khams rigs snu sa 7bo nga sa mchothog la gser khri phul ba dang lha sar bstan srung dang blang dmag gsar 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa 'dra/skyes pa rnams la brel zing zhig tshugs shing / nga'i bza' zla bso/da nams bag gro sbag rtse bar 'gro yi yin zhes phyi 'gro yang yang byed/ 'od zer rin po che yang rgya gar nas tshur phebs byung ba dbu skra sor gsum tsam bzhag pa dang skya chas bzhes kyang / skyabs rje yongs 'dzin khri byang rin po che'i sku mdun bcar skabs dbu skra breg cing grwa chas bzhes nas phebs kyi 'dugade rjes dus yun gang mtshams nas bza' zla ba11da nams bag 11sa nga la rgya cadal ched dmag la chas dbo sa skor bshad nas mal bosgo chum zla nas nga tsho'i rta drel bsgong/ zla ba gcig gi rjes gcung po 'brug g.yong dang nga gnyis kyis a sgyu ngag dbang skal bzang la kha par btang ste khams bde dris shing / gcung snga sa a sgyu bsdudad nams bag lha dang nga ཿtsho 'grul pa thon grabs yod ces bshad/ kho gnyis ma thug par 'o/ gnyis phyin pas a 'o/ ngag dbang 48

rgyal srung gaṣa/la 'gyed/ 49skal bzang gis nga skug ces bshad kyang kho chod lnga na pa'i dus zin pas cadad zer rin po che'i sku mdun thon mjal la bcar skabs/ 'od zer rin po ches gcung po 'brug gamo nga la sha nye ral gri 'doms pa bco brgyad dang sta gri zla ba leb chen 'khyer yod dam/ zhes ku re gnang / bza' zla bsod nams bag gror thung mda' gcig dang ring mda' gcig yodad pa dang / bu 'brug gasku nga la me mda' sbed rag gcig dang thung mda' gcig yod/de skabs rgya dmag gis ku ru zam par srung bya bzhag sku da pas gsang ba'i thog thon dgos rkyen/ gcen mo'i bza' zla bu slo gros rgya rong nang gi chu lung gzhis kar thengs mang phebs kyi yod pas kho nga la dodags gnas chung khyad kho nga gis masnuman cha rnams za chas yin khul rta drel brgyad la bkal nas nyi ma 'char tsam la bung bu ba rnams dang mnyam ku ru zam pa brgal zhing / bza' zla bse da nams bag gro dang bu 'brug g.yong / dzadas g.yang bcas rta re bzlo na nas rjes su phyin/kho cho lha khari rten gzhi bcas rjes dang blang dmag rnams la lha zhig dbo sa pa dang dus mtshungs mal lha gung dkar nas lo so/ bzhi tsam yin pa'i dpa' bo khro 'bar gyi rten khog gsar pa zhig lha sar 'byor/ 'od zer rin po ches rtsa sgo dbye rgyur 'od zer bla brang du gus mo 'od zer rin po che'i spun nye yin pas mthodan 'aro/da bzhin bcar skabs/ bla brang gi 'khyam rar 49

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 49skal bzang gis nga sgug ces bshad kyang kho tsho thon pa'i dus zin pas 'od zer rin po che'i sku mdun thon mjal la bcar skabs/ 'od zer rin po ches gcung po 'brug g.yong la sha nye ral gri 'doms pa bco brgyad dang sta gri zla ba leb chen 'khyer yod dam/ zhes ku re gnang / bza' zla bsod nams bag gror thung mda' gcig dang ring mda' gcig yod pa dang / bu 'brug g.yong la me mda' sgo rag gcig dang thung mda' gcig yod/de skabs rgya dmag gis ku ru zam par srung bya bzhag yod pas gsang ba'i thog thon dgos rkyen/ gcen mo'i bza' zla bu blo gros rgya rong nang gi zu lung gzhis shar zengs mang phebs kyi yod pas khong la dogs gnas zung khyad khong gis mtshon cha rnams za chas yin khul rta drel brgyad la bkal nas nyi ma 'char tsam la bung bu ba rnams dang mnyam ku ru zam pa brgal zhing / bza' zla bsod nams bag gro dang bu 'brug g.yong / chos g.yang bcas rta re bzhon nas rjes su phyin/kho tsho sto khar rten gzhi bcas rjes dang blang dmag rnams la lha zhig dgos pa dang dus mtshungs mal gro gung dkar nas lo so bzhi tsam yin pa'i dpa' bo khro 'bar gyi rten khog gsar pa zhig lha sar 'byor/ 'od zer rin po ches rtsa sgo dbye rgyur 'od zer bla brang du gus mo 'od zer rin po che'i spun nye yin pas mgron 'bod bzhin bcar skabs/ bla brang gi 'khyam rar 49

50 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bstan srung dang blang dmag la 'gro mkhan smar khams pa mi phos bskor ba'i dbus lha khog la khri mtho po zhig dang / cung dma' tsam la 'od zer rin po cher khri zhig bsgron/ g.yas g.yon dge 'dun pa bcus zhal 'don mdzad cing / lha khog gi khri'i g.yas zur na 'od zer dgon pa'i gra log 'phrin las kyis rnga rdung gin dpa' bo khro 'bar gyi rtsa sngags drag tu bton skabs lha khog yang yang a stong brgyab/ bud med gus mo las med pas zur zhig tu nyam zung gis bsdad/gang mtshams nas 'od zer rin po ches mchod 'bru lha khog la gtor ba de ma thag lha khog hob langs kyis ki sgra dang bcas sged pa'i dpa' dam shub nas phyungs/ shur sgra drag tu 'don zhing nga'i mthong snang la shub tor gyur pa mthong / g.yas g.yon mi rnams 'ur thing nger bros pa nga yang zhed de phyi bltas med par bros nas choms chen gyi 'og shod du srebs skabs yar shog ces rgyab nas 'bod pa phyir lta skabs rgan 'phrin las rnga yu lag tu bzung bzhin nga'i rjes ded nas yong / bskyar log gis bla brang gi 'khyam rar 'dzul skabs dpa' bo khro 'bar 'od zer rin po cher sku phyag 'bul bzhin 'dug nga la der tshogs mi rnams kyis nam rgyun slo khog che mdog byed mkhan dus de ring zhabs 'dren zhus so / / zhes rtsed mtshar byed/50

5༷ rgan rerware ma bce sa drang gtam/bstan srung dang blang dmag la 'bo mkhan smar khams pa mi 'o/sa bskor ba'i dbus lha khog la khri mtho po zhig dang / cung dma' tsam la 'od zer rin wa cher khri zhig balha na/ g.yas gasku/na dge 'dun pa bcus zhal 'don mdzad cing / lha khog gi khri'i g.yas zur na 'od zer dgon pa'i grwa log 'phrin las kyis rnga rdung gin dpa' nge lnga 'bar gyi rtsa sngags drag tu bto/na skabs lha kho ga yang yang a stong brgyab/ bud med gus mo las med pas zur zhig tu nyam chung gis bsdad/gang mtshams nas so/da zer rin wa ches mchodad 'byu lha kho ga la gto/ra ba de ma thag lha kho ga ho ba langs kyis ki sgra dang bcas sged pa'i dpa' dam shub nas phyungs/ shur sgra drag tu 'dorme/ zhing nga'i mthong stsang la shub to/ra gyur pa mthodang / g.yas g.yon mi rnams 'ur thing nger bros pa nga yang zhed de phyi bltas med par spradas nas chodams chen gyi 'o/ga shod du slebs skabs yar cadag ces rgyab nas 'angeted pa phyir lta skabs rgan 'phrin las rnga yu lag tu bzung bzhin nga'i rjes ded nas yong / bskyar log gis bla brang gi 'khyam rar 'dzul skabs dpa' bo khro 'bar 'od zer rin po cher sku phyag 'bul bzhin 'dug nga la der zogs mi rnams kyis nam rgyun lho kho ga che mawa ga byed mkhan dus de ring zhabs 'dren zhus so / / zhes rtsed mtshar byed/50

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 51'od zer bla brang nas lha chas tshang ma bzos nas bstan srung dang blang dmag gi ched lho khar btang zhing / nga tshos rme ru gling kha'i 'khris kyi shar phyogs su rten khang zhig brgyab ste/ rgyun sdod 'phrin bskul ba grwa pa gnyis bzhag rten mkhar nas rtags mtshan ya ma zung sna tshorags byung bas bod rgya gnyis dmag rgyag gi yod med dang / rgyal pham ji byung rten mkhar la brtag pa byed pa'i dus shig byung / gal te bod dmag pham skabs rten mkhar gyi nye mkhris nas mtshan gang zug ngu'i sgra dang ro drud kyi yod pa'i sgra zhig thos/ de rjes nyin zhig grwa pa gnyis kyis deng dus rten mkhar sngar las 'tshub cha cher song bas zhed nas sdod mi thub tshul brjod par lha skyabs mgon po zhes pa'i bla rgan zhig ston par btang / lto khar yang dpa' bo khro 'bar la lung brtag thig po dang 'ga' dog sar thog phebs brgyab ste 'phrin las myur po yod sgor thos/bza' zla dang gcung po dmag sar thon nas zla ba gnyis rjes a pho ngag dbang skal bzang lha sar 'byor/ rjes su nga dang a pho rab rgyas kyi bza' zla bsam gtan dbang mos bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin pa'i mi rnams kyi ched gnas zung la lung bstan zhu bar phyin te/ gnas zung dgon par mang ja dang sku 'gyed bcas phul nas lung zhu skabs gnas chung gis don gyi bdag po sku phyar 'gal rkyen med ces brang khog la thengs 51

rgyal srung gaX/la 'gyed/ 51'od zer bla brang nas lha chas tshang ma bzos nas bstan srung dang blang dmag gi ched lho khar btang zhing / nga tshos rme ru gling kha'i 'khris kyi shar phyogs su rten khang zhig brgyab ste/ rgyun sde da 'phrin bskul ba grwa pa gnyis bzhag rten mkhar nas rtags mtshan ya ma zung sna snumags byung bas bod rgya gnyis dmag rgyag gi sku da med dang / rgyal pham ji byung rten mkhar la brtag pa byed pa'i dus shig byung / gal te wa da dmag pham skabs rten mkhar gyi nye mkhris nas mtshan gang zug ngu'i sgra dang ro drud kyi yod pa'i sgra zhig thos/ de rjes nyin zhig grwa pa gnyis kyis deng dus rten mkhar sngar las 'tshub cha cher so/nga bas zhed nas spyodad mi thub tshul brtsodad par lha skyabs mgon the zhes pa'i bla rgan zhig snon par btang / lho khar yang dpa' cad kho 'bar la lung brtag thig po dang 'ga' dodag sar thog phebs brgyab ste 'phrin las myur po yod skor thos/bza' zla dang gcung po dmag sar thon nas zla ba gnyis rjes a pho ngag dbang skal bzang lha sar 'gyor/ rjes su nga dang a pho rab rgyas kyi bza' zla bsam gtan dbang mo sa bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin pa'i mi rnams kyi ched gnas chung la lung bstan zhu bar phyin te/ gnas chung dgon par mang ja dang sku 'gyed bcas phul nas lung zhu skabs gnas chung gis dodan gyi bdag po'i sku phywar 'gal rkyen med ces brang khog la thengs 51

52 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'ga' thug tsam re zhus nas sku yal/ bsam gtan dbang mo sa slol ma chodas 'dzodams/ lha 'di ci red/yud tsam nas yal song zer/ lha gzhan zhig la lung zhu skabs drag po'i sbyin sreg glugs dathodas bshad pas nga cho dmag mi'i 'brel sku/da rnams kyis drag po'i sbyin sreg la dbo sa pa'i rnga mo nga gi mabo dang / wa mo'i mgo / spyang ki'i mgo/ khyi mgo/ ze ma ra mgo 'bum/ ram pa/ rtsa ku sha sogs 'bad pas bsgrubs te/ rgyud pa lha da smad cig nas dge 'dun brgyad grwa gdan drangs/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis nyin gnyis tsam sgrub gzhag gnang nas drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad/da dung ngas dgra lha'i dpung skyed byed rgyal mtshan rtse mo dang / rje btsun lha la ma/ rlung rta bcas par shing blta sa shing par brgyab nas ri mtho sar rlung rta btang / bod spyi don ched du rlung rta gaho nga mkhan gzhan yang du ma 'dug de rjes rgyud smad pa'i dge 'dun pa bcu gsum gdan drangs nas gdugs dkar gto/ra chen brgyab pa dang / brag yab chung tshang rin wa cher mo sdi zhus te 'bras spungs gung ru khang tshan gyi zhe ṭam bla mas dbus dge 'dun pa nyer gsum gdan drangs nas lha la ma 'bum ther bsags pa bcas bgyis/dus shig de mo rin po ches g.yog po zhig nga 'bod par btang 52

52 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'ga' thug tsam re zhus nas sku yal/ bsam gtan dbang pos sgrol ma chos 'dzoms/ lha 'di ci red/yud tsam nas yal song zer/ lha gzhan zhig la lung zhu skabs drag po'i sbyin sreg blugs dgos bshad pas nga sto dmag mi'i 'brel yod rnams kyis drag po'i sbyin sreg la dgos pa'i rnga mong gi mgo dang / wa mo'i mgo/ spyang ki'i mgo/ khyi mgo/ ze ma ra mgo 'bum/ ram pa/ rtsa ku sha sogs 'bad pas bsgrubs te/ rgyud pa stod smad cig nas dge 'dun brgyad grwa gdan drangs/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyis nyin gnyis tsam sgrub gzhag gnang nas drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad/da dung ngas dgra lha'i dpung skyed byed rgyal mtshan rtse mo dang / rje btsun sgol ma/ rlung rta bcas par shing brkos shing par brgyab nas ri mtho sar rlung rta btang / bod spyi don ched du rlung rta gtong mkhan gzhan yang du ma 'dug de rjes rgyud smad pa'i dge 'dun pa bcu gsum gdan drangs nas gdugs dkar gtor chen brgyab pa dang / brag yab khrung tshang rin po cher mo phya zhus te 'bras spungs gung ru khang tshan gyi zhe ṭam bla mas dbus dge 'dun pa nyer gsum gdan drangs nas sgrol ma 'bum ther bsags pa bcas bgyis/dus shig de mo rin po ches g.yog po zhig nga 'bod par btang 52

rgyal srung gaX/la 'gyed/ 53gnang ba bzhin phar bcar stabs rin lnga ches nga la yi ge zhig gnang nas/bsod nams bag thod lha khar bstan srung dang blang dmag gi 'o/gas dalnga na yin pa dang / da dung jo lags spel zur ba dang / dga' ldan rgan nyi ma / smar khams pa mgo krag bcas kyang phogs dngo na red gsungs/ yi ge'i nang yang kho cho tshang ma bde wa yin tshul 'kho da/ de'i la/na ngas bshad nas rin po che'i gsol dpon chos 'phel gyis bris te bskur rgyur mngags/ de rjes bza' zla'i yi ge lha sar sku da pa'i lha rgya ri'i gzim shag brgyud 'byor yang ngas yi ge mi shes pas nga'i khyim mtshes chab malnga ba dga' rdi ra gyis skru ga gi yod/ nyin zhig khyim mtshes a cag g.yu sgron nga'i nang 'byedar te sgrol ma chos 'dzoms nga de ring ba ma rir bsang btang bar 'gro skabs/ rgya mi'i dmag sgar nas rgya sgyu gas za mkhan rnams dga' snang chen lnga sa sku nga / de'i dbus nga tsho'i khyim mtshes dga' rdor yang 'dug pas gzab gzab byed dgos bcadad byung bas ngas kyang de nas bzung gzab gzab byas pa yin/nga'i bza' zla bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin nas zla ba dgu 'das pa'i rjes gus mo dang / drel dpon rta mgrin/ bza' zla'i spun nye shes rab mcho mo bcas 'bri gung du rta bachodan nas bu 'o/na ded par phyin/'bri gung mthil du me mda' 'khyer ba'i rta pa lnga tsam dang 'phrad de/ wa ye / nag mo ham pa chen ngo khyed mar babs lha ga nga chom bstan srung 53

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 53gnang ba bzhin phar bcar sgabs rin pon ches nga la yi ge zhig gnang nas/bsod nams bag gro lho khar bstan srung dang blang dmag gi phogs dpon yin pa dang / da dung jo lags spel zur ba dang / dga' ldan rgan nyi ma / smar khams pa mgo krag bcas kyang phogs dpon red gsungs/ yi ge'i nang yang kho tsho tshang ma bde po yin tshul 'khod/ de'i 'a/na ngas bshad nas rin po che'i gsol dpon chos 'phel gyis bris te bskur rgyur mngags/ de rjes bza' zla'i yi ge lha sar yod pa'i lha rgya ri'i gzim shag brgyud 'byor yang ngas yi ge mi shes pas nga'i khyim mtshes chab mdo ba dga' rdor gyis klog gi yod/ nyin zhig khyim mtshes a cag g.yu sgon nga'i nang 'byor te sgrol ma chos 'dzoms nga de ring ba ma rir bsang btang bar 'gro skabs/ rgya mi'i dmag sgar nas rgya phogs za mkhan rnams dga' snang chen pos yong / de'i dbus nga tsho khyim mtshes dga' rdor yang 'dug pas gzab gzab byed dgos brjod byung bas ngas kyang de nas bzung gzab gzab byas pa yin/nga'i bza' zla bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin nas zla ba dgu 'das pa'i rjes gus mo dang / drel dpon rta mgrin/ bza' zla'i spun nye shes rab mtsho mo bcas 'bri gung du rta bzhon nas bu lon ded par phyin/'bri gung mthil du me mda' 'khyer ba'i rta pa lnga tsam dang 'phrad de/ wa ye / nag mo ham pa chen po khyed mar babs shog nga tshong bstan srung 53

55 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/dang blang dmag gis sdug dka' las tshad med brgyab kyang / khyod rta bzhon te snang ba skyid po/ rdzig nyams kyis g.yog 'khrid cing / tshong zog bkal ba'i drel ded ces/ skya chas spras pa'i grwa pa zhig gis nga la thung mda'i so kha sprad byung /ngas zu bzhi sgang drug shog khag ga nas yin nam/ dris pas/ thu'i/mar bobs zhes ngar ngar byed/ rgyab tu yod pa'i skya bo zhig gis de 'dra byed nyan le ma red zer/ ngas sha btsos long yod na chos long yod/ khyed cho gang gi 'og yin nam/ zhes nan gyis dris pas/ pho gsar zhig gis nga tsho a 'brug mgon po bkra shis kyi shog yin brjod/ ngas a 'brug mgon po bkra shis deng dus gang du yod dam/ lo ga tshod yin nam dris pas/ ri 'di'i rgyab la yod cing lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad yin zer/ shes rab mtsho mos a cag mar bab rogs zhes brjod pa ngas rta mgrin dang g.yog mor khyed tsho sge breg gi red bsams nas zhed kyi 'dug gam/ nga babs kyi min ga re bya rgyu yod/ da bar khams pas tshul min byed kyi 'dug ces stong gsum skad kyis chod pa khyed tsho red/ zhes bshad pas/ drel dpon rta mgrin gyes nga ni g.yog po yin/ kho rang ni sbyin bdag red/ zla bo zu bzhi sgang drug gi phogs dpon red ces bshad mtshams ngas kha btsum lab kyang skad cha mang che ba bshad tshar/ de'i dkyil mi gte po zhig gis/ cung snying tsam ngang 54

54 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/dang blang dmag gis sdug dka' las tshad med brgyab kyang / khyodad rta bzhon te snang ba skyid po/ rdzig nyams kyis g.yodag 'khrid cing / tshong zog bkal bo'i drel ded ces/ skya chas spras pa'i grwa pa zhig gis nga la thung mda'i sa kha sprad byung /ngas chu bzhi sgang drug sna ga khag ga nas yin nam/ dris pas/ thu'e/mar bobs zhes ngar ngar byed/ rgyab tu yod pa'i skya bo zhig gis de 'dra byed nyan le ma red zer/ ngas sha btsos long yod na tshos long yodad/ khyed chos gang gi rtsosgo/ga yin nam/ zhes nan gyis dris pas/ 'og gsar zhig gis nga chos a 'byug mabo na sngag bkra shis kyi 〈snag yin brjod/ ngas a 'brug mgon po bkra shis deng dus gang du yod dam/ lo ga chodad yin nam dris pas/ ri 'di'i rgyab la yod cing 'o/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad yin zer/ shes rab mchod mo sa a cag mar bab rogs zhes brjod pa ngas rta mgrin dang g.yog mo ra khyed chog ske breg gi red bsams nas zhed kyi 'dug gam/ nga babs kyi min ga re bya rgyu sku da/ da bar khams pas tshul min byed kyi 'dug ces stong gsum skad kyis chod pa khyed tsho red/ zhes bshad pas/ drel dpon rta mgrin gyis nga ni g.yog po yin/ kho rang ni sbyin bdag red/ zla bo chu bzhi sgang drug gi 'o/gas dawa na red ces bshad mtshams ngas kha btsum lab kyang skad cha mang che ba bshad tshar/ de'i dkyil mi gte po zhig gis/ cung lhing tsam ngang 54

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 55khyed tsho gang du bsdad kyi yod dam/ sna thag bcong rgyu e yod zer/ nga tsho 'bri gung mthil dgon par sdod kyi yod ces bshad/nga tsho 'bri gung mthil dgon gyi a mgon rin po che'i gzim shag tu 'byor ba dang grwa pa de dang mi gzugs zung zhig yong nas sna thag btsong rogs lab byung ba/ ngas mi re la rgya gar gyi sna thag lcags krin zung ngu re sprad/ grwa pa des kho pa tsho sga skye rgu mdo nas yin pa dang mi gzugs thung ba de sgar dpon red ces ngo sprod dang / nga tsho bstan srung dang blang dmag la 'dzul rgyu'i ngo sprod yi ge zhig sprad rogs bshad byung / ngas rgya gung khran gyis khams rdzus mang po btang tshul grags pa khyod tsho ma yin nam/ bstan srung dang blang dmag gang du yod med ngas mi shes zhes bshad pas/ sgar dpon gyes de 'dra rtsa ba nas min/ nga'i pha rgyud 'di dang 'di yin zhes dang /da ni/ rgya mis nga tsho'i lung pa rtsa gtor btang nas chags rten rtsa ba nas med ces mig thu phrum phrum gtong / ngas lha sar khyed tsho'i pha yul gcig pa med dam/ gal srid med na nga'i a phor bshad chog ces khas blangs/nga dang sgar dpon gleng mol byed skabs grwa pa des shin tu rgud kyang dpon g.yog gi la rgya ma dor bar lag tu me mda' bzung nas sgo 'gram bya ra lhod med byed/ngas a mgon rin po che'i gsol dpon la rgya mir khyed 'bri gung 55

rgyal srung gaX/la 'gyed/ 55khyed tsho gang du bsdad kyi yod dam/ sna thag btsong rgyu e yod zer/ nga tsho 'bri gung mthil dgon par sde da kyi yod ces bshad//nga tsho 'bri gung mthil dgon gyi a mgon rin wa che'i gzim shag tu 'byor ba dang grwa pa de dang mi gzugs chung zhig yong nas sna thag btsong rogs lab byung ba/ ngas mi re la rgya gar gyi sna thag lcags krin chung ngu re sprad/ grwa pa des kho pa tsho sga skye rgu mdo nas yin pa dang mi gzugs chung ba de sgar dpon red ces ngo sprod dang / nga tsho bstan srung dang blang dmag la 'dzul rgyu'i lnga sprodad yi ge zhig sprad rogs bshad byung / ngas rgya gung khran gyis khams rdzus mang sngo btang tshul grags pa khyedad snu ma yin nam/ bstan srung dang blang dmag gang du yod med ngas mi shes zhes bshad pas/ sgar dawa na gyis de 'dra rtsa ba nas min/ nga'i pha rgyud 'di dang 'di yin zhes dang /da ni/ rgya mis nga cherware lung pa rtsa gaho ra btang nas chags rten rtsa ba nas med ces mig chu phrum phrum gtong / ngas lha sar khyed tsho'i pha yul gcig pa med dam/ gal srid med na nga'i a sngo ra bshad chodag ces khas blangs/nga dang sgar dpon gleng mol byed skabs grwa pa des shin tu rgud kyang dpon g.yog gi la rgya ma dor bar lag tu me mda' bzung nas lha 'gram bya ra lhod med byed/ngas a mabo na rin wa che'i gamo la dakhrodan la rgya mir khyed 'bri gung 55

56 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/bka' rgyud pas mthu dang nus pa blta na rgyu yod dam/ dris pas/ khong gis lha sa'i zhal shes ('bri gung gi yul skad a cag zhes pa'i don )la 'dredar pa yod na/nga tsho 'bri gung bka' rgyud pa la mthu nus sku da dang yodad/ rgya mir zhe drag bya rgyu gang yodang zhes brtsodad/ kho nga gi bka' bzhin ngas mthu'i rdzas g.yag mo blus te sbyin bdag ma tshang ba med par zhus te/ 'bri gung bka' rgyud pa'i bla ma bcu bzhi snu gas phebs la gdan drangasku/ shing gtor rgyag 'phen yang ra 'phrod pa'i nus pa smin ma thub/'bri gung du nga chodar bdag pa'i rgyu khrodag ga cho da yod min blta zhib byed skabs rmang dang sbag dkar mi tshang gnyis la ra tham sku da pa 'bri g.yag brgya dang nyi shu tsam dang / bza' zla bsod nams bag gro'i spun nye so/ga bla brang phyag malhurtad rang phrug gis da dung ra tham ma brgyab pa'i 'bri g.yag nyer bzhi tsam yod ces bsgyudad/ ('bri g.yag lo gsum la son skabs drud dang por brtsi ba dang drud dang po ma slebs bar ra tham rgyag gi med/) nam rgyun bza' zla snying rje che yang mi tshang dbul wa 'ga' zhig la bun btang nas skyed blang rgyu bzos 'dug ngas dbul lnga rnams la bun rtsa chag btang ste ma ṇi the bsna sa brgyab bcug pa dang /'ga' shas la ma ṇi dang sgrol ma gasku ga bcug pa yin/de dus stabs legs kyi bya ba des rjes su nga 'bri gung pa'i 'thab 'dzing gzed ma dgos pa byung / nga la bsam slo de ji ltar 'khor ba yin 56

55 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bka' rgyud pas mthu dang nus pa bton rgyu yod dam/ dris pas/ khong gis lha sa'i zhal shes ('bri gung gi yul skad a cag zhes pa'i don )la 'byor pa yond na/nga tsho 'bri gung bka' rgyud pa la mthu nus yod dang yod/ rgya mir zhe drag bya rgyu gang yong zhes brjod/ khong gi bka' bzhin ngas mthu'i rdzas g.yag ro blus te sbyin bdag ma tshang ba med par zhus te/ 'bri gung bka' rgyud pa'i bla ma bcu bzhi tshogs phebs la gdan drangase/ shing gtor rgyag 'phen yang ra 'phrod pa'i nus pa smin ma thub/'bri gung du nga tshor bdag pa'i rgyu zog ga tshod yod min blta zhib byed skabs rmang dang sbag dkar mi tshang gnyis la ra tham yod pa 'bri g.yag brgya dang nyi shu tsam dang / bza' zla bsod nams bag gro'i spun nye sog bla brang phyag mdzod rang phrug gis da dung ra tham ma brgyab pa'i 'bri g.yag nyer bzhi tsam yod ces brjod/ ('bri g.yag lo gsum la son skabs drud dang por brtsi ba dang drud dang po ma sgebs bar ra tham rgyag gi med/) nam rgyun bza' zla snying rje che yang mi tshang dbul po 'ga' zhig la bun btang nas skyed blang rgyu bzos 'dug ngas dbul po rnams la bun rtsa chag btang ste ma ṇi rdo brkos brgyab bcug pa dang /'ga' shas la ma ṇi dang sgol ma gsog bcug pa yin/de dus stabs legs kyi bya ba des rjes su nga 'bri gung pa'i 'thab 'dzing gzed ma dgos pa byung / nga la bsam blo de ji ltar 'khor ba yin 56

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 57nam zhe na/ ma nang a 'o/ 11da phyi nang gang sar rgyus mnga' zab pas spyi tshogs kyi 'khor phyogs shes te/ rang yul du bun btang ba'i 'dzin rnams bsregs nas bun rtsa chag btang ba skabs der mi rnams kyis ma nang a sgyu khyod 'dug cesdo/ gleng yang / rjes su mig gi mthodang ba'i spyi chodags kyi ga/nas stangs las ma nang a 21 spyang sna(sa gras yin pa chosad dpag thub/a mgon rin po che'i gsol dpon rig 'dzin slo gros kyis gsungs par/ spyi 'o/ 1958 wa da zla 8 nang a 'brug mabo na po bkra shis so/gas bstan srung dang blang dmag rnams 'bri gung nang gi 'dam bu sum mdor sgar phab/ bu 'brug g.yong yang mnyam du yod pa sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug gis gcung po 'byug gamo nga brgyud dang blang dmag rnams la g.yag dang mar bskyal ba dang / lcang lo can rin po che dang / a mgon bla brang phyag mdzodad sde pa mgo na wa sa mngo na gsal med pa'i thodag nas gasku ga po btang ste rgyag phye sprad/ sog bla brang gis bu 'byug gasku nga bsus te sne len byas/ bu 'brug g.yodang dmag spyir gyur te g.yodag grwa pa rdob rdob rna codag thod skra shad ring po bzhag pa gnyis yod 'dug gcung por rta dkar po chen po zhig sku da pa ngal che bas a mgon rin po che'i chibs rta zhig dang brje tshong gnang /sang nyin zlo gas pa rgya mi'i gnam gru zhig 'phur yong par gcung 57

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 57nam zhe na/ ma nang a pho bod phyi nang gang sar rgyus mnga' zab pas spyi tshogs kyi 'khor phyogs shes te/ rang yul du bun btang ba'i 'dzin rnams bsregs nas bun rtsa chag btang ba skabs der mi rnams kyis ma nang a pho spyo 'dug cechu/ gleng yang / rjes su mig gi mthong ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs las ma nang a 'ong spyang cadas gras yin pa tshand dpag thub/a mgon rin po che'i gsol dpon rig 'dzin zlo gros kyis gsungs par/ spyi lo 1952 bod zla 8 nang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis sogs bstan srung dang blang dmag rnams 'bri gung nang gi 'dam bu sum mdor sgar phab/ bu 'brug g.yong yang mnyam du yod pa sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug gis gcung po 'byug g.yong brgyud dang blang dmag rnams la g.yag dang mar bskyal ba dang / lcang lo can rin po che dang / a mgon bla brang phyag mdzod sde pa mgon pos mngon gsal med pa'i thog nas g.yog po btang ste rgyag phye sprad/ sog bla brang gis bu 'brug g.yong bsus te sne len byas/ bu 'brug g.yong dmag spyir gyur te g.yog gra pa rdob rdob rna cog thod skra shad ring po bzhag pa gnyis yod 'dug gcung por rta dkar po chen po zhig yod pa ngal che bas a mgon rin po che'i chibs rta zhig dang brje tshong gnang /sang nyin zhogs pa rgya mi'i gnam gru zhig 'phur yong par gcung 57

58 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/wa sa me mda' brgyag par 'gro skabs sog sprul rin wa ches dgo na pa rtsa gtor gtong gi red/ me mda' ma brgyag ces bkag nyin gcig gi rjes 'bri gung ba mi bzhis lam sne bstan te mamo mo rag tu 'byor skabs rgya mis skug ra sprad de dmag 'khrug chen lnga brgyab/ der mtshor chen sngo zhig yod pas rgya bod gnyis ka'i dmag mi grangs med mamor ded res dang /dngangs skrag gis mtshadangs pa bcas kyis phyi ma'i lam du btsan gyis ded/dang blang dmag 'ga' zhig gzugs por rmas shul tsam med par mig mdangs nas shi ba dang / kha shas rgyu ma dodan nas shi/ gang ltar dang blang dmag sgyu na che zhig shi bas rjes su a mgon rin ngo che 'a'o/ ba brgyab par phebs/ dmag 'khrug der mabo na 〈sna bkra shis la me sgyogs thebs nas rmas skyon byung / dmag 'khrug de'i skabs gcung wa 'byug gasku nga la gnas tshul ci zhig 'phrad min shes ma byung /sems rnal du mi gnas pa'i sa phag spyi 'e1 1959 'e1 gsar pa de 'bri gung du btang zhing bod tshes lnga nyin sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug dang / a mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod rig 'dzin slo gros gnyis kyang lha sar snyad cha brgyag dathodas pa bcas nga chod tshang ma mnyam du thodan/ nyin gsum rjes sga pa de dag 'gyor te nga la me mda' btsong dgos pa dang / ngos sbyor dgo sa bshad kyang me mda' 'chodang rgyu med cing ngos spyor sprad rgyu yang dam 58

58 gan mo ma bcos drang gtam/pos me mda' brgyag par 'gro skabs sog sprul rin po ches dgon pa rtsa gtor gtong gi red/ me mda' ma brgyag ces bkag nyin gcig gi rjes 'bri gung ba mi bzhis lam sne bstan te mtsho mo rag tu 'byor skabs rgya mis sgug ra sprad de dmag 'khrug chen po brgyab/ der mtsho chen po zhig yod pas rgya bod gnyis ga'i dmag mi grangs med mtshor ded res dang /dngangs skrag gis mchongs pa bcas kyis phyi ma'i lam du btsan gyis ded/dang blang dmag 'ga' zhig gzugs por rmas shul tsam med par mig mdangs nas shi ba dang / kha shas rgyu ma don nas shi/ gang ltar dang blang dmag phon che zhig shi bas rjes su a mgon rin po che 'pho ba brgyab par phebs/ dmag 'khrug der mgon po bkra shis la me sgogs thebs nas rmas skyon byung / dmag 'khrug de'i skabs gcung po 'drug g.yong la gnas tshul ci zhig 'phrad min shes ma byung /sems rnal du mi gnas pa'i sa phag spyi 'od 1959 lon gsar pa de 'bri gung du btang zhing bod tshes lnga nyin sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug dang / a mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod rig 'dzin slo gros gnyis kyang lha sar nyo cha brgyag dgos pa bcas nga tsho tshang ma mnyam du thon/ nyin gsum rjes sga pa de dag 'byor te nga la me mda' btsong dgos pa dang / ngos spyor dgos bshad kyang me mda' 'tshong rgyu med cing ngos sbyor sprad rgyu yang dam 58

rgyal srung g.yul 'gyed/ 59don ma byung bar nar 'gyangs shor/bod du dus 'gyur zhig yong rgyu mi phal che ba'i sems nang yod pas lha sa ru bzhi nas rin thang can gyi ca dngos gdan sa khag dang rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis la bcol gyi yod/ nga'i khyim du yang g.yog mo shes rab mtsho mo dang / gcung mo chos g.yang / phru gu gnyis bcas las go chod pa'i mi gcig kyang med pas/ nga tsho'i gser dngul g.yu byur dang / gyon gos sogs sgam drug tsam a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gi bde chen rab rgyas kyi shag tu bcol ba dang / a pho ngag dbang skal bzang dang thun mong du rda yang dang / bcu sgor/ ṭam ka dkar po bcas sgam gcig dang / rgya zog do po 'ga' shas yod pa rgyud smad du brtsal rte smar khams pa a pho bkra shis don grub srung byar btsugs/

rgyal srung ga3༅la 'gyed/ 59don ma byung bar nar 'gyangs cadar/wa da du dus 'gyur zhig skusgong rgyu mi phal che ba'i sems nang sku da pas lha sa ru bzhi nas rin thang can gyi ca dngos gdan sa khag dang rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis la bcol gyi yodad/ nga'i khyim du yang g.yog mo shes rab mtsho mo dang / gcung mo chodas g.yang / phru gu gnyis bcas las bo dzadad pa'i mi gcig kyang med pas/ nga tsho'i gser dngul g.yu byur dang / gyon gos mo gas sgam drug tsam a 'o/ ngag dbang skal bzang gi bde chen rab rgyas kyi shag tu bcol ba dang / a pho ngag dbang skal bzang dang thun mong du rda yang dang / bcu sgor/ ṭam ka dkar po bcas sgam gcig dang / rgya zog do po 'ag/'a shas sku da pa rgyud smad du bcol she smar khams pa a pho bkra shis don grub srung byar btsugs/

60 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bdun pa/bod kyi hai ma snyo ru bzhud/sa phag spyi 'o/ 1959 lo'i sgyu na lam yang grub cing / sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug dang / a mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod rig 'dzin blo lha sa gnyis kyang snyad cha brgyab tshar bas 'o/ga rgyu'i gra sgrig ngang gnas/nyin der kho gnyis phyir phyin pa dang a pho ngag dbang skal bzang khyim du yod/gang mtshams nas 'phags pa lha'i mkhan chung bsku1da nams rgya mtsho lus la grwa chas gyodan nas thung mda' btags shing 'byedar te/ a sgyu ngag dbang skal bzang la/ 7gong sa mchog dmag sgar la gdan drang rtsis yod pas sredag dpang tshugs kyis srung byar 'gro dbo sa zer/ a phos/ khyodad smyo ba min nam/ lus la grwa chas khyedan nas me mda' btags pa ched du rgya mis bsnyad btags yul bzos pa zhig red/ nga 'gro bar bsnyadan pa gang yang med pas min zhes bshad/ de nas yang bskyar 'phags pa lha'i mkhan 60

60 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bdun pha/bod kyi nyi ma lto ru bzhud/sa phag spyi lo 1959 lo'i smon lam yang grub cing / sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug dang / a mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod rig 'dzin blo gros gnyis kyang nyo cha brgyab tshar bas log rgyu'i gra sgrig ngang gnas/nyin der kho gnyis phyir phyin pa dang a pho ngag dbang skal bzang khyim du yod/gang mtshams nas 'phags pa lha'i mkhan chung bsod nams/ rgya mtsho lus la grwa chas gyon nas thung mda' btags shing 'byor te/ a pho ngag dbang skal bzang la/ 7gong sa mchog dmag sgar la gdan drang rtsis yod pas srog dpang tshugs kyis srung byar 'gro dgos zer/ a phos/ khyod spyo ba min nam/ lus la grwa chas gyon nas me mda' btags pa ched du rgya mis bsnyad btags yul bzos pa zhig red/ nga 'gro bar bzhon pa gang yang med pas min zhes bshad/ de nas yang bskyar 'phags pa lha'i mkhan 60

bod kyi nyi ma lho ru bzhud/ 61chung phyu pa skya 'o/ga cig dang zhwa mo u sub gyodan/ srung ba ga shal la btags nas slebs te a 'o/ra/ rta gnyis la sga brgyab yod pas/ g.yog po g.yugs bzhag nas nga rang gnyis rgyugs 'gro zer/ a phos/ nga tsho'i lung pa'i mi med pas nga mi 'gro/ khyodad rang songs zhes bshad pas mkhan chung gcig pur bud/a pho sa nga la rgya mi dmar wa sa hrang had grong khyer chen po de nyin gsum la bzung / de'i ring rta bong khyi sogs go masan gyi sgra la 'jigs te skad tsam grags mi nus/ bod dka' las khag tsam red/ nga blta bar 'gro gi yin zhes phyin/ nga yang nor bu gling khar 'gro 'dod kyang a phos skyon phab par 'jigs/ phyi nas mi tshogs kyi 'ur skad grags skabs sems rnal du mi gnas pas/ bsang galta nga bar 'alha tshul bstan rgyas gling du slebs skabs bar skor gyi tsho sa tshong mkhan g.yang 'alnga mas rngul nag 'tshub 'tshub ngang 'byor te gnyen lags/ da yin na 'phags pa lha mkhan chung gi sdug ro drud yong gi yod zer/ nga ni zhed nas snying grang sing brgyab/ ga re byas sam dris pas/ khe rgya 21gas za mkhan yin pas mi mang gis rdung nas khorware sdug ro drud yong gi yod zer/ nga'i sems nang chag sgo ma slong / da dpe bsags se nga bsams/ yar ltag 'o/ga nang du yong stabs mi rnams kyis glo bur du khrom bsdus te khrom bkyag sogs ca dngos dza dzor gyis nga tsho'i 61

bod kyi nyi ma lto ru bzhud/ 61khrung phyu pa skya log cig dang zhwa mo u sub gyon/ srung ba ga shal la btags nas slebs te a phor/ rta gnyis la sga brgyab yod pas/ g.yog po g.yugs bzhag nas nga rang gnyis rgyugs 'gro zer/ a phos/ nga tsho'i lung pa'i mi med pas nga mi 'gro/ khyod rang songs zhes bshad pas mkhan chung gcig pur bud/a phos nga la rgya mi dmar pos hrang had grong khyer chen po de nyin gsum la bzung / de'i ring rta bong khyi sogs go mtshon gyi sgra la 'jigs te skad tsam grags mi nus/ bod dka' las khag tsam red/ nga blta bar 'gro gi yin zhes phyin/ nga yang nor bu gling khar 'gro 'dod kyang a phos skyon phab par 'jigs/ phyi nas mi tshogs kyi 'ur skad grags skabs sems rnal du mi gnas pas/ bsang gtong bar 'gro tshul bstan rgyas gling du spebs skabs bar skor gye tshos tshong mkhan g.yang 'dzoms rngul nag 'tshub 'tshub ngang 'byor te gnyen lags/ da yin na 'phags pa lha mkhan rbung gi sdug ro drud yong gi yod zer/ nga ni zhed nas snying grang sing brgyab/ ga re byas sam dris pas/ kho rgya phogs za mkhan yin pas mi mang gis rdung nas kho sdug ro drud yong gi yod zer/ nga'i sems nang chag sgo ma slong / da dpe bsags song bsams/ yar ltag log nang du yong stabs mi rnams kyis slo bur du khrom bsdus te khrom bkyag sogs ca dngos dza dzor gyis nga tsho'i 61

62 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/khang bdag sgrub khang bla brang gi sgo ra bkag nas 'gro sa mi 'dug pas tshong khang nas ltag sgo brgyud phyin/yud tsam nas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang phebs te bu mo/ da yin na dpe bsags thal/ mkhan chung gi ro mar 'drud yong gi 'dug zer/ yun tsam nas 'phags pa lha'i tshong pa co ta bla rgan nga tsho'i khyim du yong nas da byas ma song / nga tsho'i mkhan chung bsad nas ro rag rgyag pa dang skor rgyag par rtsis sprad de dbugs khang nang blug rtsis byed pa/ ngas ro rin rdo tshad drug cu sprad rgyu byas pa yin zhes/ rdo tshad drug cu snga g.yar nga'i mdun nas 'khur te ro nyos/ da dung grong khyer nang skad 'bod dza drag byed pa der a phos rtsam pa za mi dang 'bras za mi dbye ba phye/ rtsam pa za mi thams cad tshur shog 'bras bza' mi thams cad rgya rtsa la rgyugs/ zhes bshad kyi 'dugang 'gro zhes rkang 'khor zhig bzhon nas bskyod/'phags pa lha'i yab tshang gi gzim shag rgya mtsho'i sgo 'gram slog shing zhig dbril skabs bu mo zhig gi thog tu lhung ste grongs/ slog shing mi mang gis nga tsho'i sgo 'gram bar 'drud/ sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug dang / a mgon bla brang gi gsol dpon rig 'dzin slo gros dpong mo khyim du 'byor te bshad don/ nor gling rdo'i seng ge'i mdun 'phags pa lha'i mkhan chu nga gi phyogs la mi mang 'ur skabs mkhan thung gis me mda' 62

62 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khang bdag sgrub khang bla brang gi sgo ra bkag nas 'asku sa mi 'dug pas dza nga khang nas ltag sgo brgyud phyin/yud tsam nas a sgyu ngag dbang skal bzang phebs te bu mo/ da yin na dpe bsags thal/ mkhan chung gi ro/ mar 'drud yong gi 'dug zer/ yun tsam nas 'phags pa lha'i tshong pa co ta bla rgan nga tsho'i khyim du yodang nas da byas ma song / nga tsho'i mkhan chung bsad nas gro rag rgyag pa dang skor rgyag par rtsis sprad de dbugs khang nang blug rtsis byed pa/ ngas ro rin rdo tshad drug cu sprad rgyu byas pa yin zhes/ 〈sna tshad drug cu snga g.yar nga'i mdun nas 'khur te ro nyos/ da dung grong khyer nang skad 'bod dza drag byed pa der a phos rtsam pa za mi dang 'bras za mi dbye ba phye/ rtsam pa za mi thams cad tshur cadag 'bras bza' mi thams cad rgyacirtsa la rgyugs/ zhes bshad kyi 'dugang 'gro zhes rkang 'kho ra zhig bzhon nas bskyod/'phags pa lha'i yab tshang gi gzim shag rgya mdzarware sgo 'gram blo ga shing zhig dbril skabs bu mo zhig gi thodag tu lhung ste grongs/ glog shing mi mang gis nga tsho'i sgo 'gram bar 'drud/ sog bla brang gi phyag mdzod rang phrug dang / a mgon bla brang gi gsol dpon rig 'dzin slo gros dgong mo khyim du 'gyor te bshad don/ nor gling rdo'i seng ge'i mdun 'phags pa lha'i mkhan zung gi phyogs la mi mang 'ur skabs mkhan chung gis me mda' 62

bod kyi nyi ma lto ru bzhud/ snyo3gnam la thengs gnyis brgyab pa dang / bud med dar ma zhig gis pang gdan mabo la g.yo gas nas rdung / mkhan chung gis nga ma sod/ skad cha bshad rgyu yod ces thengs mang zhu ba 'then yang bsad song zer/ dgong mo de a pho ngag dbang skal bzang tshur yong nas mi mang 'thus mis nor gling srung skyob ched lung tshan so sor sa cha babo sa pa smar khams pa bde skyid gling kha phyogs la khel byung / zhes yun tsam bsdad/ de nas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang dang rgan bkra shis/ sprul sku bla g.yang / drel dngo na rta mgrin/ drel nga/ blo bzang rgyal ma tshan/ phram wang/ ngag dbang mkhas gyub bcas phyin/ nyin gsum tsam nas rgan bkra shis sku nga nas kho cho ra phyu pa sa maho ga gsum bakhrod dbo sa zhes bshad pa bzhin phran gyis phyu pa sa mawa ga gsum bajo sa te bskur/spyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 12 nyin ga ṇi shar a ne dang kun bde gling kun bzang lags kyis gtsos nga tsho bud med rnams kyinu/ zhol rdo ring 'gram du tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas bud med kyi gyen langs skor la gros bsdur byas/ yab gzhis kyi lcags rir phug ron zhig babs 'dug pa slo bur ping skyur ma zhig gis thad kar 'khur song bas nga'i sems nang rnam rtog langs te zhol shar lcam sku zhabs la ltas ngan pa rang red bshad pas/ kho nga gis nga yang rnam ༄ ga chen po za byung zhes gsungs/ chodags 'dur ga ṇi shar a rje dang kun bde gling kun bzang gnyis kyis gtam bshad 63
