bod kyi nyi ma lho ru bzhud/ 63gnam la zengs gnyis brgyab pa dang / bud med dar ma zhig gis pang gdan mgo la g.yo gas nas rdung / mkhan zung gis nga ma sod/ skad cha bshad rgyu yod ces zengs mang zhu ba 'azen yang bsad song zer/ dgong mo de a pho ngag dbang skal bzang tshur yong nas mi mang 'thus mis nor gling srung skyob ched lung tshan so sor sa cha bgos pa smar khams pa bde sgyed gling kha phyogs la khel byung / zhes yun tsam bsdad/ de nas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang dang rgan bkra shis/ sprul sku bla g.yang / drel dpon rta mgrin/ drel nga/ sgo bzang rgyal ma tshan/ phram po/ ngag dbang mkhas grub bcas phyin/ nyin gsum tsam nas rgan bkra shis yong nas kho tshor phyu pa sa mdog gsum bzo dgos zhes bshad pa bzhin phran gyis phyu pa sa mdog gsum bzos te bskur/spyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 12 nyin ga ṇi shar a ne+e dang kun bde gling kun bzang lags kyis gcos nga cho bud med rnams kyis/ zhol rdo ring 'gram du chogs 'du 'tshogs nas bud med kyi gyen langs sgor la gros bsdur byas/ yab gzhis kyi lcags rir phug ron zhig babs 'dug pa slo bur ping skrur ma zhig gis thad gar 'khur song bas nga'i sems nang rnam rtog langs te zhol shar lcam sku zhabs la ltas ngan pa rang red bshad pas/ khong gis nga yang rnam rtog chen po za byung zhes gsungs/ chogs 'dur ga ṇi shar a ṇi dang kun bde gling kun bzang gnyis kyis gtam bshad 63

64 gan mo ma bcos drang gtam/yun ring spel/ kun bde gling kun bzang lags dang ga ṇi shar a ne'i gtam bshad kyis mi sems bkug thub cing khong rnam gnyis kyang gces pa'i srog blos gtong bar the chom spu tsam mi byed pa'i dpa' mo zhig yin/da dung 'gan 'khur ba gartsa bo'i gras zhol shar lcam sku zhabs dang /gzhis gro sgang gi lcam/ spe'u shar khang gnyer tshing sgol ma/ ram pa'i khang gnyer tshe brtan bcas yod/ tshogs 'du 'chogs skabs rgya mi brgyad tsam gye phyogs gang sa nas par brgyab kyang nga tshor rnam rtog tsam yang ma byung bar gang 'dod par brgyab bcug pa red/ de rjes tshang mas lha sa bsgor nas bden 'bod bsgrags/ lde mig sogs lcags trug tshong mkhan lha sa ba rmo bo srid nor yang nga tsho mnyam du yong nas rgya mis lam khar btsugs pa'i rgyug khra la gcin pa btang / thal ba bshos pa sogs byas/ bud med rnams bde skyid gling khar bal po'i gzhung tshab la re 'bod zhu bar 'gro skabs ya lan byed mkhan ma byung / de nas bde skyid gling khar rgya gar sku tshab mdun phyin nas 'go khrid rnams dang thug nas re 'dun bton pa red/ de nyin khrom skor rtsa ba'i cha nas legs grub byung bas sang nyin mu mthud 'gro rgyur khungs so sor log pa gus mo bde skyid gling kha phyogs la a pho ngag dbang skal bzang thug par phyin/ der smar khams pa bco lnga tsam 'dug pa kho tshos nag mo grib mtshon srung la phog nyen yod ces thag nyer yong ma bcug par rgyang 64

64 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/yun ring spel/ kun bde gling kun bzang lags dang ga ṇi shar a ne+e'i gtam bshad kyis mi sems bkug thub cing kho nga rnam gnyis kyang gces pa'i srog chodas gto/nga bar the tshom spu tsam mi byed pa'i dpa' mo zhig yin/da dung 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo'i gras zhol shar lcam sku zhabs dang /gzhis gro sgang gi lcam/ sle'u shar khang gnyer tshing sgrol ma/ ram pa'i khang gnyer tshe brtan bcas yod/ tsharags 'du 'asnurags skabs rgya mi brgyad tsam gyi phyogs gang sa nas par brgyab kyang nga chomar rnam lto ga tsam yang ma byung bar gang 'dod par brgyab bcug pa red/ de rjes tshang mas lha sa bskor nas bden 'ange da bsgrags/ lde mig so/gas lcags drug chosang mkhan lha sa ba spyod bo srid cadar yang nga tsho mnyam du yong nas rgya mis lam khar btsugs pa'i rgyug khra la gcin pa btang / thal ba bathodas pa drodags byas/ bud med rnams bde skyid gling khar bal po'i gzhung tshab la re 'awa da zhu bar 'gro skabs ya lan byed mkhan ma byung / de nas bde skyid gling khar rgya gar sku tshab mdun phyin nas 'go khrid rnams dang thug nas re 'dun bton pa red/ de nyin khrom skor rtsa ba'i cha nas legs gyub byung bas sang nyin mu mthud 'gro rgyur khungs so sor 'othog pa gus mo bde skyid gling kha phyogs la a pho ngag dbang skal bzang thug par phyin/ der smar khams pa bco lnga tsam 'dug pa kho tshos nag mo'i grib masnu na srung la 'o/ga nyen sku da ces thag nyer yong ma bcug par rgyang 64

bod kyi nyi ma lho ru bzhud/ snyo5tsam la bzhag cing zas kyang dkar zas 'ba' zhig la bsten/a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gis tshur yong ste gus mo gtsang po'i nye 'gram 'khrid de phal cher mi ring bar 7skyabs mgon rin po che lha sa nas gdan 'dren zhu rgyu red na/ su la yang ma shod/ rgya dmar 'di glags khel thabs med pas lnga sga la gang la yang 'gro mi dgos par rang mabo gang thon ngang phru gu gnyis gasku lha nga yag po gyis/ ca dngos rnams snga phyi ma gtogs rgya mis 'phrog rgyur nges pas bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas ma byed/ gal te btson du 'tshud pa'i gnas tshul byung tshe sngon nas bsam blor gra sgrig byas te skad cha nyung tsam dang / dang po gang bshad las 'gyur ba med pa gyis/ phal cher nga'i mtha' ma'i skad cha yin srid/ces brjod de srung byar phebs/ nga sems ha cang gi skyo ba'i ngang khyim su bskyod/ sang nyin rgan bkra shis btang ste dngul cung bskur shog zer rang nyid la yod pa'i lag dngul gyi thog gzhan nas rdo tshad cung g.yar te chig stong tsam bskur/65

bod kyi nyi ma lto ru bzhud/ 65tsam la bzhag cing zas kyang dkar zas 'ba' zhig la bsten/a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gis tshur yong ste gus mo gtsang po'i snye 'gram 'khrid de phal cher mi ring bar 7skyabs mgon rin po che lha sa nas gdan 'dren zhu rgyu red na/ su la yang ma shod/ rgya dmar 'di glags khel thabs med pas ngo rgol gang la yang 'gro mi dgos par rang mgo gang thon ngang phru gu gnyis gso skyong yag po gyis/ ca dngos rnams snga phyi ma gtogs rgya mis 'phrog rgyur nges pas bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas ma byed/ gal te brtsan du 'tshud pa'i gnas tshul byung tshe sngon nas bsam blor gra sgrig byas te skad cha nyung tsam dang / dang po gang bshad las 'gyur ba med pa kyis/ phal cher nga'i mtha' ma'i skad cha yin srid/ces brjod de srung byar phebs/ nga sems ha cang gi skyo ba'i ngang khyim su bskyod/ sang nyin rgan bkra shis btang ste dngul cung bskur shog zer rang nyed la yod pa'i lag dngul gyi thog gzhan nas rdo tshad cung g.yar te chig stong tsam bskur/65

66 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/brgyad pha/skyes pa steng pa'i nyin tho/spyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 20 tho rengs lding sgra zhig gis zar zir gyi rmi lam de yang dkrogs byung / dngangs skrag ngang lam seng yar langs te sgo rar rgyug pas mi tshang ma sgo rar 'dzoms nas da ci byed dgos sam/ dmag brgyag gi 'dug ces ngu cor sgog kha shas ni nyon thor sgor byed/ blo rtsa brtan pa 'ga' zhig gis 7gong sa mchog gi sku phyu ci byas yod dam zer/ nam langs rjes tshong gi re ba med kyang tshong khang sgo phye nas bltas pas grwa pa khyu dang khyu lag tu gri bzung nas rgyug ngas tshong khang gi zer rdzus phyu pa 'ga' grwa chas gyon pa'i grwa par sprad/nyin gung mtshams bod mi 'ga' zhig gis ra mo che'i sgod gzim phud nang yod rgya khang me bsreg gi yin brjod byung ba/ ngas sa snum lcags krin gnyis sprad/ nyi ma la khar ma byon tsam la bya skyag dkar po ri nas 66

66 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/mergyad pa/skyes pa stong pa'i hain mo/spyi 'o/ 1959 zla 3 tshes 20 lnga rengs ljing sgra zhig gis zar zir gyi rmi lam de yang dkrogs byung / dngangs skrag ngang lam seng yar langs te sgo rar rgyug pas mi tshang ma lha rar 'dzoms nas da ci byed dgo sa sam/ dmag brgyag gi 'dug ces ngu khyodar sgrog kha shas ni hon sprodar lnga ra byed/ chod rtsa brtan pa 'ga' zhig gis 7gong sa mchodag gi sku phyu ci byas yod dam zer/ nam langs rjes tshong gi re ba med kyang tshong khang sgo phye nas bltas pas grwa pa khyu dang khyu lag tu gri bzung nas rgyug ngas tshong khang gi ther rdzus phyu pa 'ga' grwa chas gyodan pa'i grwa par sprad/nyin gung mtshams wa da mi 'ga' zhig gis ra mo che'i thod gzim phud nang yod rgya khang me bsreg gi yin brjod byung ba/ ngas sa snum lcags krin gnyis sprad/ nyi ma la khar ma gyon tsam la bya skyag dkar po'i ri nas 66

skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo/ 67mi'i dpung tshogs du ma rgyug mo nga ba/ bod mi rnams kyis dang blang dmag mi slebs so/nga zhes dga' 'bod byed/ ngas rgyang shel bltas pas rgya dmag ser chil chil 'ur yong ba mthong bas/ nga tsho'i dang blang dmag ma red/ rgya dmag red brjod pas skyag rdzun ma shod zer/ a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i bza' zla mdo phrug gis nga'i rgyang shel 'a10ga nas zhib par bltas te dalnga sa gnas rgya dmag red bsnyu da/ sgrub khang bla brang gi phyag mdzod lags kyang rgyang shel bsnams nas phebs te yun tsam gzigs rjes rgya mi red ces/lam seng se rar phebs/bud med gnyis kyis rgya mi'i rgyang grags nas po tā la dang / ra mo che/ lha sa bcas bcings 'alha la dmag mis blangs zin pas/ lnga 'o/ga pa rnams mgo sgur zhes bshad/ me sgyogs kyi mde'u zhig gis nga'i khang pa'i zur nas galho ra/ skyes pa pho lus tshang ma rgya mis gsod/ par grags pas nga tshos rgya sgo mdung mas mnan zhing phru gu'i a ma rnams kyis phru gu lnga sgrub khang bla brang gi lci ba blugs sar sbas/spyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 21 mtshan mo lha ra phyi ma ga ler rdung byung bas phye skabs dang blang dmag la phyin pa'i a maro/ gnyis lho kha nas nga tsho'i khyim mtshes a mdodzi sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i bza' zla mdod drug gi khyim du 'gyor/ gcig gi ming la 'jigs med dang ma ṇi bla brang gi phyag mdzod 67

skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo/ 67mi'i dpung tshogs du ma rgyug yong ba/ bod mi rnams kyis dang blang dmag mi slebs song zhes dga' 'bod byed/ ngas rgyang shel bltas pas rgya dmag ser chil chil 'ur yong ba mthong bas/ nga tsho'i dang blang dmag ma red/ rgya dmag red brjod pas skyag rdzun ma shod zer/ a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho sa bza' zla mdo phrug gis nga'i rgyang shel 'phrog nas zhib par bltas te dngos gnas rgya dmag red brjod/ sgrub khang bla brang gi phyag mdzod lags kyang rgyang shel bsnams nas phebs te yun tsam gzigs rjes rgya mi red ces/lam seng se rar phebs/bud med gnyis kyis rgya mi'i rgyang grags nas po tā la dang / ra mo che/ lha sa bcas bcings 'grol dmag mis blangs zin pas/ ngo log pa rnams mgo sgur zhes bshad/ me spyogs kyi mde'u zhig gis nga'i khang pa'i zur nas gtor/ skyes pa pho lus tshang ma rgya mis gsod par grags pas nga tshos rgya sgo mdung mas mnan zhing phru gu'i a ma rnams kyis phru gu lnga sgrub khang bla brang gi lci ba blugs sar sbas/spyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 21 mtshan mo sgo ra phyi ma ga ler rdung byung bas phye skabs dang blang dmag la phyin pa'i a mdo gnyis lto kha nas nga tsho'i khyim mtshes a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i bza' zla mdo drug gi khyim du 'byor/ gcig gi ming la 'jigs med dang ma ṇi bla brang gi phyag mdzod 67

68 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/red zer/ gcig gi ming la dngul sku zer kho gnyis bza' zla thug par yong ba dang mtshan mo bza' zla'i nang bsdad na nyen 'gan mi baphra da pas maro/ drug gi khyim du nyen g.yol la yong pa yin zer/ dngul skus ngas rgya mi gcig kyang bsad thub ma byung zhes rang gis rang la 'khang ra byed/chu tshod gnyis tsam gyi rjes nga tsho'i khyim mtshes sras chung gi gzim shag sgo rar rgya dmag gi skad dang rdog sgra bcas dus gcig la grags pas mdo phrug ngus/ 'jigs med dang dngul skus bros nas thar thabs mi 'dug pas rgya mi'i lag tu 'chi rgyu gtan khel/ zhes mdza na srung dang 'jigs med kyi thung mda' nga la sprad/ ngas masnu rme/ srung dbyug pa zhig la bstodan nas gyang srub cig tu sbas shing / thung mda' lham bo ga shos/ tsi zhig nang blugs/ kho gnyis sgrub khang bla brang gi gsang gcadad gsar pa'i nang bcug ste lha ja sgam stong pa brtsigs nas bkagade ma thag rgya dam/ga gis sras chung gzim shag gi ltag sgo brgyud sgrub khang bla brang gi sge'u khung bcags nas 'bu grog ma tshang nas thon ltar se chil ler 'dzul te/ rgya dmag 'ga' shas kyis mdung mas mnan pa'i rgya sgo phye song ba dang dus mtshungs/ bod gzhung gi pu li si'i dmag sgar phyogs nas me mda'i sgra zhig grags te rgyal sgo phye mkhan rgya dmag cig sa thog 'gyel/ ngas rgya dmag rmas ma der byin rten zhig sprad/ shi khar a 68

6 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/red zer/ gcig gi ming la dngul sku zer kho gnyis bza' zla thug par yong ba dang mtshan mo bza' zla'i nang bsdad na nyen 'gan mi bzod pas mdo drug gi khyim du nyen g.yol la yong pa yin zer/ dngul skus ngas rgya mi gcig kyang bsad thub ma byung zhes rang gis rang la 'khang ra byed/zu chod gnyis tsam gyi rjes nga tsho'i khyim mtshes sras zung gi gzim shag sgo rar rgya dmag gi skad dang rdog sgra bcas dus gcig la grags pas mdo phrug ngus/ 'jigs med dang dngul skus bros nas thar thabs mi 'dug pas rgya mi'i lag tu 'chi rgyu gtan khel/ zhes mtshon srung dang 'jigs med kyi thung mda' nga la sprad/ ngas mtshorma srung dbyug pa zhig la bskon nas gyang srub cig tu sbas shing / thung mda' lham gog shos tsi zhig nang blugs/ kho gnyis sgrub khang bla brang gi gsang gcod gsar pa'i nang bcug ste sgo ja sgam stong pa brtsigs nas bkagade ma thag rgya dam/ga gis sras thung gzim shag gi ltag sgo brgyud sgrub khang bla brang gi sge'u khung bcags nas 'bu grog ma tshang nas thon ltar se chil ler 'dzul ce/ rgya dmag 'ga' shas kyis mdung mas mnan pa'i rgya sgo phye song ba dang dus mtshungs/ bod gzhung gi pu li si'i dmag sgar phyogs nas me mda'i sgra zhig grags te rgyal sgo phye mkhan rgya dmag cig sa thog 'gyel/ ngas rgya dmag rmas ma der byin rten zhig sprad/ shi khar a 68

skyes pa gyong pa'i nyin mo/ 69ma/ a ma/ zhes gdung 'bod ya nga ba byed cing phyi mar bzhud/ rgya dmag rnams kyis lam seng zhwa mo phud nas mya ngan mtshon par byas/ lce khung nang sbas pa'i phru gu rnams zhed nas ngus te khor yug ngu cor gyis khengs/sdon ma nga tsho'i tshong shag rgya mi sna gug gug kho pas lag par kha par gcig bzung / mnyam du sgal par kha par sgam 'khyer ba'i dmag mi gcig dang /rgyab mdun la sku srung ba gnyis re bcas kyis srung skyob dang bcas dmag dpon gyi chas gyon nas rdzig nyams dang bcas nga tsho'i mdun 'byor/ nga tshos tshong gi khe sgobs la bltas nas tshong shag sgrig pa las kho pa'i gdong ris ngo ma de bar mthong med/rgya dmag gis sgrub khang bla brang gi thog nas slog 'od nam mkha'i mthongs su bkye bas/ phyogs thams cad skya sing nger rgya 'bum sgang gi thang steng rang re'i mi tshogs rgyugs 'gro ba gsal por mthong / der rgya dmag gcig gis sbi ri ghan char pa bab pa ltar 'phen stabs bod mi du ma zhig 'gyel ba ngas me mda' rgyag mkhan de 'jus pa yin/rgya dmag gzhan zhig gis nga'i mgo bor me mda'i kha mde'u sprad pa / dpon po sna gug can des sbu yog rda la (ma brgyag )zhes lag gis me mda' bkyag song ba me mda'i sgra rna ba'i gting la gzer brgyab pa zhig grags/rgya dpon gyes bod skad thog khyod spyo 'am/ nga med na khyed bsad song zer/69

skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo/ 69ma/ a ma/ zhes gdung 'bod ya nga ba byed cing phyi mar bzhud/ rgya dmag rnams kyis lam seng zhwa mo phud nas mya ngan mchodan par byas/ lci khung nang sbas pa'i phru gu rnams zhed nas ngus te khor yug ngu cor gyis khengs/sngon ma nga dzarware chosang shag rgya mi sna gug gug kho pas lag par kha par gcig bzung / mnyam du sgal par kha par sgam 'khyer ba'i dmag mi gcig dang /rgyab mdun la sku srung ba gnyis re bcas kyis srung skyob dang bcas dmag dpon gyi chas gyon nas rdzig nyams dang bcas nga tsho'i mdun 'gyor/ nga tshoras dza nga gi khe spobs la bltas nas dza nga shag sgrig pa las kho pa'i gange nga ris ngo ma de bar mthong med/rgya dmag gis sgrub khang bla brang gi thosneg nas spyodag sotshed nam mkha'i mthongs su bkye bas/ phyogs thams cad skya sing nger rgya 'bum sgang gi thang steng rang re'i mi tshogs rgyugs 'gro ba gsal por mthong / der rgya dmag gcig gis sbi ri ghan char pa bab pa ltar 'phen stabs bod mi du ma zhig 'gyel ba ngas me mda' rgyag mkhan de 'jus pa yin/rgya dmag gzhan zhig gis nga'i mabo phra ra me mda'i kha mde'u sprad pa / dalnga na wa sna gug can des sbu sku ga rda la (ma brgyag )zhes lag gis me mda' bkyag song ba me mda'i sgra rna ba'i gting la gzer brgyab pa zhig grags/rgya dpon gyis bod skad thog khyod smyo 'am/ nga med na khyed bsad song zer/69

70 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nga ni zhed nas 'gul yang mi thub pa'i tshod du slebs kyang don med kyi mi bsad nas ci byed bshadacipa yin/de nas nam skya ldang zhing 'dug la lha sa phal che ba rgya mis bzung tshar bas rgya dmag rnams cung smyod po ra nga tsho'i grong pa rnams las chu 'khol lho nga ste btung zhing sgrub khang bla brang gi g.yab 'khor nang tshang ma thang chad nas gnyid du yur/dalnga na sngo gcig gis a cag g.yu 〈snan gyi khang pa'i sbug/ nyal gyi yin zhes bshad pas khe par bya g.yab cig gasku(gas nas lha lcag brgyab nas g.yu sgron nga'i nang slebs/ nam langs nas gang mtshams nas dmag mis dalnga na po rtsad bcad pas a cag g.yu sgron gyis dawa na po gnyid nyal song bshad rgyur/ rgya skad kyis zi la 'a song )bshad pas rgya dmag gis g.yu sgon bzung nas me mda' btsugs te nga'i mdun 'khrid/ g.yu sgro na gyis nga la lde mig g.yugs nas snyad phye dbo sa pa'i re ba bto/na pas/ ngas lam seng sgo phye bas rgya da〈snan sgo nas thodan yong bas gzhi nas g.yu sgron sgruthod/ rgya dadze na kho pa nga'i nang la slebs byung ba gcung mos ja blugs pa 'thung bzhin bza' zla bsod nams bag spo dang / gcung po 'brug g.yong ga par yod dam zer/bza' zla grongs pa dang / gcung po pha yul la log go bshad pas/ rgya dpon gyis ha/ ha/ ha zhes bgad mo bgad/ kho pa'i sems nang chosad bgam 70

70 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nga ni zhed nas 'gul yang mi thub pa'i tshod du slebs kyang don med kyi mi bsad nas ci byed bshad pa yin/de nas nam skya ldang zhing 'dug la lha sa phal che ba rgya mis bzung tshar bas rgya dmag rnams cung stod ngo ra nga tsho'i grong pa rnams las chu 'khol sgong ste btung zhing sgrub khang bla brang gi g.yab 'khor nang tshang ma thang chad nas gnyid du yur/dpon po gcig gis a cag g.yu sgron gyi khang pa'i sbug nyal gyi yin zhes bshad pas kho par bya g.yab cig g.yogs nas sgo lcag brgyab nas g.yu sgron nga'i nang spebs/ nam langs nas gang mtshams nas dmag mis dpon po rtsad bcad pas a cag g.yu sgron gyis dpon po gnyid nyal song bshad rgyur/ rgya skad kyis zi la 'a song )bshad pas rgya dmag gis g.yu sgon bzung nas me mda' btsugs te nga'i mdun 'khrid/ g.yu sgron gyis nga la lde mig g.yugs nas sgo phye dgos pa'i re ba bton pas/ ngas lam seng sgo phye bas rgya dpon sgo nas thon yong bas gzhi nas g.yu sgron slod/ rgya dpon kho pa nga'i nang la slebs byung ba gcung mos ja blugs pa 'thung bzhin bza' zla bsod nams bag gro dang / gcung po 'byug g.yong ga par yod dam zer/bza' zla grongs pa dang / gcung po pha yul la log go bshad pas/ rgya dpon gyes ha/ ha/ ha zhes bgad mo bgad/ kho pa'i sems nang tshod bgam 70

skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo/ 71zebs kyang nga la yi ge zhib sprad de dka' ngal byung skabs 'di ston dgos zer/ kho pa nga'i khyim nas thon te dmag mi rnams dang mnyam zhogs zas bza' skabs ngas yi ge mer bsregs/zhogs pa chu tshod bdun pa tsam la rgya ros khengs pa'i rlangs 'khor chen po zhig rgya dpon sna gug can gyi mdun du yong / kho pas blta zhib cig byas rjes sa gnas gzhan du btang / de 'dra zhig la gtsug lag khang la me 'bar gyi 'dug pa rgya dpon gyis gtsug lag khang mi mang gi red dam/ zhes dris byung ba/ ngas red bshad nga/sa/ rgya dmag kha shas gtsug lag khang la me gsod par mngags/ngas mdo/ phrug la nang do na rnams mngags nas lag tu kha btags bzung / rgya dpon dang rgya dmag 'khrid de bod pa mgo sgur bar shog ces ska da 'bod byas/ ha chen lang gsar du spebs skabs bod pa'i bud med cig gis nga la khro gnyer gyis sdig mo byed / de nas ngas rgya dmag rnams der bzhag nas mgyogs myur khyim du yong skabs mdo phrug gis 'jigs med dang dngul sku gsang gcod nas bton nas lag tu kha btags re bzung nas 'dug kho gnyis kyis rgya dmag khongs pha yul gcig pa go sa yond pa zhig dang thug pa kho pa sa mgo sgur zhes brjod byung ba mgo sgur bas slod byung / me mda' dang srung ba sprad rogs thar na bstan srung dang blang dmag 71

72 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/la 'gro rgyu yin zhes kho gnyis phyin/ de nas nga gtsug lag khang la phyin pas me gsod mkhan bod mi tshang ma bzung nas bcug 'dug pa lam seng log phyin/ phar lam khrom gzigs khang gi mi ro rnams rgya dmag gis dbor ba nas sa kong zhig nang grwa pa zhig 'das pa'i mgo 'og sa drud shul sngog skabs thung dma' zhig sbas 'dug 'das po des bod mi rigs ched legs skyes ji tsam phul min dang / tha na nga tshos mtshan sogs ma rtogs kyang rang nyid 'chi nges pa shes te mchon dgra lag tu ma shor ched sbas pa de lta bu yang bod mi'i dpe mtshon zhig red/ sang nyin rgya dmag dang las byed bzhi tsam khyim du yong nas mtshon cha yod min bsngogs/ gnangs nyin nga nor bu gling khar a pho ngag dbang skal bzang sogs 'brel yod bco lnga tsam gyi phung po e rnyed bsam nas phyin/ gzhan bud med 'ga' skra yi lhad ma zang zing ngang mar slod cing ngu shar rgyag gin mi ro'i dkyil phar rgyug tshur rgyug gis ci zhig gi phung po 'tshol bzhin 'dug skyid thu'i g.yas g.yon la bod mi dang khyi/ ba phyugs/ rta bong bcas shi ba'i ros khengs shing / dbu dang gzugs so sor bral ba'i gzim 'gag ba zhig gi phung po yang mthong rgya dmag rnams kyis bod mi'i sku phung rnams las mchon cha rnams len bzhin nga tshor bltas te jag pa mang po shi 'dug blta bar shog khyed rang gi khyo ga yod dam brjod/ sgyid chu'i khar phung po 'ga' zhig g.yeng ba'i dbus 72

skyes pa stong pa'i nyin mo / 73a 'o(re phung lnga min nam snyam pa zhig la a 'ongag brgyab nas bltas pas ma red/ nyin phyed ring phung po btsal yang ngo shes gcig kyang ma rnyed/phyi nyin yang bskyar phung po 'tshol bar phyin pas nor gling lho sgo'i gling lhag tu mi ro dang / rta ro/ khyi ro sogs kyi bang rim brtsigs shing /da dung bod mi du mar phung po mu mthud dbor bcug rgan bkra shis lho sgo'i nang phung po dbor bzhin 'dug pa sgo bkag kyang / nga mthong ba dang rgyang nas ngag dbang skal bzang 'dir med/ gtsang po'i khar ro e rnyed ltos ang / zhes 'ango da/ khram sngo zhes pas lho sgo nas lag brdas ngag dbang skal bzang bros so/nga / srung mar mjal skyems phul dgos/zhes lag brda sprad/ gzhan ngo shes pa rnams kyis thag ring nas rang rang gi pha ma'am/ bza' zla/ gcen gcung / phrug gu bcas gang rung la gse na ngo ra gnas yod ces 'e bas lha gas zhes 'phra da/ri ltarī brtsigs pa'i phung wa ra sa snum bshodas nas me brgyab kyang skabs der 'bar ma so/nga yang rjes su gang byas ma shes/ sa phyos/sa gang du bltas kyang skyes pa mthodang rgyu med cing lha sa sgo nga khyer gyi kho ra yug kun du zhags shig gis 'khrigs shing khang pa 'ga' la da dung yang me 'bar/lam bar bud med phrug gu chung ngu khrid pa dang kher rkyang 'ga' brel 'tshub kyis phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed/73

74 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/nga rang ma pho rnyed rgyu med pa thag chod pas nang la log rjes gcung mo chos g.yang gis a cag rgya mis khyed rang rtsad gcod par khyim du 'byor byung zhes zhed snang byed/ gung tshigs bza' rtsis byas kyang 'jigs rngangs che ba'i dmag dang dmag gi god chag sems la 'char te za mi thub par 'jig rten la re thag chod pa'i snang ba zhig 'char zhing / nor gling du nyin gnyis bsgor bas rkang par yang zu thing don/ khyim mtshes a cag g.yu sgon nga'i mdun yong ste/ bde chen rab rgyas kyi ca dngos srung mkhan rgan chos 'byor rgya mis me+e mda' sgal par bskur nas 'khrid cing / ca dngos gzhung bzhes dang sgo thel brgyab bo zhes brjod/ nga rang bzung bar dogs te mar khu dang rtsam pa bsres pa'i spags g.yos pa dang / phyu pa dang gam pa li gra sgrig byas/bskos pa'i las kyi bde ba//myos pa'i mdza' bor chags shing //dang bas pang du blangs kyang //ro bcud sdug gis 'khyer ro//74

75 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/po'i lcam sku zhabs las lhag pa'i rdzig nyams ston pa/ da ston dang / zhes nga 'khrid/ ngas ske la gzi gcig dang / lag par gzi yi 'du 'jomams kha shas/ gser gye gdu bu gcig tshigs khebs gnyis bcas btags yond/ sgo 'gram du rgya dmag khongs nga tsho'i lung pa gcig pa rtam rdo me mda' ring mda' zhig 'khur nas bsdad 'dug pa dang / g.yas g.yon khyim mtshes rnams kyis blta rub brgyab/ ngas rtam rdo la rgan lags nga ga par 'khrid kyi red dam/ zhes dris kyang kha mi grags/ slog shing ril ba de'i steng nga bzhag ste rtam rdo srung bcug dmag dpon gnyis dang shar lho'i sras bkra shis don grub dbyangs can gyi tshong khang nang phyin te/ kho pa tshos zab nan gyi sgo nas dbyangs can la khyede kyis bshad pa dngos bden yin nam/'gan 'khur bya thub bam zhes dris/ dbyangs can gyis mna' skyel tho btsugs ngang dngos bden yin zhes mdzub zel brgyab/ngas yang bskyar rtam rdo la ga par 'khrid mkhan red dam zhes dris pas/ phreng ring la min nam zer/ kho pa tsho dbyangs can gyi mdun nas tshur yong ste nga khrid khar ngas dbyangs can la bzhugs ā/ rang kha mgyogs pa ma gtogs nga btson khang la 'tshud rgyur nges/ khyed rang la phan thogs na 'grig ces bshad/nyin yin yang mthong rgyu med pa'i ser tshab bla ma'i dod khang nag 76

7snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ po'i lcam sku zhabs las lhag pa'i rdzig nyams ston pa/ da ston dang / zhes nga 'khrid/ ngas ske la gzi gcig dang / lag par gzi yi 'du 'jo mas kha shas/ gser gyi gdu bu gcig tshigs khebs gnyis bcas btags sku1da/ sgo 'gram du rgya dmag khongs nga tsho'i lung pa gcig pa rtam rdo me mda' ring mda' zhig 'khur nas bsdad 'dug pa dang / g.yas g.yon khyim mtshes rnams kyis blta rub brgyab/ ngas rtam the la rgan lags nga ga par 'khrid kyi red dam/ zhes dris kyang kha mi grags/ glog shing ril ba de'i steng nga bzhag ste rtam rdo srung bcug dmag dpon gnyis dang shar lho'i sras bkra shis don grub dbyangs can gyi ce'ong khang nang phyin te/ kho pa dza sa zab nan gyi 〈sna nas dbyangs can la khyede kyis bshad pa dacadas bden yin nam/'gan 'khur bya thub bam zhes dris/ dbyangs can gyis mna' skyel tho btsugs ngang dacadas bden yin zhes mdzub thel brgyab/ngas yang bskyar rtam the la ga par 'khrid mkhan red dam zhes dris pas/ phreng ring la min nam zer/ kho pa choja dbyangs can gyi mdun nas tshur yong ste nga khrid khar ngas dbyangs can la bzhugs ā/ rang kha mgyogs pa ma gtogs nga btso na khang la 'tshud rgyur nges/ khyed rang la phan thogs na 'grig ces bshad/nyin yin yang mthong rgyu med pa'i ser tshab bla ma'i dod khang nag 76

nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 77khung zhig tu bcug byung ba/ sems su rang nyid gcig pu yin par snyam yang dus gang mtshams nas dbugs gtong len byed pa'i sgra zhig thos pa/mig 'dris par byas te ga ler blta skabs rdo ring tsho dpon dang / se ra byes kyi khang gnyer red/ chu tshod phyed ka'i rjes pho dang mo so sor dbye ste rgya dpon zhig dang dmag mi gnyis kyis nga rlangs 'khor nang 'dzul bcug ste phreng ring sgo 'gram babs bcug gcung mo chos g.yang sgo 'gram mal chas dpung par bkal nas nga sgug 'dugargya dpon gyis rgyan cha rmams blangs te bod skad thodag khyed rang gi ca dngos rjes su phar sprad kyi red brjod kyang / ngas sprad rtsis ma byas pas so krang nor bu rdo rjes a cag nga rgyal ma byed rjes su khyed rang la sprad kyi red zer bas phar sprad/ yig cha zhig la mdzub thel brgyab bcug nas ga ṇi shar gyi a rje dang lo drug cu yol ba'i rmo bo drug tsam gyis gtsos bud med kyis khengs pa'i btson khang chen po zhig nang bcug phar phyogs khang par bud med sum cu tsam 'dug grod pa ltogs dus khyim nas 'khyer ba'i spags de za skabs gzugs yang sing sing gi phan thogs chen po byung yang rgyun thung nang zad/de sngon rgya las yin yang rjes su 'bras zan rtsam zan dbye skabs rtsam zan khongs rgya lha la nang zhugs pa'i lha sa ba bkra g.yang dang / tshe 77

nyam thung khrims rar 'tshud/ 77khung zhig tu bcug byung ba/ sems su rang nyid gcig pu yin par snyam yang dus gang mtshams nas dbugs gtong len byed pa'i sgra zhig thos pa/mig 'dris par byas te ga ler blta skabs rdo ring tsho dpon dang / se ra byes kyi khang gnyer red/ zu tshod byed ga'i rjes pho dang mo so sor dbye ste rgya dpon zhig dang dmag mi gnyis kyis nga rlangs 'khor nang 'dzul bcug ste phreng ring sgo 'gram babs bcug gcung mo chos g.yang sgo 'gram mal chas dpung par bkal nas nga sgug 'dugargya dpon gyis rgyan cha rnams blangs te bod skad sgog khyed rang gi ca dngos rjes su phar sprad kyi red brjod kyang / ngas sprad rtsis ma byas pas so krang nor bu rdo rjes a cag nga rgyal ma byed rjes su khyed rang la sprad kyi red zer bas phar sprad/ yig cha zhig la mdzub zel brgyab bcug nas ga ṇi shar gyi a ṇi dang lo drug cu yol ba'i rmo bo drug tsam gyis gcos bud med kyis khengs pa'i btson khang chen po zhig nang bcug phar phyogs khang par bud med sum cu tsam 'dug grod pa ltogs dus khyim nas 'khyer ba'i spags de za skabs gzugs yang sing sing gi phan thogs chen po byung yang rgyun thung nang zad/de sngon rgya las yin yang rjes su 'bras zan rtsam zan dbye skabs rtsam zan kho ngas rgya rgodal nang zhugs pa'i lha sa ba bkra g.yang dang / tshe 77

78 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/sgol ma dang / spel gong pad sgon bcas kyang bcon du 'tshud/ kho tsho rgya skad yag cing spel gong pad sgon gyis rgya yig kyang cung shes/ sngon ma lcags hrug btsong ba dang bla phyag gi 'khyam rar mchod 'bul skabs g.yog rgyug ste lto tshe phyid thabs byed pa'i rmo bo spen pa sgol ma yang nga tsho dang mnyam du yod/ spen pa sgol ma dbul phongs yin pas rgya mi ched du khyim du mtshams 'dri dang srid don gyi g.yo 'phrul bstan par yong nas skad cha dri skabs/ rgya mi'i re ba las ldog ste nya ches nya zung dang / 'bu ches 'bu thung bzas pa'i dpe ltar ngo tsha med pa'i rgya gung khran khyod tshos nga tshong bzas pa red ces bshad pas/ rgya mis 'dzin bzung byas pa dang shul du phru gu gnyis bdag med lus yod/btson pa phal che bar bdun rer zas zengs re skyel mkhan yod kyang spen ma sgrol mar blta rtog byed mi su gcig med/ spen pa sgol ma ni 'tsho bas gdungs ba'i gdong rid cing chu lbur mig gnyis sha rus kyi bar kong du 'dzul ba'i dngos gnas nyam thag pa zhig red/nyin gsum gyi rjese/ nga breng ring btson khang gi yig tshang du skad btang ste bza' zla dang gcung po ga par yod med dris/ ngas kho gnyis bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin pa dang a pho ngag dbang skal bzang nor gling du ngo rgol la phyin sgor bshad/ da lta kho cho gang du yod dam/ de dus ngag 78

78 rgan snangare ma bcos drang gtam/sgrol ma dang / spel gong pad sgron bcas kyang btson du 'tshud/ kho chod rgya skad yag cing spel gong pad lha na gyis rgya yig kyang cung shes/ sngon ma lcags srug bce nga ba dang bla phyag gi 'khyam rar mchodad 'bul skabs g.yog rgyug ste lto tshe phyid thabs byed pa'i sna nge spen pa sgrol ma yang nga tsho dang mnyam du yod/ spen pa lha la ma dbul 'o/ngas yin pas rgya mi ched du khyim du mtshams 'dri dang srid dodan gyi gasku 'phrul bstan par sku nga nas skad cha dri skabs/ rgya mi'i re ba las ldog ste nya ches nya chung dang / 'bu ches 'bu chung bzas pa'i dpe ltar ngo tsha med pa'i rgya gung khran khyod chodas nga tsha bzas pa red ces bshad pas/ rgya mis 'dzin bzung byas pa dang shul du phru gu gnyis bdag med lus yod/btso na pa phal che bar bdun rer zas thengs re skyel mkhan yodad kyang spen ma sgrol mar blta lta ga byed mi su gcig med/ spen pa sgrol ma ni 'tsho bas gdungs ba'i gdong rid cing chu lbur mig gnyis sha rus kyi bar kong du 'dzul ba'i dngos gnas nyam thag pa zhig red/nyin gsum gyi rjes/ nga phreng ring btson khang gi yig tshang du skad btang ste bza' zla dang gcung po ga par yod med dris/ ngas kho gnyis bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin pa dang a pho ngag dbang skal bzang nor gling du ngo rgol la phyin skor bshad/ da lta kho tsho gang du yod dam/ de dus ngag 78

nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 79dbang skal bzang mi mang 'thus mi ma red dam brjod/ kho ༅ deng dus gar song mi 'dug la a 'o/ ngag dbang skal bzang mi mang gi 'thus mi yin min ngas byung ba nas mi shes zhes bshad/rjes su yang dri ba thengs bdun tsam bkod byung ba'i nang don gtso bo ni/ bza' zla bsod nams bag gro dang gcung po log spyod pa'i lam du bskyod pa'i brgyud rim dang / lho kha nas bza' zla'i yi ge thengs ga tshod 'byor min/ bla dpon su zhig bstan srung dang blang dmag dang 'brel ba yod med/ bud med kyi ngo rgol la phyin min dris/ bza' zla dang gcung ngo dmag la 'thod khar ma gtogs ngas lha sa mol byas pa mo gas brgyud rim rtsa ba nas shes ma byung / gung khran tang gis pho dang mo gnyis 〈sna so yin zhes gsungs kyi yod/ bza' zla dang gcung ngo 'o/ga spyod pa'i lam du zhugs par nga la jus tog gang yang med/ bde mtshams kyi yi ge thengs gnyis tsam 'byor byung / bla dpon su zhig dang log spyod pa 'brel ba yod med shes ma byung zhes bshad/ skabs der a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gi bslab bya rnams phan thogs ha cang chen po byung /res gza' nyi ma zhig la gcen mo skal g.yang g.yu sgron gyis bu tshe ring dbang phyug khrid nas thug par 'gyor te/ bu tshe ring da bang phyug gis bon shod slob grwa'i dge rgan rtse drung log pa pad rdor lags su dwa phrug yin 79

nyam cung khrims rar 'tshud/ 79dbang skal bzang mi mang 'thus mi ma red dam brjod/ kho tsho deng dus gar song mi 'dug la a pho ngag dbang skal bzang mi mang gi 'thus mi yin min ngas rtsa ba nas mi shes zhes bshad/rjes su yang dri ba thengs bdun tsam bkod byung ba'i nang don gartsa bo ni/ bza' zla bsod nams bag gro dang gcung po log spyod pa'i lam du bskyod pa'i brgyud rim dang / lto kha nas bza' zla'i yi ge zengs ga tshod 'byor min/ bla dpon su zhig bstan srung dang blang dmag dang 'brel ba yod med/ bud med kyi ngo rgol la phyin min dris/ bza' zla dang gcung po dmag la 'gro khar ma gtogs ngas gros mol byas pa sogs brgyud rim rtsa ba nas shes ma byung / gung khran tang gis pho dang mo gnyis so so yin zhes gsungs kyi yod/ bza' zla dang gcung po log spyod pa'i lam du zhugs par nga la jus tog gang yang med/ bde mtshams kyi yi ge zengs gnyis tsam 'byor byung / bla dpon su zhig dang log spyod pa 'brel ba yod med shes ma byung zhes bshad/ skabs der a pho ngag dbang skal bzang gi bslab bya rnams phan thogs ha cang chen po byung /res gza' nyi ma zhig la gcen mo skal g.yang g.yu sgon gyis bu tshe ring dbang phyug khrid nas thug par 'byor te/ bu tshe ring da bang phyug gis bon shod sgob grwa'i dge rgan rtse drung log pa pad rdor lags su dwa phrug yin 79

80 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/brdzod de khong nas bon shod slob grwar bcug byung zhes shod mtshams/ nga tsho sdod sa'i nye 'gram la mi med pa dang bsnyun/ sgrol ma chodas 'aX mas/bcadan khang nang gzab gzab byas nas sdod ang / deng sang lha sa'i nang rgya mis lnga lha la gsum dang chag yang gnyis zer ba'i las 'gul spel nas de snga'i sde dawa na mi drag dang / bla ma bcas la 'thab rtsodad btang nas mi de zo shi min ro min rdung gi 'dug da dung bod dngul dang rgya dngul brje dbosnas pa'i btsan bka' btang nas mi tshang mang lnga ra pad shag phyogeng gun chen 11 bsduges 〈snang zhes bcesad/ (mchan 'grel/ bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs la ngo skol dang / ngo log zing 'grug la ngo skol/ mnga' bdag chen po gsum la ngo skol/ de snga'i khral dang 'u lag chag yang gtong rgyu bcas la zer )nyin zhig snyadags pa nga dang bud med bzhi za khang nye 'gram zas gasku khyodar gyi las byed skabs/ gtsug lag khang gi dathothor gnyer da〈snan sku zhabs bstan dar lags nyen rtewag gnyis kyis btso na khang lha 'gram lag gnyis lcags brgyab ste bar skor gyi 'go khrid dang / gtsug lag khang gi daskadar gnyer gnyis bcas kyis khrid/ gung tshigs kyi bostong tsam la sku zhabs bstan dar lags mi bzhis bkyag nas bcesan khang 〈sna 'gram bskyal/ zhal ras skrang zhing skad cha shod mi thub kyang mchu to skam po yang yang 'gul ba ngas chu dgos pa'i brdar go nas chu grang mo zhig phul/ de rjes btson khang nang 80

80 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/brjod de khong nas bon shod slob grar bcug byung zhes shod mtshams/ nga tsho sdod sa'i nye 'gram la mi med pa dang bsnyun/ sgol ma chos 'dzoms/bcon khang nang gzab gzab byas nas sdod ang / deng sang lha sa'i nang rgya mis ngo rgol gsum dang chag yang gnyis zer ba'i las 'gul spel nas de snga'i sde dpon mi drag dang / bla ma bcas la 'thab rtsod btang nas mi de tsho shi min ro min rdung gi 'dug da dung bod dngul dang rgya dngul brje dgos pa'i btsan bka' btang nas mi tshang mang por pad shag gyong gun chen 11 bzodas sonang zhes baljangad/ (mchan 'grel/ bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs la ngo rgol dang / ngo log zing 'khrug la ngo nol/ mnga' bdag chen po gsum la ngo rgol/ de snga'i khral dang 'u lag chag yang gtong rgyu bcas la zer )nyin zhig zhogs pa nga dang bud med bzhi za khang nye 'gram zas g.yo sbyor gyi las byed skabs/ gtsug lag khang gi dkor gnyer dpon sku zhabs bstan dar lags nyen rtog gnyis kyis brtsan khang sgo 'gram lag gnyis lcags brgyab ste bar sgor gyi 'go khrid dang / gtsug lag khang gi dkor gnyer gnyis bcas kyis khrid/ gung tshigs kyi gong tsam la sku zhabs bstan dar lags mi bzhis bkyag nas bcon khang sgo 'gram bskyal/ zhal ras skrang zhing skad cha shod mi thub kyang mchu to skam po yang yang 'gul ba ngas chu dgos pa'i brdar go nas thu grang mo zhig phul/ de rjes btson khang nang 80

nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 81glugs nas lha lcags brgyab ste bzhagamakhar rdo bla brang gi khang gnyer dbyangs can sgrol dkar ra mo che 'go khrid dang nyen rtog pas btson nas skad gtong skabs/ rngangs 'tshab chen pos/ wa ye/ sgro la chos/ tshing sgrol ma zhes nga gnyis kyi ming nas grangs med 'bod cing / nga ci 'dra byed dgos sam zhes/ gcin pa shor te go thung nas nar nar thon/ nga gnyis kyis btson khang gi kri to yodan la rogs pa byed mo gas zhes bshad pas kho pas dbyangs can sgrol dkar la lta tsam byas te/ nyes rdung gtang na tshur rtsis blang gi min zhes bshad/ de nas phar khrid nas cung zhig gi rjes tshur bskyal ba nyes rdung btang ma byung zhes brdzod/yang nyin gsum tsam rjes rgyud stod phyag mdzod chung ba dang / sku ngo ra sa rgya rgan/ rtse drung stodabs 'gyor brtson 'grus bcas kyang so so'i sa gnas kyi 'go khrid dang nyen rtewag pas khrid nas nyes rdung tshad med btang bas/ yar mis bkyag nas dawa ra zhing dus de nas bzung sku phra ra sa rgya rgan spyan gnyis phan med bzos/ nga phreng ring btson khang du bzhag ring las ka tsag tsig bskul ba las dam drag che ba gang yang ma byung /zla ba 'ga' yi rjes phreng ring btson khang gi btson pa rnams nas nyes 'gan che ba gha ṇi shar gyi a ṇis ga4pas mi drug tsam bzhag pa las/ nga 81

nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 81blugs nas sgo lcags brgyab ste bzhagamakhar rdo bla brang gi khang gnyer dbyangs can sgol dkar ra mo che 'go khrid dang nyen rtog pas btson nas skad gtong skabs/ rngangs 'tshab chen pos/ wa ye/ sgol chos/ tshing sgol ma zhes nga gnyis kyi ming nas grangs med 'bod cing / nga ci 'dra byed dgos sam zhes/ gcin pa shor te go thung nas nar nar thon/ nga gnyis kyis btson khang gi kri to yon la rogs pa byed rogs zhes bshad pas kho pas dbyangs can sgol dkar la lta tsam byas te/ nyes rdung gtang na tshur rtsis blang gi min zhes bshad/ de nas phar khrid nas cung zhig gi rjes tshur bskyal ba nyes rdung btang ma byung zhes brjod/yang nyin gsum tsam rjes rgyud stod phyag mdzod thung ba dang / sgu ngo ra sa rgya rgan/ rtse drung stobs 'byor brtson 'grus bcas kyang so so'i sa gnas kyi 'go khrid dang nyen rtog pas khrid nas nyes rdung tshad med btang bas/ yar mis bkyag nas dbor zhing dus de nas bzung sku ngo ra sa rgya rgan spyan gnyis phan med bzos/ nga phreng ring btson khang du bzhag ring las ka tsag tsig bskul ba las dam drag che ba gang yang ma byung /zla ba 'ga' yi rjes phreng ring bcon khang gi brtsan pa rnams nas nyes 'gan che ba gha ṇi shar gyi a ṇis gcesas mi drug tsam bzhag pa las/ nga 81

82 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/tsho so so'i ca dngos bskur te rnga chen slog khang du 'dzugs skrun byed par rlangs 'khor nang khrid/ rnga chen gyi ri gsham mthar slog btang ba'i lcags skud ze ma ra mgo rim pa gsum gyes bskor zhing de'i dbus btson pa sdod yul gur skya chil ler khengs shing / sgo gnyis mchis/ nga tsho'i sngon du gung min tang gi rgya mi btson pa nyis brgya tsam ngan las la ded bzhin pa dang /kho tsho phal che ba dmag dpon yin skor dang dus tshod kyi mtha' gsal gyi red ces bde skyid kyi skya rengs shig 'char rgyu'i yid ches drag tu byed/nga tsho slebs nas nyin gsum tsam rjes sa gnas so so nas bcon pa grangs med dbor yong ba mang che ba grwa pa yin pas ri sdebs dmar chil ler khengs/ nga tshor sa bkra bstan te ri chung kha bshag ste bar du slog khang bzo dgos zhes bshad song ba/ sa 'di nas log rgyu med pa 'chi rgyur nges snyam/ sgrub khang bla brang gi gnyer pa chos ldan yang rnga chen du las gar 'dug pa phyag mdzod kyi skor dri skabs se rar log rjes ske bsdams nas lcebs tshul gsungs/nga tsho bud med kyi gur nye 'gram paṇa chen 'os sprul rin po che dang khong gi yongs 'dzin 'dug yongs 'dzin rnam 'gyur ngan zhing gur du 'byor ba dang lam seng gzims nas bzhugs pa dgung lo bgres shing las ngal che bas min nam snyam/ las sar tshang ma mnyam du yin pas songs sprul 82

82 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/tsho so so'i ca dngos bskur te rnga chen glog khang du 'dzugs skrun byed par rlangs 'khor nang khrid/ rnga chen gyi ri gsham mthar glog btang ba'i lcags skud ze ma ra mgo rim pa gsum gyis bslor zhing de'i dbus btson pa sdod yul gur skya chil ler khengs shing / sgo gnyis mchis/ nga tsho'i sngon du gung min tang gi rgya mi bsgu na pa nyis brgya tsam ngan las la ded bzhin pa dang /kho tsho phal che ba dmag dasngo na yin skor dang dus tshod kyi mtha' gsal gyi red ces bde skyid kyi skya rengs shig 'char rgyu'i yid ches drag tu byed/nga cho slebs nas nyin gsum tsam rjes sa gnas sku so nas bathongan pa grangs med dngo ra sku nga ba mang che ba grwa pa yin pas ri ldebs dmar chil ler khengs/ nga chodar sa bkra bstan te ri chung kha bshag ste bar du glog khang bzo dgo sa zhes bshad song ba/ sa 'di nas 'e ga rgyu med pa 'chi rgyur nges snyam/ sgrub khang bla brang gi gnyer pa chos ldan yang rnga chen du las kar 'dug pa phyag mjortad kyi skor dri skabs se rar log rjes ske bsdams nas lcebs tshul gsungs/nga tsho bud med kyi gur nye 'gram paṇa chen 'os sprul rin po che dang khong gi yongs 'dzin 'dug yongs 'dzin rnam 'gyur ngan zhing gur du 'khyodar ba dang lam seng gzims nas bzhugs pa dgung lo bgres shing las ngal che bas min nam snyam/ las sar zurgang ma mnyam du yin pas 'os ji/la 82

nyam zung khrims rar 'tshud/ 83ren po cher g.yam rdo chung ba bskur te bzod yang byas kyang rin po ches/blugs shog blugs shog sgon mi 'dug gsungs/'tsho ba skyo 'ing las ka tho rengs skar gral ma zhig gong nas bskul ba dang bsgul ded che bas yangs pa can pa bkra shis rab brtan gyes za rgyu 'di 'dra dang / las ka 'di 'dra byed pa las thur mchongs pa dga' yi red/ ces bshad par khrims gcod kyis lag rtse nas rtswa thag gis rim brgyud bsdams nas mthar lag gnyis rgyab nas bsdams nas 'azen dus/ mig hril dbang med tshur don yong gi 'dug pa dang / chu tshod skar kha shas bzhag nas thag pa rim pas bkrol dus mig hril phar 'dzul gyi 'dug lto kha ba yon tan phun tshorags la yang 'thab 'dzings zengs gnyis btang /nga'i rkang par chu sbyar sgyes nas rgya mi'i sman bcos kyis phan 'bras ma sgon pa paṇa chen 'os sprul rin po cher rgyu mtshan zhus pas ljags phu btab pa'i rtsam pa gnang ste/ rin po ches gsungs pa bzhin mer bsregs nas byugs pas seng drag tu gyur/rnga chen slog khang du bdun rer zas thengs re bskyal bcug gi yod/nga'i khyim nas gcung mos bskyal ba'i zas nas gus mos rin po che ma bzhugs pa'i skabs khong gi mog cang phyur ba dang bye ma ka ra cung blugs nas bzhag gi yod/ rin po ches dang po sus blugs mi mkhyen yang rjes su mkhyen 83

nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 83rin po cher g.yam rdo chung ba bskur te bzod yang byas kyang rin po ches/glugs shog blugs ca ga skyodan mi 'dug gsungs/'ahrū ba skyo 'ing las ka tho rengs skar gral ma zhig gong nas bskul ba dang bskul ded che bas yangs pa can pa bkra shis rab brtan gyis za rgyu 'di 'dra dang / las ka 'di 'dra byed pa las chur mchongs pa dga' yi red/ ces bshad par khrims gcod kyis lag rtse nas rtswa thag gis rim brgyud bsdams nas mthar lag gnyis rgyab nas bsdams nas 'then/ dus/ mig hril dbang med tshur don yong gi 'dug pa dang / chu tshod skar kha shas bzhag nas thag pa rim pas bkrol dus mig hril phar 'dzul gyi 'dug lho kha ba yon tan phun snurags la yang 'thab 'dzings thengs gnyis btang /nga'i rkang par chu lbur skyes nas rgya mi'i sman bcos kyis phan 'bras ma thon pa paṇa chen 'os sprul rin/ po cher rgyu mtshan zhus pas ljags phu btab pa'i rtsam pa gnang ste/ rin lnga ches gsungs pa bzhin mer bsregs nas byugs pas seng drag tu gyur/rnga chen slog khang du bdun rer zas thengs re bskyal bcug gi yod/nga'i khyim nas gcung mos bskyal ba'i zas nas gus mos rin po che ma bzhugs pa'i skabs kho nga gi mo ga ca/nga phyur ba dang bye ma ka ra cung blugs nas bzhag gi yod/ rin po ches dang po sus glugs mi mkhyen yang rjes su mkhyen 83

84 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/te khyedad la rtag par phyu ra dang bye ma ka ra sus bskyal gyi 'dug gam zhes bka' dri gnang /nyin zhig nga tsho sa blugs pa'i sle po sgal par 'khyer nas bang sgrig ste dmag mi'i rgyab 'ded dang bcas ri ldebs sa dbor bzhin 'gro gi yod/nga brag g.yang khar slebs pa dang slo bur thod nas ri nyil te sa rud kyis nga g.yang la ded cing slel po rdo chen zhig gis mnan pas/ thog sa lnga tsam yod pa'i g.yang khar nga dpyang dpyang la bkal zhing rdul 'tshub kyis mun rub pa bzhin gang yang mi mthong / sa rdul 'jags rjes gsar du 'gyor ba'i dmag mi dang ngu shar tshir tshir byed pa'i las rogs rnams kyise nga dang sa cogeg mnan pa'i mi rnams bskyabs/wa da gzhung gi grwa bzhi'i dmag mi tshul khrims zla ba so/gas bce na pa las mi drug dang rgyab 'ded rgya dmag gnyis brag cadag mnan nas spyodangs pa dang / ram pa khang gnyer gyi tshe brtan sgrol ma sogs mi dgur rmas skyon tshabs che byung / sle wa cadas mnan med tshe nga 'chi rgyur the cho ma med kyang daspo na mchodag gi thugs rje'am las ba〈snad ma zad pas 'chi lam nas thar tsam byung / sa shodas mnan pa'i las mi 'ga'i lus sa so/ga nas malnga nga rgyu med kyang rdo gseb nas skra'i nyag ma thar thor sa steng mngon/yang nyin gcig tshogs 'du'i sar si ling mo na 'ba' pa legs 84

84 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/te khyod la rtag par phyu ra dang bye ma ka ra sus bskyal gyi 'dug gam zhes bka' dri gnang /nyin zhig nga tsho sa blugs pa'i sle po sgal par 'khyer nas bang sgrig ste dmag mi'i rgyab 'ded dang bcas ri ldebs sa dbor bzhin 'gro gi yod/nga brag g.yang khar spebs pa dang slo bur thod nas ri nyil te sa rud kyis nga g.yang la ded cing spel po rdo chen zhig gis mnan pas/ thog sa lnga tsam yod pa'i g.yang khar nga dpyang dpyang la bkal zhing rdul 'tshub kyis mun rub pa bzhin gang yang mi masang / sa rdul 'jags rjes gsar du 'byor ba'i dmag mi dang ngu shar tshir tshir byed pa'i las rogs rnams kyise nga dang sa 'o/ga mnan pa'i mi rnams bskyabs/bod gzhung gi grwa bzhi'i dmag mi tshul khrims zla ba sogs bcon pa las mi drug dang rgyab 'ded rgya dmag gnyis brag 'og mnan nas grongs pa dang / ram pa khang gnyer gyi tshe brtan sgol ma sogs mi dgur rmas skyon tshabs che byung / spe po rdos mnan med tshe nga 'chi rgyur the tshom med kyang daspo na mtsho ga gi thugs rje'am las bsod ma zad pas 'chi lam nas thar tsam byung / sa rdos mnan pa'i las mi 'ga'i lus sa 'og nas mthong rgyu med kyang rdo gseb nas skra'i nyag ma thar thor sa steng mngon/yang nyin gcig tshogs 'du'i sar si ling yon 'ba' pa legs 84

nyam chung khrims rar 'tshud/ 85bshad kyis mig chu galta nga bzhin slog gi 'phrul 'khor tshod blta byed skabs/stabs ma legs pa'i rkyen ngan 'phrad pas nga blta bar 'gro skabs dmag mi gnyis dang btson pa las mi bzhi 'phrul 'khor nang shor te sha thor rus thor phyin nas 'das/ dmag mi dang bsguran pa las mi su yin yang mi yin pas nga tshos mya ngan zhu dgo sa zhes ske bcad nas lkog mar byil byil byas/de nas 〈snan mtshams khyed ga rnams kyi sbed par thag pa btags nas gtsang por 'dzul zhing / bud med rnams kyis chu kha nas rdo brgyud sprod byas te rag brgyab/ rjes su bud med rnams la yang 'gyig gos g.yogs nas chu nang 'dzul bcug nas yar don pa dang a rag cung re blugs/ pho mo khyad med chu nang skar ma bco lnga tsam sdod dgos pa dang yar thon dus bzi yom yom gyis 'gyel grabs byed/rnga chen las grwa'i bsnyu na pa las mi gung min tang gi rgya mi phal che ba lo rgas lus gcong thog sa chu ma 'phrod pa'i dka/'a ngal dang / las kas mchu dang lag par gas shing rma mang ba mo gas nyam thag par yodad kyang / thag pas brag steng kho snur dpyang la bkal te brag gshag rgyu dang / rdzas me spar bcug de dag gi gzugs po'i nus pa shin tu zhan pas las kaci'achar gzhi ltar bsgrub ma thub pas sgyur bskadad ma btang ba'i nyes ming thog dmar gsod gtong gi yod red ces/ rgya mi gsum tsam 'ardzor dang 'jag ma/ 85

nyam thung khrims rar 'tshud/ 85bshad kyis mig chu gtong bzhin slog gi 'phrul 'khor chod blta byed skabs/stabs ma legs pa'i rkyen ngan 'phrad pas nga blta bar 'gro skabs dmag mi gnyis dang btson pa las mi bzhi 'phrul 'khor nang shor te sha thor rus thor phyin nas 'das/ dmag mi dang bcesan pa las mi su yin yang mi yin pas nga tshos mya ngan zhu dgos zhes ske bcad nas lkog mar byil byil byas/de nas stonan mtshams khyod ga rnams kyi sted par thag pa btags nas gtsang por 'dzul zhing / bud med rnams kyis chu kha nas rdo brgyud sgod byas te rag brgyab/ rjes su bud med rnams la yang 'khrug gos g.yogs nas zu nang 'dzul bcug nas yar don pa dang a rag cung re blugs/ pho mo khyad med khru nang skar ma bco lnga tsam sdod dgos pa dang yar thon dus bzi yom yom gyis 'gyel grabs byed/rnga chen las grwa'i bcasan pa las mi gung min tang gi rgya mi phal che ba lo rgas lus gcong thog sa chu ma 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal dang / las gas mchu dang lag par gas shing rma mang ba sogs nyam thag par yod kyang / thag pas brag steng kho cho dpyang la bkal te brag gshag rgyu dang / rdzas me spar bcug de dag gi gzugs po nus pa shin tu zhan pas las ka 'char gzhi ltar bsgrub ma thub pas sgyur bkod ma btang ba'i nyes ming thog dmar gsod gtong gi yod red ces/ rgya mi gsum tsam 'jor dang 'jag ma/ 85

86 nyan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'khyer nas sngon du phyin/ cung tsam nas rgya dmag gnyis kyis me mda' lag tu 'dzin nas btson pa las mi gcig ded/ dus yun gang mtshams nas me mda'i sgra rna lam du grags pa de 'dra ba'i ngang tshul thengs mang byung /nga brtsan nas slod khar gung min tang gi bcon pa las mi lnga bcu tsam las lhag med/ skabs re bod mi btson pa las mi grangs med rgya nag dang tshwa la dkar po la 'gro dgos zhes 'khrid 'gro/ nyin zhig rgya dpon krang go ha sogs rgya dpon mang po zhig yong ste thu tshod gcig tsam rtswa zhwa gyon te las ka byas nas par brgyab pa sonags byas/lha sar nga'i khyim na phrug gu gnyis dang lo bcu drug la son pa'i gcung mo chos g.yang las med pas phrug gur blta rtog ched spyi tshogs btson pa'i ming thog slod rgyu gtan khel/ rnga chen du sdod ring sems thag nye por gyur pa'i zi khron grung ching nas yin pa'i dmag mi'i sman pa mkhas pa zhig gi bza' zla bud med cig yod pa des/ mo rang lo lnga dmar shog 'og la btson du bsdad myong bas khyod rang spyi tshogs sgog phyin na yag po yong gi ma red/ yi ge cung shes kyi 'dug pas bod ljongs las byed slob grwar rgyugs/ngas thabs byas chog ces brjod kyang / ngas nga la phru gu gnyis yod pas khyim la 'o/ga gi yin zhes bshad/86

8snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'khyer nas cadan du phyin/ cung tsam nas rgya dmag gnyis kyis me mda' lag tu 'dzin nas bsungan pa las mi gcig ded/ dus ༷/na gang mtshams nas me mda'i sgra rna lam du grags pa de 'dra ba'i ngang tshul thengs mang byung /nga btson nas glod khar gung min tang gi btson pa las mi lnga bcu tsam las lhag med/ skabs re cadad mi bcasan pa las mi grangs med rgya nag dang tshwa la dkar po la 'gro dgos zhes 'khrid 'gro/ nyin zhig rgya dpo na krang go ha sogs rgya dpon mang po zhig yodang ste chu tsho da gcig tsam rtswa zhwa gyon te las ka byas nas par brgyab pa 〈snags byas/lha sar nga'i khyim na phrug gu gnyis dang lo bcu drug la son pa'i gcung mo chos g.yang las med pas phrug gur blta shodag ched spyi chongags bsgu na pa'i ming thog slod rgyu gtan khel/ rnga chen du sdod ring sems thag nye por gyur pa'i zi 〈snan grung ching nas yin pa'i dmag mi'i sman pa mkhas pa zhig gi bza' zla bud med cig yod pa des/ mo rang lo lnga dmar shog 'og la btson du bsdad myong bas khyod rang spyi tshogs thog phyin na yag po yong gi ma red/ yi ge cung shes kyi 'dug pas bod jongs las byed lho ba grwar rgyugs/ngas thabs byas chodag ces bcadad kyang / ngas nga la phru gu gnyis yod pas khyim la 'engag gi yin zhes bshad/86

rgan /de ma bcos drang gtam/bcupa/bza' dze+e bu phrug yun tsam thugaspyi lo 960zla 7tshes la dmangs ga/de bcos sgyur 'go tshugs/slod 'grol gtang rgyu'i bcon pa las mi bzhi bcu tsam mnyam du khungs so sor sprad rgyu'i yi ge re sprad de slod/khyim du 'byor rjes gcung mo dang dga' nye du ma 'dzoms/lha'u rta ra'i gzim shag tu bzos pa'i nga /de sa gnas kyi u yon lhan khang la 'byor sgo bkod par 'gro skabs rgya mo lo zung hung zha'o rmin zhes pas//ba stegs sgog bsdad bcug ste phru gu gnyis yod dam/nang khul gang sar bskyod chog mod/thag ring nas 'grul pa slebs tshe 'grul sgo brgyag dgos pa dang bskyod dgos byung na/snyan seng zhu dgos/zhes brjod/sa khul kru'u rin lha'u rta ra'i ma chen 'jam dbyangs dbang 'dus kyis/ wa ye/ a cag da nas bzung gcen lags zhes pa'i ming de yod 88

rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/mecupa/meza' shi bu phrug yun tsam bugaspyi 'e1 960zla 7tshes la dmangs ga4rware ba༄ges sgyur 'bo tshugs/spyodad 'bo la gtang rgyu'i bsguran pa las mi bzhi bcu tsam mnyam du khangs so sor sprad rgyu'i yi ge re sprad de slod/khyim du 'byor rjes gcung ༄mo dang dga' nye du ma 'dzoms/lha'u rta ra'i gzim shag tu bzos pa'i nga tsho'i sa gnas kyi u sku na lhan khang la 'gyor tho bkod par 'ahro skabs rgya mo lo chung hung zha'o rmin zhes pas/rkub stegs thog bsdad bcug ste phru gu gnyis yod dam/nang khul gang sar bskyod chog mod/thag ring nas 'gyul pa slebs tshe 'grul tho brgyag dbo sa pa dang bskyodad dbo sa byung na/snyan seng zhu dgos/zhes brjod/sa khul kru'u rin lha'u rta ra'i ma chen 'jam dbyangs dbang 'dus kyis/ wa ye/ a cag da nas bzubye 8gcen lags zhes pa'i ming de yod

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 89ma red/ nyin bco lnga nas lta rtog byed mir byas rjes gang byas dang nor 'khrul gang shor ngos len dang / zla ba rer zhu yig re sprad dgos/ zla ba gsum re nas tshogs 'du'i sgog ngos len zhu dgos zhes dgongs zhu bya yul tsu'u krang no nor ngo sgod byas/nyin shas nas nga'i khang pa sgo dgos bshad pa bzhin sgo skabs tshong zog rgya gar nas thon pa'i sgra 'dzin 'khor lo dang / rlung 'phrin bcas gzhung bzhes btang 'dug pa dang / dbyin ji'i tha mag kha bi yang gcung mo chos g.yang gis bo nga tshad ji yin ma shes par pham dzadang brgyab/ bsam grub gling du sge'u khung med pa'i khang pa nag khung zhig sprad byung ba der tshong zog lhag lus gzi byur cung dang shing sgrog sgo skabs shing sgrog mi gshongs pasaphyir brtsigs/ nang du mi sdod sa bzos pa yin/bkod sgrig byas pa'i ngal las la bskyod de nyin lnga tsam rjes tsu'u krang a ma zla ba'i zhus ngor 'go khrid lta bar yong nas/ de sngon se ra byes kyi khang pa sge'u khung la rgyug pa'i phra ma btang ba'i nag khung ring po zhig sprad/nga tsho'i sgo ra'i nang ser byes mkhan zur lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog dang mtshan zhabs sog po lhun grub chogs gnyis bzhugs yond/ rtag par ku ru zam par las gar 'khrid pa'i nyin zhig rgya 'bum sgang nas 'gro skabs rgyud stod kyi khang pa phyogs brgyad khang gsar phyogs nas sgol chos/ zhes 89

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 89ma red/ nyin bco lnga nas lta rtog byed mir byas rjes gang byas dang nor 'khrul gang shor ngos len dang / zla ba rer zhu yig re sprad dgos/ zla ba gsum re nas cho gas 'du'i thodag ngo sa len zhu dathodas zhes dbo ngas zhu bya yul tsu'u krang no nor ngo sprod byas/nyin shas nas nga'i khang pa the dgos bshad pa bzhin spo skabs tsho nga zog rgya gar nas thodan pa'i sgra 'dzin 'kho ra lo dang / rlung 'phrin bcas gzhung bzhes btang 'dug pa dang / dbyin ji'i tha mag kha bi yang gcung mo chodas g.yang gis lha nga tshad ji yin ma shes par pham snurang brgyab/ bsam grub gling du sge'u khung med pa'i khang pa nag khung zhig sprad byung ba der tshong zog lhag lus gzi byur cung dang shing slog spo skabs shing sgrog mi gshodangs pas phyir brtsigs/ nang du mi sdod sa bakhrodas pa yin/bkod sgrig byas pa'i ngal las la bskyod de nyin lnga tsam rjes tsu'u krang a ma zla ba'i zhus ngor 'go khrid lta bar yong nas/ de sngon se ra byes kyi khang pa sge'u khung la rgyug pa'i phra ma btang ba'i nag khung ring po zhig sprad/nga tsho'i lha ra'i nang ser byes mkhan zur lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog dang mtshan zhabs sku ga 〈sna lhun gyub chosags gnyis bzhugs yod/ rtag par ku ru zam par las kar 'khrid pa'i nyin zhig rgya 'bum sgang nas 'aX skabs rgyud lha da kyi khang pa phyogs brgyad khang gsar phyogs nas sgrol dzages/ zhes 89

90 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/'awa da/ phar bltas pas rta drel gyi lud phung zhig gi steng nas srin bal bar 'tshangs kyi khyodan gos hral drul 'dzar re ba zhig gyon/ mabo la a thodar dreg can bkab pa'i mi zhig gis sgro la chodas/ nga ngo e shes/ zhes pus mo ra lag gis ram skyor byed bzhin ga ler yar langs/ lus rid cing mig ya gcig zhar/ ya gcig de yang kong du 'dzul ba'i mi der zhib par bltas pas rgyud stod phyag mdzod rgan rig 'dzin red/ a tsi/ phyag mdzod rig 'dzin lags red/ gang du bzhugs sku da dam/ 'es dris pasakyi/ lta nga gis nga bathoton nas bdas skabs 'bordzo sa gzhan med stabs ngo shes bkra g.yang la rtsis sprad pas bkra g.yang gis nga ga〈sna gi sku da gsungs/ ngas sku na cung phul/de nas mi ring bar 'jig rten phyi mar bzhud/nyin zhig bu tshe ring dbang phyug sge dar dmar po dang dpung rtags dmar lnga btags nas slebs te rgan rig 'dzin tshe ring lags kyis nga slob phrug yag wa yin pas/ nyal chas 'khur nas slob grwar spo dbo sa gsungs byung zhes phyin te nyin bdun tsam rjes/ slob grwa'i dge rgan rig 'dzin tshe ring gis nga la a ma lags/ tshe phyug de ring slod kyi red gsungs/ ci yin nam snyam ste bka' dri zhu rtsis la rig 'dzin tshe ring lags rkang 'kho ra bzlogen nas phebs tshar/gung tshigs la bu tshe ring dbang phyug 'byor te rgan rig 'dzin tshe 90

90 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/'bod/ phar bltas pas rta drel gye lud phung zhig gi steng nas srin bal bar 'tshangs kyi gyon gos hral trul 'dzar re ba zhig gyon/ mgo la a cor dreg can bkab pa'i mi zhig gis sgol chos/ nga ngo e shes/ zhes pus mor lag gis ram skyor byed bzhin ga ler yar langs/ lus rid cing mig ya gcig zhar/ ya gcig de yang kong du 'dzul ba'i mi der zhib par bltas pas rgyud stod phyag mdzod rgan rig 'dzin red/ a tsi/ phyag mdzod rig 'dzin lags red/ gang du bzhugs yod dam/ 'es dris pas khong gis nga btson nas bdas skabs 'gro sa gzhan med stabs ngo shes bkra g.yang la rtsis sprad pas bkra g.yang gis nga gso gi yod gsungs/ ngas yon cung phul/de nas mi ring bar 'jig rten phyi mar bzhud/nyin zhig bu tshe ring dbang phyug ske dar dmar po dang dpung rtags dmar po btags nas slebs te rgan rig 'dzin tshe ring lags kyis nga slob phrug yag po yin pas/ nyal chas 'khur nas slob grwar spo dgos gsungs byung zhes phyin te nyin bdun tsam rjes/ slob grwa'i dge rgan rig 'dzin che ring gis nga la a ma lags/ tshe phyug de ring slod kyi red gsungs/ ci yin nam snyam ste bka' dri zhu rtsis la rig 'dzin tshe ring lags rkang 'khor bas na nas phebs tshar/gung tshigs la bu tshe ring dbang phyug 'byor te rgan rig 'dzin tshe 90

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 91ring lags kyis ga re gsungs sam/ zhes dris/ rgan lags kyis de ring slod kyi red ga/sungs byung khyed rang gis ga re byas sam/ a ma/ ngas nag pang ldebs gung khran tang phar rgyugs/ twa la'i bla ma khri 'o/ brtan pa lha gatshe ring dbang phyug khri lo brtan pa shog ces bris/ de rjes grogs po tshogs khug dang / don rdor/ bstan 'dzin don grub kyis kyang bris/ nga tsho gsum bar skor du phyin nas de don bris nas mjug la ming bkod pa yin/ ming la brten nas rtsad chod de nga dza bkar skabs dang po 'bri mkhan nga yin pa nang khul bshad pas/ nyin bdun tsam bkag nyar byas nas dge rgan gyis tshe ring dbang phyug khri 'o/ brtan pa shog ces bris yod pa de'i thog nas phrug gu'i bsam tshul yin pa mtshon pa red/ ces de ring glod byung zer/mtshan mo zhig nga'i rmi lam la bza' zla bsod nams bag gro shug pa thar thor du skyes pa'i bod kyi spang ri zhig tu phyu pa stod nas phud de gzi mdangs 2ma nas bsdad/ thag nyer rgod gnyis babs pa zhig rmis pas/sems la rnam rtog langs pa dang gnyid hob sad brgyab cing / da phal cher bza' zla'i rnam shes kyis nga la brda btang ba min nam snyam/de nas mi ring bar nga tsho ku ru zam par las ka byed pa'i nyin zhig nga lam seng yong dgos pa'i brda 'byor/ thal phung sgang du sgug pa'i dmag mi gnyis kyis khyim du khrid de nga dang bza' zla mnyam du brgyab pa'i par la 91
