92 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'di ngo shes sam zhes dris/ slo bur snying la tsha gzer brgyab nas ci shod ma byung zhing dpral pa nas kyang rngul nag nar nar thodan/ ga ler sems mnan nas nga'i bza' zla yin bshad/ dmag mi wa da rigs des khyodad kyi bza' zla gsang yib nye 'gram dgra wa thang gi dmag sgar la yod/ bza' zlas khyodad dang gtug rgyu'i re 'dodad bzhin sems pa bzang ba'i nga tsho'i dawa na lnga sa chodag mchan sprad sku nga bas/ sang nyin gtug par sna ga ces kho pa gnyis 'o/ga phyin/sang nyin snga dro u yon lhan khang gi bde 'jags las khungs su dathodangs zhur 'bo skabs dmag mis sgyu na nas bshad 'dug pas bde 'jags bag gro sa kar bo ra med par dgongs pa sprad/ gcen mo bza' chod gnyis kyi mdun phyin nas gnas tshul bshad pas/ bu blo ༷ sa lags kyis bso/da nams bag 〈sna lags phyu med na ma gaho gas tshur sku nga ba dpe mi srid ces hon thor thor byed/ nga dang gcen mos zas yag po zhig 'khyer zhing / bu tshe ring dbang phyug slob grwa nas dgongs pa zhus nas khrid/ dmag sgar phyi sgo srung skyob pas par dang nga bsdur te nang du btang / sgo gsum par 'byor skabs rgya chas spras pa'i gtsang mo zhig thug pa der 'bri gung nas khrid pa'i mi zhig 'dug gam/ zhes dris pas/ 'dug ces mnyam du khrid/khang chung zhig 'dzul skabs bza' zla lus la 'awa ga pa'i slog pa gyodan zhing khang pa der rgya gyum btings pa'i nyal khri gnyis dang rgya khyodag gcig 92

92 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/'di ngo shes sam zhes dris/ slo bur snying la tsha gzer brgyab nas ci shod ma byung zhing dpral pa nas kyang rngul nag nar nar thon/ ga ler sems mnan nas nga'i bza' zla yin bshad/ dmag mi bod rigs des khyod kyi bza' zla gsang yib nye 'gram dgra bo thang gi dmag sgar la yod/ bza' zlas khyod dang gtug rgyu'i re 'dod bzhin sems pa bzang ba'i nga tsho'i dpon pos chog mchan sprad song bas/ sang nyin gtug par shog ces kho pa gnyis log phyin/sang nyin snga dro u yon lhan khang gi bde 'jags las khungs su dgongs zhur 'gro skabs dmag mis sngon nas bshad 'dug pas bde 'jags bag gros gar kor med par dgongs pa sprad/ gcen mo bza' tsho gnyis kyi mdun phyin nas gnas tshul bshad pas/ bu slo gros lags kyis bsod nams bag gro lags spyo med na ma gtogs tshur yong ba dpe mi srid ces hon thor thor byed/ nga dang gcen mos zas yag po zhig 'khyer zhing / bu tshe ring dbang phyug slob gra nas dgongs pa zhus nas khrid/ dmag sgar phyi sgo srung skyob pas par dang nga bsdur te nang du btang / sgo gsum par 'byor skabs rgya chas spras pa'i gtsang mo zhig thug pa der 'bri gung nas khrid pa'i mi zhig 'dug gam/ zhes dris pas/ 'dug ces mnyam du khrid/khang zung zhig 'dzul skabs bza' zla lus la 'brog pa'i slog pa gyon zhing khang pa der rgya grum btings pa'i nyal khri gnyis dang rgya lcog gcig 92

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 9 'dug rgya dmag dpon gnyis dang drung yig gcig ring mda' 'khyer ba'i a mdo ba skad sgyur dmag mi zhig bcas rim gyis 'byor/ a mdo ba des nga la kho pa'i bza' zla yin nam/ zer ba dang bza' zlas mar bltas song ba bu tshe ring dbang phyug gis nga'i pa lags sprang po chags 'dug ces brjod/ phar phyogs khang par 'brog pa gnyis 'dug a cag sems khral gyes mig khru gtong /nga ni skyid po nyis rtseg med par sdug gsum rtseg ces pa ltar sdug gi kha grangs mang rkyen hon sgor ba lta bus ngu shor rgyu med par ga re byed par yong ngam/ zhes dris/ rang dang phrug gu dran pas tshur yong pa yin brjod/ngas khyod nga dang phrug gu dran drag pas da res dpe bsags pa red/ gung khran tang yang dag pa yin pas 'bras spungs do ba chen po dang zhe ṭam bla ma gnyis rang skyon ngos len zhus nas srid jus go yangs btang / khyod a phrug mgon po bkra shis log spyod pa'i rkub la rgyug na de ma gtogs yonang rgyu ci yod ces bshad/bza' zlas ltog tse'i sgang la khu tshur brdab nas phor pa sgog cing /ngag nas da bskos lto bskos gcig dang / phyi ma'i 'gro lam so so nged/bstan pa'i srog shing a 'brug sbyin bdag la log spyod ces/ bshad nyes che/khyed nga la mi dgos mar rgyugs zhes ngar/ skad sgyur a mdo des me mda'i 93

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 93'dug rgya dmag dpon gnyis dang drung yig gcig ring mda' 'khyer ba'i a mdo ba skad sgyur dmag mi zhig bcas rim gyis 'gyor/ a mdo ba des nga la kho pa'i bza' zla yin nam/ zer ba dang bza' zlas mar bltas song ba bu tshe ring dbang phyug gis nga'i pa lags sprang po chags 'dug ces bsnyu da/ phar phyogs khang par 'dzadag pa gnyis 'dug a cag sems khral gyis mig chu gaho nga /nga ni skyid po nyis rtseg med par sdug gsum rtseg ces pa ltar sdug gi kha grangs mang rkyen hon thor ba lta bus ngu shor rgyu med par ga re byed par yong ngam/ zhes dris/ rang dang phrug gu dran pas tshur sku nga pa yin brjod/ngas khyod nga dang phrug gu dran drag pas da res dpe bsags pa red/ gung khran tang yang dag pa yin pas 'bras spungs dod ba chen ngo dang zhi ṭam bla ma gnyis rang skyon ngos len zhus nas srid jus go yangs btang / khyod a phrug mabo/na lnga bkra shis 'o/ga 〈snad pa'i rkub la rgyug na de ma galta gas sku/nga rgyu ci yod ces bshad/bza' zlas lcog tse'i sgang la khu tshur brdab nas phor pa slog cing /ngag nas da bskos lto bskos gcig dang / phyi ma'i 'gro lam so/ so red/bstan pa'i snu ga shing a 'brug sbyin bdag la 'o/ga spyod ces/ bshad nyes che/khyed nga la mi dbo sa mar rgyugs zhes ngar/ skad sgyur a maro/ des me mda'i 93

95 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/mjug shing rdeg rtsis skabs rgya dpon gyis zhu ma bcug par nga zur du 'khrid nas kho da lta nga rgyal langs pa'i skabs red/ mgon po bkra shis snying gi rtsa la 'khyer bsdad yod/ gnas skabs 'di 'drar zhi 'jam byed dgos zhes bshad/ gzhi nas nga dmag mi de gnyis mdun ngu shor te dpe mi srid/mi pho rgod la 'jon pa'i rigs thams cad phar phyin na'ang kho cha mig thibs nas tshur 'ong / khyed tshos kho la zas yag po sprad rogs/ zhes bshad pas sems khral ma byed kho btson khang la bcug rgyu las gsad kyi ma red/ khyed gnis gleng mol byas nas sdod ces/ rgya dmag rnams gzhan du bskyod/ nga ya ri 'dzul skabs bza' zla bsod nams bag gros rgya mis ga re bshad dam/ zhes dris/ khyod rang 'gron drag nas srog bskyal bar slebs byung zhes bshad kyi 'dug byas pas/ gcen mos khyed rang tshur phebs nas ci byed/ rgya mis mi mang po bsad kyi 'dug ces ngus/ nyin gang nga cho khe gtsang bzhag byung / log khar yang rgya dpon gyis gnangs nyin nas si ling pu'u la bskyal rgyu yin pas sang nyin gtug par shog ces bshad byung ba/ sang nyin yang bskyod/gnangs nyin nga gnyis si ling pu'u la phyin pas yar btang gi mi 'dug la der bskyal yod med skad cha dri sa yang ma snyed/ thog khar yar bltas pas ngo shes btson pa drung 'khor dkyus ma zhig dang mi gsum zha la 94

94 rgan lngarware ma bcos drang gtam/mjug shing rkeg rtsis skabs rgya dpon gyis zhu ma bcug par nga zur du 'khrid nas kho da lta nga rgyal langs pa'i skabs red/ mgon po bkra shis snying gi rtsa 'a 'khyer bsdad yod/ gnas skabs 'di 'drar zhi 'jam byed dgos zhes bshad/ gzhi nas nga dmag mi de gnyis mdun ngu shor te dpe mi srid/mi sgyu rgod la 'jon pa'i rigs thams cad phar phyin na'ang kho cha mig thibs nas tshur 'ong / khyed tshos kho la zas yag po sprad rogs/ zhes bshad pas sems khral ma byed kho btson khang la bcug rgyu las gsad kyi ma red/ khyed gnyis gleng mol byas nas sdod ces/ rgya dmag rnams gzhan du bskyod/ nga yar 'dzul skabs bza' zla bsod nams bag gros rgya mis ga re bshad dam/ zhes dris/ khyod rang 'jon drag nas srog bskyal bar slebs byung zhes bshad kyi 'dug byas pas/ gcen mo sa khyed rang tshur phebs nas ci byed/ rgya mis mi mang po bsad kyi 'dug ces ngus/ nyin gang nga tsho khe gtsang bzhag byung / log khar yang rgya dasnga na gyis gnangs nyin nas si ling pu'u la bskyal rgyu yin pas sang nyin gtug par shog ces bshad byung ba/ sang nyin yang bskyod/gnangs nyin nga gnyis si ling pu'u la phyin pas yar btang gi mi 'dug la der bskyal yod med skad cha dri sa yang ma rnyed/ thog khar yar bltas pas ngo shes btson pa drung 'khor dkyus ma zhig dang mi gsum zha la 94

bza' mi bu sbug yun tsam thug 95rgyag bzhin pa gcen mos da nangs bathoton pa slebs sam zhes 'a1/da pa/ drung 'khor gyis nga gnyis la rgyab slog ste gzhas mdangs dang bstun/ bstan srung dang blang dmag gi phogs dpon red zer ba'i mi zhig gro mo dge bshes rin po che'i mnyam da nangs zhogs pa bcug nyin bco lnga'i rjes ma gtogs da lta thug pa'i go skabs med/ ces brdzod pa / nga gnyis kyis nang don yid la nges par byas te kar lor med par khyim du bskyodad pa'i lam gyi chu khung chen po zhig tu nyin shas nas rang shi brgyab pa'i bdag med kyi bod mi'i mo zhig mchis/zla ba gnyis tsam mjug la gro mo dge bshes rin po che'i phyag mdzod kyi sku zla slo chos lags nga'i khyim du phebs nas gro mo dge bshes rin po che slod pa dang / khong gis bza' zla bso/da nams bag gro da skabs bde thang yin/ mgyodags ngo sgru da mi sku/nga ngam/ gsungs byung zhes bshad/ nga nyin zhig tshong khang nang bsdad pa 'i skabs rin po che mjal ba thog khar gang/na drangs/ lta nga gis rgya mis nga rgya gar gyi mi khosgongs yin pas rgya gar la mkhyodags po gtang chodag bshad byung / gnas tshul ci yod yi ge bris nas bskyal cadag ngas 7go nga sa mchog la nges par dbul chodag ces gsungs/ gzhan bka' mol zhib lhong ma byung bar rin po che khong phebs/shar sing ma ba bkra shis dodan grub kyis rin wa cher phebs sgrig gang sku da zhus 95

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 95rgyag bzhin pa gcen mos da nangs btson pa slebs sam zhes 'bod pa/ drung 'khor gyis nga gnyis la rgyab slog ste gzhas mdangs dang bstun/ bstan srung dang blang dmag gi phogs dpon red zer ba'i mi zhig gro mo dge bshes rin po che'i mnyam da nangs zhogs pa bcug nyin bco lnga'i rjes ma gtogs da lta thug pa'i go skabs med/ ces brjod pa / nga gnyis kyis nang don yid la nges par byas te gar lor med par khyim du bskyod pa'i lam gyi zu khung chen po zhig tu nyin shas nas rang shi brgyab pa'i bdag med kyi bod mi'i ro zhig mchis/zla ba gnyis tsam mjug la gro mo dge bshes rin po che'i phyag mdzod kyi sku zla blo chos lags nga'i khyim du phebs nas gro mo dge bshes rin po che slod pa dang / khong gis bza' zla bsod nams bag gro da skabs bde thang yin/ mgyogs po slod mi yong ngam/ gsungs byung zhes bshad/ nga nyin zhig tshong khang nang bsdad pa 'i skabs rin po che mjal ba thog khar gangan drangs/ khong gis rgya mis nga rgya gar gyi mi khongs yin pas rgya gar la mgyogs po gtang chog bshad byung / gnas tshul ci yod yi ge bris nas bskyal gog ngas 7gong sa mchog la nges par dbul chog ces gsungs/ gzhan bka' mol zhib lhong ma byung bar rin po che khong phebs/shar sing ma ba bkra shis don grub kyis rin po cher phebs sgrig gang yod zhus 95

96 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nas sdod skabs/ nyin zhig blo chos lags kyis rin po che phreng ring la rgya mis khrid nas nyin gsum 'das kyang go rgyu mi 'dug ces sems khral byed/nyin lnga tsam song ba'i rjes nga gad 'phyag pa'i skabs slo chos lags phebs te rin po che phreng ring la gdan drangs tshul gyis shar sing mar bskyal nas phebs 'byor zin pa'i lan 'byor byung zhes bshad/ de'i sang nyin rgya gzhung gis shar sing ma'i bkra shis don grub bzung nas rin po che dang 'brel ba gang yod ces phreng ring du lo gnyis bcug pa red/rin po ches gsungs pa bzhin nga'i bza' zla nyin shas nas dmag dpon gsum gyis khyim du bskyal te nga'i lta rtog pa dang gus gnyis u yon lhan khang la skad btang ste/ lha sar zing 'khrug skabs bros pa'i khri smon sras dang / kong po nas bzung ba'i sde dge ba ja rgod bsam 'phel bza' zla bsod nams bag gro bcas kho tsho gsum slod pas bsod nams bag gror khyod chos rogs pa byed dgos zhes bshad/ sang nyin nas bza' zla bsod nams bag gror yig cha sgog sbyang byed rgyu zhig sprad de lha sa nas bros byol phyin pa'i nang mir slob gso spel te bros byol ba rnams mgyogs tsam log na/ nga tsho bzhin nyes med slod rgyu red ces bshad bcug bza' zla bso da nams bag gro dgong mo yid thang chad nas tshur yong ste khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gis nga tsho'i mi thug rgyu med pa khyed chos bzos/ da skabs khyed tsho skyid po 96

9snyo rgan lngatware ma bce sa drang gtam/nas sdod skabs/ nyin zhig slo chos lags kyis rin po che phreng ring la rgya mis khrid nas nyin gsum 'das kyang bo rgyu mi 'dug ces sems khral byed/nyin lnga tsam so/nga ba'i rjes nga gad 'phyag pa'i skabs slo chodas lags phebs te rin po che phreng ring la gdan drangs tshul gyis shar sing mar bskyal nas phebs 'byor zin pa'i lan 'byor byung zhes bshad/ de'i sang nyin rgya gzhung gis shar sing ma'i bkra shis po na grub bzung nas rin wa che dang 'brel ba gang yod ces phreng ring du lo gnyis bcug pa red/rin wa ches gsungs pa bzhin nga'i bza' zla nyin shas nas dmag dpon gsum gyis khyim du bskyal te nga'i lta lta ga pa dang gus gnyis u sku na lhan khang la skad btang ste/ lha sar zing 'khrug skabs spradas pa'i khri spyodan sras dang / kong po nas bzung ba'i sde dge ba ja rgod bsam 'phel bza' zla bse da nams bag gro bcas kho chod gsum sgru da pas bamo da nams bag bo ra khyod chodas ro/gas pa byed dgos zhes bshad/ sang nyin nas bza' zla bsod nams bag bo ra yig cha sgrog sbyang byed rgyu zhig sprad de lha sa nas bros byol phyin pa'i nang mir slob ga〈sna spel te snga sa drotel ba rnams mgyogegs tsam 'e/ga na/ nga tsho bzhin nyes med slod rgyu red ces bshad bcug bza' zla bso da nams bag spyod dbo nga mo yid thang chad nas tshur sku nga ste khyim tshang 'ga' zhig gis nga tsho'i mi thug rgyu med pa khyed tshos bzos/ da skabs khyed chod skyid po 96

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 97byas/ nga cho ra snying tshim rgyag gi yod dam/ zhes rgyag res brgyab kyi 'dug zer/ bza' zlas 'brel yod 'go khrid la nga mu mthud btson khang du bcug rogs/ slob gso spel bar 'gro yi min/ zhes bshad/ 'go khrid des bya rgodad bsam 'phel dang khri smon sras kyang bskyod kyi yod pas 'bo dbo sa zhes bshad kyang de nyin nas ma bskyod/ de nas nga tsho'i lho'i khyim mtshes spos bcug nas der nyen rtog pa gnyis bsdad/nyin shas ring bza' zla bsku da nams bag gro dang nga gnyis phan tshun gyi skyid sdug lhug mol byung ba bza' zla btson khang nang slebs don ni/ rdzo kha'i chu bzhi sgang drug gi rten gzhi thor nas rag ra dang cha phreng thub bstan gnyis kyi shog rtsa ri phyo gas la yodad pa/ kho tshor gnas tshul mkho gtong ched sa cha dang mi rgyus mnga'i bab dang bsnyun/ 'bri gung du sku nga nas 'brog par rdzus te mi ser dkyus ma la chodang bskur nas lha sar gnas tshul nyul bar btang ste/ gnas tshul rtsa ri phyogs kyi dang blang dmag mir 'phrod thabs byas/ gnas tshul mkhe sgrub byed mkhan de gras nas par rgyag lag rtsal shes pa'i dkar mdzes 'phrin las bsam grub ji'i lung khrang dang / 'bri gung gi dbul po'i bu zhig lha sar 'dzin bzung byas/ 'bri gung mthil dgon pa'i grwa pa rdob rdob rgyal mchog dang / pha dzi gnyis snga rjes rtsa ri'i phyogs chu bzhi sgang drug sar gnas tshul bskyal bar 'gro skabs gtsang po zhig gi 97

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 97byas/ nga tshor snying tshim rgyag gi yod dam/ zhes rgyag res brgyab kyi 'dug zer/ bza' zlas 'brel yod 'go khrid la nga mu mthud bcon khang du bcug rogs/ slob gso spel bar 'gro yi min/ zhes bshad/ 'go khrid des bya rgod bsam 'phel dang khri spon sras kyang bskyod kyi yod pas 'gro dgos zhes bshad kyang de nyin nas ma bskyod/ de nas nga tsho'i lho'i khyim mtshes sgos bcug nas der nyen rtog pa gnyis bsdad/nyin shas ring bza' zla bsod nams bag gro dang nga gnyis phan tshun gyi skyid sdug lhug mol byung ba bza' zla btson khang nang spebs don ni/ lho kha'i chu bzhi sgang drug gi rten gzhi thor nas rag ra dang cha phreng thub bstan gnyis kyi shog rtsa ri phyogs la yod pa/ kho tshor gnas tshul mkho gtong ched sa cha dang mi rgyus mnga'i bab dang bsnyun/ 'bri gung du yong nas 'brog par rdzus te mi ser dkyus ma la chong bskur nas lha sar gnas tshul nyul bar btang ste/ gnas tshul rtsa ri phyogs kyi dang blang dmag mir 'phrod thabs byas/ gnas tshul mkho ngasgrub byed mkhan de gras nas par rgyag lag rtsal shes pa'i dkar mdzes 'phrin las bsam grub ji'i lung khrang dang / 'bri gung gi dbul po'i bu zhig lha sar 'dzin bzung byas/ 'bri gung mthil dgon pa'i grwa pa rdob rdob rgyal mchog dang / pha dzi gnyis snga rjes rtsa ri'i phyogs thu bzhi sgang drug sar gnas tshul bskyal bar 'gro skabs gtsang po zhig gi 97

98 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/mdun nas rgya mis bzung nas tshur khrid/gzhan rnams kyis gsang ba dngos sbas te rang mgo thon thabs gnas tshul 'grel bshad byas pas khungs 'khyol yang / 'bri gung gi dbul po'i bu de'i pha shang krang yin pa/sa gsang ba khrur gyar te bza' zla bsod nams bag 11 bzung ste lcags brgyab nas mal gro gung dkar la zhag lnga bkag nyar byas/ rgya mis bza' zlar dang blang dmag gi so pa yin min dri skabs min zhes bshad/ khungs skyel re re nas byed skabs khyod chos shes na/ da bar nga bzung ma thub pa lag sus bsdams sam/ zhes shod skabs nyes rdung btang /nga sond/ ma gsad na khyed dzad min/ shi ma thub na nga mi min/ zhes bshad skabs nyes rdung gis sman khang la 'khrid dgos bzos byung zhes bshad/dgong mo de skad cha de tsam la mtshams bzhag nas nga tsho gnyid du yur/ nyin zhig nga rang khrom bton nas bsdad pa'i skabs sngar gyi la rgyar bsams te u yon nor bu chos sgon ched du yong ste/ nga'i khyim mtshes nyen rtog pas se'u khung 'gram nas gsang nyan byed kyi yod sgor brda sprad/ de don ngas bza' zlar bshad pas bza' zlas nga la mgo skor gtong ched gnas skabs slod pa las yang bskyar 'dzin bzung byed kyi red/ nga dang blang dmag gi phogs dpon byas pa rgya mis shes kyi red/ ces zer/spyi lo 1961 nyin zhig bza' zla bsod nams bag gror gang nas 98

98 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/mdun nas rgya mis bzung nas tshur khrid/gzhan rnams kyis gsang ba da3ges sbas te rang mgo thon thabs gnas tshul 'grel bshad byas pas khungs 'khyodal yang / 'bri gung gi dbul po'i bu de'i pha shang krang yin pa/sa gsang ba phyir gyar te bza' zla bamo da nams bag bo bzung ste lcags brgyab nas mal ༷ gung dkar la zhag lnga bkag nyar byas/ rgya mis bza' zlar dang blang dmag gi so pa yin min dri skabs min zhes bshad/ khungs skyel re re nas byed skabs khyod tshos shes na/ da bar nga bzung ma thub pa lag sus bsdams sam/ zhes shod skabs nyes rdung btang /nga sod/ ma gsad na khyed snur min/ shi ma thub na nga mi min/ zhes bshad skabs nyes rdung gis sman khang la 'khrid dgo sa bakhrodas byung zhes bshad/dgong mo de skad cha de tsam la mtshams bzhag nas nga tsho gnyid du yur/ nyin zhig nga rang kho ma bshedan nas bsdad pa'i skabs sngar gyi la rgyar bsams te u yon nor bu chodas sprodan ched du yong ste/ nga'i khyim mtshes nyen rtog pas se/'u khung 'gram nas gsang nyan byed kyi yod skor brda sprad/ de don ngas bza' zlar bshad pas bza' zlas nga la mgo sgo ra gtong ched gnas skabs slod pa las yang bskyar 'dzin bzung byed kyi red/ nga dang blang dmag gi phogs darngegen byas pa rgya mis shes kyi red/ ces zer/spyi 'o/ 1961 nyin zhig bza' zla bsku da nams bag gror gang nas 98

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 99sgos min ma shes kyang 7skyabs mgon rin po che rgya gar du chos tshogs kyis chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bas/ gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi cho ga gtang na/ zhes bshad/ nga la gzi byur chen po kha shas yod pa gzhan la btsong rgyur bskyal nas gong tshad mtho tsam byung bas/ smon lam sku 'gyed sgor lnga re dang mang ja phul zhing gnas brtan phyag mchod 'don ched de mo rin po che dang / lha btsun rin po che/ ser byes mkhan zur gtsang pa thabs mkhab/ lags/ mtshan zhabs lhun grub tshonags gnyis bcas se ra byes kyi bla chung zhig gi gzim shag skal gdong nang gdan drangs/ bza' zla bsod nams bag gro g.yol ched khrom tsag tsig bton par bskyod/lha btsun rin po ches rten 'brel yin zhes gsungs te yun tsam gsol ja mchod nas phebs te gsol zas phar bskyal bar shog gsungs/ser byes mkhan zur gtsang pa lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog gi dge phrug byams ba bstan 'dzin lags su gus mos bla ma'i gsol chas la nga lag pa 'chang gi min pas khyed kyis bzo rogs/ ngas me ma hur thag byas chog ces zhus/ byams pa bstan 'dzin lags dang sku zhabs gzhan zhig gis mog mog bzo rtsis skabs de mo rin po ches mog mog mthil mthug po dang yag po bzo dgos pa'i sgob ston gnang / gung tshigs la sha mog phul skabs kha shas rdol ba de mo rin po ches gzigs skabs rnam rtog slong mkhan ma byan 99

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 99thos min ma shes kyang 7skyabs mthosten rin dzege che rgya gar du chos tshogs kyis chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bas/ gnas brtan phyag mdzar+shad kyi ces ga gtang na/ zhes bshad/ nga la gzi byur chen ngo kha shas yod pa gzhan la btsong rgyur bskyal nas gong tshad mtho tsam byung bas/ smon lam sku 'gyed sgor lnga re dang mang ja phul zhing gnas brtan phyag mchod 'don ched de mo rin po che dang / lha btsun rin po che/ ser byes mkhan zur gtsang pa thabs mkhasdo/ lags/ mtshan zhabs lhun grub dza'igs gnyis bcas se ra byes kyi bla chung zhig gi gzim shag skal gdong nang gdan drangs/ bza' zla bsod nams bag ༷ ga/sku la ched kho ma tsag tsig bton par bskyod/lha btsun rin po ches rten 'brel yin zhes gsungs te yun tsam gsol ja mchodad nas phebs te gso/la zas phar bskyal bar cadag gsungs/ser byes mkhan zur gtsang pa lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog gi dge phrug byams pa bstan 'dzin lags su gus mo sa bla ma'i gsol chas la nga lag pa 'chang gi min pas khyed kyis bzo rogs/ ngas me ma hūr thag byas chodag ces zhus/ byams pa bstan 'dzin lags dang sku zhabs gzhan zhig gis mog mog bzo rtsis skabs de mo rin po ches mog mog mthil mthug po dang yag po bzo dgos pa'i slob ston gnang / gung tshigs la sha mog phul skabs kha shas rdol ba de mo rin po ches gzigs skabs rnam rtog slong mkhan ma byan 99

100 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/su red dam/ yar shodag gsungs/ byams bstan lags kyis yar phyin nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhus/gnas brtan phyag mchodad kyi chod ga btang nas nyin lnga 'das pa'i mtshan mo'i nam phyed sgo rar rdog sgra sogs 'ur zing brgyab cing / sgo drag tu rdung byung bas ngas bzhu mar spar nas shin tu nag pa'i khang pa ga ler gsal bar byas pa dang / bza' zlar sngon du yar langs nas sgo dbye dang zhes bshad/ phru gu gnyis nyal sa nas gsang rjodad nang 10sa/ phyi nas 'o/ga spyod pa mar thon shog ces pa'i sgra dang / me mda'i sgor tog dkrugs pa'i sgra mnyam du thos/ nga gnyis mar blta bar 'gro skabs khyodan pa'i kha nas nga'i nang la bi ri lhan gyis so/ kha sprad pa se gas dza drag gi drag rtsub la khyim mtshes rnams kyang langs nas rim pas sgo rar 'jomams/bza' zla bso/da nams bag ༷ sa nga gsad gtub ci byed khyed tsho'i lag tu sku da pas dkrog dkrog byas te bud med dang phru gur zhed snang bskul ba las kyi tha red/ ces bshad par/ dmag dasnga na sde dge ba zhig gis pho khyo ga de ring nas 'gro rgyu red zer/ bza' zlas khyed sems khral ma byed nga 'asprod shag shag yin/ 〈snad rgya phyogs 'dzul ba 'joston 〈sna yin bsams kyi 'dug gam/ zhes dris/ bo/ pas nga 'dzul sku da ces bshad de dmag mi la bza' zla bamo da nams bag bo 'dzin dgo sa pa'i bka' btang / ngas rgan 100

100 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/su red dam/ yar shog gsungs/ byams bstan lags kyis yar phyin nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhus/gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi cho ga btang nas nyin lnga 'das pa'i mtshan mo'i nam phyed sgo rar rdog sgra sogs 'ur zing brgyab cing / sgo drag tu rdung byung bas ngas bzhu mar spar nas shin tu nag pa'i khang pa ga ler gsal bar byas pa dang / bza' zlar sngon du yar langs nas sgo dbye dang zhes bshad/ phru gu gnyis nyal sa nas gsang spyod nang bros/ phyi nas log spyod pa mar sgon shog ces pa'i sgra dang / me mda'i sgor tog dkrugs pa'i sgra mnyam du thos/ nga gnyis mar blta bar 'gro skabs khron pa'i kha nas nga'i nang la bi ri ghan gyis so kha sprad pa sogs dza drag gi drag rtsub la khyim mtshes rnams kyang langs nas rim pas sgo rar 'dzoms/bza' zla bsod nams bag gros nga gsad gtub ci byed khyed tsho'i lag tu yod pas dkrog dkrog byas te bud med dang phru gur zhed snang bskul ba las kyi tha red/ ces bshad par/ dmag dpon sde dge ba zhig gis pho khyo ga de ring nas 'gro rgyu red zer/ bza' zlas khyed sems khral ma byed nga 'gro shag shag yin/ khyod rgya phyogs 'dzul ba 'jon po yin bsams kyi 'dug gam/ zhes dris/ bo pas nga 'dzul yod ces bshad de dmag mi la bza' zla bsod nams bag gro 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' btang / ngas rgan 100

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 101lags ga par bskyal gyi red dam/ zhes sde dge ba der dris pas phreng ring la bskyal gyi red ces brdzod/bza' zla bsku da nams bag bo khyim du zla ba gcig las ma bzhag par snying rje bral ba'i rgya dmag spyang ki'i khyu che gas kyis khrid skabs nga la khyed slo bde po gyis zhes 'bod yong / sems sdug lci pos mtshan ring de bskyal nas nam skya ldang skabs sgo ra gcig nang sdod pa'i mgar rigs bud med tshes gsum nga'i mdun slebs te/ ngas rgya dmag gis rjes ded byas pas nga phod phyogs nas khrid song zhes lan sprad byung ba rang nyid kyi nyen 'gan la ma bsams par/ sems 'khur de lta bu byas par sems dbus dga' snang tshad med byung / nyi shar mtshams gus nyal chas 'khyer nas phreng ring btson khang du phyin nas zo krang nor bu rdo rje la/ rgan lags sku mkhyen nga'i bza' zla'i nyal chas blang rogs gyis zhes re ba bton pas/ su red dam/zhes tshur dris pa bstan srung dang blang dmag gi phogs dpon red zer ba'i mi de red bshad pas/ 'o da/ khyed kyi bza' zla de 'dra yin pa dpe bsags pa red/ ces sems khral che ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas mal chas nyen rtog pa brgyud rtsis blangs/ de rjes zla ba gnyis zas sprod ma bcug pa dang thug 'phrad bkaganyin zhig tsha ba ro/nga pa g.yu sgron mkhar rgyug btsugs nas 'khyar 101

bza' mi bu phrug yun tsam thug 101lags ga par bskyal gyi red dam/ zhes sde dge ba der dris pas phreng ring la bskyal gyi red ces brjod/bza' zla bamo da nams bag gro khyim du zla ba gcig las ma bzhag par snying rje bral ba'i rgya dmag spyang ki'i khyu tshorags kyis khrid skabs nga la khyed blo bde po gyis zhes 'bod yong / sems sdug lci pos mtshan ring de bskyal nas nam skya ldang skabs sgo ra gcig nang sdod pa'i mgar rigs bud med tshes gsum nga'i mdun slebs te/ ngas rgya dmag gis rjes ded byas pas nga phod phyogs nas khrid song zhes lan sprad byung ba rang nyid kyi nyen 'gan la ma bsams par/ sems 'khur de lta bu byas par sems dbus dga' snang tshad med byung / nyi shar mtshams gus nyal chas 'khyer nas phreng ring btson khang du phyin nas zo krang nor bu rdo rje la/ rgan lags sku mkhyen nga'i bza' zla'i nyal chas blang rogs gyis zhes re ba bton pas/ su red dam/zhes tshur dris pa bstan srung dang blang dmag gi phogs dpon red zer ba'i mi de red bshad pas/ 'o da/ khyed kyi bza' zla de 'dra yin pa dpe bsags pa red/ ces sems khral che ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas mal chas nyen lta ga pa brgyud rtsis blangs/ de rjes zla ba gnyis zas sgod ma bcug pa dang thug 'phrad bkaganyin zheg tsha ba rong pa g.yu sgron mkhar rgyug btsugs nas 'khyar 101

102 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/'khyor nga'i mdun yong / skabs der g.yu sgon gyi ngang tshul ni lus la phyu pa hral drul zhig gyon zhing mgo skra'i lan bu rnams zang zing du gyur/ na tshod sum cu yol tsam gyi dar ma zhig yin yang dpral par shar shur gnyer ris mang zhing / nag nog dreg pa mthug po bgos pa'i bzhin gye mdog rang nyid kyi mgo skyes la 'gran pa lta bu zhig mchis/ dab dib ngag gis sgrol chos/ nga la don zhig bshad rgyu yod pas gtsug lag khang la yong rogs zer/ ngas g.yu sgon khrid de 'gro skabs gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'phyor du bskyod mtshams bzhag ste g.yu sgron gyis jo bo rin po che'i phyogs su mdun gtad de thal mo sbyar/ ngag nas shab shub spon lam 'don mur mig rbu phrum phrum btang ste yun tsam bsdad/ de nas mig 'og mchi mas das/ kyang gzhi nag pa'i gdong nga la gtad de nyin shas sdon ngas ske la gri btab nas rang shi brgyag rtsis byas kyang 'chi ma thub ces rma shul de mig la bstan/mu mthud bshad don/ gnad don de ni dbyangs can la ngas gser to la bzhi g.yar ba skyin tshab rgya sgor nyis brgya las ma sprad pa ma zad/ nga la chab srid kyi gnad don bzos nas sdug sna rgu la sbyar/ bstan srung dang blang dmag la phyin pa'i nga'i bza' zla slo bzang rgyal mtshan 'chi med pa dang sgol chos khyod dang thug na/ nga 'chi ba'i gnad don tshang ma dbyangs can la thug yond ces lan sprad dgos/ ngas don de a cag a yod dang spun 102

bza' mi bu prug yun tsag thug 10 mched gzhan zhig la yang mngags yod/ khyod kyis jo bo rin po che dpang du btsugs nas don de khas blang dgos zhes u tshugs kyis mna' bskyal bcug byung / skabs der ngas sems gso rim par btang yang nyin lnga tsam nas skyid thu sngon mor mchongs nas lcebs/dge sdig spang blang med pa//g.yo rgyu'i thabs la 'bad de//rang bde gzhan gnod tha ma//'gyod pa'i gling du bskyal lo//103

104 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/bcu gcigaganas chung ge nang rten/spyi lo 1963 lo nyin zhig gus de mo bla brang du bcar bas de mo rin po che dang / gnas chung mchog sprul rin po che/ khri ngag dbang nor bu bcas lhan rgyas bzhugs te mdun lcog thog phur pa zhig bzhag gnang /nged la de mo rin po ches 'di mgo la 'jog ces phur pa'i byin rlabs gnang zhing / gnas thung mchog sprul rin po ches gser to la gsum dang / sa snum lcags kring gcig nyo sa yod dam/ gsungs/ gser dang sa snum thabs ngas zhus chog ci mdzad dam zhus pas/ khri ngag dbang nor bu dang nga gnyis bum pa ri la bsang gtang bar 'gro dgos gsungs/de dag gus mos thabs shes zhus te yar phul bas khong rnam pa gnyis bum pa ri la bsang btang nas mar phebs te rten 'brel yag po byung zhes mnyes tshor dpag med gnang / de mo rin po ches bka' 'dri gnang 104

104 rgan mo'i ma bcethos drang gtam/bcu gcigaganas chung gi nang rten/spyi 'o/ 1963 lo'i nyin zhig gus de mo bla brang du bcar bas de mo rin po che dang / gnas chung mchog sprul rin po che/ khri ngag dbang chodar bu bcas lhan rgyas bzhugs te mdun cog chodag phur pa zhig bzhag gnang /nged la de mo rin po ches 'di mgo la 'jog ces phur pa'i byin rlabs gnang zhing / gnas chung mchodag sprul rin po ches gser to/ la gsum dang / sa snum lcags kring gcig snyad sa yod dam/ gsungs/ gser dang sa snum thabs ngas zhus tshadag ci mdzad dam zhus pas/ khri ngag dbang nor bu dang nga gnyis bum pa ri la bsang gtang bar 'gro dgos gsungs/de dag gus mo sa thabs shes zhus te yar phul bas kho nga rnam pa gnyis bum pa ri la bsang btang nas mar phebs te rten 'brel yag po byung zhes mnyes tsho ra dpag med gnang / de mo rin po ches bka' 'dri gnang 104

gnas chung gi nang rten/ 105ba / mchog sprul rin po ches nga gnyis bsang spungs nas me spar rtsis skabs tsag sgra 'khyer mi 'dug sngon du dar lcogs btsugs skabs gro bur phyu pa dkar wa gyodan zhing skra zhug dmar thing nger brgyab pa'i mi zhig slebs pa tsag sgra yod med dri dgos snyam mur/ mi de gar song cha med gyur pa dang bsang la me 'ur se 'bar song zhes gsungs/ de mo rin po ches kyang rten 'brel legs zhes gsungs/nyin kha shas nas gnas chung mchodag sprul rin po che sman khang dang khri ngag dbang nor bu nad gasku ga la phebs khul gyis gnas chung gi nang rten bsnams nas/ gnas chung gi grwa 'e ga gnyis kyis 〈sna moste bar phebs skyel zhus te rgya gar la bros phebs/ nyin shas nas mi de gnyis tshur 'gyor ba gnas tshul dri skabs nye zho med par phebs zin zhes brjod pa de don de mo rin snga che la gus mo sa zhus/nyin zhig u yon 'phrin las kyis nged la gral rim pa'i bu phrug gzhan rnams stod lung du ngal rtsol la btang bas bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms kyang gtang dgos bshad/ bu mo lo na bcu gnyis dang 'dzin grwa drug par son yod pa slob grwa nas phyir 'then gyis stod lung du ngal rtsol la btang dgos byung /stod lung du dus yun gang mtshams ngal rtsol byas te lha sar u 105

gnas cung gi nang rten/ 105ba 1 mchog sprul rin po ches nga gnyis bsang spungs nas me spar rtsis skabs tsag sgra 'khyer mi 'dug sngon du dar lcogs btsugs skabs slo bur phyu pa dkar po gyon zhing skra zhug dmar thing nger brgyab pa'i mi zhig slebs pa tsag sgra yod med dri dgos snyam mur/ mi de gar song cha med gyur pa dang bsang la me 'ur se 'bar song zhes gsungs/ de mo rin po ches kyang rten 'brel legs zhes gsungs/nyin kha shas nas gnas thung mchog sprul rin po che sman khang dang khri ngag dbang nor bu nad g.yog la phebs khul gyis gnas zung gi nang rten bsnams nas/ gnas zung gi grwa 'o/ga gnyis kyis gro mo bar phebs skyel zhus te rgya gar la bros phebs/ nyin shas nas mi de gnyis tshur 'byor ba gnas tshul dri skabs nye zho med par phebs zin zhes brjod pa de don de mo rin po che la gus mos zhus/nyin zhig u yon 'phrin las kyis nged la gral rim pa'i bu phrug gzhan rnams stod lung du ngal rtsol la btang bas bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms kyang gtang dgos bshad/ bu mo lo na bcu gnyis dang 'dzin grwa drug par son yod pa sgob grwa nas phyir 'azen gyis stod lung du ngal rtsol la btang dgos byung /stod lung du dus yun gang mtshams ngal rtsol byas te lha sar u 105

106 gon mo ma bcos drang gtam/yon lhan khang du sa khul gyi las gla len skabs/ sa gnas bud med u yon rgyag lod dang tsunyi krang dngos grub kyis bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms la las gla nga tsho las mang ba mgo bde byas pa red/ ces ham song bshad par/ bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms kyis las gar yong re bzhin 'go khrid nas zel tse brgyag gi yod/ ngas 'go 'khrid baspus med/ ces rtsod gleng byas/nga tsho'i sa khul gyi hru chi bstan pas khyed gnyis kyis gang byung bshad rgyu med/ zel tse brgyag rgyu nga dang rkang btsugs kyis 'gan 'khyer gyi yod pas las ka byas pa'i 'bras bu red ces bshad pas/ kho pa gnyis sa gnas der byed thabs ma byung yang lam bar bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms mnyam rub kyis brdungs pas nang la 'byor skabs kha mig tshang ma skrang nas ngo ma shes ba bzodas/rang phrug la don med brnyas bcos tshad med btang bar nga'i sems nas bzod thabs gtan nas ma byung bas / ngas bu mo lag gis 'khrid nas nga'i bu mo gsad rogs gyes zhes ngu co 'don bzhin shor bas gral rim pa'i zhwa mo yod pa'i bud med lhag chos kyis btson khang la 'gro 'am/ zhes mthar bkag gtong / sems kyi sdug bsngal mnan ma thub par ma smad kyi ngu skad che cher 'don skabs gzhan gyis thos dogs lhag chos kyis a cor gyes nga'i kha bkab nas gyong las khe til 'bru tsam rag rgyu med par de las chag sgo 106

10snyo rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/yon lhan khang du sa khul gyi las gla len skabs/ sa gnas bud med u sku na rgyag lod dang tsu3 krang dngos grub kyis bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms la las gla nga chordo las mang ba mgo bde byas pa red/ ces ham song bshad par/ bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms kyis las kar yong re bzhin 'go khrid nas thel tse brgyag gi yod/ ngas 'go 'khrid bslus med/ ces rtsodad kleng byas/nga tsho'i sa khul gyi tru chi bstan pas khyed gnyis kyis gang byung bshad rgyu med/ thel tse brgyag rgyu nga dang rkang btsugs kyis 'gan 'khyer gyi yod pas las ka byas pa'i 'bras bu red ces bshad pas/ kho pa gnyis sa gnas der byed thabs ma byung yang lam bar bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms mnyam rub kyis brdungs pas nang la 'byedar skabs kha mig tshang ma skrang nas ngo ma shes pa bajosgos/rang phrug la don med brnyas bcos tshad med btang bar nga'i sems nas bakhro da thabs gtan nas ma byung bas / ngas bu mo lag gis 'khrid nas nga'i bu mo gsad rogs gyis zhes ngu co 'don bzhin shor bas gral rim pa'i zhwa mo yod pa'i bud med lhag chodas kyis bsgu na khang la 'asprod 'am/ zhes mthar bkag gtong / sems kyi sdug bsngal mnan ma thub par ma smad kyi ngu skad che cher 'a〈snan skabs gzhan gyis 1snas to/gas lhag chodas kyis a thodar gyis nga'i kha bkab nas gyosteng las khe til 'bru tsam rag rgyu med par de las chag sgo 106

gnas chung gi nang rten/ 107yong gi red ces slob gso dang sha tsha'i zhu ba 'then/ cung nga rgyal 'jags pas khyim du 'dzul nas ma smad nga gnyis mnyam du yun ring ngus/khri ngag dbang nor bu dang gnas chung mchog sprul rin po che'i sa gnas kyi 'bo khrid byang phyogs kyi pa sangs nga'i mdun slebs te byang phyogs grong lhan 'bo khrid kyis kho par mi kho ga mis ma lon/ khyi nyal rgyug pas ma longs/ zhes pa ltar bla ma gnyis bskyal ba red ces gshe gshe btang tshul bshad/ ngas ma shes tshul gyis khong gnyis bros yod kyi ma red/ bros kyang thar sa med pas bo mo nas bzung gi red/ pa sangs lags sgo da bhod bzhugs shig ces lab/ rjes su nga dang de mo rin po che'i gsang yum la bla ma gnyis phebs pa shes yod ces sngagegs gnas byas/nyin gcig nga tsho tshogs 'dur bskongs te dar po gling bud med zla bas nga ka bar btags nas gnas chung mchodag sprul rin lnga che dang / khri ngag dbang nor bu phebs khar de mo rin po che dang / gsang yum/ mkhan zur lhun grub thabs mkhas/ mtshan zhabs dalnga sa grub tshogs gnyis bcas lhan 'dzoms gnang ste bstan ma'i sku rten la lha phab pa red/ skabs der lhas ga re bshad dam zhes dang / kho gnyis phyin dus khyodad kyis shes kyi sku da/bstan ma'i sku rten dang de mo rin po che'i gsang yum gyis ngos len zhus byung / zhes bshad/107

gnas thung gi nang rten/ 107yong gi red ces sgob gso dang sha tsha'i zhu ba 'azen/ cung nga rgyal 'jags pas khyim du 'dzul nas ma smad nga gnyis mnyam du yun ring ngus/khri ngag dbang nor bu dang gnas rbung mchog sprul rin po che'i sa gnas kyi 'go khrid byang phyogs kyi pa sangs nga'i mdun spebs te byang phyogs grong lhan 'go khrid kyis kho par mi khog mis ma lon/ khyi nyal rgyug pas ma longs/ zhes pa ltar bla ma gnyis bskyal ba red ces gshe gshe btang tshul bshad/ ngas ma shes tshul gyis khong gnyis bros yod kyi ma red/ bros kyang thar sa med pas gro mo nas bzung gi red/ pa sangs lags ltod ltod bzhugs shig ces lab/ rjes su nga dang de mo rin po che'i gsang yum la bla ma gnyis phebs pa shes yond ces dogs gnas byas/nyin gcig nga tsho chogs 'dur bskongs te dar po gling bud med zla bas nga ka bar btags nas gnas chung mchog sprul rin po che dang / khri ngag dbang nor bu phebs khar de mo rin po che dang / gsang yum/ mkhan zur sdun grub thabs mkhas/ mtshan zhabs dngos grub tshogs gnyis bcas lhan 'dzoms gnang ste bstan ma'i sku rten la lha phab pa red/ skabs der lhas ga re bshad dam zhes dang / kho gnyis phyin dus khyod kyis shes kyi yod/bstan ma'i sku rten dang de mo rin po che'i gsang yum gyis ngos len zhus byung / zhes bshad/107

1༷8 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ngas spyi tshogs rnying par lha phab pa mthong yang spyi tshogs gsar par rtsa ba nas ma mthodang la su bros min yang mi shes/ nga phal pa'i bud med la kho gnyis kyis zhwa mo g.yogs yod kyi ma red/ nga pho ra sprod byed bcug ro/gas/ gdodang gtug skabs kho gnyis kyis khas blang na khrims ci zhig gtang yang chog sngon chad kho tsho mi drag yin yang nga tsho nyam chung la thub mod btang gi med pas nga chorta mnyam za mnyam 'thung gi 'cham sngo sku da/ ces bathe da/bud med rgyag 'esgod kyis smas/ zhes 'gram lcag gcig zhus te bshad kyi yin nam min/ ma bshad na 'di zhu gi yin zhes thege chen rngege zhig zhu grabs byed/ de nas kri pu sru'u chi bstan pa 'byor te sgrol ma chos 'dzoms kyis ga re byas sam/ zhes dris/ rgyag 'o/da kyis mnga' bdag 'o/ga spyodad pa mos gnam sa gnam rdung byas nas lha phebs pa 1ris len ma zhus tshul bshad par hru'u chi bstan pas de rigs sngon nas thag cod pa red/ ces bshad de gazlo gas 'degs ci yang ma byas/cung nas rgya mi 'ong pu krang 'ong ste ga re byas sam/ zhes dris/dar po gling zla bas sngar bzhin bshad/ kho pas thag pa bkrol nas nga sgru da nas rgyug ces zer/ nga skas nas bab skabs kho pa tsho ra mo bce'on pa yin pas de 'dra byed mi phod/ don med snyad 'dogs byas nas ga re byed kyi yod ces gshe gshe btang ba the sa/ go nga gsal bla sprul rnams la dodan 108

108 gon mo ma bcos drang gtam/ngas spyi tshogs rnying par lha phab pa mthong yang spyi tshogs gsar par rtsa ba nas ma mthong la su bros min yang mi shes/ nga phal pa'i bud med la kho gnyis kyis zhwa mo g.yogs yod kyi ma red/ nga tsho ra sprod byed bcug rogs/ gdong gtug skabs kho gnyis kyis khas blang na khrims ci zhig gtang yang chog sngon chad kho cho mi drag yin yang nga tsho nyam zung la thub tshod btang gi med pas nga tsho mnyam za mnyam 'thung gi 'cham po yod/ ces brjod/bud med rgyag lod kyis smas/ zhes 'gram lcag gcig zhus te bshad kyi yin nam min/ ma bshad na 'di zhu gi yin zhes rdo chen po zhig zhu grabs byed/ de nas kri pu tru'u chi bstan pa 'byor te sgol ma chos 'dzoms kyis ga re byas sam/ zhes dris/ rgyag lod kyis mnga' bdag log spyod pa mos gnam sa gnam rdung byas nas lha phebs pa ngos len ma zhus tshul bshad par tru'u chi bstan pas de rigs sngon nas thag chod pa red/ ces bshad de gzhogs 'degs ci yang ma byas/cung nas rgya mi 'ong pu krang 'ong ste ga re byas sam/ zhes dris/dar po gling zla bas sngar bzhin bshad/ kho pas thag pa bkrol nas nga slod nas rgyug ces zer/ nga skas nas bab sgabs kho pa tshor mo bcon pa yin pas de 'dra byed mi phod/ don med snyad 'dogs byas nas ga re byed kyi yod ces gshe gshe btang ba thos/ gong gsal bla sprul rnams la don 108

gnas chung gi nang rten/ 109gnad de dang da dung sgra sdud 'kho ra lo las spyi dza gas thodag daskadag gtam spel ba red ces 'thab 'dzing btang zhing / lhag par de mo rin po che'i gsang yum gnas tshul des 'thab snyu da mi zad pa btang rkyen mthar phyu nas de ga'i mur sku tshe 'das /109

gnas thung gi nang rten/ 109gnad de dang da dung sgra sdud 'khor lo las spyi tshogs thog dkrog gtam spel ba red ces 'thab 'dzing btang zhing / lhag par de mo rin po che'i gsang yum gnas tshul des 'thab rtsod mi zad pa btang rkyen mthar spyo nas de ga'i mur sku tshe 'das/109

110 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bcu gnyis/dad pa'i shig chu sa la lhung /spyi lo 1961 lo nas rgya gzhung gis bod du lo lnga mnyam las 'gyangs pa'i srid jus gzhir bzung chong pa rnams chong las gnyer chog pa dang / gral rim pa'i nang mir za 'bru'i dod nyin rer sgor re sprad pa sogs cung srid jus go yang yod/ nga rang rtsa ba'i chab srid kyi zhwa yod khongs yin yang khrom gzigs khang u yon lhan khang dang bzo chong las khungs la snyan seng zhus te bar sgor byang du chong khang chung ngu sgog sa nyis thog can zhig bzung / thog sa dang por nga tsho ma bu gsum sgos shing gsham du sdon gyi zlo nye 'ga' la ma rtsa g.yar nas a rag dang bu ram/ tha mag ja bcas 'tshong gi yod/'cho ba cung yar rgyas phyin pa'i go skabs dang bsnyun nyin gcig pha yul gcig pa dbyangs can kyis nged la gzhis rtser chong brgyag par 'gro 110

110 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bcu gahais/dad pa'i sgig chu sa la lhung /spyi 'ege 1961 'o/ nas rgya gzhung gis ngo da du 'o/ lnga mnyam las 'gyangs pa'i srid jus gzhir bzung tsho nga pa rnams tsho nga las gnyer chog pa dang / gral rim pa'i nang mir za 'bru'i dod nyin rer sgor re sprad pa sogs cung srid jus go yang yod/ nga rang rtsa ba'i chab srid kyi zhwa yod khongs yin yang khrodam gzigs khang u yodan lhan khang dang bakhrod tsho nga las khungs la snyan seng zhus te bar skor byang du tshong khang chung ngu thog sa nyis thog can zhig bzung / thog sa dang por nga tsho ma bu gsum spos shing gsham du sngo na gyi blo nye 'ga' la ma rtsa g.yar nas a rag dang bu ram/ tha mag ja bcas 'tshong gi yod/'tsho ba cung yar rgyas phyin pa'i go skabs dang bstun nyin gcig pha yul gcig pa dbyangs can gyis nged la gzhis rtser chodang brgyag par 'bo 110

dad pa'i mig zu sa la rnyi nga / 111'am/ zhes gros dris pa bzhin/ sa khul dang bzo tshong cud la dgongs pa zhus te dbyangs can dang mnyam du rlangs 'khor sgog shu gu la brgyud gzhis rtser thon/ nga gnyis gzhis rtse dam can lha khang zhes pa'i khyim du gnas tshang sa/yar nas bsdad/sang nyin de gus mo a ṇi bkra shis lhun wa dza sag rta nag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi bza' zla rgan pas shes te dza sag gi gnyer pa dngos grub lags rlangs 'khor 'khrid nas nga bsu bar slebs/ dza sag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi gzim shag gi bkod pa legs shing khor yug gtsang ba/ g.yas g.yon la sku srung ba 'ga' dang sgo rim pa gsum brgyud dgos/ dus yun gang mtshams nga tsho ma thug pas dza sag cis 'jigs med dang lhag par a ṇi dgyes tshor chen po byed/ya rabs shin tu che ba'i g.yog po rnams kyis sne len byas te yun tsam phan tshun skyid sdug gleng / de nas a ṇis lam 'khrid byas te gzim shag nang blta bar khrid/ mchod khang nang rten gcor gser zangs kyi phyag stong spyan stong mi tshad cig dang / rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par chen po re/ da dung ga'u re re'i nang rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par re gser gyis btums nas bzhugs/ de'i gsham du phyag pang dang dpe cha skru ga sa bcas nyams dga' ba zhig gda'/111

dad pa'i mig chu sa la nyu nga / 111'am/ zhes gros dris pa bzhin/ sa khul dang bzo tsho nga cud la dgongs pa zhus te dbyangs can dang mnyam du rlangs 'khor lnga ga shu gu la brgyud gzhis rtser thon/ nga gnyis gzhis rtse dam can lha khang zhes pa'i khyim du gnas tshang ga/yar nas bsdad/sang nyin de gus motsware a ṇi bkra shis lhun lngatsware dza sag rta nag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi bza' zla rgan pas shes te dza sag gi gnyer pa dngos grub lags rlangs 'khor 'khrid nas nga bsu bar slebs/ dza sag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi gzim shag gi bkod pa legs shing khor yug gtsang ba/ g.yas g.yon la sku srung ba 'ga' dang sgo rim pa gsum brgyud dbo sa/ dus yun gang mtshams nga tsho ma thug pas dza sag cis 'jigs med dang lhag par a rje dgyes tshor chen po byed/ya rabs shin tu che ba'i gasku ga po rnams kyis sne len byas te yun tsam phan tshun skyid sdug gleng / de nas a rjes lam 'khrid byas te gzim shag nang blta bar khrid/ mchod khang nang rten gtsor gser zangs kyi phyag stong spyan stong mi tshad cig dang / rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par chen po re/ da dung ga'u re re'i nang rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par re gser gyis btums nas bzhugs/ de'i gsham du phyag pang dang dpe cha 'e ga sa bcas nyams dga' ba zhig gda'/111

112 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/cis 'jigs med kyis a ṇir ci a shel zhes 'bod pa khams skad yin pa'i tshul yang lung pa tshang ma gcig min pas nga tsho'i lung par a shel zer na kha cher brjod/ nyin shas nas dza sag cis 'jigs med kyis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yab yum gsol tshigs la gdan drangs pa mnyam du bzhugs gral sgrig pa'i go skabs byung /gnyer pa dngos grub lags kyis sne shan byas te gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun por mchod mjal la khrid pa mchod mjal zengs dang po zhu yul/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa rje btsun slo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing stag spyi lo 1914 lor bzhengs gnang ba'i 'dzam gling nang gi gser zangs sku brnyan che shos/ rgyal ba byams pa'i lha khang nang rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par chen po zhig bzhugs su gsol ba dang / sku gnyer lags kyis lha mo rab brtan ma'i sku brnyan la gus zhabs dang bcas phyag gis gtad de bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di'i kha gnon la lha mo rab bstan ma 7paṇa chen rin po ches ched du bzhengs sgor gsungs pa dang / de nas lha khang tshang mar rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par mnyam du bshams 'dugasdon chad rang phyogs nas 7paṇa chen rin po che ngo ma min tshul dang dza sag cis 'jigs med kyis bod la gnod tshul bskur ba 'debs mkhan 112

112 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/cis 'jigs med kyis a ṇir ci a shel zhes 'a11da pa khams skad yin pa'i tshul yang lung pa tshang ma gcig min pas nga tsho'i lung par a shel zer na kha cher brjod/ nyin shas nas dza sag cis 'jigs med kyis 7paṇa chen rin 1ste che'i yab yum gasku la tshigs la gdan drangs pa mnyam du bzhugs gral sgrig pa'i go skabs byung /gnyer pa dalnga sa grub lags kyis sne shan byas te gdan sa chen wa bkra shis lhun por mchod mjal la khrid pa mchod mjal thengs dang po zhu yul/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa rje btsun slo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing stag spyi lo 1914 lor bzhengs gnang ba'i 'dzam gling nang gi gser zangs sku brnyan che hotes/ rgyal ba byams pa'i lha khang nang rgyal masnu ga yab sras gnyis kyi sku par chen sngoge zhig bzhugs su gsol ba dang / sku gnyer lags kyis lha motho rab brtan ma'i sku brnyan la gus zhabs dang bcas phyag gis gtad de bstan pa'i dgra ro/ 'di'i kha gasna na la lha mo rab bstan ma 7paṇa chen rin po ches ched du bzhengs skor gsungs pa dang / de nas lha khang tshang mar rgyal mchodag yab sras gnyis kyi sku par mnyam du bshams 'dugasngon chad rang phyogs nas 7paṇa chen rin wa che lnga ma min tshul dang dza sag cis 'jigs med kyis 〈snad la gasdudad tshul bskur ba 'debs mkhan 112

dad pa'i mig chu sa la lhung / 113mang du mchis/ snang mtha'i chodas gar kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin ngo che sku ngo mar mi dad pa'i wa da mi ches dathodan yang / gus mo ni bo nga gi gtam 'chal des 7paṇa chen rin po cher dmigs bsal dad pa dang bskur ba 'debs mkhan gnyis ka'i khongs su med par bar gnas su sdod dgos byung /nga'i bza' zla bsod nams bag hros de sngon skyes chen dam pa de lta bur bskur ba 'debs mi nyan/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'ong gi red ces dag snang dang dad pa tshad med byed/da ni ngas rgyu mtshan cha tshang ba malnga nga bas rgyal malngar+shag yab sras gnyis kyi thugs bskyed dam bca' la 'gyur ba spu tsam mi 'dug snyam ste/7paṇa chen rin po cher khog pa phyi nang log song snyam pa'i dad pa drag tu skyes shing / spyi 'ege 11snyo2 lha sa'i smon lam chen moter 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chibs kha bsgrur skabs/ rgya dmar gyis rgyud smad du btsugs pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs zhes pa'i bla sprul gyi slob grwar tshe smon gling dang / phur cadag byams mgo na rin wa che/ a mgo na rin snga che/ mi nyag chodas kyi rgyal mtshan/ rta brang rin wa che/ stag brag rin wa che/ 'jam dpal rgya mchod/lo bsam pa rin po che/ dga' ldan khri stag rin po che bcas la dge rgan rgya mi zhig gis dbang ches dbu skra 'bang ga li bzhag bcugaspyodan lam chen mo ra bla sprul rnams phebs dbo sa pas ched du 7paṇa 113

114 gan mo ma bcos drang gtam/chen rin po ches gzigs sa'i mdun gral du bzhugs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gzigs rjes tshangags thog de gar bka' baspyodan dang sbrags bla sprul rnams dbu skra bregs par btang gnang ba sogs/ dngos su mig mthong byung ba'i dam pa'i mdzad bzang rnams yid la dran te dbang med dad pa'i mig zu sa thog tu phrum phrum lhung /gzhis rtser tshong zog gang tsam nyos te yang bskyar yong rgyur 'ga' zhig bzhag ste sang nyin lha sar sgon mkhan spyan gsal sgob phrug bzhi tsam mnyam bde chen pho brang du sgos/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i 'phrul 'khor slob grwa ba pho gzhon gzugs thang ga btang go chod sha stag dang / tshang mas lus la phyu ba gyon zhing skra lhas ma bzhag rna bad gser gye a long re btags shing / slob phrug re re'i ga shar rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par re yod pa'i ga'u dpyang / nyal khang rer slob phrug gnyis dang dngul ting bdun tshar re bsgrigs/ gsham du spo lo rtsed yul thang chen po zhig bcas khor yug la bltas pa tsam gyis dmigs yul nges can zhig gi ched slob grwa ched btsugs gnang ba gsal por mngon/ ngas 7paṇa chen rin po che sku tshe brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed don 'grub pa'i smon lam drag tu bton/dza sag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi spun mched bod gzhung gi rtse drung sku ngo khren tu zhes pa btson nas 1da 'grol btang ma thag cig yod 114

dad pa'i mig thu sa la snyung / 115pa der/ yi ge dang phyu pa dngul bcas bskur te nang don tshang ma yi ger yod ces gsungs/ sang nyin snga dro gtsang ljongs kyi gtsug rgyan gzhis rtse bde chen pho brang nas rlangs 'khor sgog thon te dgong dro lha sar bde 'byor byung / ngas lha sar dza sag cis 'jigs med kyi spun mched sgu ngo khren tu byang phyogs grong lhan khul yod pa rtsad chod kyang gnyis ka chab srid kyi zhwa yod yin pas rang 'gar 'dzoms thabs med rkyen/ grong lhan gsum pa'i pad g.yang gi khyim du 'dzoms nas nang don tshang ma yi ger yod ces gsungs kyi 'dug ces bshad/ tshur khong cho khams bde yin min dang khong bod gzhung gi phyag dpe do dam pa yin gsungs/rig gsar skabs sa gnas bde 'jags mi snas zhib bsher byas pa'i 'og sgu ngo khren tu'i khyim nas rgya mis bod mir mnar gcod gtong tshul gyi nyin bo'i deb cig thon pas 'dzin bzung gis de nas bzung sku ngo gar song cha med gyur/ spyi lo 1964 bod zla 6 pa'i nang nga lha sar 'byor nas nyin lnga tsam rjes u yon lhan khang la 'bod byung ba/ de'i nang a cag dbyangs can mig chu gtong bzhin log spyod pa gang du phyin yang dpon po bzhin rlangs 'khor nang bskyod ces zer/ u yon lhan khang 'go khrid kyis khyod gzhis rtser sgo 'cham la btang ngam/ dza sag cis 'jigs med dang khyed gnyis 115

dad pa'i mig chu sa la rming / 115pa der/ yi ge dang phyu pa dngul bcas bskur te nang don tshang ma yi ger yod ces gsungs/ sang nyin snga wa gtsang ljongs kyi gtsug rgyan gzhis rtse bde chen pho brang nas rlangs 'khor thog thon te dgong dro lha sar bde 'byor byung / ngas lha sar dza sag cis 'jigs med kyi spun mched sku ngo khren tu byang phyo gas cadang lhan khul sku da pa rtsad chodad kyang gnyis ka chab srid kyi zhwa yod yin pas rang 'gar 'jo mas thabs med rkyen/ bo nga lhan gsum pa'i pad g.yang gi khyim du 'jo mas nas nang nge na tshang ma yi ger sku da ces gsungs kyi 'dug ces bshad/ tshur kho nga chod khams bde yin min dang kho nga wa da gzhung gi phyag dpe de dam pa yin gsungs/rig gsar skabs sa gnas bde 'jags mi snas zhib bsher byas pa'i cadag sku ngo khren tu'i khyim nas rgya mis lnga da mir mnar gasgu da gto/nga tshul gyi nyin tho'i deb cig thon pas 'dzin bzung gis de nas bzung sku ngo gar song cha med gyur/ spyi lo 1964 bod zla 6 pa'i nang nga lha sar 'gyor nas nyin lnga tsam rjes u mo na lhan khang la 'bod byung ba/ de'i nang a cag dbyangs can mig chu galta nga bzhin 'o/ga spyodad pa gang du phyin yang dawa na wa bzhin rlangs 'kho ra nang bskyodad ces zer/ u yon lhan khang 'go khrid kyis khyodad gzhis rtser sgo 'cham la btang ngam/ dza sag cis 'jigs med dang khyed gnyis 115

dad pa'i mig zu sa la lhung / 119nas dmag rtsed sna sgomags bstan pa ste/ mi'i bkod pa bzhin rta rnams kyis nyal langs rgyug gsum sogs ci 'dod byed cing slob grwa ba rnams kyang spyang grung 'dzoms shing rtsal stobs rgyas pa/ drag po'i mchon cha bshig sgrig ci byed dus bkag nang byed pa sogs mi rta gnyis la bsam yul las 'das pa'i slob sgong sprad gnang 'dugadamag rta nyi shu tsam dang 'phrul rigs/ me mda' dang / 'bar rdzas/ dpa' dam sogs mtshon cha'i rigs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dang cis 'jigs med sogs la rang skyong ljongs su 'thab 'dzing gtong skabs seng chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyes 'ther 'don byed par 7paṇa chen rin po ches dbu sgur mi gnang bar/ seng chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan la spyan log gzigs shing sdig mdzub sprad nas bzhugs/ cis 'jigs med skra ring po de mar slod/ 'thab 'dzing gtong yul jo lags dbang rgyal lags zer ba zhig kyang 'dug snyam/de'i dgong dro tshogs 'dur bskongs nas 7paṇa chen rin po cher dgag pa brgyab pa dang sa khul du las don ru khag slebs nas tru'u chi mgo dkar dang / skad sgyur bcas nas grong khyer u yon lhan khang du zla gcig lhag tsam ring nga rang 'bod de dri ba byas don/ dza sag cis 'jigs med dang khyod sna khug gcig nang dbugs btang / dor ma gcig nang rkang pa 119

dad pa'i mig chu sa la lhang / 119nas dmag rtsed sna cho gas bstan pa ste/ mi'i baspoged pa bzhin rta rnams kyis nyal langs rgyug gsum so/gas ci 'ato/da byed cing lho ba grwa ba rnams kyang spyang grung 'jo mas shing rtsal stobs rgyas pa/ drag po'i mchodan cha bshig sgrig ci byed dus bkag nang byed pa sku gas mi rta gnyis la bsam yul las 'das pa'i slob sbyong sprad gnang 'dugadamag rta nyi shu tsam dang 'phrul rigs/ me mda' dang / 'bar rdzas/ dpa' dam sogs mtshadan cha'i rigs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dang cis 'jigs med sogs la rang skyong ljongs su 'thab 'dzing gtong skabs seng chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis 'ther 'don byed par 7paṇa chen rin wa ches dbu sgur mi gnang bar/ seng chen lho bzang rgyal mtshan la spyan 'o/ga gzigs shing sdig mdzub sprad nas bzhugs/ cis 'jigs med skra ring po de mar slod/ 'thab 'dzing gtong yul jo lags dbang rgyal lags zer ba zhig kyang 'dug snyam/de'i dgong dro tshogs 'dur bskongs nas 7paṇa chen rin po cher dgag pa brgyab pa dang sa khul du las snga na ru khag slebs nas dru'u chi mabo dkar dang / skad sgyur bcas nas grong khyer u sku na lhan khang du zla gcig lhag tsam ring nga rang 'bod de dri ba byas don/ dza sag cis 'jigs med dang khyod sna khug gcig nang dbugs btang / dor ma gcig nang rkang pa 119

120 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/rgyus/ cis 'jigs med kyis bza' zla gzhon pa'i spun mched rgya gar la bros pa shes bzhin gsang ba dang / paṇa chen gyis 'phrul 'khor slob grwa bas mes rgyal la drag po ngo log byed pa'i 'char gzhi dang / lha sar paṇa chen ru zogs dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mi su dang su yod/ gzhis rtser cis 'jigs med kyi snum 'khor bed spyad pa sogs bgrangs te bsun 'tsher shugs cher bzos/ gong gsal don gnad de dag sgog thengs 'ga' bsnyad 'dogs drag tu byas pas sems nang ma bzod par rang shi brgyag dgos snyam pa thengs 'ga' dran/thengs shig ngas tshogs 'dur 7paṇa chen dza sag gung khran tang gis mi thub pa des nga la gsang gtam bshad kyi red dam/ rgyab khab kyis da lta cis 'jigs med bsad yod kyi ma red/ cis 'jigs med rgya nag dang lha sa gang du yod kyang skad gtang nas ra sprod mdzod/ de'i nang nga the byus yod na srog thog gtong rkyang gyes/ nga la don med snyad 'dogs lce bas rang shi brgyag dgos bsams kyang phru gu yond pas byed thabs mi 'dug bshad/dpon po des khyed kyis mi mang dkyil de 'dra lab phod pa slo khog che ba la zer/ ngas blo khog ma red da ni 'u thug pa red ces bshad rkyen bud med gnyis kyis rdung rdeg gtang rtsis byed kyang dpon pos bkag rang shi brgyag dogs nyin shas nas nyen rtog pa gnyis srung bar btang ba las de nas bzung 120

120 rgan mo'i ma brtsas drang gtam/rgyus/ cis 'jigs med kyis bza' zla gazlo na pa'i sprun mched rgya gar la snga sa pa shes bzhin gsang ba dang / paṇa chen gyis 'phrul 'khe ra cadab grwa bas mes rgyal la drag po'i lnga 'o/ga byed pa'i 'char gzhi dang / lha sar paṇa chen ru tshogs dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mi su dang su yod/ ga/zhis rtser cis 'jigs med kyi snum 'kho ra bed spyad pa se gas bgrangs te bsun 'tsher shugs cher bakhrodas/ thodang gsal dodan gnad de dag thodag thengs 'ga' bsnyad 'dogs drag tu byas pas sems nang ma bajo da par rang shi brgyag dbo sa snyam pa thengs 'ga' dran/thengs shig ngas chodags 'dur 7paṇa chen dza sag gung khran tang gis mi thub pa des nga la gsang gtam bshad kyi red dam/ rgyab khab kyis da lta cis 'jigs med bsad yod kyi ma red/ cis 'jigs med rgya nag dang lha sa gang du yod kyang skad gtang nas ra sprod mdzod/ de'i nang nga the byus yod na srog thog gtong rkyang gyis/ nga la don med snyad 'dogs lci bas rang shi brgyag dbo sa bsams kyang phru gu sku(da pas byed thabs mi 'dug bshad/dpo na wa des khyed kyis mi mang dkyil de 'dra lab phod pa slo kho ga che ba la zer/ ngas slo khog ma red da ni 'u thug pa red ces bshad rkyen bud med gnyis kyis rdung rdeg gtang rtsis byed kyang dalnga na lnga sa bkag rang shi brgyag dodags nyin shas nas nyen lta ga pa gnyis srung bar btang ba las de nas bzung 120

dad pa'i mig chu sa la ldung / 121nga la bsnyad 'dogs gang yang ma byas/7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs gzhir nga cho phal pa'i mis do zla mi thub kyang khong dang cis 'jigs med sogs sku bcar ba rnams dang /'phrul 'khor slob grwa ba rnams ngan rgu 'tshang ba'i btson rar 'tshud pa'i bya ba de ltar ma mdzad par/ sdon 'tshud nas dgra lag nas rang dbang lung pa zhig tu bros byol phebs na de gas 'thus pa yod snyam pa'i slo zhig yang yang skyes/ de sdon rang mi bsam yod 'gas 7paṇa chen rin po che'i mdzad par dpags na sku la nye zho zhig 'ong rgyur the tshom mi 'dug ci drag ces sems khral byed pa don la gnas so//nyin zhig nga tsho khrom gzigs khang gi spyi tshogs btson pa nyer ba/sum dang gral rim pa rnams chogs 'du 'chogs nas chos la ngo rgol dang rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la ngo rgol byed dgos pa sogs gtam bshad spel/ mi re re bzhin ngo gol byed bcug ste tshig tho blangs/ lha'u rta ra'i rtse mgron bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis ngas sngon dus byang spyi byed pa'i skabs mi ser la lcags brgyab ste rta lcags zhus nas mnar gcod btang / phag ri ja sho byed skabs khrims 'gal ba zhig la lo thum brgyab pa yin/ gung khran tang gis nga tā la'i rgyug khyi red gsungs kyang tā la'i bla mas nga la mi mang la sdug gtong gsungs ma byung / mi mang rnams la sdug gtong mkhan nga rang tsho 121

dad pa'i mig chu sa la lhung / 121nga la bsnyad 'dodags gang yang ma byas/7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs gzhir nga tsho phal pa'i mis do zla mi thub kyang khong dang cis 'jigs med sogs sku bcar ba rnams dang /'phrul 'khor slob grwa ba rnams ngan rgu 'tshang ba'i btson rar 'tshud pa'i bya ba de ltar ma mdzad par/ sngon 'tshud nas dgra lag nas rang dbang lung pa zhig tu dzadas dre la phebs na de gas 'thus pa sku da snyam pa'i blo zhig yang yang skyes/ de sngon rang mi bsam yodad 'gas 7paṇa chen rin wa che'i mdzad par dpags na sku la nye zho zhig sothong rgyur the chosam mi 'dug ci drag ces sems khral byed pa thegen la gnas so//nyin zhig nga chopa 〈snam gzigs khang gi spyi cho gas bce na pa nyer sa/sum dang gral rim pa rnams chodags 'du 'chodags nas chodas la ngo sgo la dang rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la lngardzo lha la byed dbosgos pa sogs gtam bshad spel/ mi re re bzhin ngo rgoglu byed bcug ste tshig tho blangs/ lha'u rta ra'i rtse mgron bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis ngas sgyu na dus byang spyi byed pa'i skabs mi ser la lcags brgyab ste rta lcags zhus nas mnar gcod btang / phag ri ja sho byed skabs khrims 'gal ba zhig la skosna thum brgyab pa yin/ gung khran tang gis nga twa la'i rgyug khyi red gsungs kyang tā la'i bla mas nga la mi mang la sdug gtong gsungs ma byung / mi mang rnams la sdug gtong mkhan nga rang tsho 121

122 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/yin/ zhes bshad/bde chen rab rgyas khang gnyer bla phyag jo lags phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyes kyang ngas bud med don du mi bsad cing / sngon dus bla phyag bgyes pa dang gzhis ka bzung ba sogs rang nyid kyi byas nyes rkyang pa rgyas bshad da 'grigs so zhes shod dgos bar byas/ yon tan can rnams kyis don dngos rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis la mtshan smad zhu ma dgos par bskor nas shod mkhas kyang / gus mo sogs phal che bas de ltar mi shes pas shod res mtshams ngas zhing dam par ngo rgol zhu yi min/ nga la rgyu mtshan yod/nga tsho'i pha yul du 7rgyal ba yab sras dang / jo bo yid bzhin nor bu/ se 'bras dge gsum bcas mjal thub na skye ba phyi ma mi lus 'thob pa'i yid ches byed pas de dag mjal bar dad pas dbus su yong / de nas bza' tshang kha thug nas lha sar gtan sdod byed dgos byung / zhes bshad pas/dmag dpon des khyed rang gis de ring drang po bshad song / da nas bzung de ltar bshad mi chog ces bshad/122

124 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/min gyi mgron khang che khag nang khu/ ga babo sa nas bzhag ste/ kho nga cesar rgya gzhung bod sdod las byed rnying pas bod kyi ngo sgod dang 'brel ba'i slob gso chen po gsum gyi slob spyong zla shas sprad pa'i rjes su/ rgya las gsar pa de dag la slob gso chen wa gsum gyi las sdadan ru khag ces ming btags/phal cher spyi 'o/ 19snyo3 nas 19snyo5 'o/ gsum nang kho nga chod mi bcu re cho khag cha bgo sa kyis lha sa'i spyodang gseb khul du mngags gaX nga byas pa ltar bskyod de/ hrong gseb khul gyi bod mi shes ldan mi sna dang lto bo sa cung drag pa rnams la mang chodags ngan skul byas te nyin mo ra las kar 'gro dgos pa smos med thog mtshan mor dus yun ring por tshogs 'du bskongs kyi yod/de'i thog gung khran tang la dga' zhen/ tang gi 'go khrid la brtsi bkur/ spyi tshadags ring lugs kyi lam lugs la srung brtsi zhu dgos pa sogs kyi bsam blo'i slob gamo zhes ming btags kyang / don du 'thab rtsod dang dgag rgyag gi las 'gul spel nas bod mi mang por sdug sbyong btang ste dka' sdug chen po bzos skor nam rgyun lha sa'i nang bong bu ded nas lci ba tsho nga mkhan dang / zho khog la phug dzadang mkhan gyi hrong gseb rngod shes mkhan cesas kha gcig bsgrags kyis/ da yin na/ tang gi las byed pas nga tsho hrong gseb pa kher rkyang byed chog gi ma red/ hrong khyer 124

sgob gso chen po gsum gyi chags sgo/ 125nang zho khog la phug brtsangs chog gi ma red zer/ nga cho spags mi dgos spags khu rags pa mi 'dug zer/ nga tshor rgya mis go dogs kyis sdug skad rgyag mkhan ha cang mang /grong gseb khul du rgya mis de ltar byas pa'i dmigs yul ni/ dang po zhing khul du zhing pa zem dud bcu re tsam la gcig phan gcig rogs kyi tshul du rogs res chogs chung zhes ming btags nas btsugs yod pa/ de dag rim pas mi mang spyi khang ngam kung tre can la bsgyur rgyu yin pa rjes la nga'i bu slob gru thon nas zhing khul du lo gsum bsdad skabs gsal po shes rtogs byung 'dugade yang / zhing par cha mtshon na/ mi so sor lto chas sgol sgod dang / gyon gos/ nang chas tsam las nyar mi chog par/ sa zhing dang so nam lag cha/ sgo phyugs sems can sogs sgon skyed rgyu cha dang / rgyu chas yongs rdzogs mnyam sdeb la dbang ba zhes brjod de so nam zhing pa'i mkhar dngos btsan dbang gis bsdus/ de bzhin lag shes pa dang ngal rtsol gyi nus shugs yod tshad mnyam las khang du yod dgos pa las kher rkyang ngam rang 'dod kyi sger las byed mi chog pa bzos/mi mang kung hre re re'i nang / ru khag ces pa nyung na gsum dang mang na drug bar sna chogs yod cing / ru khag rer dud tshang bco lnga nas 125

12snyo rgan mo'e ma bcos drang gtam/mang na dud tshang bzhi cu tsam khyedan mi grangs 100 nas 400 lhag yong / zhing pa rnams ru khag gi tud krang zhes grong tsho'i 'go pa'i bkod 'doms so/ga gtan 'bebs kyi dus chodad nang / mkhar rnga rdung ba 'am shu brgyab pa gang rung cadag sa zhing 'debs las dang / brnga bsdu/ rtsa ngan bkog pa/ chu yur gsar bzo/ tsher ma dang shing 'thu ba/ lam bzo/ chu ragakhang pa bshig bachod sogs kyi ngal snyu la nyin rer mang cadas chu chodad 17 nas 18 bar dang / nyung shos la'ang chu tshod 10 ring byed dgos/ phyi dro las ma'argams bzhag nas lto chas zin pa dang 'char can ma'argan 31re zu+orgogs 'dur 'bo+o dgos pa dngo / dus tshod mang che ba 'char can gyi+o rgyal gces slab gas dang 'thab rtsad dang dgag rgyag nang bskyal dgas pa ma zad/mtshams re skyon brjod dang rang skyon rang brjod ces ru khag nang gi bod mi phan tshun skyodan brjod byed res byas te grong pa khyim mtshas phan tshun 'cham mthun med pa sdod dgos/ru khag nang mnga' tshab dang gnas tshul yod pa'i mi yod na ga dus yin na'ang mang tshogs kyi 'thab rtsodad dang dgag pa skyon brjod byas te dab/'a sdu/ga chen po myong gi yod/ dper na/ gra bzhi ru khag nang yod pa'i sems bzang zhing spyod pa legs pa'i tsha ltas gnyer pa'i bu mo rgan pa tshe lha/ bza' zla 'das grongs phyin kyang khong rang la mnga' tshab kyi ming btags nas yod 126

sgob gso chen po gsum gyi chags sgo/ 127dus nyes pa yod min la ma ltos par rtag tu 'thab rtsod dang dgag pa phogs pa'i sdug sbyong mnar gcod myong dgos pa ma zad/ nyin mtshan 'brel nas sdug las tshang ma byed dgos kyi yod kyang lo mjug gi thob bya ru khag nang gi nus shugs skyo ba'i sgob bya las sprod kyi med/de bzhin gra pa dbul phongs zhang thub bstan rig 'dzin zhes pa gcig yod pa des nye 'gram du yod pa'i rgya dmag btson bzung bas tshal zhing du chu gtong ched zhing pa dang chu 'phrog res byed skabs/ zhang pos rgya dmag la khyi ser po zhes brjod pa'i nyer len la khong la ru khag nas mang chogs sgrig 'dzugs kyis 'thab rtsod nyin grangs mang po btang rkyen kho pa rang shi brgyag khar mi gzhan gyis bskyabs/zhing par mchon na'ang / lo gcig dpung sa 'og tu bcug nas dka' las ga chod brgyab kyang lo mjug tu ston 'bras ji byung sdeb spungs sgog rgyal gces gzhung 'bru dang / 'byu lhag spus tshong / mas 'gan spus tshong / gzi brjid sprus tshong / mu ge sngon 'ayog dmag rgyag grwa sgrig sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis 'byu rigs yar bsdus te/ kha mo da lag yond zhing pa nus shugs rab la mi rer za 'byu khal 15 dang /de byings rnams rim pas khal 12 nas khal 8 las rags kyi med stabs ltos grong pa mi rgyag pa dang / gos kyi lus po ma drod par lha sa'i 127

slob gso chen po gsum gyi chags sgo/ 127dus nyes pa yod min la ma ltos par ṅge/ga tu 'thab rtsod dang dgag pa phogs pa'i sdug sbyong mnar gcod myong dgos pa ma zad/ nyin mtshan 'brel nas sdug las tshang ma byed dgos kyi yod kyang lo mjug gi thob bya ru khag nang gi nus shugs skyo ba'i lnga ba bya las sprod kyi med/de bzhin gra pa dbul phongs zhang thub bstan rig 'dzin zhes pa gcig yod pa des nye 'gram du yod pa'i rgya dmag btson bzung bas tshal zhing du chu gtong ched zhing pa dang chu 'phrog res byed skabs/ zhang pos rgya dmag la khyi ser po zhes brdzod pa'i nyer len la khong la ru khag nas mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs kyis 'thab rtsod nyin grangs mang po btang rkyen kho pa rang shi brgyag khar mi gzhan gyis bskyabs/zhing par mtshon na'ang / lo gcig dpung sa 'og tu bcug nas dka' las ga tshod brgyab kyang lo mjug tu ston 'bras ji byung sdeb spungs thog rgyal gces gzhung 'bru dang / 'bru lhag sbus tshong / so/sa 'gan spus tshong / gzi brjid sprus tshong / mu ge sngon 'gog dmag rgyag grwa sgrig sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis 'byu rigs yar bsdus te/ kha yod lag yod zhing pa nus shugs rab la mi rer za 'byu khal 15 dang /de byings rnams rim pas khal 12 nas khal 8 las rags kyi med stabs ltos spyodang pa mi rgyag pa dang / gos kyi lus po ma drod par lha sa'i 127

1na8 rgan mo'i ma brtsas drang gtam/bar skor dang kho ma gzhung du lto slong mkhan gyis sprang pos khengs bsdad kyi yod/ de'i stodar zhing pa chodas/ mig skya nam rgyas po/ kha yud cang cang / za rgyu med pa'i skyid po/ gyon rgyu med pa'i dro po/ zhes zur za byas yod/ de las tshabs che ba la slob gso/ chen 11 ga3/ma gyi las 'gul rjes su/ bo nga gseb so so'i nang yod pa'i dgo na pa dang mchodad rten/ ma ṇi lha khang se gas yod pa rnams slob gso chen po gsum gyi las dodan ru khag gis bkod byus 'og hrong sde so so'i nang gi hur brtson pa dang tang mi/ gzhon nu bcas kyis galho ra sgo la byed kyi sku da pa red/ dper na/lha sa'i nye 'gram gyi grwa bzhi dgon pa'i grwa bzhi lha mo dang / phur lcog bla brang / myang ral nang du yod pa'i pha nge nga kha'i dgo na pa sogs dgon pa dang / mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs kyi thang skya dgon pa/ 'bri gung mthil dbo na gyi dgo na pa rnying shul grags can mang lnga / gzhan yang stag rtse rdzong khongs kyi dgon pa mang che ba gtor ba ma zad/ lha sa'i nang yod pa'i bstan rgyas gling dang / tshe smon gling / rgyud gra stod smad gnyis sogs dgon pa chung 'bring mang po gtor ba red/gal che sna sa gcig la dab/'a ldan dgon pa 'char gzhi yod pa'i ngang stor bshig btang nas dgon pa'i nang gi gser dngul dang / rtsa che'i dngos rdzas rnams rgya mis sngon la dgon pa'i grangs tho gzhir bzung mo ḍa'i 128

12/ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bar skor dang khrom gzhung du lto slong mkhan gyes sprang pos khengs bsdad kyi yod/ de'i skor zhing pa tshos/ mig skya nam rgyas po/ kha yud cang cang / za rgyu med pa'i skyid po/ gyon rgyu med pa'i dro po/ zhes zur za byas yod/ de las tshabs che ba la slob gso chen po gsum gyi las 'gul rjes su/ grong gseb so so'i nang yod pa'i dgon pa dang mchod rten/ ma ṇi lha khang sogs yod pa rnams sgob gso chen po gsum gyi las don ru khag gis bkod byus 'og grong sde so so'i nang gi hur brtson pa dang tang mi/ gzhon nu bcas kyis gtor rgol byed kyi yod pa red/ dper na/lha sa'i nye 'gram gyi gra bzhi dgon pa'i grwa bzhi lha mo dang / phur lcog bla brang / myang ral nang du yod pa'i pha bong kha'i dgon pa sogs dgon pa dang / mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs kyi thang skya dgon pa/ 'bri gung mthil dgon gye dgon pa rnying shul grags can mang po/ gzhan yang stag rtse rdzong khongs kyi dgon pa mang che ba gtor ba ma zad/ lha sa'i nang yod pa'i bstan rgyas gling dang / tshe smon gling / rgyud gra stod smad gnyis sogs dgon pa zung 'bring mang po gtor ba red/gal che shos gcig la dab/'a ldan dgon pa 'char gzhi yod pa'i ngang stor bshig btang nas dgon pa'i nang gi gser dngul dang / rtsa che'i dngos rdzas rnams rgya mis sdon la dgon pa'i grangs tho gzhir bzung mo ḍa'i 128

sgob gso chen po gsum gyi chags sgo/ 129nang dbor 'dren byas mjug dgon pa'i tshogs gdan dang / mchod rdzas/nang chas dang shing cha rnams nye 'khor mal gro dang / stag rtse rdzong / stod lung rdzong sogs nang gsar du btsugs pa'i mi mang spyi khang gi mkho chas su cha bgos byas te dgon pa gyang ro zing nger bzos rjes/ zla ba 'ga' shas ring grong gseb khag gi rta drel ther se da nga / grong khyer nang gi ther ge mnyam las kyis dga' ldan dgon nas sa khul so sor dbor 'dren byas par mi mang mang zogs kyis lkog tu dpe srid kyi ma red/ dga' ldan dgon pa'i ca lag dang shing bya dbor gyi 'dug bskal pa ji srid bar dmyal ba rdo rje thig nag nang lhung gi red zer lkog lab brgyab pa ma gtogs mdun la shod cig zhugs/skabs der dga' ldan dgon gyi shing bya nyo tshong dang dbor 'dren byed mkhan gcig nga'i grong pa red/ rjes la khong tsho'i bza' tshang gnyis dang phrug gu gnyis bcas snga rjes nad mnar gyis 'das grongs gyur song bas/spyir btang bod mi'i kha rgyun la dgon pa'i rgyu dngos la lag pa 'chang na mjug 'bras yag po mi yong zhes pa bden par rtogs/dga' ldan dgon pa rgya mis dmigs yul dang 'char gzhi yod pa'i ngang stor bshig btang ba'i gnas tsul zhib phra dgon pa'i kru'u rin nas spyi lo 1982 nang lha sar tshogs pa'i bod rgyud nang bstan mthun 129

slob gse chen lnga gsum gyi chags lha / 1na9nang dawa ra 'dren byas mjug dgon pa'i gas gdan dang / mchod rdzas/nang chas dang shing cha rnams nye 'khor mal hro dang / stag rtse rdzong / stod lung sprodang mo gas nang gsar du btsugs pa'i mi mang spyi khang gi mkho chas su cha bgos byas te dgo na pa gyang ro/ zing nger baphra sa rjes/ zla ba 'ga' shas ring grong gseb khag gi rta drel ther be+e dang / grong khyer nang gi ther ge mnyam las kyis dga' ldan dbo na nas sa khul so/ sor dnge ra 'dren byas par mi mang mang chongags kyis lkog tu dpe srid kyi ma red/ dga' ldan dgon pa'i ca lag dang shing bya dbor gyi 'dug bskal pa ji srid bar dmyal ba rdo rje thig nag nang ltung gi red zer lto ga lab brgyab pa ma gto/gas mdun la thodad :se zhu/thag/skabs der dga' ldan dgon gyi shing bya nyo tshong dang dbor 'dren byed mkhan gcig nga'i hrong pa red/ rjes la khong tsho'i bza' tshang gnyis dang phrug gu gnyis bcas snga rjes nad mnar gyis 'das bosangs gyur sku/nga bas/spyir btang wa da mi'i kha rgyun la dgo na pa'i rgyu dngo sa la lag pa 'chang na mjug 'bras yag snga mi sku nga zhes pa bden par stodags/dga' ldan dgon pa rgya mis dmigs yul dang 'char gzhi sku da pa'i ngang stor bshig btang ba'i gnas tshul zhib phra dgon pa'i kru'u rin nas spyi 'e 1982 nang lha sar tshogs pa'i wa da rgyud nang bstan mthun 129

130 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/tsho gas kyi tshogs 'du'i thog gsal po bshad pa skabs der lha sa'i nang skad grags chen po byung / nga tsho lha sa'i grong lhan so so'i nang slob gso chen ngo gsum gyi skabs nyin mo khang pa bshig ral dang / de min nye 'gram gyi grong gseb tu skon kha btsas ma brnga bsdu dang hrong lhan so so'i zhing kha 'debs las/ gzhan yang 'dam rwa'i nang rtswa bskadag pa so/gas ngal rtsodal sgyur bkod byed dgos/mtshan mo 'char can rang skyodan ngo sa len zhu dgos pa ma zad/ dka' las che snadzis der byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel dgos zhes mi gzhan gyi skyon bton dgos dus nyin mtshan ma 'khyol ba'i dka' sdug chen po myang dgas byung /phal cher spyi 'o/ 19snyo5 lo'i ston kha tsam la 'bras spungs dgon gyi gra pa rdo rje kun dga' zer bas dgon pa'i nang gi gra hur brtson pa gcig bsad pa red ces kho nga de nyin sredag thodag gi nyes pa btang nas bsad mo nga bas mi rnams kyis de thog gdungs sems shugs che byed/nga yang phrug gu gnyis med na de lta'i dka' sdug myang pa las me mda' rgyag thengs gcig la bsad na tag tag red snyam dran gyi sku da/130

130 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/tshogs kyi chogs 'du'i thog gsal po bshad pa skabs der lha sa'i nang skad grags chen po byung / nga cho lha sa'i grong lhan so so'i nang slob gso chen po gsum gyi skabs nyin mo khang pa bshig ral dang / de min nye 'gram gye grong gseb tu ston kha btsas ma brnga bsdu dang grong lhan so so'i zhing kha 'debs las/ gzhan yang 'dam rwa'i nang rtswa bkog pa sogs ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed dgos/mtshan mo 'char can rang skyon ngos len zhu dgos pa ma zad/ dka' las che shos der byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel dgos zhes mi gzhan gye skyon bton dgos dus nyin mtshan ma 'khyol ba'i dka' sdug chen po myang dgos byung /phal cher spyi lo 1965 lo'i ston kha tsam la 'bras spungs dgon gyi gra pa rdo rje kun dga' zer bas dgon pa'i nang gi gra hur brtson pa gcig bsad pa red ces khong de nyin srog thog gi nyes pa btang nas bsad song bas mi rnams kyis de thog gdungs sems shugs che byed/nga yang phrug gu gnyis med na de lta'i dka' sdug myang pa las me mda' rgyag thengs gcig la bsad na tag tag red snyam dran gye yod/130

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 131bcu bzhe/rig gnas gsar brje'i h+phung 'tshub/rig gsar tshugs pa dang nga tsho spyi tshogs bcon pa rnams phyi la 'brel ba byed rgyu'i go skabs med/ 'on kyang nga'i bu tshe ring dbang phyug lha sa sgob gra 'bring ba'i nang slob sbyong byed kyi yod stabs/ rjes la bus nga la rig gnas gsar brje zhes ga re zer gyi yod pa dang / rig gnas gsar brje bod la ji ltar dar ba'i gnas tshul cha tshang ngo sgod byas par gzhigs na/ bod rab byung me+e rta/ spyi lo 1966 zla 5 tshes 16 nyin rgya nag dbus dmar shog tshogs pa'i nang / krung gung krung dbyang gis 5/16 brda tho zhes pa gros 'cham byung ste/ de nyin nas rgya nag rgyal yonangs su lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa'i rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa spel 'go tshugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa red/131

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 131mecu mezhi/rig gnas gsar merje'i rnung 'tshub/rig gsar tshugs pa dang nga chod spyi tshogs bce na pa rnams phyi la 'brel ba byed rgyu'i go skabs med/ 'on kyang nga'i bu tshe ring dbang phyug lha sa slob gra 'bring ba'i nang snyadab lha nga byed kyi yod stabs/ rjes la bus nga la rig gnas gsar brje zhes ga re zer gyi sku da pa dang / rig gnas gsar brje bod la ji ltar dar ba'i gnas tshul cha tshang ngo spyod byas par gzhigs na/ cadad rab byung me rta/ spyi 'o/ 19snyosnyo zla 5 tshes 1snyo nyin rgya nag dbus dmar cadag chodags pa'i nang / krung gung krung dbyang gis 5/16 brda thesto zhes pa thothos 'cham byung ste/ de nyin nas rgya nag rgyal sku ngas su 'o/ rgyus sprodag byung cadang med pa'i rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa spel 'go tshugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas pa red/131

132 rgan mo'i ma bcetes drang gtam/las 'gul de thog mar gzhung gi las khungs dang lhag par du rig gnas kyi khyab kho ngas nang dril bsgrags dang bo sa bsdur sbyang bshad thengs mang byas te/ rgya nag gi sa mtshams su gnas pa'i snga da nang las 'gul de spel dgos dang ma dgos rtsod gleng byas shing / rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang cho gas nang spyir btang gi khyab bsgrags tsam las las 'gul dacadas gzhi ma spel bar bzhag cing / skabs der las khungs mo so'i nang rgya nag pe cin gyi nyin re'i gnas tshul ji byung gi mi dmangs nyin re'i gsar shog dang /hrang had nas gnyer ba'i 'un hud gsar cadag ces pa rgya nag gzhung 'brel gyi gsar cadag bcas nang gzhung gi langs 〈snags srid byus dang / rgya nag ches mtho'i dbang cha'i bsti gnas nang dbang cha'i 'thab rtsod kyi gnas stangs ji byung la bahro gleng byas pa tsam las sa gnas rang gi dngos sku da gnas tshul dang zung sbrel byed kyi yod pa rma red/dus yun ring po ma song bar rgya nag pe cin du yodad pa'i ching hwa mtho slob nang slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i bod rigs kyi slob phrug ang dang po zla ba tshe ring dang / ngag dbang tshe ring gnyis bod nang slebs te/ lus la rgya dmag gi dmag chas khyodan zhing / dpung pa'i steng rgya yig gi dmar srung dmag ces 'kho da pa'i ras dmar po'i dpung rtags btags pa lha sa'i las khungs khag dang / lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba'i nang gdan zhus kyis rgyal 132

1 2 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/las 'gul de sgog mar gzhung gi las khungs dang lhag par du rig gnas kyi khyab khongs nang dril bsgrags dang gros bsdur sbyang bshad thengs mang byas te/ rgya nag gi sa mtshams su gnas pa'i bod nang las 'gu' de spel dgos dang ma dgos rtsod gleng byas shing / rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs nang spyir btang gi khyab bsgrags tsam las las 'gul dngos gzhi ma spel bar bzhag cing / skabs der las khungs so so nang rgya nag pe cin gyi nyin re'i gnas tshul ji byung gi mi dmangs nyin re'i gsar shog dang /hrang had nas gnyer ba'i 'un hud gsar shog ces pa rgya nag gzhung 'brel gye gsar shog bcas nang gzhung gi langs phyogs srid byus dang / rgya nag ches mtho'i dbang cha'i bsti gnas nang dbang cha'i 'thab rtsod kyi gnas stangs ji byung la bgro gleng byas pa tsam las sa gnas rang gi dngos yod gnas tshul dang zung sbrel byed kyi yod pa ma red/dus yun ring po ma song bar rgya nag pe cin du yod pa'i ching dwa mtho slob nang slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i bod rigs kyi sgob phrug ang dang po zla ba tshe ring dang / ngag dbang tshe ring gnyis bod nang spebs te/ lus la rgya dmag gi dmag chas gyon zhing / dpung pa'i steng rgya yig gi dmar srung dmag ces 'khod pa'i ras dmar po'i dpung rtags btags pa lha sa'i las khungs khag dang / lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba'i nang gdan zhus kyis rgyal 132

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ lhazha3sa pe cin gyi rig gsar gnas tshul ngo sprod byed skabs/ bod nang da dung yang rig gsar las 'gul 'bo ma tshugs bar 'jam thing nger gnas pa sogs/ skad shugs chen lnga sa skyodan bajo da dang las 'gul spel dgos pa'i skul slang byas/da dung kho nga tsharas yig chen tshags par bris nas lha sa slob 'bring gi slob phrug tshos rnga rdung dar 'phyar gyis yi ge bod rang skyong ljongs la bskyal bar bskyod skabs/ skabs de'i yi ge len mkhan gyi dpon po mos dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung gi snying stobs la nga tshos slob sbyong byed kyi yin zhes kha mkhas 'dra chags kyis khas len byas pa red/dus yun gang tsam/ song rjes/ lha sa'i skud yod rgyang bsgrags nang bod rang skyong jongs tang ud ces pa'i sa gnas kyi las khungs mtho shos nang rig gnas gsar brje'i 'go khrid tshogs chung zhes pa zhig dngos su dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags yang nas yang du byas so//yin na'ang / rig gnas gsar brje zhes ga re zer gyi yod/las 'gul des nga tshor dka' ngal gsar pa ga re bzo srid pa shes kyi med stabs/ nyin ltar rgyang bsgrags nang dang khrodam gzhung gang sar mi rnams kyis ru star bsgrigs nas skad 'bod byas pa dang / cho gas 'du yang yang 'tshogs kyi sku da pa'i gnas tshul bshad kyi yod kyang / dodan snying 133
