134 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ga re byed grabs yod pa shes kyi med/nyin zhig nga'i bu nang la log yodang nas nyin shas rjes khong tsho rgya nag nas slebs pa'i dmar srung dmag dzā ba phrug rgya mi gachodan skyes mang po zhig yod pa mnyam lho kha khul du 'aspyod yi yin/ nang la nyin ma ga/nyis ngal gsos te nyal chas dang bza' chas lta ga tsam gra bsgrig nas thodag zer bshad kyi 'dug zer/ ngas/ bu rgya phrug de tsho dang mnyam phyin na yag po yod red dam/ zhes 'dri dus nga'i bus snang dogs yod ma red/ khong tsho tshang ma rgya nag gi dpon po chen po'i bu phrug red zer bshad pa dang chabs cig bod nang rig gnas gsar brje 'go ma 'dzugs gong rgya nag nang rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul gyi thog ma'i 'byung stangs skor khong tshos bu la bshad pa rnams nga la bshad byung /ma'o tse tung gis spyi 'o/ 19snyosnyo zla 5 nang rgya nag tu sngar lo rgyus thob/ byung myong med pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul zhig spel zhing / las 'gul de spel dbo sa pa'i dmigs yul gce phra ni/ ma'o tse tung gis de snga 1958 'o/ra rgya nag rgyal yongs su/ ngar shugs gcig sgrim dang yang rtse lhur len/ mang nyung legs bsri bcas kyi sgo nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi'i lam phyogs dang / mdun mchothongs chen po / mi mang spyi khang bcas 'dzugs sa/nyer byed pa'i las 'gul shugs che spel ba pham 134

135 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/ga re byed grabs yod pa shes kyi med/nyin zhig nga'i bu nang la log yong nas nyin shas rjes khong tsho rgya nag nas slebs pa'i dmar srung dmag slob phrug rgya mi gzhon skyes mang po zhig yod pa mnyam lho kha khul du 'gro yi yin/ nang la nyin ma gnyis ngal gsos te nyal chas dang bza' chas tog tsam gra bsgrig nas shog zer bshad kyi 'dug zer/ ngas/ bu rgya phrug de tsho dang mnyam phyin na yag po yod red dam/ zhes 'dri dus nga'i bus snang dogs yod ma red/ khong tsho tshang ma rgya nag gi dpon po chen po'i bu phrug red zer bshad pa dang chabs cig bod nang rig gnas gsar brje 'go ma 'dzugs gong rgya nag nang rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul gyi thog ma'i 'byung stangs skor khong tshos bu la bshad pa rnams nga la bshad byung /ma'o tse tung gis spyi lo 1966 zla 5 nang rgya nag tu sngar lo rgyus thob/ byung myong med pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul zhig spel zhing / las 'gul de spel dgos pa'i dmigs yul gco bo ni/ ma'o tse tung gis de snga 1958 lor rgya nag rgyal yongs su/ ngar shugs gcig sgrim dang yang rtse lhur len/ mang nyung legs bsri bcas kyi sgo nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi'i lam phyogs dang / mdun mchongs chen po / mi mang spyi khang bcas 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i las 'gul shugs che spel ba pham 134

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 135nyes su phyin pa'i rjes/ kho pa'i tang nang dang rgyal khab kyi dbang cha gal che khag cig li'u hra'o chi dang thing zha'o phing gnyis kyi lag tu shor ba de tshur 'phrog pa dang / dmigs yul gnyis pa ni rgya nag rgyal sku ngas nang kho pa'i chab srid dang dpal 'gyor gyi srid byus 'dzin stangs thad lta ba mi mthun pa'i gung khran tang nang gi gnad yod mi sna phon chen sku da pa de dag tang na/nga gi ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa reng/ ces snyes ming btsugs shing tang nas phyir 'bud 'thab 'dzings btang ste/ maso/ tse tung kho rang gi bsam blo dang lta ba gtso bo byas pa'i srid dbang sger gcod kyi s+t+ri chodags ring lugs zhes pa'i mi gcig dbang 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i lam lugs shig 'dzugs gnyer byed rgyu de yin/skabs der rgya nag gi dbang cha'i las khungs lce ba'i nang gi go gnas ang gasde/ma pa bzung mkhan mi sna gal che lha(sa gras rgya nag rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon kra'u en le dang dmag dpung nang gi dbang cha che shos gras bzung mkhan ling pecad khag gnyis so sos rang gi dbang cha brtan srung ched/ macad tse tung gis spel ba'i las 'gul der rgyab skyor byas pa zhig red/rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i las 'gul de'i thog ma'i 'byung rkyen ni/ gong du mdo tsam bshad pa ltar/ 1958 spyi zla 135

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 135nyes su phyin pa'i rjes/ kho pa'i tang nang dang rgyal khab kyi dbang cha gal che khag cig li'u hra'o chi dang ning zha'o phing gnyis kyi lag tu shor ba de tshur 'phrog pa dang / dmigs yul gnyis pa ni rgya nag rgyal yongs nang kho pa'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi srid byus 'dzin stangs thad lta ba mi mthun pa'i gung khran tang nang gi gnad yod mi sna phon chen yod pa de dag tang nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa reng ces nyis ming btsugs shing tang nas phyir 'bud 'thab 'dzings btang ste/ ma'o tse tung kho rang gi bsam blo dang lta ba gtso bo byas pa'i blud dbang sger gcod kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs zhes pa'i mi gcig dbang 'dzin gyi rgyal po lam lugs shig 'dzugs gnyer byed rgyu de yin/skabs der rgya nag gi dbang cha'i las khungs ste ba'i nang gi go gnas ang gsum pa bzung mkhan mi sna gal che 31sa gras rgya nag rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon kra'u en le dang dmag dpung nang gi dbang cha che shos gras bzung mkhan ling pe'o khag gnyis so sos rang gi dbang cha brtan srung ched/ ma'o tse tung gis spel ba'i las 'gul der rgyab skyor byas pa zhig red/rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i las 'gul de'i thog ma'i 'byung rkyen ni/ gong du mdo tsam bshad pa ltar/ 195( spyi zla 135

13snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/5 tshes 1 nyin rgya nag dmar gzhung gi gzhung 'brel gsar deb dar dmar dus deb 'don zengs dang po'i thog ma'o tse tung gis mnyam las khang gcig lnga sprod byas pa zhes pa'i lca ma yig spel te/ mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs rgyu'i 'bod skul byas pa dang / de rjes lo de'i spyi zla 8 tshes 9 nyin ma'o tse tung gis rgya nag shar phyogs la yod pa'i hran tung zhing chen gyi lha nga gseb khul du 'tshams 'dri lta skor byed skabs/ kho pas slar yang mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byas na legs po 'dug mi mang spyi khang gi dge mtshan che shodas ni/ bzo las/ zhing las/ che nga las/slob grwa/ dmag dpung bcas tshang ma spyi khang sdeb gcig tu 'dus yod pa der 'dzin skyong dang 'go khrid byed bde po yod ces bshad de/ rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi gro nga gseb khul du mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i las 'gul ༷/gas chen zhig spel yod/so/na kyang / skabs de'i rgya nag dmar gzhung gi gce 'dzin gzhon pa li'u hracad chis/ las 'gul der motes mthun ma byas par/ gal che'i kha phyogs rang bzhin gyi gnad dodan skor la rgya nag dmar gzhung gi dbang cha'i lce gnas chab srid cus kyis 〈snas bsdur byed dathodas pa las/ mi re zung gis thag gcod byas na 'grig gi ma red/ ces bshad par/ ma'o tse tung gis nga ni gung khran tang gi gtso 'dzin dang / dmar shog tshogs mi 136

136 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/5 tshes 1 nyin rgya nag dmar gzhung gi gzhung 'brel gsar deb dar dmar dus deb 'don zengs dang po'i thog ma'o tse tung gis mnyam las khang gcig ngo sgod byas pa zhes pa'i rtsom yig spel te/ mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs rgyu'i 'bod skul byas pa dang / de rjes lo de'i spyi zla 8 tshes 9 nyin ma'o tse tung gis rgya nag shar phyogs la yod pa'i hran tung zhing chen gyi grong gseb khul du 'tshams 'dri lta skor byed skabs/ kho pas spar yang mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byas na legs po 'dug mi mang spyi khang gi dge mtshan che shos ni/ bzo las/ zhing las/ chong las/sgob grwa/ dmag dpung bcas tshang ma spyi khang sdeb gcig tu 'dus yod pa der 'dzin skyong dang 'go khrid byed bde po yod ces bshad de/ rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi grong gseb khul du mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i las 'gul shugs chen zhig spel yodad/'on kyang / skabs de'i rgya nag dmar gzhung gi gas 'dzin gzhon pa li'u hra'o chis/ las 'gul der mos mthun ma byas par/ gal che'i kha phyogs rang bzhin gyi gnad don sgor la rgya nag dmar gzhung gi dbang cha'i lte gnas chab srid cus kyis gros bsdur byed dgos pa las/ mi re zung gis thag gcod byas na 'grig gi ma red/ ces bshad par/ ma'o tse tung gis nga ni gung khran tang gi gtso 'dzin dang / dmar shog chogs mi 136

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'amub/ 137tshang mas so/sa 'dems byas pa zhig yin pas/ ngas tang gi nge na du bsam 'char cathod mi chogeg pa gang yin nam/ zhes lan 'debs byas kyang / skabs de'i chab srid cus kyi chodags mi khren yun dang ting zhaso/ phing / beng ta hon/beng kren/ li phu khrun/ than kren ling bcas kyis macad yi bsam 'char la nyan 'asprodag ma byas par/ li'u la rgyab skyodar byas sku da kyang / maso/ tse tung gis/ spyi zla 11 tshes 2 nyin kan su'u zhing chen kreng kra'u la ce gas pa'i rgya nag dbus gzhung gi las dodan tsho gas 'du'i the ga kho pa'i mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i srid byus yang dag pa yin tshul bskyar gleng byas te/ mu mthud rgya nag rgyal sku ngas kyi ༷ nga gseb khul du mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byed rgyu dar spel btang yod/stabs ma legs par 1959 'o( mjug nas 'bo tshugs te 1960'o/ nas 19snyo2 bar rgya nag rgyal sku ngas su lo gsum bsnyud mar mu ge chen wa byung nas skabs der mu ge dang nad yams sogs kyi rkyen pas/'das bo ngas su gyur ba'i mi grangs bye ba gnyis lhag tsam byung yod (rgya nag gzhung 'brel gyi bsdoms tho khag nang gsal yod )ces rgya nag gzhung nas kyang skabs de'i mu ge skyob thabs su dbus sa'i las khungs khag dang / dmag dpung / bzo grwa dang slob grwa tha na hrong khyer dang grong rdal nang gi phru gu 'o/ gsum yan chad kyi za 'bru'i tshad gzhi nyung du btang ste ‘ṭ+wāṃthon spel gron chung ’’gi las 137

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 1 7tshang mas 'os 'dems byas pa zhig yin pas/ ngas tang gi don du bsam 'char shod mi chog pa gang yin nam/ zhes lan 'debs byas kyang / skabs de'i chab srid cus kyi tshogs mi khren yun dang ting zha'o thing / beng ta hon/beng kren/ li phu khrun/ than kron ling bcas kyis ma'o yi bsam 'char la nyan 'jog ma byas par/ li'u la rgyab skyor byas yod kyang / ma'o tse tung gis/ spyi zla 11 tshes 2 nyin gan su'u zhing chen kreng kra'u la tshogs pa'i rgya nag dbus gzhung gi las don tshogs 'du'i thog kho pa'i mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i srid byus yang dag pa yin tshul bskyar gleng byas te/ mu mthud rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi grong gseb khul du mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs gnyer byed rgyu dar spel btang yod/stabs ma legs par 1959 lo mjug nas 'go tshugs te 1960lo nas 1962 bar rgya nag rgyal yongs su lo gsum bsnyud mar mu ge chen po byung nas skabs der mu ge dang nad yams sogs kyi rkyen pas/'das grongs su gyur ba'i mi grangs bye ba gnyis lhag tsam byung yod (rgya nag gzhung 'brel gyi bsdoms tho khag nang gsal yod )ces rgya nag gzhung nas kyang skabs de'i mu ge skyob thabs su dbus sa'i las khungs khag dang / dmag dpung / bzo grwa dang slob gra tha na grong khyer dang grong rdal nang gi phru gu lo gsum yan chad kyi za 'bru'i tshad gzhi nyung du btang ste thon spel gron chung gi las 137

138 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/'gul zhig spel nas rgya che'i grong gseb khul gye mu ge skyob thabs byas par/phan nus sgon rgyu'i tshab tu grong khyer nang gi rgya che'i mang tshogs la thad gar za 'bru mi 'dang ba'i dka' ngal chen po bzos rkyen/ ma'o tse tung gi spel ba'i mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs pa'i las 'gul la pham nyes byung ste/ rgya nag gi sa khul 'ga' shas dang lhag par bod nang lo lnga'i ring mi mang mnyam las phyir 'gyangs byas pa zer ba'i gnas tshul de byung yod/de dang dus mnyam rgya nag pe cing du 'tshogs pa'i rgya nag gung khran tang gi rgyal yonangs 'thus mi'i chogs chen skabs brgyad pa'i sgog li'u hra'o chi rgya nag rgyal khab kyi gas 'dzin du 'dems thon byung ba dang / teng zha'o phing rgya nag dmar shog dbus chab srid cus kyi drung che lhan khang gi spyi khyab drung cher 'dems sko byung ste/ ma'o tse tung la yod pa'i tang dang rgyal khab kyi 'dzin skyong dang dpal 'byor srid byus gtan 'bebs byed pa'i gal che'i dbang cha khag cig li'u dang steng gnyis kyi lag tu shor bar ma zad/ de'i sdon tsam du rgya nag dmag dpung gi dbang cha dang las gnas che shos gras bzung mkhan gal che'i mi sna zhig gis/ thad gar ma'o tse tung la don gnad de'i thad 'gan khur blang dgos pa'i skyon brjod shugs chen byas par/ ma'o yis rang skyon ngos len byed rgyu'i tshab tu rjes su rgol lan tsha nan slog pa ra mi rnams ya mtshan chen po nabyung ba red/138

138 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'gul zhig spel nas rgya che'i lha nga gseb khul gyi mu ge skyodab thabs byas par/phan nus thon rgyu'i tshab tu grong khyer nang gi rgya che'i mang cho gas la thad kar za 'bru mi 'dang ba'i dka' ngal chen po bzos rkyen/ ma'o tse tung gi spel ba'i mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs pa'i las 'gul la pham nyes byung ste/ rgya nag gi sa khul 'ga' shas dang lhag par bod nang lo lnga'i ring mi mang mnyam las phyir 'gyangs byas pa zer ba'i gnas tshul de byung yod/de dang dus mnyam rgya nag pe cing du 'tsho gas pa'i rgya nag gung khran tang gi rgyal sku ngas 'thus mi'i chosags chen skabs brgyad pa'i sgyu ga li'u hracad chi rgya nag rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin du 'dems thon byung ba dang / teng zha'o phing rgya nag dmar shodag dbus chab srid cus kyi drung che lhan khang gi spyi khyab drung cher 'dems sko byung ste/ ma'o tse tung la yod pa'i tang dang rgyal khab kyi 'dzin skyong dang dpal 'byor srid byus gtan 'bebs byed pa'i gal che'i dbang cha khag cig li'u dang teng gnyis kyi lag tu shor bar ma zad/ de'i sngo na tsam du rgya nag dmag dpung gi dbang cha dang las gnas che cadas gras bzung mkhan gal che'i mi sna zhig gis/ thad kar macod tse tung la dodan gnad de'i thad 'gan khur blang dgos pa'i skyon brjod shugs chen byas par/ ma'o yis rang skyosten lnga sa len byed rgyu'i tshab tu rjes su sgo la lan tsha nan slog par mi rnams ya mtshan chen 〈sna byung ba red/138

rig gnas gsarngo brje'i rlung 'dzub/ 139de nas lo rabs drug cu'i nang / rgya nag gi rig gnas khyab khongs nang gi shes ldan mi sna khag cig gis gna' wa'i rgya nag gong ma'i rgyal rabs nang byung ba zhes pa'i sgrung gtam zhig gtam brjod kyi 'khrab gzhung bzos te/ rgya nag rgyal sku ngas su khyab pa'i rig gnas kyi dus deb thog 'god spel byas par ma zad/ 'khrab gzhung de gzhir bzung nas gtam brjod dang phrang zhi sogs bzos te rgya nag gi grong khyer che khag nang dngos su 'khrab ston byas par/ skabs de'i rgya nag gi mthod rim mi snas mtshon pa'i rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi dga' mo sa chen ro/ byas yod/'khrab gzhung de'i ming la had rus go gnas phab pa zhes 'bod kyi yod pa dang / 'khrab gzhung de'i nang don gtso bo ni/ sngar rgya nag gong ma zhig gi dus su/ rgya che'i mi mang chu log sogs rang byung gnod 'tshes rkyen pas/ 'cho gos dka' ngal chen po 'phrad pa'i skabs der/ bo/nga ma tshang gi spun nye zhig gis sa gnas dpon rigs dang ngan pa lag sbrel byas te/ mi ser gyi sa khang dang rgyu dngos/ tha na mi ser gyi bud med yan chad btsan 'phrog byas te/ mi ser la rang gi bde sdug zhu gtugs rgyag yul med par 'a chad 'u thug gi mtshams su/ had rus zhes pa'i khrims dpon gdong nag gcig yod pa des/ mi mang gi bde sdug la blta skyong byas te/gong ma tshang gi nang mi'i spyod ngan 'dri rtsad zhib 'jug byas mthar nyes can 139

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 139de nas lo rabs drug cu'i nang / rgya nag gi rig gnas khyab khongs nang gi shes ldan mi sna khag cig gis gna' bo rgya nag gong ma'i rgyal rabs nang byung ba zhes pa'i sgrung gtam zhig gtam brjod kyi 'khrab gzhung bzos rte/ rgya nag rgyal yongs su khyab pa'i rig gnas kyi dus deb sgog 'god spel byas par ma zad/ 'khrab gzhung de gzhir bzung nas gtam brjod dang phrang zhi sogs bzos te rgya nag gi grong khyer che khag nang dngos su 'khrab ston byas par/ skabs de'i rgya nag gi mtho rim mi snas mtshon pa'i rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi dga' mos chen po byas yod/'khrab gzhung de'i ming la had rus go gnas phab pa zhes 'bod kyi yod pa dang / 'khrab gzhung de'i nang don gtso bo ni/ sngar rgya nag gong ma zhig gi dus su/ rgya che'i mi mang zu log sogs rang byung gnod 'tshes rkyen pas/ 'cho gos dka' ngal chen po 'phrad pa'i skabs der/ bong ma tshang gi spun nye zhig gis sa gnas dpon rigs dang ngan pa lag sbrel byas te/ mi ser gyi sa khang dang rgyu dngos/ tha na mi ser gye bud med yan chad btsan 'phrog byas te/ mi ser la rang gi bde sdug zhu gtugs rgyag yul med par 'a chad 'u thug gi mtshams su/ had rus zhes pa'i khrims dpon gdong nag gcig yod pa des/ mi mang gi bde sdug la blta skyong byas te/gong ma tshang gi nang mi'i spyod ngan 'dri rtsad zhib 'jug byas mthar nyes can 139

14༷ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/khrims rar sbyar nas mi mang gi bde don grub kyang / rjes la gong mas rang gi spun nye'i skyon cha 'gebs srung ched had rus zhes pa'i khrims dpon gyi go gnas phab pa'i sgor red/'khrab gzhung der mi mang gi dga' mos chen po byas yod na'ang /rgya nag gzhung dang lhag don du ma'o tse tung gis 'khrab gzhung de'i nang don rig gnas gcig pu'i gnad don zhig ma yin par/ de'i nang chab srid kyi gnad don chen po zhig bstan gyi yod pa de ni/ gna' bo'i sgrung gtam bed spyad de deng gi spyi tshogs la zur za skyon 'dzugs byas pa de red ces bshad pa red/ ma'o tse tung gis 'khrab gzhung der do snang de tsam byed dgos don ni/ rgya nag gong ma'i dus skabs su byung ba zhes pa'i sgrung gtam de/ma'o kho pas rgya nag dbang bsgyur byas pa'i dus skabs su dngos su byung zhing /gnas tshul de byung nas lo shas las phyin med/de yang 1959 lo spyi zla 7 pa'i nang rgya nag dmar gzhung gi ches mabo mi sna lhan 'dzoms byas pa'i lu hran gyi chogs 'du zhes pa'i 17ga (lu hran zhes pa rgya nag gong ma'i skabs tsha g.yol byed yul gyi yul ljongs mdzes pa'i ri gong 'ib red/)skabs de'i rgya nag dmar gzhung gi rgyal srung blon chen dang / mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi gzhon pa'i go gnas bzung mkhan beng ta tos mngon sum 'dzems med ngang ma'o tse tung gi mi 140

140 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/khrims rar sbyar nas mi mang gi bde ro/na grub kyang / rjes la gong mas rang gi sprun nye'i skyon cha 'gebs srung ched had rus zhes pa'i khrims dpon gyi go gnas phab pa'i skor red/'khrab gzhung der mi mang gi dga' mo sa chen lnga byas sku da na'ang /rgya nag gzhung dang lhag don du ma'o tse tung gis 'khrab gzhung de'i nang don rig gnas gcig pu'i gnad don zhig ma yin par/ de'i nang chab srid kyi gnad dodan chen po zhig bstan gyi yod pa de ni/ gna' bo'i sgrung gtam bed spyad de deng gi spyi tshogs la zur za skyon 'dzugs byas pa de red ces bshad pa red/ ma'o tse tung gis 'khrab gzhung der do snang de tsam byed dgos don ni/ rgya nag gong ma'i dus skabs su byung ba zhes pa'i sgrung gtam de/ma'o kho pas rgya nag dbang bsgyur byas pa'i dus skabs su dasngo sa su byung zhing /gnas tshul de byung nas lo shas las phyin med/de yang 1959 lo'i spyi zla 7 pa'i nang rgya nag dmar gzhung gi ches mtho'i mi sna lhan 'jo mas byas pa'i lu hran gyi cho gas 'du zhes pa'i thog (lu hran zhes pa rgya nag gong ma'i skabs tsha gasku la byed yul gyi yul lto ngas mdzes pa'i ri stong 'is red/)skabs de'i rgya nag dmar gzhung gi rgyal srung blo na chen dang / mi dmangs bcings bkre la dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi gazlo na pa'i bo gnas bzung mkhan beng ta hos malnga na sum 'dzems med ngang macad tse tung gi mi 140

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 141mang spyi khang btsugs pa'i las 'gul spel ba'i nor 'khrul la skyon 'dzugs shugs chen byas te/ cho gas 'du de'i thog ma'o ngo tsha kha skyengs dgos pa bzos te/ tshogs 'du mjug bsdoms ma byas par lu hran nas pe cing du phyi log byas te yun ring ma song bar/ slo bur 'jab rgol byed pa'i thabs ngan bed spyad de/ beng ta hos la tang rgol ru tshogs kyi byed gte'i nyes ming btsugs te tang phyi nang gi go gnas yongs rdzogs phab ste/ 'dzin bzung do dam byas pa red/rgyu mtshan de dag la brten/ tad rus go gnas phab pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'khrab gzhung de'i nang don ngo ma de ni/ mi rnams kyis gong ma tshang la skyon brjod byas te/ had rus la bstod glu len pa'i gnad don zhig gtan nas ma yin par de las ldog ste/ ma'o tse tung gis rang gi byas nyes 'gebs srung ched/ mi mang gi bde sdug la bsam blo btang ste drang gtam bshad phod mkhan be+eng ta hos kyi go gnas phab par skyon brjod dang ther bton byed kyi yod pa gsal por mchon gyi yod par brten/ ma'o tse tung gis gnad don 'di thag gcod zin pa'i chab srid kyi gyod gzhi gcig slar yang rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas tshur rgol khra sgog brgyab pa zhig la brtsis/ kho pas 1965 zla 11 tshes 10 nyin hrang had du yod pa'i wun hud gsar tho ga ces pa'i bodag (ma'o yi lta ba'i rjes 'brangs pa dang mjug tu mi bde shob kha'i gras shig 141

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 141mang spyi khang btsugs pa'i las 'gul spel ba'i ce ra 'khrul la skyodan 'dzugs shugs chen byas te/ che gas 'du de'i thodag maso/ lnga tsha kha skyengs dgo sa pa bzos te/ chodags 'du mjug bsdoms ma byas par lu hran nas pe cing du phyi log byas te yun ring ma song bar/ slo bur 'jab rgol byed pa'i thabs ngan bed spyad de/ beng ta hos la tang rgol ru tsho gas kyi byed gte'i nyes ming btsugs te tang phyi nang gi thod gnas sku ngas rdzogs phab ste/ 'dzin bzung do dam byas pa red/rgyu mtshan de dag la brten/ had rus bo gnas phab pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'khrab gzhung de'i nang ro/na lnga ma de ni/ mi rnams kyis go nga ma tshang la skyon brjod byas te/ had rus la bstod glu len pa'i gnad don zhig gtan nas ma yin par de las sgyu ga ste/ macodi tse tung gis rang gi byas nyes 'gebs srung ched/ mi mang gi bde sdug la bsam blo btang ste drang gtam bshad sgyu da mkhan beng ta ho sa kyi go gnas phab par skyodan bcadad dang ther bton byed kyi yod pa gsal wa ra mcho na gyi sku da par brten/ macod tse tung gis gnad dodan 'di thag gce da zin pa'i chab srid kyi gyodad gzhi gcig slar yang rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas tshur lha la khra phru ga brgyab pa zhig la brtsis/ kho pas 1965 zla 11 tshes 10 nyin hrang had du yod pa'i wun hūd gsar sna/ga ces pa'i 1snag (ma'o yi lta ba'i rjes 'brangs pa dang mjug tu mi bani shos khu'i gras shig 141

142 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/yin pa/ nye dus rgya nag gzhung gi lo 2༷ btson bcug byas te chod bkrol banang ba )ya'ong ༷ na yon la ngan sgul byas pa ltar/ 'go brjod du gsar du rtsom sgrig byas pa'i had rus go gnas phab pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'khrab gzhung la dpyad pa 'es pa'i dpyad gtam zhig spel bar ma zad dpyad gtam de rgya nag rgyal yonangs kyi gsar shog dang dus deb khag nang bskyar du 'god spel byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/skabs der rgya nag dbus chab srid cus kyi tshogs mi dang pe cing grong khyer gyi spyi khyab beng kren gyis/ don gnad de'i thad ma'o tse tung gi byed stangs la 'dod mos ma byung bar/ skabs de'i rgya nag rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzigi li'u hra'o chi dang / rgya nag dbus dmar shog chab srid cus kyi drung che lhan khrang gi spyi khyab drung che teng zha'o phing gnyis la khong gi bsam tshul dang ma'o yi byed tshul bcas snyan seng zhus te/ ma'o yi byed stangs de rigs rgya nag dmar gzhung dbus chab srid cus kyis gtan 'bebs zin pa'i mnyam sdeb 'gan khur gyi sgrig 'dzugs kyi rtsa don dang mthun gye med tshul shugs che nan bshad byas yod kyang /'on kyang / ma'o tse tung gis de mjug slar yang rig gnas khyab khongs kyi 'brel yod mi sna khag cig dang mjal 'phrad byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun/ deng skabs rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi rig gnas khyab khongs nang 142

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 143gi rgyal rabs dang lo rgyus kyi deb/ glu gar dang gtam brjod/ slog brnyan dang phrang zhi/ gsar shog dang rlung 'phrin sogs rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi gar stegs tshang ma'i thog gung khran tang gis 'go khrid pa'i bzo zhing dmag gsum gtso bo byas pa'i rgya nag gsar pa'i bdag po tshos/ gsar brje dang thon skyed nang byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag par bstod glu dang bsngags brjod ma byas par/ shi nas lo mang song ba'i gong ma dang btsun mo/ rgyal po dang rgyal mo/ zlon po dang mi drag sogs lha 'dre gdon bgegs rnams la ched du mngags te bsngags brjod dang / bstod glu len pa'i don gnad 'di rig gnas dang rig rtsal gyi gnad don gcig pu zhig ma yin par/ de'i nang du rig gnas khyab khongs kyi dbang cha de 'byor med gral rim dang 'byor ldan gral rim gnyis bar su'i lag tu yod min gyi gnad don gal che zhig la thug yod/ngas bltas na/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi tshab byed mi sna dang gsar brjer ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi skabs 'tshol ring lugs pa/ bzo bcos ring lugs pa 〉 na chen zhig gung khran tang gi nang dang / srid gzhung gi nang /dmag dpung gi nang / rig gnas khyab khongs kyi sde tshan khag gi nang du g.yo 'dzul byas te khong tshos dbang cha zin 'dug pas/ nga tshos mngon gsal dod po dang / khyon yongs nas mang tshogs skul slong byas te 1 rig gnas 143

rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub/ 143gi rgyal rabs dang 'o/ rgyus kyi deb/ khru gar dang gtam brjod/ glog brnyan dang phrang zhi/ gsar cadag dang rlung 'phrin mo gas rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi gar stegs tshang ma'i thodag gung khran tang gis 'go khrid pa'i bajo zhing dmag gsum gtso bo byas pa'i rgya nag gsar pa'i bdag po sas/ gsar brje dang thon skyed nang byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag par bstod glu dang bsngags brjod ma byas par/ shi nas 'e mang song ba'i bo nga ma dang btsun mo / rgyal ngo dang rgyal mo/ blon wa dang mi drag se gas lha 'dre gdodan bgegs rnams la ched du mngags te bsngags brjod dang / bstod glu len pa'i don gnad 'di rig gnas dang rig rtsal gyi gnad don gcig pu zhig ma yin par/ de'i nang du rig gnas khyab khongs kyi dbang cha de 'gyor med gral rim dang 'gyor ldan gral rim gnyis bar su'i lag tu sku da min gyi gnad ro/na gal che zhig la thug yad/ngas bltas na/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi tshab byed mi sna dang gsar brjer ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi skabs 'tshol ring lugs pa/ bzo bcos ring lugs pa phon chen zhig gung khran tang gi nang dang / srid gzhung gi nang /dmag dpung gi nang / rig gnas khyab khongs kyi sde tshan khag gi nang du gasku 'dzul byas te khong choms dbang cha zin 'dug pas/ nga chodas mngon gsal dod po dang / khyon yongs nas mang tshogs skul slong byas te / rig gnas 143

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 145bco lja/rig gnas gsar baje chen po dab /dmar spung dmagade nas yun ring ma song bar/ 1966 zla 5 tshes 16 nyin/ma'o tse tung gis kho pa'i bza' zla cang cing dang rgya nag dmar gzhung gi gsang las kyi 'go gtso khang treng / rgya nag nang ma le'i dmar po'i lta ba mkhas pa yin/ zhes pa'i khren po ta bcas mi gsum gtso gyur gyi rgya nag dbus rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i las 'gul gyi 'go khrid chogs chung bsko gzhag byas pa dang / chabs cig rgya nag rgyal yongs nang rig gnas gsar brje chen wa las 'gul dngos su spel 'go tshugs pa'i yig cha don tshan 16 'khod pa zhig kyang rgya nag gzhung gi dbus sa'i rlung 'phrin khag dang gsar shog khag nas khyab bsgrags byas/lo de'i spyi zla 6 tshes 1 nyin ma'o tse tung gis pe cing grong 145

146 nyan mo ma bcos drang gtam/khyer du snye yon tse (rgya nag dmag spyi snye rung kren gyi bu mo )sogs slob phrug bdun kyis skabs de'i pe cing grong khyer gyi spyi khyab beng kran gyis gtsos pa'i dpon rigs khag cig dang / de bzhin mtho slob khag tu yod pa'i li'u hra'o chi'i bza' zla wang kong mes gtso bo byas pa'i las don ru khag la skyon 'dzugs byas pa'i yig chen tshags par la rgyab skyor byas pa dang / chabs cig gong gsal ching hwa mtho slob kye khong gtogs slob grwa 'bring ba'i slob phrug de dag dmar srung dmag dpa' bo red/ ces tshad mabo'i bsngags brjod byas pa'i yi ge zhig btang ba de spyi zla 6 tshes 24 nyin rlung 'phrin dang gsar shog nang 'grems spel byas rjes de ma thag tu pe cing gi sgob grwa khag nang tu mdung rtse dmar po 'khyer cing / dpung par ras dar dmar po'i thog dmar srung dmag ces bris pa'i dpung rtags btags te dmag gos ser po gyon zhing / dmar srung dmag yin zhes gzhon nu slob grwa ba gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang sgon/ma'o tse tung gi gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen nas slob phrug de tshor mjal 'phrad dang chabs cig kho pa'i dpung par yang / dmar srung dmag ces pa'i dpung ras dmar po gong gsal sgob phrug snyen yon tse zhes pas g.yogs nas rim bzhin gnas tshul gang yang mi shes pa'i dmar srung dmag de dag la rgya nag dbus rig gsar 'go khrid chogs chung gis ngan skul byas/146

146 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khyer du snye yon tse (rgya nag dmag spyi snye rung kren gyi bu mo )sku gas slob phrug bdun gyis skabs de'i pe cing grong khyer gyi spyi khyab beng kran gyis gtsos pa'i dngo na rigs khag cig dang / de bzhin malnga slob khag tu yod pa'i li'u hracod chi'i bza' zla wang kong mes gtso bo byas pa'i las don ru khag la skyon 'dzugs byas pa'i yig chen tshags par la rgyab skyodar byas pa dang / chabs cig bo nga gsal ching hwa malnga stsodab kyi kho nga gto/gas cadab grwa 'bring ba'i cadab phrug de dag dmar srung dmag dpa' bo red/ ces tshad mtho'i bsngags brjod byas pa'i yi ge zhig btang ba de spyi zla 6 tshes 24 nyin rlung 'phrin dang gsar shodag nang 'grems spel byas rjes de ma thag tu pe cing gi lho ba grwa khag nang tu mdung rtse dmar po 'khyer cing / dpung par ras dar dmar po'i thog dmar srung dmag ces bris pa'i dpung rtags btags te dmag bo sa ser lnga gyodan zhing / dmar srung dmag yin zhes gazlo na nu slob grwa ba gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang thon/macad tse tung gi gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen nas phru ba phrug de tsho ra mjal 'phrad dang chabs cig kho pa'i dpung par yang / dmar srung dmag ces pa'i dpung ras dmar sngo bo nga gsal slob phrug snyen yon tse zhes pas g.yogs nas rim bzhin gnas tshul gang yang mi shes pa'i dmar srung dmag de dag la rgya nag dbus rig gsar 'go khrid cho gas chung gis ngan skul byas/146

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 147mi ngan de dag gi ngan bskul la brten dmar srung dmag gis li'u hra'o chi'i khongs mi yin pa'i pe cing hrong khyer gyi spyi khyab beng kren la/ tang nang ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa dang / had rus go gnas phab pa'i 'khrab gzhung 'bri rtso ma byed mkhan gyi rgyab rtsa nag sprod yin pa'i nyes ming btsugs te/ dmar srung dmag dang mang tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod gtong 'go tshugs pa dang chabs cig pe cing grong khyer gyi rig gnas sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin gtso gras ting tho dang / wu han/ le'o mo sar mi gsum yang khyim tshang gsum gyi grong tsho zhes pa'i nyes ming btsugs te/ khong rnams lha 'dre gdon bgegs red/ces shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po zhig g.yogs nas rnga rdung dar 'phyar gyi khrom gzhung du 'khrid de/ mang tshogs la 'thab rtsod byed 'jug pa'i las 'gul dngos su 'boge btsugs/ rgya nag gi rgyal sa pe cing nas 'go tshugs te rim pas grong khyer che khag dang zhing chen khag tu rig gnas gsar brje'i khyab 'phel 'aX bzhin pa'i gnas tshul de dag gsar shog dang rlung 'phrin thog nas zhib phra dril bsgrags byas pa'i rjes su/ spyi zla 6 zla stod du lha sar yod pa'i bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par khang gi las byed pa khag cig gis bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po/ zhes pa'i las 'gul gyi me lce dang wang sbar 'bo tshugs te tshags par las khungs de'i 147

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 147mi ngan de dag gi ngan bskul la brten dmar srung dmag gis li'u hra'o chi'i khongs mi yin pa'i pe cing grong khyer gyi spyi khyab beng kren la/ tang nang ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa dang / had rus go gnas phab pa'i 'khrab gzhung 'bri rtsom byed mkhan gyi rgyab rtsa nag po yin pa'i nyes ming btsugs te/ dmar srung dmag dang mang tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod gtong 'go tshugs pa dang chabs cig pe cing grong khyer gyi rig gnas sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin gas gras ting tho dang / wu tan/ le'o mo sar mi gsum yang khyim tshang gsum gyi grong cho zhes pa'i nyes ming btsugs te/ khong rnams lha 'dre gdon bgegs red/ces shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po zhig g.yogs nas rnga rdung dar 'phyar gyi khrom gzhung du 'khrid de/ mang tshogs la 'thab rtsod byed 'jug pa'i las 'gul dngos su 'go btsugs/ rgya nag gi rgyal sa pe cing nas 'go tshugs te rim pas grong khyer che khag dang zhing chen khag tu rig gnas gsar brje'i khyab 'phel 'gro bzhin pa'i gnas tshul de dag gsar shog dang rlung 'phrin sgog nas zhib phra dril bsgrags byas pa'i rjes su/ spyi zla 6 zla stod du lha sar yod pa'i bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par khang gi las byed pa khag cig gis bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po/ zhes pa'i las 'gul gyi me lce dang lnga sbar 'go tshugs te tshags par las khungs de'i 147

148 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/rtsom sgrig pa dang / 'gan 'dzin gcig lcogs yin pa'i cin hra zhes pa'e rig gnas mkhas pa zhib/ la skyon 'dzugs byed 'go tshugs pa dang chabs cig rang skyong dril bsgrags las khungs dang / rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung dang tang ud khag so so nang cin hra yi rgyab rtsa nag po su yin zhib bsher zer 'don yang byed 'go tshugs/skabs der bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pa'i dbang 'dzin mi sna tshos gnas tshul de mu mthud rgya skyed mi 'gro ba'i ched du/ bod 'di rgya nag gi nang sa'i grong khyer che khag dang mi 'dra bar/ mtha' mtshams sa khul zhig yin pas/ gal te bod nang zang zing byung tshe rgyal nang gi gral rim dgra bo dang rgyal khab phyi la yod pa'i log spyod pas dus skabs dang bstun ste ngo log zing 'khrug slong gi red zer bshad de/ bod nang 'go tshugs ma thag yin pa'i rig gsar gyi las 'gul gzhi rgya zung chung de 'ja' yal ba ltar med pa bzo ched du/ li'u hra'o chis pe cing gi mtho slob khag tu las don ru khag btang ba ltar/ bod ldongs nyin re'i tshags par las khungs nang du'ang / bod rang skyong ldongs tang ud sogs nas las don ru khag ces pa'i tang srid kyi la sa byed pa phon chen zhig btang ste/ mtho rim mi snar skyon brjod byed pa'i las 'gul de mtshams 'jog thabs byas/'on kyang / skabs der pe cing du tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang spel bzhin 148

148 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/sna ma sgrig pa dang / 'gan 'dzin gcig lcogs yin pa'i cin hra zhes pa'i rig gnas mkhas pa zhis/ la skyogen 'dzugs byed 'asku tshugs pa dang chabs cig rang skyong dril bsgrags las khungs dang / rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung dang tang ༷/da khag mo so'i nang cin hra yi rgyab rtsa nag rngo su yin zhib bsher ther 'dodan yang byed 'go tshugs/skabs der bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pa'i dbang 'dzin mi sna tshos gnas tshul de mu mthud rgya skyed mi 'gro ba'i ched du/ bod 'di rgya nag gi nang sa'i bo nga khyer che khag dang mi 'dra bar/ mtha' mtshams sa khul zhig yin pas/ gal te wa da nang zang zing byung tshe rgyal nang gi gral rim dgra wa dang rgyal khab phyi la yod pa'i 'e ga spyodad pas dus skabs dang bstun ste ngo log zing 'khrug slong gi red zer bshad de/ bod nang 'go tshugs ma thag yin pa'i rig gsar gyi las 'gul gzhi rgya chung chung de 'ja' yal ba ltar med pa bakhrod ched du/ li'u hra'o chis pe cing gi mthod stsodab khag tu las don ru khag btang ba ltar/ bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par las khungs nang du'ang / bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud sogs nas las don ru khag ces pa'i tang srid kyi la sa byed pa 'o/na chen zhig btang ste/ mthe rim mi snar skyodan bajo da byed pa'i las 'gul de mtshams 'jo ga thabs byas/'on kyang / skabs der pe cing du tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang spel bzhin 148

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 149pa'i dmar srung dmag gi las 'gul der ma'o tse tung ngo mas skul slong dang rgya ba skyor byed bzhin yod par brten/ mtho slob khag tu li'u hra'o chis btang ba'i las don ru khag rnams pham nyes chen po byung ste khungs so sor phyir log byed dgos byung ba ltar/ bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par las khungs nang du yod pa'i las don ru khab kyang phyir 'azen byed dgos byung bar ma zad/ khong chor bod nang gi rig gsar las 'gul bkag 'gog byas pa'i nyes ming gsar pa zhig kyang phog pa red/de nas yun ring ma song bar bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pa'i mas rim dbang 'dzin las khungs de'i drung che'i gras shig dang / bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yonan gzhon pa wang 'chi med kyis 'go khrid pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rig gnas gsar brje chen wa 'go khrid tshogs rbung zhes pa dngos su btsugs/spyi zla 7 tshes shar du bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms shig bskongs tshogs byas pa'i thog ma'o tse tung gis pe cing du/ spyi zla 5 tshes 16 nyin rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i las 'gul spel 'go tshugs pa'i brda yig don tshan 16 yond pa der slob sbyong byed 'go tshugs shing / bod nang yod pa'i rgya'i mtho rim 'go khrid las byed de tshos rang nyid ma'o tse tung ge rjes 'brangs pa lhag bsam 149

rig gnas gsar brje chen wa dang / dmar srung dmag 149pa'i dmar srung dmag gi las 'gul der ma'o tse tung ngo mas skul lho nga dang rgya ba skyor byed bzhin sku da par brten/ mtho slob khag tu li'u hra'o chis btang ba'i las don ru khag rnams pham nyes chen po byung ste khungs so sor phyir log byed dgos byung ba ltar/ bod jongs nyin re'i tshags par las khungs nang du yod pa'i las don ru khas/ kyang phyir 'then byed dgos byung bar ma zad/ kho nga cho ra lnga da nang gi rig gsar las 'gul bkag 'gog byas pa'i nyes ming gsar pa zhig kyang sgyu ga pa red/de nas yun ring ma song bar bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pa'i mtho rim dbang 'dzin las khungs de'i drung che'i gras shig dang / bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid ༷/ sku/na gazlothon pa wang 'chi med kyis 'bo khrid pa'i bod rang skyodang jongs kyi rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i 'bo khrid cho gas chung zhes pa dngo sa su btsugs/spyi zla 7 tshes shar du bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi tshogs 'du rgyas 'alnga mas shig bskongs cho gas byas pa'i thodag macad tse tung gis pe cing du/ spyi zla 5 tshes 1snyo nyin rig gnas gsar brje chen lnga zhes pa'i las 'gul spel 'bo tshugs pa'i brda yig snga cha/ tshan 1snyo sku/da pa der slob spyong byed 'go tshugs shing / bod nang yod pa'i rgya'i mtho rim 'go khrid las byed de chodas rang nyid ma'o tse tung gi rjes 'brangs pa lhag bsam 149

150 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/rnam dag can zhig yin pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal ston ched/ 'go khrid nang khul phan tshun skyon 'dzugs byed 'go tshugs pa dang dus mtshungs/ pe cing grong khyer gtso gyur rgya nag zhing chen khag nas rig gsar las 'gul spel mkhan dmar srung dmag bod nang yong rgyur dga' bsu zhu ba'i thag gcod kyang byas/de nas bzung rgya nag rgyal yongs su ri 'gul mcho 'khyoms ltar spel bzhin pa'i gdug rtsub can gyi chab srid kyi las 'gul de'i 'dre rlung bod nang dngos su slebs 'go tshugs/spyi lo 1966 zla 7 zla mjug tu bod nang thog mar rgya nag nas slebs pa'i ching twa mtho slob dang / pe cing mtho sgob/ pe cing mi rigs slob grwa sogs kyi dmar srung dmag yin/ zhes pa'i rgya'i slob phrug brgya skor zhig lha sa sgob 'bring dang / bod ljongs dge 'os slob grwa khag gnyis nang du spebs te/ khong chos rgya nag dang rig gsar gye las 'gul dang dmar srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs 'go btsugs pa'i brgyud rim gnas tshul zhib phra ngo sprod byas par ma zad/ bod nang yod pa'i slob grwa khag gnyis kyi nang du'ang dmar srung dmag btsugs dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas/ de dang dus mnyam bod nang yod pa'i rgya nag gi gzhung 'brel gyi gsar 'gyur las khang shin twa gsar khang bod kyi yan lag ces pa dang / bod ljongs nyin 150

150 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/rnam dag can zhig yin pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal ston ched/ 'boste khrid nang khul phan tshun skyon 'dzugs byed 'go tshugs pa dang dus mtshungs/ pe cing bo nga khyer gasgur gyur rgya nag zhing chen khag nas rig gsar las 'gul spel mkhan dmar srung dmag wa da nang yong rgyur dga' bsu zhu ba'i thag gce da kyang byas/de nas bzung rgya nag rgyal sku ngas su ri 'gul mtsho 'khyoms ltar spel bzhin pa'i gdug rtsub can gyi chab srid kyi las 'gul de'i 'dre rlung bod nang dngos su slebs 'go tshugs/spyi 'o/ 196snyo zla 7 zla mjug tu nge da nang thodag mar rgya nag nas slebs pa'i ching twa mtho slob dang / pe cing mtho slob/ pe cing mi rigs lho ba grwa sogs kyi dmar srung dmag yin/ zhes pa'i rgya'i slob phrug brgya stodar zhig lha sa slob 'bring dang / bod ljongs dge 'os slob grwa khag gnyis nang du slebs te/ kho nga chodas rgya nag dang rig gsar gyi las 'gul dang dmar srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs 'go btsugs pa'i brgyud rim gnas tshul zhib phra ngo sprod byas par ma zad/ bod nang yod pa'i slob grwa khag gnyis kyi nang du'ang dmar srung dmag btsugs dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas/ de dang dus mnyam wa da nang sku da pa'i rgya nag gi gzhung 'brel gyi gsar 'gyur las khang shin twa gsar khang bod kyi yan lag ces pa dang / bod ljongs nyin 150

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 151re'i tshags par sogs kyi las byed pa khag cig gis kyang rig gsar gyi las 'gul de bod nang 'phral mar spel ma thub par rgya nag zhing chen khag gi rjes su lus yod pa dang / lhag par du bod nang da dung yang bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi mtshon rtags dgon sde khag dang / de tsho'i nang yod pa'i lha 'dre gdon bgegs rnams gtor rgol byas med par skyon brjod byas pa'i rtsom yig bsnyud mar gsar shog thog 'god spel byas/rlung 'phrin thog nas kyang bskyar bshad yang bshad byed bzhin pa'i nyin zhig la rgya nag pe cing gi rlung 'phrin thog nas ma'o tse tung gis rig gnas rnying pa dang / bsam slo rnying pa/ goms gshis rnying pa/ lugs srol rnying pa bcas rnying pa bzhi rtsa gtor btang ste rig gnas gsar pa dang /bsam slo gsar pa/ goms gshis gsar pa/ lugs srol gsar pa bcas gsar pa bzhi 'dzugs dgos/ zhes pa'i ches mabo'i mdzub ston zhes pa/ (skabs der ma'o tse tung gi bshad pa'i gtam bshad tshang mar ches mtho'i mdzub ston zhes brjod kyi yod )dril bsgrags yang nas yang du byas te de ma thag tu lha sa sgob 'bring (po tā la'i rgyab )nang du'ang lus la dmag gos ser po gyon zhing / dpung pa ra dmar srung dmag ces dpung ras dmar po btags pa'i dam ra srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs de btsugs so//skabs der dmar srung dmag nang 'dzul zhugs byed mkhan phal 151

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 151re'i tshags par sku(gas kyi las byed pa khag cig gis kyang rig gsar gyi las 'gul de ngo da nang 'phral mar spel ma thub par rgya nag zhing chen khag gi rjes su lus yod pa dang / lhag par du bod nang da dung yang bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi mtshon rtags dgon sde khag dang / de tsho'i nang yodad pa'i lha 'dre gdon bgegs rnams gto/ra rgol byas med par skyon bajo da byas pa'i lca ma yig bsnyud mar gsar cadag the ga 'go da spel byas/rlung 'phrin thodag nas kyang bskyar bshad yang bshad byed bzhin pa'i nyin zhig la rgya nag pe cing gi rlung 'phrin thog nas macaste tse tung gis rig gnas rnying pa dang / bsam blo rnying pa/ goms gshis rnying pa/ lugs srol rnying pa bcas rnying pa bzhi rtsa gtor btang ste rig gnas gsar pa dang /bsam blo gsar pa/ lhasnems gshis gsar pa/ lugs 11la gsar pa bcas gsar pa bzhi 'dzugs dbo sa/ zhes pa'i ches mtho'i mdzub stodan zhes pa/ (skabs der ma'o tse tung gi bshad pa'i gtam bshad tshang mar ches mtho'i mdzub ston zhes brdzod kyi yod )dril bsgrags yang nas yang du byas te de ma thag tu lha sa slob 'bring (po twa la'i rgyab )nang du'ang lus la dmag gos ser po gyon zhing / dpung pa ra dmar srung dmag ces dpung ras dmar wa btags pa'i dam ra srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs de btsugs so//skabs der dmar srung dmag nang 'dzul zhugs byed mkhan phal 151

152 rgan mo'i ma bcetes drang gtam/che ba bod nang mo da pa'i rgya mi'i mtho rim 'go khrid las byed kyi phru gu tsho dang /de nas nge da mi'i nang yar langs zhing bran zhes pa'i bu phrug rnams yin pa las/ skabs der rgya mi'i shodad tshul ltar gral rim yag wa med pa'i mnga' bdag dang / mnga' tshab/ ngo log zing 'khrug nang yod pa'i log spyod pa/zhing pa phyug wa dang 'ango ga bdag bcas rigs bzhi'i mi sna zhes pa'i bu phrug rnams dmar srung dmag nang 'dzul zhugs byed mi chodag pa ma zad/ rtag tu dmar srung dmag gi kha rdung dang las ka bskul ba rnams byas te bachodad sgom byas nas sgyu da rgyu las khong tshor kha gtad bcag na rang nyid la gyong chen po rag gi yodad/de dus rgya nag nas yodang ba'i dmar srung dmag rgya phrug de tsho sa 'byug la 'brug phrug skyes pa dang / rma byar rma phrug skyes pa/ tsi tsir tsi phrug skyes pas tshe gang ring sa khug nang sdod rgyu las lhag pa sku nga thabs med ces gral rim mtho dman dang / mi rigs dbye 'byed kyi srid byus lag star byas te rigs bzhi'i bu phrug yongs la mthong chung dang thub tshod gtong rkyang byed kyi sku da/cadab grwa'i nang dmar srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs btsugs ma thag slob grwa'i sngar yod kyi sgrig 'dzugs dang / dge rgan dang dge phrug gi 'du shes rnams nyin de nas bzung tshang ma lugs srol rnying par brtsis 152

152 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/che ba bod nang yod pa'i rgya mi'i mtho rim 'go khrid las byed kyi phru gu tsho dang /de nas bod mi'i nang yar langs zhing bran zhes pa'i bu phrug rnams yin pa las/ skabs der rgya mi'i shod tshul ltar gral rim yag po med pa'i mnga' bdag dang / mnga' tshab/ ngo log zing 'khrug nang yod pa'i log spyod pa/zhing pa phyug po dang 'brog bdag bcas rigs bzhi'i mi sna zhes pa'i bu phrug rnams dmar srung dmag nang 'dzul zhugs byed mi chog pa ma zad/ rtag tu dmar srung dmag gi kha rdung dang las ka bskul ba rnams byas te bzod sgom byas nas sdod rgyu las khong tshor kha gtad bcag na rang nyid la gyong chen po rag gi yod/de dus rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag rgya phrug de tshos 'byug la 'brug phrug skyes pa dang / rma byar rma phrug skyes pa/ tsi tsir tsi phrug skyes pas tshe gang ring sa khug nang sdod rgyu las lhag pa yong thabs med ces gral rim mtho dman dang / mi rigs dbye 'byed kyi srid byus lag star byas te rigs bzhi'i bu phrug yongs la mthong chung dang thub tshod gtong rkyang byed kyi yod/sgo ba grwa'i nang dmar srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs btsugs ma thag gronab grwa'i sngar yod kyi sgrig 'dzugs dang / dge rgan dang dge phrug gi 'du shes rnams nyin de nas bzung tshang ma lugs srol rnying par brtsis 152

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 15 te thor bshig tu phyin pa dang / chabs cig nyin re'i las 'gan gtso bo rig gzhung shes bya slob khred byed pa'i 'dzin grwa tshugs rgyu de yang med par gyur te/ de'i tshab tu nyin ltar ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom phyogs bsdu sa dang gzhung 'brel gsar tho ga sogs blta grongag byas te/ skabs der rgya nag nang dar khyab che ba'i nyin ltar snga dro ma'o tse tung la bstod pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi gzhas dang zhabs bro 'khrab dbo sa pa/ dgong mo nyal khar ma'o yi 'dra par mdun slob prug tshang ma yar langs te/ rang gi bsam slo rtsis sgod byas te/ ma'o la sems pa rnam dag byed dgos pa'i thog gsar brje mthar phyin pa byed rgyu'i dam bca' 'bul dgos/zhes pa'i bsun 'tsher can gyi las 'gul zhig kyang yud tsam spel nas dus yun ring po ma song bar/ dmar srung dmag gi mig nang ma 'gro ba'i sgob grwa'i 'gan 'dzin dang / dge rgan khag cig la lha 'dre gdon bgegs zung zung red ces sdug sbyong gtong 'go tshugs/153

rig gnas gsar brje chen po dang / dmar srung dmag 153te thor bshig tu phyin pa dang / chabs cig nyin re'i las 'gan gtso bo rig gzhung shes bya slob khred byed pa'i 'dzin grwa tshugs rgyu de yang med par gyur te/ de'i tshab tu nyin ltar ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom phyogs bab cos dang gzhung 'brel gsar cadag sogs blta skru ga byas te/ skabs der rgya nag nang dar khyab che ba'i nyin ltar snga dro ma'o tse tung la bstod pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi gzhas dang zhabs lnga 'khrab dalhasnes pa/ dbo nga mo nyal khar macad yi 'dra par mdun slob phrug tshang ma yar langs te/ rang gi bsam khyod rtsis sgod byas te/ macad la sems pa rnam dag byed dgos pa'i thog gsar brje mthar phyin pa byed rgyu'i dam bca' 'bul dgos/zhes pa'i bsun 'tsher can gyi las 'gul zhig kyang ྅༅da tsam spel nas dus yun ring po ma song bar/ dmar srung dmag gi mig nang ma 'gro ba'i rnyedab grwa'i 'gan 'dzin dang / dge rgan khag cig la lha 'dre gdodan bgegs chung chung red ces sdug sbyong gtong 'go tshugs/153

154 rgan lnga re ma bcetes dang gtam/bcu drugadhing bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chagaphal cher 196snyo zla 8 tshes 12 la/ lha sa rnyesab grwa 'bring ba'i nang spo bur du mi khag cig gis rnga rdung dar 'phyar byed bzhin par slebs pa dang / kho nga chorware lag tu yig chen tshags par chen sngo zhig bris nas 'khyer zhing / skabs der slob grwa'i rgyang bsgrags lnga ga nas rus ming shad zer ba'i rgya yig dge rgan zhig yod pa kho sa/ dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug rnams rtsed thang du 'dzoms dgos pa'i brda btang ba ltar slob phrug rngams slob grwa'i rtsed thang du 'dzoms 'phral/ gong gsal rnga rdung dar 'phyar byed mkhan mi de snums lag tu bzung ba'i yig chen tshags par de slob grwa'i darma ra srung dmag gi 'go byed bu mo krang zhes pa de dang shad zer ba'i dge rgan gnyis la sprad/yig chen tshags par de'i nang / dmar srung dmag dpa' ngo chung 154

154 gon mo ma bcos dang gtam/bcu drugadhing bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chagaphal cher 1966 zla 8 tshes 12 la/ lha sa sgosab grwa 'bring ba'i nang slo bur du mi khag cig gis rnga rdung dar 'phyar byed bzhin par spebs pa dang / khong tsho lag tu yig chen tshags par chen po zhig bris nas 'khyer zhing / skabs der slob grwa'i rgyang bsgrags thog nas rus ming shad zer ba'i rgya yig dge rgan zhig yod pa khos/ dmar srung dmag dang sgob phrug rnams rtsed thang du 'dzoms dgos pa'i brda btang ba ltar slob phrug tshoms slob grwa'i rtsed thang du 'dzoms 'phral/ gong gsal rnga rdung dar 'phyar byed mkhan mi de chos lag tu bzung ba'i yig chen tshags par de slob grwa'i dam ra srung dmag gi 'go byed bu mo krang zhes pa de dang shad zer ba'i dge rgan gnyis la sprad/yig chen tshags par de'i nang / dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung 154

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 155chung khyed rnam pas nga tsho'i sems nang gi nyi ma dmar cadasdo/ yin pa'i rlabs chen gyi slob dpon dang / rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi'i ches mtho'i mdzub ston bka' srung ci bsgrubs zhus te/ rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gtong ba'i las 'gul tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis spel ba'i sprodag mar bkas bskadad brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi bsam slo dang / rig gnas rnying pa mchodan pa'i lha sa'i ༷ nga khyer nang gi dbo na pa lha khang nang gi lha 'dre garo/na bgegs de dag 'phral du gtor rgol gtong ba'i gsar brje'i bya spyod spel rgyur/ nga chodas rgyab skyodar mtha' gcig tu zhu yi sku da/ ces pa'i nang wa na de 'dra zhig bkod pa dang / mi de cho ni rgya nag dbus gzhung gi lha sar bca' sdod shin twa gsar khang gi yan lag las khungs zhes pa'i gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi las byed yin pa dang / kho nga chodas snga sa nas ngo da nang rig gsar gyi las 'gul spel dbo sa pa'i ngan skul byas mo da/rgya mi'i las byed de dzapas yig chen tshags par slob grwar bskyal ma thag rgya nag nas sku nga ba'i dmar srung dmag de tsho dang / dge rgan shad dang dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed rgya mo krang zhes pa kho nga tshos 'go khrid de slob grwa'i rgya phrug dmag gis gtso bo byas pa'i dmar srung dmag dang de byings dmar srung dmag nang ma tshud pa'i slob hrug tshang ma ru star bsgrigs te rnga brdung dar 'phyar thog rnying bzhi rtsa gtor dang gsar pa bzhi gsar 155

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 155zung khyed rnam pas nga tsho'i sems nang gi nyi ma dmar shob/ yin pa'i rlabs chen gyi sgob dpon dang / rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi'i ches mabo'i mdzub ston bka' srung ci bsgrubs zhus te/ rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gtong ba'i las 'gul tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis spel ba'i sgog mar bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi bsam blo dang / rig gnas rnying pa mtshon pa'i lha sa'i grong khyer nang gi dgon pa lha khang nang gi lha 'dre gdon bgegs de dag 'phral du gtor rgol gtong ba'i gsar brje'i bya spyod spel rgyur/ nga tshos rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu zhu yi yod/ ces pa'i nang don de 'dra zhig bkod pa dang / mi de cho ni rgya nag dbus gzhung gi lha sar bca' sdod shin dwa gsar khang gi yan lag las khungs zhes pa'i gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi las byed yin pa dang / khong tshos snga sa nas bod nang rig gsar gyi las 'gul spel dgos pa'i ngan skul byas yod/rgya mi'i las byed de tshos yig chen tshags par 11ba grar bskyal ma thag rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag de tsho dang / dge rgan shad dang dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed rgya mo krang zhes pa khong tshos 'go khrid de slob grwa'i rgya phrug dmag gis gtso bo byas pa'i dmar srung dmag dang de byengs dmar srung dmag nang ma tshud pa'i sgob phrug tshang ma ru star bsgrigs te rnga brdung dar 'phyar thog rnying bzhi rtsa gtor dang gsar pa bzhi gsar 155

156 na mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'dzugs byed dgos pa'i 'bod tshig bsgrags pa dang / yang mtshams re ma'o tse tung gi gtam bshad las bzos pa'i gzhas gdangs ngar po de 'dra yang gtong bzhin du slob grwa'i sgo nas thon ste/ rdzong rgyab klung khang dang / zhol mdun thang gi khrom gzhung brgyud shar rgyag lha sa gtsug lag khang gi lto ngos su yod pa'i gsung chos ra bar 'khrid/de gar mang tshogs gang 'tshams 'du 'dzoms byung rjes/ thog mar sgob grwa'i zlos gar nas rmongs dad byed rgyu med pa'i gtam brjod cig 'khrab rjes dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed rgya mo krang dang / bod mi bkra shis tshe ring zhes pa gnyis kyis lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gtong dgos pa'i skor/ bod rgya skad yig gnyis thog nas mang tshogs la drel bsgrags byed skabs de'i ring / nga'i bu rang khyim dang thag nye po yod pas mgyogs myur lha gtor 'char gyi gnas tshul nga la lan skyel bar spebs te/ dmar srung dmag gi lha btor rtsis byed kyi 'dug ces bshad/ ngas mdang dgong nga'i me+e lam du lha tshang ma nam mkhar 'phur ba'i rmi lam btang byung / da ltas bzang ba ma red/ de las bu rang za 'thung byas te mgyogs po phar rgyugs ma gtogs sgob grwa nas gshe gshe gtang yong zhes bshad/bu khyim nas sgon te/ gsung chos ra bar 'gro skabs/ rme ru rnying pa'i rgyal sgo'i 'khris su yod pa'i gtsug lag khang gi shar sgo'i nang nas rgya 156

15snyo rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/'dzugs byed dgos pa'i 'bod tshig bsgrags pa dang / yang mtshams re ma'o tse tung gi gtam bshad las bzos pa'i gzhas gdangs ngar lnga de 'dra yang gtong bzhin du slob grwa'i sgo nas thon ste/ rdzong rgyab klung khang dang / zhol mdun thang gi kho ma gzhung brgyud shar rgyag lha sa gtsug lag khang gi lha sngo sa su yod pa'i gsung chos ra bar 'khrid/de gar mang chodags gang 'tshams 'du 'dzodams byung rjes/ thodag mar slob grwa'i zlos gar nas rmongs dad byed rgyu med pa'i gtam brjod cig 'khrab rjes dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed rgya mo krang dang / lnga da mi bkra shis tshe ring zhes pa gnyis kyis lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang rnying bzhi rtsa gtor galta nga dbo sa pa'i skor/ wa da rgya skad yig gnyis thodag nas mang che gas la dril bsgrags byed skabs de'i ring / nga'i bu rang khyim dang thag nye po yod pas mkhyodags myur lha gshesar 'char gyi gnas tshul nga la lan skyel bar slebs te/ dmar srung dmag gi lha la/tor rtsis byed kyi 'dug ces bshad/ ngas mdang dgong nga'i rmi lam du lha tshang ma nam mkhar 'phur ba'i rmi lam btang byung / da ltas bzang ba ma red/ de las bu rang za 'thung byas te mgyogs sngo phar rgyugs ma galtastegs 〈geb grwa nas gshe gshe gtang yong zhes bshad/bu khyim nas thon te/ gsung chos ra bar 'gro skabs/ rme ru rnying pa'i rgyal lha'i 'khris su sku da pa'i gtsug lag khang gi shar snyo'i nang nas rgya 156

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 157mi lo gzhon phon chen zhig phyir thon/ de nas bu mgyogs po gdong chen zur nas gsung chos ra bar 'gro skabs mi mang po zhig ngu 'bod byed bzhin bar skor nang gi tshong khang dang ja khang / za khang / de bzhin khrom ston mkhan tshang ma 'tshab 'dzub ngang khrom bsdus te/ da dpe bsags so/ ltas ngan mthong ngo zhes/ sdug bshad byed/nga'i bu'i slob grwa'i dmar srung dmag khag cig kyang bar skor nang rgyugs spebs pa dang bu gdong thug byung bas khong tshor/ da ga re byas song zhes bus dris pas/ dmar srung dmag rgya phrug khong tsho gtsug lag khang nang du lha gtor bar shor song / nga cho bar skor nang gi khang pa'i thog kha'i rtser yod pa'i dar lcog de cho bkog par btang byung zhes bshad 'duganga'i bu gsung chos ra bar spebs skabs/ gsung chos ra ba'i mdun thang du mi mang po zhig blta rub brgyab nas bsdad yod pa dang / gsung chos ra ba'i sdings cha'i rgyab ngos kyi ldebs bris tshang ma gtor tshar ba ma zad gtsug lag khang gi thog kha'i rtse la rgya mi'i dmar srung dmag dang de min gyi sgo ba phrug mang po zhig rgya phibs thog yar 'dzegs nas lha btsugs dang / gan ji ra/ ri dwags pho mo sogs mchod rdzas rnams gtor/ bu gtsug lag khang gi 'khyam rwa'i nang yar 'dzul skabs/ de gar dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug de bzhin rgya las pa/ grong mi u yon lhan khang bcas 157

ning bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 157mi lo gzhon pho na chen zhig phyir thodan/ de nas bu mkhyodags ngo gdodang chen zur nas gsung chos ra bar 'gro skabs mi mang po zhig ngu 'bod byed bzhin bar skor nang gi tshong khang dang ja khang / za khang / de bzhin khrom stodan mkhan tshang ma 'tshab 'tshub ngang kho ma bsdus te/ da dpe bsags so// ltas ngan mthong ngo zhes/ sdug bshad byed/nga'i bu'i slob grwa'i dmar srung dmag khag cig kyang bar slor nang rgyugs slebs pa dang bu gdong thug byung bas khong tshor/ da ga re byas song zhes bus dris pas/ dmar srung dmag rgya phrug khong chos gtsug lag khang nang du lha gtor bar shor song / nga tsho bar skor nang gi khang pa'i thog kha'i rtser yod pa'i dar cog de tsho bkog par btang byung zhes bshad 'duganga'i bu gsung chos ra bar slebs skabs/ gsung chos ra ba'i mdun thang du mi mang po zhig blta rub brgyab nas bsdad yod pa dang / gsung chodas ra ba'i sdings cha'i rgyab ngo sa kyi ldebs bris tshang ma gto/ra tshar ba ma zad / gtsug lag khang gi sprodag kha'i rtse la rgya mi'i dmar srung dmag dang de min/ gyi slob phrug mang sngo zhig rgya phibs lnga ga yar 'dzegs nas lha btsugs dang / gan ji ra/ ri dwags pho mo sogs mchod rdzas rnams gtor/ bu gtsug lag khang gi 'khyam ru'i nang yar 'dzul skabs/ de gar dmar srung dmag dang rnyedab phrug de bzhin rgya las pa/ cadang mi u yon lhan khang bcas 157

158 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/kyi hur bcengan pa sogs mi mang 11 zhig gis gtsug lag khang gi lha khang khag nas gtor 'gyel btang zin pa'i 'jim sku dang / mchod rdzas/ dpe cha/thang ga sogs dngos rdzas 'dra min sna tshogs dbor 'dren byed bzhin pa de sar rgya mi'i shin twa gsar khang zhes pas par len byas/sa steng du mchodad me gtor ba'i mar khus rdo gcal tshang ma tshos nas 'khyil zhing / 'gro lam tshang ma lha ro dang dpe chas khengs te phar tshur g.yol sa med par gang byung sa thodag tu g.yugs/ bus bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul de dag mthong skabs yud tsam ring / gtsug lag khang gi lha sku rten gsum tshang ma gtor tshar 'dug snyam zhing hang sangs te sdod pa'i skabs der/ lha sa'i skud yod rgyang bsgrags nang nas/ dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung tshos/ rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi las 'gul spel te jo khang gtor rgol gtong bzhin yod pa'i gnas tshul bod rgya skad yig gnyis 〈snag nas bskyar chodas yang chodas kyis bshad/dus yun ring po ma song bar/ lha sa'i nang yod pa'i rgya mi'i las khungs dang slob grwa/ sman khang / lag shes bzo grwa/ de bzhin shar phyogs/byang phyogs/ lho phyogs zhes sa khul khag bgos pa'i grong mi ༷/ sku/na lhan khang bcas kyi mang tshogs dang slob grwa/ las byed sogs mi grangs stong phrag mang sngo gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rgya gzhung gis btsan skul byas 158

158 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/kyi hur brtson pa sogs mi mang po zhig gis gtsug lag khang gi lha khang khag nas gtor 'gyel btang zin pa'i 'jim sku dang / mchod rdzas/ dpe cha/thang ga sogs dngos rdzas 'dra min sna tshogs dbor 'dren byed bzhin pa de tshor gya mi'i shin twa gsar khang zhes pas par len byas/sa steng du mchod me gtor ba'i mar khus rdo gcal tshang ma tshos nas 'khyil zhing / 'gro lam tshang ma lha ro dang dpe chas khengs te phar tshur g.yol sa med par gang byung sa bog tu g.yugs/ bus bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul de dag mthong skabs yud tsam ring / gtsug lag khang gi lha sku rten gsum tshang ma gtor tshar 'dug snyam zhing hang sangs te sdod pa'i skabs der/ lha sa'i skud yod rgyang bsgrags nang nas/ dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung tshos/ rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gye las 'gul spel te jo khang gtor rgol gtong bzhin yod pa'i gnas tshul bod rgya skad yig gnyis thog nas bskyar zlos yang zlos kyis bshad/dus yun ring po ma song bar/ lha sa'i nang yod pa'i rgya mi'i las khungs dang slob grwa/ sman khang / lag shes bzo grwa/ de bzhin shar phyogs/byang phyogs/ lto phyogs zhes sa khul khag bgos pa'i grong mi u yon lhan khang bcas kyi mang chogs dang sgob grwa/ las byed sogs mi grangs stong phrag mang po gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rgya gzhung gis btsan skul byas 158

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 159pa ltar/ rnga rdung dar 'phyar dang lag tu dmar srung dmag dpa' bo thung chung gis rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi las 'gul la rgyab skyor yod ces pa'i yig chen tshags par 'khyer te skad 'bod byed bzhin du gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'gram du 'byor rim ltar/ khong tsho'i yig chen tshags par dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed du sprad rjes/ dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug rnams rang sar phyir log byas/chabs cig gtsug lag khang nye 'khor du yod pa'i bar skor don gcod khang gi khongs gtogs bar skor dang khrom gzigs khang / rab gsal/rgyal kha lam bcas grong mi u yon lhan khang gi bde 'jags 'gan 'dzin dang hur brtson pa/ mang chogs/ de min shar phyogs dang byang phyogs khul gyi grong mi u yon lhan khang so so'i hur brtson pa dang las byed yin pa'i mi de dag mnyam 'dzoms kyis gtsug lag khang nang gtor rgol byas pa'i lha ro gtsang sel dang dpe cha mer bsregs gtong bzhin yod/skabs de thog phal cher phyi dro'i thu chod lnga pa nas drug pa tsam la / rang skyong ljongs kyi rgya mi'i dpon rigs mtho gras shig spebs te/ khos gtsug lag khang 'di rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rgyal khab kyi srung skyob byed pa'i rig gnas kyi bsti gnas dang / gna' rdzas rjes shul rtsa chen zhig yin pas/ 'di gtor chog gi ma red/ yin na'ang / dmar 159

ning bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 159pa ltar/ rnga rdung dar 'phyar dang lag tu dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung gis rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi las 'gul la rgyab skyor sku da ces pa'i yig chen tshags par 'khyer te skad 'bod byed bzhin du gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'gram du 'byor rim ltar/ khong tsho'i yig chen tshags par dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed du sprad rjes/ dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug rnams rang sar phyir 'o/ga byas/chabs cig gtsug lag khang nye 'khor du yod pa'i bar skor dodan gcadad khang gi kho ngas galta gas bar stodar dang kho ma gzigs khang / rab gsal/rgyal kha lam bcas bo nga mi ༷/ yon lhan khang gi bde 'jags 'gan 'dzin dang hur brtson pa/ mang chodags/ de min shar phyogs dang byang phyogs khul gyi gro nga mi u yon lhan khang so so'i hur brtsodan pa dang las byed yin pa'i mi de dag mnyam 'jomams kyis gtsug lag khang nang galta ra lha la byas pa'i lha ro gtsang sel dang dpe cha mer bsregs gto/nga bzhin yod/skabs de thog phal cher phyi dro'i chu tshod lnga pa nas drug pa tsam la / rang skyong ljongs kyi rgya mi'i dpon rigs mtho gras shig slebs te/ khos gtsug lag khang 'di rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rgyal khab kyi srung skyodab byed pa'i rig gnas kyi bsti gnas dang / gna' rdzas rjes shul rtsa chen zhig yin pas/ 'di ga/jo ra chodag gi ma red/ yin na'ang / dmar 159

16༷ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung dang gsar brje'i mang tshogs kyis rang 'gul ngang gtor bas byed thabs med ces bshad/mang chogs khag cig gis/ kho par de 'dra yin na/ da gin gtsug lag khang ma gtor gong la yonang nas bkag 'gog byed dgos/ da las ka tshang ma tshar dus/ skad cha 'di 'dra bshad rgyu de/ gna' bo'i gtam dper yod pa bzhin/ pha bsad pas ma tshad ri 'go dmag gis bskor/ 'brong bsad pas ma tshad rnga mas dar lcog btsugs/ ske bcad pas ma tshad rtsonag mar khrul byil btang song zhes zur za dang skyon brjod shugs che byas rkyen rgya dpon de phyi log byas/sgob phrug dang dmar srung dmag sgob grwar phyir log pa'i rjes su'ang / rgya mi'i las khungs dang / bzo grwa/ de bzhin slob grwa'i nye khor gyi zhing pa khag cig snga rjes su slob grwar yig chen tshags par bskyal bar spebs te/ mtshan nam phyed tsam bar slob grwa'i rtsed thang du rnga rdung dang skad 'bod kyis ngang nas dus tshod bskyal te/ de nas nyal khang khag tu phyir log byas te sgob phrug nang khul nyin mor byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams dran gso btang ste bgro gleng byed skabs/ gzhi nas dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug lha sa'i jo khang nang ma 'dzul sdon nas gtsug lag khang gi lha sgu rten gsum gtor zin pa dang / de dag gtor mkhan ngo ma yang rgya nag dbus gzhung 160

1snyo0 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung dang gsar brje'i mang tshogs kyis rang 'gul ngang gasnodar bas byed thabs med ces bshad/mang chortags khag cig gis/ khodzi par de 'dra yin na/ da gin gtsug lag khang ma gshester bo nga la sku nga nas bkag 'bothog byed dbothos/ da las ka tshang ma tshar dus/ skad cha 'di 'dra bshad rgyu de/ gna' bo'i gtam dper yod pa bzhin/ pha bsad pas ma tshad ri 'go dmag gis bskor/ 'dzadang bsad pas ma tshad rnga mas dar khyodag btsugs/ sge bcad pas ma tshad e ga mar byil byil btang so/nga zhes zur za dang skyon brjod shugs che byas rkyen rgya dalnga na de phyi sku ga byas/slob phrug dang dmar srung dmag slob grwar phyir log pa'i rjes su'ang / rgya mi'i las khungs dang / bzo grwa/ de bzhin slob grwa'i nye khor gyi zhing pa khag cig snga rjes su slob grwar yig chen tshags par bskyal bar slebs te/ mtshan nam phyed tsam bar slob grwa'i rtsed thang du rnga rdung dang skad 'asngo da kyis ngang nas dus cho da bskyal te/ de nas nyal khang khag tu phyir 'o/ga byas te slob phrug nang khul nyin mo ra byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams dran gso btang ste baspyod gleng byed skabs/ gzhi nas dmar srung dmag dang lho ba phrug lha sa'i jo khang nang ma 'dzul 10na nas gtsug lag khang gi lha sku rten gsum gtor zin pa dang / de dag gtor mkhan ngo ma yang rgya nag dbus gzhung 160

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 1snyo1nas cadad la btang ba'i slob ga〈sna chen skra gsum gyi las 'gul spel mkhan gyi las ro/na ru khag ces pa'i rgya'i las byed de rnams yin pa gsal sngo/ shes rtogs byung 'dugade yang / de nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod dang po tsam la/ lha sa slob 'bring gi dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug rnams lha sa'i bar skor nang gi gtsug khag khang du ma 'dzul bo nga gi chu chodad gnyis pa tsam gyi spyodan du/ skabs der lha sa grong khyer dang grong gseb khag nas phyir log byas nas yun ring ma song ba'i 〈snab gasku chen sngoge gsum gyi (su+ob gso chen po gsum ni rgyal khab kyi zhing las dang / lag shes bzo las/ ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi bzo tshong las rigs bcas gsum la spyi tsho gas ring lugs kyi bsgrur bkod byed rgyu bcas la zer )las sngaṭan ru khag rgya mi'i las byed mi grangs 300 tsam zhig gis bar lha ra bo nga mi ༷/ sku na lhan khang gi bde 'jag (kru'u ren 'gan 'dzin pa sangs dang de bzhin sa ṭhal de'i hur brtson pa gsung chos ra ba'i nye 'khris sga ru shag khang 'og lcags bzo mnyam las kyi las mi/ de snga'i rkun po khag cig ):sku ngan khag cig gis ngan pa rgyus sku da byas te gtsug lag khang gi lho 〈sna lug tshang dang / se ra ltag sgo/ shar lha / mchodad khri khang / byang sgo bcas khag gsum nas gsang thabs kyis nang 'dzul byas te/ lha khang nang gi sku rten dang mchodad me/ dpe cha/ thang ga mdzadad rdzas sna chortags yod pa tshang ma gtor ste sa la g.yugs nas/ jo bo sha kyu mu ne+e dang / rgya bza' kong rdzo/161

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gye god chag 161nas bod la btang ba'i sgob gso chen po gsum gye las 'gul spel mkhan gyi las don ru khag ces pa'i rgya'i las byed de rnams yin pa gsal po shes rtogs byung 'dugade yang / de nyin gyi phyi r+sā zu chod dang po tsam la/ lha sa sgob 'bring gi dmar srung dmag dang slob phrug rnams lha sa'i bar skor nang gi gtsug khag khang du ma 'dzul gong gi chu tshod gnyis pa tsam gye sngon du/ skabs der lha sa grong khyer dang grong gseb khag nas phyir log byas nas yun ring ma song ba'i slob gso chen po gsum gyi (slob gso chen po gsum ni rgyal khab kyi zhing las dang / lag shes bzo las/ ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi bzo tshong las rigs bcas gsum la spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsgyur bkod byed rgyu bcas la zer )las don ru khag rgya mi'i las byed mi grangs 300 tsam zhig gis bar skor grong mi u yon lhan khang gi bde 'jag (kru'u ren 'gan 'dzin pa sangs dang de bzhin sa lngal de'i tur brtson pa gsung chos ra ba'i nye 'khris sga ru shag khang 'og lcags bzo mnyam las kyi las mi/ de snga'i rkun po khag cig )mi ngan khag cig gis ngan pa rgyus yod byas te gtsug lag khang gi lto sgo lug tshang dang / se ra ltag sgo/ shar sgo/ mchod khri khang / byang sgo bcas khag gsum nas gsang thabs kyis nang 'dzul byas te/ lha khang nang gi sku rten dang mchod me/ dpe cha/ thang ga mchod rdzas sna chogs yod pa tshang ma gtor ste sa la g.yugs nas/ jo bo sha kyu mu ne dang / rgya bza' kong jo/161

162 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/srong btsan lha khang de gsum phud pa'i lha khang yod tshad gtor rjes/ rgya mi de dag yar yong sa nas mar phyir log byas/da dung go thos la gtsug lag khang ma gtor gong gi nyin shas sngon nas rang skyong ljong / dang lha grong rig gnas rnying pa bdag gnyer las khungs/zhes pa'i las byed khag cig gtsug lag khang nang du spebs te / gser/zangs/ li dmar sogs las grub pa'i rtsa chen lha sgu rten gsum dang / gzi/byu ru/ mu tig pad ma raka/ g.yu gser sogs rin chen sne mang las grub pa'i dpu rgyan dang / rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ 'tshem grub ma'i sku thang sna tshogs/ gser dngul rags sogs las grub pa'i mchod skong dang mchod ting / gzhan yang rtsa che'i dngos rigs rnying pa dkar yol dang bum pa/ stag gzig dom spyang khyi sogs kyi pags rigs/ bos chen dang rgya rum rnying pa/ sog rum dang gtsang rum sogs tshogs gdan ring thung sna tshogs bcas tshang ma tho 'god bsdu gsog brgyab nas rjes su gsang thabs kyis dbor 'dren byas pa ma zad/ ca dngos de dag nang nas mang po zhig rgya'i las byed tshos lkog nyar byas yod pa rjes la rgya mi kho rang tsho nang khul phan tshun zer 'don byed res byed skabs/ bod kyi dgon sde khag gi rtsa che'i ca dngos lkog nyar byas pa'i gnas tshul rim par thon/de'i skor dpe mtshon tsam zhus na lha sa grong sde las khungs khreng 162

162 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/srong btsan lha khang de gsum phud pa'i lha khang yod tshad gtor rjes/ rgya mi de dag yar yong sa nas mar phyir 'e ga byas/da dung go thodas la gtsug lag khang ma gtor go nga gi nyin shas sngon nas rang skyong jongs/ dang lha grong rig gnas rnying pa bdag gnyer las khungs/zhes pa'i las byed khag cig gtsug lag khang nang du slebs te / gser/zangs/ li dmar sku gas las grub pa'i rtsa chen lha sku rten gsum dang / gzi/byu ru/ mu tig pad ma raka/ g.yu gser sogs rin chen sne mang las grub pa'i dpu rgyan dang / rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ 'tshem grub ma'i sku thang sna tshogs/ gser dngul rags sogs las grub pa'i mchod skong dang mchod ting / gzhan yang rtsa che'i dngos rigs rnying pa dkar yol dang bum pa/ stag gzig dom spyang khyi mo gas kyi pags rigs/ so/sa chen dang rgya rum rnying pa/ sog rum dang gtsang rum sogs tshogs gdan ring thung sna tshogs bcas tshang ma thod 'go da bsdu gse ga brgyab nas rjes su gsang thabs kyis dawa ra 'dren byas pa ma zad/ ca dngo sa de dag nang nas mang wa zhig rgya'i las byed tsho sa lkog nyar byas yod pa rjes la rgya mi kho rang tsho nang khul phan tshun ther 'don byed res byed skabs/ bod kyi dgon sde khag gi rtsa che'i ca dngos lkog nyar byas pa'i gnas tshul rim par thon/de'i skor dpe mtsho na tsam zhus na lha sa spyodang sde las khungs khreng 162

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 1snyozhakon chus kyi li phang dru'u ci zhes pa'i rgya dpon kho bod nas rgya nag tu gnas khra sa 'gro skabs/ kho pa'i ca dngos phal che ba lha sku rten gsum dang stag gzig dodam spyang gi pags pa/ rin chen sna chosags las grub pa'i rgyan cha mang po shing sgam che chung sna cho gas nang glugs te rgya nag tu dnge ra 'dren byed skabs/ si kho na zhing chen gyi mtha' mtshams khral sa'i las khungs nas ca dalnga sa de dag gzhung bzhes btang ba dang / chabs cig kho par gzhung gi rgyu nor lto ga zos byas pa'i nyes ming btsugs te bkag nyar byas stodar skabs der lha sa'i nang rgya grags wa da grags byas nas mi tshang mas shes rtogs byung yod/dmar srung dmag gis lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du tshabs che'i gtor bshig byas pa'i nyin de nas 'go tshugs/ lha sa'i grong mi lhan khang so so'i las byed dang hur brtson pas gtso bo byas te/ de snga 1959 lo dang / de nas 19snyo4 dang 1965 'o/ra slob gso chen lnga gsum gyi las 'gul tshugs skabs/ dbo na khag che chung mang lnga zhig galta ra zin sku da pa nas gto/ra rgyu lhag pa ra mo che gtsug lag khang / nor gling pho brang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyis gasgu sa dbo na pa grwa tshang yod tshad dang / lha khang mchodad rten/ ma ṇi rdo phung sogs tshang ma gtor bshig dang mer bsregs btang ba dang dus mnyam/ nge da kyi yul ming dang kho ma gzhung / lam bar 163

rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 163kon thus kyi li phang tru'u ci zhes pa'i rgya dpon kho bod nas rgya nag tu gnas sgos 'gro skabs/ kho pa'i ca dngos phal che ba lha sku rten gsum dang stag gzig dom spyang gi pags pa/ rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i rgyan cha mang po shing sgam che zung sna tshogs nang blugs te rgya nag tu dbor 'dren byed skabs/ si khron zhing chen gyi mtha' mtshams khral sa'i las khungs nas ca dngos de dag gzhung bzhes btang ba dang / chabs cig kho par gzhung gi rgyu nor lkog zos byas pa'i nyes ming btsugs te bkag nyar byas skor skabs der lha sa'i nang rgya grags bod grags byas nas mi tshang mas shes rtogs byung yod/dmar srung dmag gis lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du tshabs che'i gtor bshig byas pa'i nyin de nas 'go tshugs/ lha sa'i grong mi lhan khang so so'i las byed dang hur brtson pas gco bo byas te/ de snga 1959 lo dang / de nas 1964 dang 1965 lor sgob gso chen po gsum gyi las 'gul tshugs skabs/ dgon khag che zung mang po zhig gtor zin yod pa nas gtor rgyu lhag pa ra mo che gtsug lag khang / nor gling pho brang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyis gtsos dgon pa grwa tshang yod tshad dang / lha khang mchod rten/ ma ṇi rdo phung sogs tshang ma gtor bshig dang mer bsregs btang ba dang dus mnyam/ bod kyi yul ming dang khrom gzhung / lam bar 163

164 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/sogs la'ang mi mang lam dang gsar 'dzugs thang chen/ rgyal kha grong mi lhan khang / yar langs grong tsho/ mi dmangs spyi gling zhes sogs rgya ming btags par ma zad/ tha na bod mi'i ming la'ang / ma'o dbus/ khren grang /li cun zer ba sogs rgya ming btags/bod yig 'bri skabs kyang bod kyi brda sgod kyi sgol rtsa gtor btang ste phrad dang dag cha sogs med par kha nas gang thon bris pa dang / bod yig nang du rgya yig gi rtags sna tshogs bed spyod byas pa/ bod mi'i goms gshis kyi tshab tu rgya mi'i goms gshis dang lugs srol byed stangs spel ba bcas bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa nas rim pas bod sa yongs la rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i las 'gul gdug rtsub can 'di dar spel byung ste/ bla ma dang dge bshes/ lha phebs mkhan gyi sku rten/ bod lugs sman pa/ mnga' bdag mnga' tshab/ zhing phyug dang 'brog bdag tha na skabs de'i rgya mi'i yar thon mi sna yin/ zhes pa'i de snga'i gzhung zhabs rnying pa rgya las su yod pa dang / gra btsun bcas tshang mar lha 'dre gdon bgegs red/ ces shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po g.yogs te rang lugs chas gos sam/ lha chas g.yogs nas khrom skor la khrid de snga rjes res mos kyis dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyi sdug gyong phog nas lus sems gnyis shar dka' sdug bzod thabs bral ba myang dgos byung zhing / skabs der lha grong 164

164 rgan mo'i ma bcetes drang gtam/sogs la'ang mi mang lam dang gsar 'dzugs thang chen/ rgyal kha gro nga mi lhan khang / yar langs grong tsho/ mi dmangs spyi gling zhes sogs rgya ming btags par ma zad/ tha na bod mi'i ming la'ang / ma'o dbus/ khren grang /li cun zer ba 〈snags rgya ming btags/bod yig 'bri skabs kyang bod kyi brda sgod kyi srol rtsa gtor btang ste phrad dang dag cha so/gas med par kha nas gang thodan bris pa dang / bod yig nang du rgya yig gi rtags sna tsho gas bed spyodad byas pa/ 〈snad mi'i bo mas gshis kyi tshab tu rgya mi'i thosnems gshis dang lugs sredal byed stangs spel ba bcas bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa nas rim pas bod sa sku ngas la rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i las 'gul gdug rtsub can 'di dar spel byung ste/ bla ma dang dge bshes/ lha phebs mkhan gyi sku rten/ wa da lugs sman pa/ mnga' bdag mnga' tshab/ zhing phyug dang 'brog bdag tha na skabs de'i rgya mi'i yar thon mi sna yin/ zhes pa'i de snga'i gzhung zhabs rnying pa rgya las su sku da pa dang / grwa btsun bcas tshang mar lha 'dre gdon bgegs red/ ces shog bu'i zhwa motho ring 〈sna gaskusgogs te rang lugs chas thosnes sam/ lha chas gasku gas nas khrom skor la khrid de snga rjes res mos kyis dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod 〈snags ming 'ahostogs sna tshosnags kyi sdug gyothong 'othog nas lus sems gnyis kar dka' sdug bzod thabs bral ba myang dgos byung zhing / skabs der lha grong 164
rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 165nang nyin ltar mi rang shi brgyab pa dang / thu la mchongs pa/ 'thab rtsod 'og shi ba sogs kyi gtam ngan rgyun chad med pa sgos rgyu yod/165
rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi god chag 1snyo5nang nyin ltar mi rang shi brgyab pa dang / chu la mchodangs pa/ 'thab rtsodad 'og shi ba sogs kyi gtam ngan rgyun chad med pa thodas rgyu sku1da/165

rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ bcu bdun/lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang /yig chen tshags par/gtsug lag khang ma gtor gong tsam gyi dgong mo zhig nga'i rmi lam la lha 'ga' zhig rta dang /'ga' zhig sprin/'ga' zhig shing rta/'ga' zhig shog bu'i rta tshon mdog sna tshogs can la bzhon te bya skyag dkar po'i ri'i phyogs nas nam mkha'i mthongs sprin gseb yal 'ahro ba rmis/chodags pa gnyid sad dus nas sems rang bzhin gyis 'khrug tshabs ho cang che/khyim mtshes spo bo thub bstan rdo rje la rmi lam dang sems 'khrug skar bshad/slothogs pa nga ja bathothol nas sdothod skabs phyi nas mi zhig gis da yin na dpe bsags song /gtsug lag khang gi rgya phibs bskasgog gi 'dug ces skad 'bod byed/ngas lam seng thog ༷ne+e 'dzegs nas bltas pas rgya phibs

rgan /de ma bcos drang gtam/bcu bdun/lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang /yig chen tshags par/gtsug lag khang ma gtor gong tsam gyi dgong mo zhig nga'i rmi lam la lha 'ga' zhig rta dang /'ga' zhig sprin/'ga' zhig shing rta/'ga' zhig shog bu'i rta tshon mdog sna tshogs can la bzhon te bya skyag dkar /de ri'i phyogs nas nam mkha'i mthongs sprin gseb yal 'gro ba rmis/zhogs pa gnyid sad dus nas sems rang bzhin gyis 'khrug tshabs ha cang che/khyim mtshes sgo bo thub bstan rdo rje la rmi lam dang sems 'khrug skor bshad/zhogs pa nga ja bkol nas sdod skabs phyi nas mi zhig gis da yin na dpe bsags song /gtsug lag khang gi rgya phibs bkog gi 'dug ces skad 'bod byed/ngas lam seng thog khar 'dzegs nas bltas pas rgya phibs 66

lha 'dre ga〈snan bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 1snyo7gtor ba dngos su mthong byung bas 'di 'dra'i ltas ngan blta ba lasaci mtho sa gcig la 'dzegs nas mdzagengs dgos min nam snyam/ nga'i khyim mtshes grwa log spo nge thub bstan rdo rje dang / grwa log zhang lags zhes pas kyang da ltas ngan mthong zhes ngus/de nas mtshan zhabs chodas 'phel dga' ba'i dge phrug yar lnga na pa de dang brag g.yab pa bud med tshes gsum lha mo/ gzhan bud med cig bcas yong nas gser bris mdo thar pa dang / 7gong sa mchog gi sku par bcas 'phrog ko sgam nang mdzadad chas 'ga' dang gzi shal bcas yod pa tshes gsum lha mos masgyu nga yang der rkub btsugs nas bkab/kla klo'i bya spyod nyin re nas tshabs cher spel te mi drag rigs kyis gtsos lha 'dre+o gdon bge+ogs la rim pas khrid pa rnams ni/ tsag gser khang ba dang zhal khang bsad nams dar rgyas la rgya chas dang / bsad dar gyi spun mched grwa 'o/ga cig la grwa chas g.yogs shing / bza' zlar gos chen gyi stod 'gag g.yodags/ sngon ka shod rda ru mgo zer ba bzhin ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma rda ru bkrol bcug nas khrid/ de mo rin po che la rtse dmar ba'i chas gasku/gas nas gsang yum dang mnyam du 'khrid/nyin zhig dgung grangs brgyad cu gya brgyad la phebs pa'i skyabs rje lha btsun rin po che na bza' grwa chas gsol nas dbu dmar ril ril 167

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 167gtor ba dngos su mthong byung bas 'di 'dra'i ltas ngan blta ba las mtho sa gcig la 'dzegs nas mchongs dgos min nam snyam/ nga'i khyim mtshes grwa log spo bo thub bstan rdo rje dang / grwa log zhang lags zhes pas kyang da ltas ngan mthong zhes ngus/de nas mtshan zhabs che sa 'phel dga' ba'i dge phrug yar thon pa de dang brag g.yab pa bud med tshes gsum lha mo/ gzhan bud med cig bcas yong nas gser bris mdo thar pa dang / 7gong sa mchog gi sgu par bcas 'phrog ko sgam nang mchod chas 'ga' dang gzi shal bcas yod pa tshes gsum lha mos mthong yang der /ba btsugs nas bkab/kla khro'i bya spyod nyin re nas tshabs cher spel te mi drag rigs kyis gcos lha 'dre gdon bgegs la rim pas khrid pa rnams ni/ tsag gser khang ba dang zhol khang bsod nams dar rgyas la rgya chas dang / bsod dar gye spun mched grwa log cig la gra chas g.yogs shing / bza' zlar gos chen gyi stod 'gag g.yogs/ sngon ka shod rda ru mgo zer ba bzhin ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma rda ru bkrol bcug nas khrid/ de mo rin po che la rtse dmar ba'i chas g.yonags nas gsang yum dang mnyam du 'khrid/nyin zhig dgung grangs brgyad cu gya brgyad la phebs pa'i skyabs rje lha btsun rin po che na bza' grwa chas gsol nas dbu dmar ril ril 167
