168 na mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khrom skor la khrid skabs nam mkha'i khyon yongs su rlung 'tshub drag tu langs/ rin po che zhed snang ye med par zhal 'dzum bzhin phebs/ mtha' la thag pa btang nas 'thab 'dzing gtong sa med pa bzos/ nyin rjes ma de yang nam mkhar thal rlung drag tu 'dzub pas mi rnams kyis lha btsun rin po che dgongs pa zhing khams gzhan la gtad rgyur tshod dpag byed pa bzhin dgongs pa rdzogs/nyin zhig nga'i ngo shes don grub sgol mas nga la gsang ba chen pos nyag re khri sprul gyis bcol ba'i me mda' go skyor nang sbas yod ces bshad byung / don der ngas yag nyes lan ma btab par lus pas rjes su don grub sgol mas bod kyi shog dngul mer sreg skabs me mda' mi gzhan gyis mthong rkyen/ nyag re khri sprul bsdams nas nga tsho tshogs 'dur 'khrid yong skabs brag g.yab pa gsol dpon zhig yod pa de dor ma'i nang gcin pa shor/ de nas nyag ri khri sprul phreng ring btson khang la bcug pa dang de rjes grwa bzhir bskyal yang rjes su ci byas mi shes par gar song cha med gyur/lo gsar tshes gcig gi nyin zhig nga'i bu mo g.yang 'dzoms rgyugs nas spebs te a ma shog dang zer/ ga re byas song ngam/ brjod bzhin blta bar phyin pas sku zhabs mkhan zur rin po che lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog gi phyag tu chogs shing bkrol gang dang spos bskur nas 168

1snyo8 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khrom skor la khrid skabs nam mkha'i khyon yongs su rlung 'tshub drag tu langs/ rin wa che zhed snang ye med par zhal 'dzum bzhin phebs/ mtha' la thag pa btang nas 'thab 'dzing gtong sa med pa bzos/ nyin rjes ma de yang nam mkhar thal rlung drag tu 'tshub pas mi rnams kyis lha btsun rin po che dgo ngas pa zhing khams gzhan la gtad rgyur tsho da dpag byed pa bzhin dgo ngas pa sgyu gas/nyin zhig nga'i lnga shes dze na grub sgrol mas nga la gsang ba chen sngages nyag re khri sprul gyis bakhyodal ba'i me mda' sga skyodar nang sbas mo da ces bshad byung / dodan der ngas yag nyes lan ma btab par lus pas rjes su dodan gyub sgre la mas wa da kyi cadag dngul mer sreg skabs me mda' mi gzhan gyis mthodang rkyen/ nyag re khri sprul bsdams nas nga tsho'i snu gas 'dur 'khrid yodang skabs brag g.yab pa gsol dpon zhig yodad pa de dor ma'i nang gcin pa shor/ de nas nyag ri khri sprul phreng ring btson khang la bcug pa dang de rjes grwa bzhir bskyal yang rjes su ci byas mi shes par gar song cha med gyur/lo gsar tshes gcig gi nyin zhig nga'i bu mo g.yang 'dzoms rgyugs nas slebs te a ma shodag dang zer/ ga re byas song ngam/ bajo da bzhin blta bar phyin pas sku zhabs mkhan zur rin wa che lhan grub thabs mkhas mdzageg gi phyag tu ce gas shing bgrongal gang dang spos bskur nas 168

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 169'khrid/ yang de rjes shig sku zhabs slo bzang dga' ba'i phyag tu mchod me dang phyogs gcig la glud yod pa'i shing bkrol zhig bskur nas khrid/rang btsan a ma tshe ring lha mor mchod me kong cig dang mar gro ril cig bskur nas 'khrid/nyin zhig gus mo khyim du 'bras spungs rgan lam rim rin po ches gnang ba'i dpe cha zhig slog bzhin pa'i skabs skor bskyod pa yong ngas lam seng dpe cha sgam nang blugs kyang sems 'tshab pas thag pa phyi la 'dzar te mabong yang nyen rtog pa stod pa bstan 'dzin rdo rjes sdod mkhas ma byas na/ gyong rag gi red ces bshad de bud/sa gas pa snga po zhig sku zhabs sog 11 lhun grub tshogs gnyis lha 'dre gdon bgegs la 'khrid pa de nas zhabs phyi sog po des bla mas gsol zas mi mchod pa dang / rin po che nang du bzhugs te phyi nas sgo lcags brgyab dgos pa/ rin po che grongs rjes sde mig u yon lhan khang la sgod dgos mngags byung zhes zer/ bud med kru'u rin bkra shis sgol mas gal che mdog la de 'dra shi gi yod na zhes bshad/ sang nyin zhogs pa zhabs khru sog po des bla ma grongs nas tsog tsog bzhugs 'dug sde mig u yon lhan bang la bskyal bar 'gro gi yin zhes thon/'bras spungs bde yangs shar pa'i chos 'phel dga' bar 'thab 169

lha 'dre galnga na bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 1snyo9'khrid/ yang de rjes shig sku zhabs slo bzang dga' ba'i phyag tu mchod me dang phyogs gcig la glud yod pa'i shing bgro la zhig bskur nas khrid/rang btsan a ma tshe ring lha mor mchod me kong cig dang mar gro ril cig bskur nas 'khrid/nyin zhig gus mo khyim du 'bras spungs rgan lam rim rin po ches gnang ba'i dpe cha zhig klog bzhin pa'i skabs skor bskyod pa yong ngas lam seng dpe cha sgam nang blugs kyang sems 'tshab pas thag pa phyi la 'dzar te mthong yang nyen rtog pa stod pa bstan 'dzin rdo rjes sdod mkhas ma byas na/ gyong rag gi red ces bshad de bud/zlosgogs pa snga 11 zhig sku zhabs skusteg 11 lhun grub chosags gnyis lha 'dre garo/na bgegs la 'khrid pa de nas zhabs phyi 〈snag sgyu des bla mas gasku la zas mi mchod pa dang / rin po che nang du bzhugs te phyi nas sgo lcags brgyab dgos pa/ rin po che hrongs rjes lde mig u yodan lhan khang la sprod dgos mngags byung zhes zer/ bud med kru'u rin bkra shis sgrol mas gal che mawa ga la de 'dra shi gi mo da na zhes bshad/ sang nyin zlosgogs pa zhabs phyi sostog wa des bla ma 1stongs nas tho ga cesag bzhugs 'dug lde mig u sku na lhan kha/ nga la bskyalacibar 'a1ste gi yin zhes thosnen/'bras spungs bde yangs shar pa'i chos 'phel dga' bar 'thab 169

170 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/'dzing gtong skabs khong gi dge hrug rig 'dzin bkra shis ther 'don byed bcug dge phrug des spyi 'o/ 1959 zla 3 chos 'phel dga' bas nga khrid de nor gling shar sgo dang byang sgo lho sgo bcas su 'pho ba brgyab kyi yod/ces mi ro tshang ma'i mgo la gcig byugs sku zhes bshad/ chogs 'phel dga' ba lags kyis nga bla ma dang mtshan zhabs pa'i tshul yin pas sems can la phan na bsams te de ltar byas pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ rgya las kyis khyed lo gsar la gung khran tang gi rjes su glud btang tshul dang / tā la'i bla ma ro langs brgyag pa'i re ba yod dam/ zhes dris/ kho nga gis h+phud btang pa 'dra po red/ dus shig la twa la'i bla ma ro langs brgyag pa'i re ba yodad/ ces bla mas 'jigs zhum med pa'i lan gnang bas mi tshang ma zhed kyang de rjes chos 'phel dga' ba lags su 'thab 'dzing btang ma song /lhun grub thabs mkhas mchodag la 'thab 'dzing btang ste ngo sa len zhu skabs khe nga gis nga 'o/ bdun nas grwa pa byas te dge bshes btang zhing /byes kyi mkhan wa ra bskos/ lha sar dmag 'khrug skabs 7skyabs mgon rin po ches nga bod du sdod gsungs pas ma bris par bsdad pa yin gsungs/lhun grub thabs mkhas mchodag 7bo nga sa mchodag dang thugs 'dris che tshul gyis lha 'dre gdodan bgegs la thengs gsum tsam 'khrid/ mkhan zur lhun grub thabs mkhas mchogag la 'thab 'dzing btang tshar rjes nga tsho'i sa khul gyi 170

170 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/'dzing gtong skabs khong gi dge phrug rig 'dzin bkra shis zer 'don byed bcug dge phrug des spyi lo 1959 zla 3 chos 'phel dga' bas nga khrid de nor gling shar sgo dang byang sgo lho sgo bcas su 'pho ba brgyab kyi yod/ces mi ro tshang ma'i mgo la gcig byugs so zhes bshad/ chos 'phel dga' ba lags kyis nga bla ma dang mtshan zhabs pa'i tshul yin pas sems can la phan na bsams te de ltar byas pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ rgya las kyis khyed lo gsar la gung khran tang gi rjes su glud btang tshul dang / tā la'i bla ma ro langs brgyag pa'i re ba yod dam/ zhes dris/ khong gis glud btang pa 'dra po red/ dus shig la tā la'i bla ma ro langs brgyag pa'i re ba yod/ ces bla mas 'jigs zhum med pa'i lan gnang bas mi tshang ma zhed kyang de rjes chos 'phel dga' ba lags su 'thab 'dzing btang ma song /lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog la 'thab 'dzing btang ste ngos len zhu skabs khong gis nga lo bdun nas grwa pa byas te dge bshes btang zhing /byes kyi mkhan por bskos/ lha sar dmag 'khrug skabs 7skyabs mgon rin po ches nga bod du sdod gsungs pas ma bros par bsdad pa yin gsungs/lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog 7gong sa mchog dang thugs 'dris che tshul gyes lha 'dre gdon bgegs la zengs gsum tsam 'khrid/ mkhan zur ldun grub thabs mkhas mchog la 'thab 'dzing btang tshar rjes nga tsho'i sa khul gyi 170

lha 'dre gathe na bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 171hru'u chi bstan pas blta rtogs bde ched kho rang gi sgo ra'i nang bzhag gi yin zhes/ byang ṇ+ḍi gas skal gdong nas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i nang spos bcug khang nga thog sa gnyis ldan gyi thog kha'i shar du tru'u chi bstan pa dang / nub tu mdo sbug gnyis can nyi ma bsten sa shin tu skyid pa zhig tu mkhan zur rin po che lhun grub thabs mkhas mchodag dang / gasdudal dpon byams pa bstan 'dzin bzhugs bcug ste don dngos mkhan zur rin po cher srung skyob dpe med zhus/skabs der lha sar mi ma thub khyi la rdo zhus zhes pa'i dpe ltar ma'o yi par chag grum bakhrodas te dbyugs pa sku gas byed mkhan grangs med yod/gamo la dpon byams pa bstan 'dzin dang nga gnyis kyis kyang ma'o yi lcags par chen wa zhig rdos brdungs te them pa'i so/ga sa brus te sbas/ de mkhan zur rin po ches mkhyen te byams bstan lags la bka' bkyon dang sbrag khosna pa'i bsod nams kyi las ljo gas med pas de ltar mi rung / zhes mtshan mo sa 'og nas par bton bcug byang phyogs grong lhan dang pos ru sgreng rin po che zla ba gnyis tsam khrom sgor la khrid de 'thab 'dzing btang nas phyag ya gcig bcag pa red/ de nas gsang yib bsgu na khang la zla ba bzhi tsam bcug 'phags pa lha yang lo gcig ring mgo la shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po zhig gyon/ lag tu mkhar rnga zhig rdung zhing / nga lha 'dre gdo/na bgigs 171

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 171hru'u chi bstan pas blta rtogs bde ched kho rang gi sgo ra'i nang bzhag gi yin zhes/ byang phyogs skal gdong nas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i nang spos bcug khang pa thog sa gnyis ldan gye thog kha'i shar du tru'u chi bstan pa dang / nub tu mdo sbug gnyis can nyi ma bsten sa shin tu skyid pa zhig tu mkhan zur rin po che lhun grub thabs mkhas mchog dang / gsol dpon byams pa bstan 'dzin bzhugs bcug ste don dngos mkhan zur rin po cher srung skyob dpe med zhus/skabs der lha sar mi ma thub khyi la rdo zhus zhes pa'i dpe ltar ma'o yi par chag grum bzos te dbyugs pa sogs byed mkhan grangs med yod/gsol dpon byams pa bstan 'dzin dang nga gnyis kyis kyang ma'o yi lcags par chen po zhig rdos brdungs te zem pa'i 'og sa brus te sbas/ de mkhan zur rin po ches mkhyen te byams bstan lags la bka' bkyon dang sbrag kho pa'i bsod nams kyi las rdzogs med pas de ltar mi rung / zhes mtshan mo sa 'og nas ba ra bton bcug byang phyogs grong lhan dang pos rwa sgreng rin po che zla ba gnyis tsam khrom sgor la khrid de 'thab 'dzing btang nas phyag ya gcig bcag pa red/ de nas gsang yib bcesan khang la zla ba bzhi tsam bcug 'phags pa lha yang lo gcig ring mgo la shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po zhig gyon/ lag tu mkhar rnga zhig rdung zhing / nga lha 'dre gdon bgegs 171

)72 rgan mo re ma bsgu sa drang gtam/yin zer khrom skor la rtag tu 'bo dgo sa byung sku da/skabs der/ lha ma mda' stobs rgyal kyi nang nas sa skya'i lha morware 'bag dang na bza' lnga na par brten ྅gebs rgyal la lha morware 'bag g.yogs/lag tu zhags pa btags/ mgo phrager snartog zhwa gasku gas nas kho ma skor du khrid rjes gsung chos ru bar mang— mogs bsnyadangs nas 'thab 'dzings btang ngo //lha nga mi phal par yang de mtshungs dka' sdug chen wa myang dgos byung ba dper na/ lha sa'i bar skor rme ru rnying pa grong lhan rjes su gsar 'dzugs hrong mi lhan khang zhes pa'i khongs sga ru shar nang sdod/ pha chodas 'dzin rig 'dzin rdo rje bza' tshor ra stod khri chung gi dngos po bcol bzhag khongs me mda' yod tshul bsnyad 'asnga gas kyis 'jigs skul la mi bajo da par phrug gu bu rgan pa nga'i bu mnyam lha sa slob 'bring du 'dzin grwa gcig nang yod pa phud/ bza' tsho gnyis dang phrug gu gsum bcas drung spyi gling kha'i rag zur nas chu la mchongs shing phrug gu chung shos 'o/ drug la slebs pa de pha'i 'jing par 'tham nas/ pha'i phung po dang mnyam du ngu 'bod kyis chus 'khyer nas 'gro skabs nor gling thod kyi chu'i nang nas hrong mis bton te bu de da lta yang gcen po mnyam bsdad yod/skabs der gcen wa ra khyim tshang nang dka' ngal chen sngo sprad stabs 172

)72 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/yin zer khrom skor la rtag tu 'gro dgos byung yod/skabs der/ spom mda' stobs rgyal kyi nang nas sa skya'i lha mo 'bag dang na bza' sgon par brten stobs rgyal la lha mo 'bag g.yogs/lag tu zhags pa btags/ mgo bor shog zhwa g.yogs nas khrom skor du khrid rjes gsung chos rwa bar mang tshogs bskongs nas 'thab 'dzings btang ngo //grong mi phal par yang de mtshungs dka' sdug chen po myang dgos byung ba dper na/ lha sa'i bar skor rme ru rnying pa grong lhan rjes su gsar 'dzugs grong mi lhan khang zhes pa'i khongs sga ru shar nang sdod/ pha chos 'dzin rig 'dzin rdo rje bza' tshor ra stod khri zung gi dngos po bcol bzhag khongs me mda' yod tshul bsnyad 'dogs kyis 'jigs skul la mi bzod par phrug gu bu rgan pa nga'i bu mnyam lha sa slob 'bring du 'dzin gra gcig nang yod pa phud/ bza' sto gnyis dang phrug gu gsum bcas drung spyi gling kha'i rag zur nas chu la mchongs shing phrug gu chung shos lo drug la spebs pa de pha'i 'jing par 'tham nas/ pha'i phung po dang mnyam du ngu 'bod kyis zus 'khyer nas 'gro skabs nor gling thod kyi zu'i nang nas grong mis bton te bu de da lta yang gcen po mnyam bsdad yod/skabs der gcen por khyim tshang nang dka' ngal chen po sprad stabs 172

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 173sgob gra nas sgon te sa khul gyi las ka tsag tsig byas nas ya nga ba'i spun gnyis 'cho thabs byas skor nga'i bus khong thug par 'gro dus bshad 'dugayang nga tsho khrom gzigs khang grong mi lhan khang khongs gtogs bde chen rab brtan nang yin pa'i dbul phongs a cag mtshams gcod ces pa la/ phrug gu bu gnyis dang bu mo gcig yod pa der sa khul gye bde 'jags 'go khrid dang bzo 'tshong khru'u zhes pa'i rgya las pas kho mos mgo bde glags 'tshong gis g.yu byur gyi tshong brgyab tshul bsnyad de/ sdigs skul tsha drag btang ba'i 'jigs snang 'og a cag mtshams gcod kyi bu mo lo 12 byas pa 'khrid de gar song med pa brlags te zla ba gcig song mtshams/ 'bras spungs dgon pa'i kha thug lha sa'i dkyil chu'i zu lhag gcig tu lcebs nas phung po rnyed skor lha sa'i nang yongs grags byung yod/lha sa bar skor dga' gro shar nang sdod gnas zung sku bsten gyi gcen mo'i mag pa bkra shis don grub la sngon du rgya'i bcon khang nas slod bkrol btang yod rung / rig gsar skabs yang bskyar khong la grong mi lhan khang nas nyin mang por bsnyad med bsnyad 'dogs kyis nyin mang por dri ba blangs pa dang / mang tshogs nang 'thab 'dzings drag po btang rkyen las gar 'gro ma thub pa 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal dang / de'i thog nyin mang por 'thab 'dzings kyi sdug bsngal ma bzod par dgong mo zhig kho rang gi nang la ske 173

lha 'dre garo/na bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 173slob gra nas thodan te sa khul gyi las ka tsag tsig byas nas ya nga ba'i spun gnyis 'chod thabs byas skor nga'i bus khong thug par 'gro dus bshad 'dugayang nga chod kho ma gzigs khang grong mi lhan khang khongs gtogs bde chen rab brtan nang yin pa'i dbul 'o/ngas a cag mtshams gsu da ces pa la/ phrug gu bu gnyis dang bu mo gcig yod pa der sa khul gyi bde 'jags 'go khrid dang bakhrod 'cho nga khru'u zhes pa'i rgya las pas kho mo sa mgo bde glags 'chodang gis g.yu byur gyi tsho nga brgyab tshul bsnyad de/ sdigs skul tsha drag btang ba'i 'jigs snang cadag a cag mtshams gce da kyi bu mo 'o/ 12 byas pa 'khrid de gar 〈snang med pa brlags te zla ba gcig song mtshams/ 'bras spungs dgon pa'i kha thug lha sa'i dkyil chu'i chu lhag gcig tu lcebs nas phung po rnyed skor lha sa'i nang yongs grags byung yod/lha sa bar skor dga' gro shar nang sdod gnas chung sku bsten gyi gcen mo'i mag pa bkra shis dodan grub la sngon du rgya'i bsgu na khang nas sgru da bkrol btang yod rung / rig gsar skabs yang bskyar khong la grong mi lhan khang nas nyin mang por bsnyad med bsnyad 'dogs kyis nyin mang sngo ra dri ba blangs pa dang / mang chodags nang 'thab 'dzings drag po btang rkyen las kar 'gro ma thub pa 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal dang / de'i thog nyin mang por 'thab 'dzings kyi sdug bsngal ma bzod par dgong mo zhig kho rang gi nang la spe 173

174 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bsdams nas rang shi rgyag dargodas byung ba sogs/ gang ltar 'o/ de'i nang rgya las pa'i sdug sbyong mnar gcod 'og chu la mchongs mkhan dang rang shi rgyag mkhan mang po byung sku da/de'i skabs/ nged ma bu gsum 'tsho ba ha cang skyel dka' bas ngas u sku na lhan khang la zhe ga go ga bce nga chodag pa'i snyan seng zhus te zlo ga go ga bsgu nga pas khe phan dang / dus rgyun lnga shes dang 'brel ba byed mi chog pas zlo ga gog snyad tshul 'brel ba byas na ha cang legs/ chodag bo ga bce nga nas zla ba gsum tsam 'bo ba'i nyin zhig zhabs bajosgo ba chen mo'i bkra shis dodan grub kyi a ma lags thug kho nga gis nga la rgan mo dpe 'dzin dodan gyi yod dam zer (sngon rgan mo dpe 'dzin zhes pa 'gyor ldan yin yang gsang ba nyul ched skud pa btsong nas sdod mkhan zhig la brdzod/) zla ba gcig gi rjes nga ༷/ sku1na lhan khang la skad btang ste zhog gog btsong dus mi su dang 'brel ba byed kyi yod dam/ khyed rang gung khran tang la khyad gsod ched zhog gog btsong pa las don dngos dbul wa min/ gral rim pa rnams khyed kyi zlo ga go ga za bar yong gi 'dug pas de ring nas zhog gog btsong mi chodag ngas su gcig dang yang 'brel ba byed kyi med ces lan btab ste da dung yang nyin nyi shu tsam btsong / nyin zhig bajo tsho nga las khungs kyi mi yodang ste zhog gog batho nga mi chodag pa dang tshong khang mu mthud sgo phye brdzod kyang tshong zog med pas las ka tsag tsig byas/174

17༄ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bsdams nas rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba sogs/ gang ltar lo de'i nang rgya las pa'i sdug spyong mnar gcod 'og thu la mchongs mkhan dang rang shi rgyag mkhan mang po byung yod/de'i skabs/ nged ma bu gsum 'tsho ba ha cang skyel dka' bas ngas u yon lhan khang la zhog gog bcong chog pa'i snyan seng zhus te zhog gog bcong pas khe phan dang / dus rgyun ngo shes dang 'brel ba byed mi chog pas zhog gog nyo tshul 'brel ba byas na ha cang legs/ zhog gog btsong nas zla ba gsum tsam 'gro ba'i nyin zhig zhabs bzo ba chen mo bkra shis don grub kyi a ma lags thug khong gis nga la rgan mo dpe 'dzin don gyi yod dam zer (sdon rgan mo dpe 'dzin zhes pa 'byor ldan yin yang gsang ba nyul ched skud pa btsong nas sdod mkhan zhig la brjod/) zla ba gcig gi rjes nga u yon lhan khang la skad btang ste zhog gog bcong dus mi su dang 'brel ba byed kyi yod dam/ khyed rang gung khran tang la khyad gsod ched zhog gog btsong pa las don dngos dbul po min/ gral rim pa rnams khyed kyi zhog gog za bar yong gi 'dug pas de ring nas zhog gog bcong mi chog ngas su gcig dang yang 'brel ba byed kyi med ces lan btab ste da dung yang nyin nyi shu tsam bcong / nyin zhig bzo tshong las khungs kyi mi yong ste zhog gog btsong mi chog pa dang tshong khang mu mthud sgo phye brdzod kyang tshong zog med pas las ka tsag tsig byas/174

lha 'dre gdodan bgegs dang yig chen tshagab/ par/ 175dgong mo rtag tu tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos pa dang / zla rer tshad bsdur zhes ming la mang tshogs kyis nga tshor rogs ram byed khul yang / don du 'thab 'dzings dang dgag pa brgyab pa dang len byed dgos pa phud/ de byings dus chod mang che ba nga tsho nang khul phan tshun skyon brjod dang slob spyong byas te sdod dgos/de'i ring spyi tshogs nang gung khran tang nang khul dbang cha'i 'thab rtsod kyi mgo 'khor nas yod dus nga tsho'i thog phran bu'i blos g.yeng tshul du gnas stabs/ yang bskyar 'thab rtsod dang bsun 'tsher bzo mkhan ma byung bar yud tsam ngal gso tshul du lhag spyi tshogs thog rig gsar mu mthud rgya che gting zab tu 'gro yi yod pa nga tshos shes rtogs dka' yang /nga'i bu mu mthud slob gra'i nang rig gsar gyi las 'gul nang 'dzul zhugs byas yod pas/ rig gsar skor kyi gnas tshul nang la yong dus nga la gsal po bshad kyi yod/de yang / rnying gtor gsar 'dzugs zhes pa'i las 'gul spel nas phal cher zla ba gcig tsam phyin pa'i rjes su rgya nag pe cing du ma'o tse tung gis gnam bde sgo mo thang chen du dmar srung dmag khri phrag mang por mjal 'phrad jengs kha shas byas pa dang chabs cig gung khran tang nang dang / srid gzhung bi nang / dmag dpung gi nang du g.yo 'dzu'/ byas pa'i 175

lha 'dre gasngagan bgegs dang yig chen tshagasdo/ par/ 175dgong mo rtag tu hrūgs 'dur 'gro dgos pa dang / zla rer tshad bsdur zhes ming la mang tshogs kyis nga tshor rogs ram byed khul yang / don du 'thab 'dzings dang dgag pa brgyab pa dang len byed dgos pa phud/ de byings dus tshod mang che ba nga tsho nang khul phan tshun skyon brjod dang slob spyong byas te sdod dgos/de'i ring spyi tshogs nang gung khran tang nang khul dbang cha'i 'thab rtsod kyi mgo 'khor nas yod dus nga tsho'i thog phran bu'i blos g.yeng tshul du gnas stabs/ yang bskyar 'thab rtsod dang bsun 'tsher bzo mkhan ma byung bar yud tsam ngal gso'i tshul du lhag spyi tshogs thog rig gsar mu mthud rgya che gting zab tu 'asku yi yod pa nga tshos shes rtogs dka' yang /nga'i bu mu mthud slob gra'i nang rig gsar gyi las 'gul nang 'dzul zhugs byas yod pas/ rig gsar skor gyi gnas tshul nang la yong dus nga la gsal po bshad kyi yod/de yang / rnying gtor gsar 'dzugs zhes pa'i las 'gul spel nas phal cher zla ba gcig tsam phyin pa'i rjes su rgya nag pe cing du ma'o tse tung rgis gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen du dmar srung dmag khri phrag mang por mjal 'phrad thengs kha shas byas pa dang chabs cig gung khran tang nang dang / srid gzhung bi/ nang / dmag dpung gi nang du g.yo 'dzulī/ byas pa'i 175

176 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan tang nang gi dbang 'dzin pa phyir zer 'don byas te rig gnas gsar brje mthar phyin pa byed dgos zhes bshad par brten/ pe cing du yod pa'i dmar srung dmag dang rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi slob grwa khag gi dmar srung dmag khri phrag mang po rig gsar gyi las 'gul khyab spel gtong ched/ rgya nag sa khul gang sar rdzing bu rdol ba ltar 'gro 'go tshugs/bod nang du'ang de sngon spebs pa'i rgya nag gi dmar srung dmag brgya skor zhig yod pa de dag bod kyi lto kha dang / gzhis ka rtse/ nag zu/ chab mdo sogs sa khul khag tu bskyod ma thag tu rgya nag zhing chen gang sa nas dmar srung dmas stong phrag mang po bod du 'byor zhing / bod nang yod pa'i dmar srung dmag gi 'go byed gtso bo'i gras brgya sgor zhig kyang lha sa nas rgya nag pe cing bar gom bgrod yin/ zhes lha sa nas thon pa dang / nyin shas shig gom bgrod byas rjes mo ṭa'i nang phyin pa yin zhes mjug tu khong zo bod la phyir log byas rjes nga'i bu sogs la bshad/skabs de dus bod rang spyong ljongs kyi tang ud dang mi mang srid gzhung gi gtsos las khungs che zung tshang ma'i nang dmar srung dmag dang /las byed pa/ mang tshogs bcas nas khungs so so 'go khrid las byed tshor skyon brjod byed pa'i yig chen tshags par stong phrag mang po bris te las 176

176 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan tang nang gi dbang 'dzin pa phyir ther 'don byas te rig gnas gsar brje mthar phyin pa byed dgos zhes bshad par brten/ pe cing du sku/da pa'i dmar srung dmag dang rgya nag rgyal sku ngas kyi slob grwa khag gi dmar srung dmag khri phrag mang lnga rig gsar gyi las 'gul khyab spel gto/nga ched/ rgya nag sa khul gang sar rdzing bu rdo la ba ltar 'bo 'bo tshugs/bod nang du'ang de sngon slebs pa'i rgya nag gi dmar srung dmag brgya skor zhig sku da pa de dag bod kyi lho kha dang / gzhis ka rtse/ nag chu/ chab mnge sogs sa khul khag tu bskyedad ma thag tu rgya nag zhing chen gang sa nas dmar srung dmas/ stong phrag mang po bod du 'gyor zhing / bod nang yod pa'i dmar srung dmag gi 'bo byed gce bo'i gras brgya skor zhig kyang lha sa nas rgya nag pe cing bar bo ma baX da yin/ zhes lha sa nas the na pa dang / nyin shas shig bogem bsku da byas rjes mo ṭa'i nang phyin pa yin zhes mjug tu khong tsho bod la phyir log byas rjes nga'i bu sogs la bshad/skabs de dus ṅgad rang skyong ljongs kyi tang ud dang mi mang srid gzhung gi gce sa las khungs che chung tshang ma'i nang dmar srung dmag dang /las byed pa/ mang tsho gas bcas nas khungs so/ so'i 'bo khrid las byed chodar skyon bajo da byed pa'i yig chen tshags par stong phrag mang wa bris te las 176

lha 'dre gathe na bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 177khungs phyi nang dang / lho 'gram/ khrom gzhung / tha na las shag dang / gsang spyod bcas kyi gyang ngos brtsigs pa'i steng sbyar yod par brten/ rang skyong ljongs kyi rig gsar 'go khrid snu gas chung gis cadab phrug las med khag cig yod pa skad btang ste/ yig chen tshags par nang mang chodags kyi bsam 'char gang yong/ pa deb chung nang dodan tshan khag mang du dbye nas bsdus/yig chen tshags par gyi nang dodan phal che ba ni/ las khungs khag gis 'bosto khrid cesas nam rgyun las ka bkod sgrig dang / gnas spar gnas spos/ 'tsho bar blta skyodang byed stangs 'grig min gyi skyodan brjod dang / phal che ba rang nyid mi dga' ba'i skyon brjod tsam las/ srid don dang 'brel ba'i nag nyes chen po btsugs pa'i gnad don nyung ngu red/de dag sbyar 'grems byas rjes las khungs khag nang mang chosags kyi bathod gleng chen wasta zhes pa'i chosags 'du che chung sna cho gas shig bskongs nas la/sa khungs so so'i 'bo khrid tsho ra mang tsho gas kyis skyon bcadad byed bcug pa dang / skabs der 'go khrid las byed tshos mang chodags kyi skyodan brjod byas par dga' bsu zhu yi yin zhes bshad de/ tsho gas 'du'i thodag kho nga tshor skyodan brdzod gang 'dra zhig byas kyang der mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi mi 'dug la gsal bshad kyang mi byed/ de nas yun ring ma song bar las khungs mang che ba'i 'go khrid gtso bo de tsho lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang tang 177

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 177khungs khru nang dang / sgo 'gram/ khrom gzhung / tha na las shag dang / gsang spyod bcas kyi gyang ngos brtsigs pa'i steng sbyar yod par brten/ rang skyong ljongs kyi rig gsar 'go khrid tshogs chung gis slob phrug las med khag cig yod pa skad btang ste/ yig chen tshags par nang mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char gang yod pa deb khrung nang don tshan khag mang du dbye nas bsdus/yig chen tshags par gyi nang don phal che ba ni/ las khungs khag gis 'go khrid tshos nam rgyun las ka bkod sgrig dang / gnas spar gnas spos/ 'tsho bar blta skyong byed stangs 'grig min gye skyon brjod dang / phal che ba rang nyid mi dga' ba'i skyon brjod tsam las/ srid don dang 'brel ba'i nag nyes chen po btsugs pa'i gnad don nyung ngu red/de dag sbyar 'grems byas rjes las khungs khag nang mang tshogs kyi bgro gleng chen po zhes pa'i tshogs 'du che chung sna tshogs shig bskongs nas la/sa khungs so so'i 'go khrid chor mang tshogs kyis skyon brjod byed bcug pa dang / skabs der 'kho khrid las byed tshos mang chogs kyi skyon brjod byas par dga' bsu zhu yi yin zhes bshad de/ tshogs 'du'i thog khong tshor skyon brjod gang 'dra zhig byas kyang der mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan gyi mi 'dug la gsal bshad kyang mi byed/ de nas yun ring ma song bar las khungs mang che ba'i 'go khrid gtso bo de tsho lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang tang 177

178 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa red ces/ nyes ming btsugs te khong tshor shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po re g.yogs nas rngam ston khrom skor du khrid pa dang chabs cig khong tshor dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod gtong 'go tshugs/skabs der las khungs gang 'dra zhig gis 'bo khrid gang rung zhig la nyes ming btsugs nas phyir 'dodan byed skabs/ der rgyab skyodar gyi tshul du las khungs tshang ma'i las byed dang mang chodags tshang ma ru star bsgrigs shing rnga brdung dar 'phyar byas te las khungs de'i sar 'gro dgos pa dang /snga rjes su rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi thad gtogs las khungs rig gnas cadab sa/so las khungs (thing )dang / dmangs srid las khungs/ 'grim 'gyul las khungs/ baX las las khungs sku gas mang che ba'i 'bo/ khrid gtso thod rnams re re bzhin phyir bton 'thab rtsodad byas nas kho nga tsho skabs de'i nyes can pa che cadas su gyur/rgyu mtshan de la brten nas slob grwa khag gi nang su gang la'ang brtsi mi dgos par rang snang gang dran gyis mi la thub chodad gtong ba dang / lhag par du rnying bzhi rtsa galta ra zhes pa'i las 'gul nang gtsug lag khang gtor mkhan dang / bod mir gdug rtsub kyi nyes rdung 'thab rtsod gtong mkhan gyi dmar srung dmag dpa' bo de tsho re re bzhin/ so so'i pha mar tang nang gi 178

17da rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa red ces/ nyes ming btsugs te khong tshor shog bu'i zhwa mo ring po re g.yogs nas rngam ston khrom skor du khrid pa dang chabs cig khong tshor dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod gtong 'go tshugs/skabs der las khungs gang 'dra zhig gis 'go khrid gang rung zhig la nyes ming btsugs nas phyir 'don byed skabs/ der rgyab skyor gyi tshul du las khungs tshang ma'i las byed dang mang chogs tshang ma ru star bsgrigs shing rnga brdung dar 'phyar byas te las khungs de'i sar 'gro dgos pa dang /snga rjes su rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi thad gtogs las khungs rig gnas slob sa/so las khungs (thing )dang / dmangs srid las khungs/ 'grim 'grul las khungs/ bzo las las khungs sogs mang che ba'i 'go khrid gtso bo rnams re re bzhin phyir bton 'thab rtsod byas nas khong tsho skabs de'i nyes can pa che shos su gyur/rgyu mtshan de la brten nas slob grwa khag gi nang su gang la'ang brtsi mi dgos par rang snang gang dran gyes mi la thub tshod gtong ba dang / lhag par du rnying bzhi rtsa gtor zhes pa'i las 'gul nang gtsug lag khang gtor mkhan dang / bod mir gdug rtsub kyi nyes rdung 'thab rtsod gtong mkhan gyi dmar srung dmag dpa' bo de tsho re re bzhin/ so so'i pha mar tang nang gi 178

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 179ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam du 'gro mkhan gyi dbang 'dzin pa red ces nyes ming phog ste/ mang tshogs kyis 'thab rtsod gtong ba dang / dus mnyam khong tsho yang dmar srung dmag gi gras nas rang bzhin gyis bud de mi tshang mas zur za dang 'phya smod/ kha rdung gtong yul zhig tu gyur/skabs der rigs bzhi mi sna'i bu phrug tshos kyang nam rgyun tshur thub tshod gtong mkhan rgya phrug dmar srung dmag de tshor/ 'khon lan slog rgyu'i go skabs thob nas rgya phrug de tshor 'brug la 'brug phrug ma skyes par tsi tsi skyes 'dug rma byar rma phrug ma skyes par tsi tsi skyes 'dug tsi tsir tsig phrug ma skyes par 'drug dang rma bya skyes 'dug ces/ zur za dang kha rdung btang bas ma zad/ khong tsho'i dpung rtags bkog ste/ nga tsho tang nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugab/ lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa tshor 'thab rtsod dang gyen log byed mkhan yin zhes bshad de/ dus de nas bzung / kho tshonas kyang dmar srung dmag gi dpung rtags btags te rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag slob phrug de tsho dang mnyam du langs nas bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pa'i rgya'i dbang 'dzin las khungs khag gi dbang 'dzin mi sna tshor dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i las 'gul nang dngos su 'dzul zhugs byed 'go tshugs/chabs cig sgob gra khag dang las khungs so so nang dmar srung 179

lha 'dre gathe na bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 179ma rtsa'i ring lugs lam du 'gro mkhan gyi dbang 'dzin pa red ces nyes ming phog ste/ mang tshadags kyis 'thab rtsod gtong ba dang / dus mnyam khong tsho yang dmar srung dmag gi gras nas rang bzhin gyis bud de mi tshang mas zur za dang 'phya smod/ kha rdung gtong yul zhig tu gyur/skabs der rigs bzhi mi sna'i bu phrug chodas kyang nam rgyun tshur thub chodad galta nga mkhan rgya phrug dmar srung dmag de tshor/ 'kho na lan slog rgyu'i go skabs thodab nas rgya phrug de tsho ra 'brug la 'byug phrug ma skyes par tsi tsi skyes 'dug rma byar rma phrug ma skyes par tsi tsi skyes 'dug tsi tsir tsig phrug ma skyes par 'byug dang rma bya skyes 'dug ces/ zur za dang kha rdung btang bas ma zad/ khong tsho'i dpung rtags bkog ste/ nga hrū tang nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugasdo/ lam du 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa tshor 'thab rtsod dang gyen 'o/ga byed mkhan yin zhes bshad de/ dus de nas bzung / khote che sa kyang dmar srung dmag gi dpung rtags btags te rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag slob phrug de tsho dang mnyam du langs nas bod rang skyong jongs tang ud ces pa'i rgya'i dbang 'dzin las khungs khag gi dbang 'dzin mi sna tshor dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i las 'gul nang dngos su 'dzul zhugs byed 'boste tshugs/chabs cig slob grwa khag dang las khungs so motsware nang dmar srung 179

180 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/dmag gyen 'odag sna/ga khag gi sgrig 'dzugs gsar 'dzugs byas pa des/ las khungs khag dang slob grwa/ bzo grwa sogs tshang ma'i rgyun ldan gyi 'dzin skyodang byed sgo khag thodar bshig tu soteng ste/ mi tshang ma kho ma gzhung du 'dzoms te las khungs so so'i nang gnas tshul ji byung bgro gleng byed pa dang yig chen tshags par blta skru ga byas nas sdod pa'i skabs shig la rgya nag pe cing masprod slob/ ching dwa malnga slob/ pe cing mi rigs slob grwa sogs rgya nag nas slebs pa'i dmar srung dmag gtso gras de tsho thun mong thog bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pas/ da phan macad tse tung gi langs phyogs srid jus ji bzhin lag star byas sku da dang med ces pa'i skyodan 'dzugs kyi yig chen tshags par zhig kho ma gzhung dang / rang skyong sgyu ngas tang ud bcas khag so se ra sbyar 'grem byas/da dung dmar srung dmag de dag rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi 'go khrid rnams dang mnyam du lhan dza gas byas te thad kar skyon 'dzugs byed skabs/ rang skyodang ljo ngas kyi dril bsgrags pu'u krang zhes pa'i mi kha bde zhing tshig lto lnga sku da mkhan ming 'arostegs la krang lcags kyi kha zhes pa'i krang tsad dbang gis (bod rang skyong ljongs tang lkud dril bsgrags las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin )dmar srung dmag gis btsugs pa'i skyon brjod don tshan re rer kho pas/ gung khran tang gi khungs ldan yig cha dang ma'o tse tung gi skabs dus so sor bshad 180

180 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/dmag gyen log shog khag gi sgrig 'dzugs gsar 'dzugs byas pa des/ las khungs khag dang slob grwa/ bzo grwa sogs tshang ma'i rgyun ldan gyi 'dzin skyong byed sgo khag thor bshig tu song ste/ mi tshang ma khrom gzhung du 'dzoms te las khungs so so nang gnas tshul ji byung bgro gleng byed pa dang yig chen tshags par blta slog byas nas sdod pa'i skabs shig la rgya nag pe cing mtho slob/ ching hwa mtho sgob/ pe cing mi rigs slob grwa sogs rgya nag nas spebs pa'i dmar srung dmag gtso gras de tsho thun mong thog bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces pas/ da phan ma'o tse tung gi langs phyogs srid jus ji bzhin lag star byas yod dang med ces pa'i skyon 'dzugs kyi yig chen tshags par zhig khrom gzhung dang / rang skyong ljongs tang ud bcas khag so sor sbyar 'grem byas/da dung dmar srung dmag de dag rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi 'go khrid rnams dang mnyam du lhan chogs byas te thad gar skyon 'dzugs byed skabs/ rang skyong ljongs kyi dril bsgrags pu'u krang zhes pa'i mi kha bde zhing tshig rno po yod mkhan ming 'dogs la krang lcags kyi kha zhes pa'i krang tsad dbang gis (bod rang skyong ldongs tang ud dril bsgrags las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin )dmar srung dmag gis btsugs pa'i skyon brjod don tshan re rer kho pas/ gung khran tang gi khungs ldan yig cha dang ma'o tse tung gi skabs dus so sor bshad 180

lha 'dre gdon bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 181pa'i gtam bshad sogs ‘thungs drangs te/ rang skyong lngongs kyi tang ud nas da bar ma'o yi langs phyogs srid jus ji bzhin lag star byas skor gyi dgag lan gsal bshad byas rkyen/ dmar srung dmag de tshor gnas skabs ring bya thabs gang yang ma byung ba red/'on kyang dmar srung dmag de dag gis rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces par thad gar skyon 'dzugs byas pa lam lhong ma byung yang / khong tshos mu mthud gzhi rgya che ba'i mang dzadags kyi las 'gul chen pon zhig spel nas las 'gul de'i nang rang skyong ljongs tang ud la me spyogs brgyab nas mer bsregs gtong gi yin/ zhes bshad pa red/181

lha 'dre gange na bgegs dang yig chen tshags par/ 181pa'i gtam bshad sogs ‘rungs drangs te/ rang skyong ldongs kyi tang ud nas da bar macad yi langs khyodags srid jas ji bzhin lag star byas skor gyi ༄dgag lan gsal bshad byas rkyen/ dmar srung dmag de tshor gnas skabs ring bya thabs gang yang ma byung ba red/'on kyang dmar srung dmag de dag gis rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces par thad kar skyon 'dzugs byas pa lam ltong ma byung yang / khong tshos mu mthud gzhi rgya che ba'i mang cho gas kyi las 'gul chen sngo zhig spel nas las 'gul de'i nang rang skyodang ljongs tang ud la me lha gas brgyab nas mer bsregs gcadang gi yin/ zhes bshad pa red/ 181

3 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bco brgyad/gyen 'o༈ga dang thegang ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thone pa/phal cher/ 9snyosnyo zla 0 zla stod tsam zhig la rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag gis 'char 'god byas pa gzhir bzung / lha sa slob grwa 'bring ba'i dmar srung dmag gi ming thog nas lha sa sne mang chodang khang gi nye 'gram du yod pa'i lha sa grong khyer gyi mahron khang ang dang po'i sgo 'gram thang chen du/lha sar yod pa'i las khungs che khag gi las byed pa dang /de bzhin gsar 'gyur las rigs dang zlos gar tshogs pa / slob grwa khag gi dmar srung dmag bcas yod pa'i balha gleng tshogs 'du chen mo zhig bskongs mogs byas pa dang /de'i brjod gzhi gtso bo ni/bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud ces par nor 'khrul che ba yod dang yang na grub 'bras/ che ba yod pa'i sgo ra yin zhing /don8 gnad de'i thad mi su 'dra zhig gis

gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 183rang mos thog gtam bshad byed chog gi yod/ skabs der phal cher tshod rtsis byas na mi khri brgal 'dug brjod na'ang nyung skyon las mang skyon med/bgro gleng 'go 'dzugs ma byas gong / bod ljongs zlos gar tshogs pa'i gzhas ma skad grags can tshe brtan sgrol mas kyang yo rog la nag chung zhes pa'i gzhas kyang btang / de nas phal cher snga dro'i gyod 10 thog lha sa sgob 'bring dmar srung dmag gi 'go khrid gras rbung bdag gis bgro gleng de tshugs dgos don sgor gyi ngo sgod gtam bshad thung tsam zhig byed skabs/ rgya skad thongag gi krung shin zhes par ad shin zhes sgra gdangs shig nor 'khrul shor nas lab par mi tshang ma gad mo yang chen po shor/nyin de'i rang mos gtam bshad dang po de skabs de'i lha sa skud yod rgyang bsgrags babs tshugs kyi gsar 'god pa thun yon zhes pa'i rgya mi zhig gis byas/ de yang khos/ nga ni rgya nag dbus gzhung gi 1965 lor bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung dngos su tshugs skabs/ pe cing rlung 'phrin khang nas bod nang btang ste bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes lha sa'i skud med rlung 'phrin shod mkhan ang dang po de yin/yin na'ang / ngas da bar gnas tshul ngo ma gsar 'god byed rgyu gas 'don byas pa las/ 'go khrid la sprel las 'a ba shes kyi med cing /183

gyen log dang rgong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 183rang mo sa lnga ga gtam bshad byed chog gi yod/ skabs der phal cher chodad rtsis byas na mi khri brgal 'dug bcadad na'ang nyung skyon las mang skyon med/babo gleng 'go 'dzugs ma byas bo nga / bod ljongs zlos gar tshogs pa'i gzhas ma skad grags can tshe brtan sgrol mas kyang o rog la nag chung zhes pa'i gzhas kyang btang / de nas phal cher snga dro'i dzadad 10 thog lha sa slob 'bring dmar srung dmag gi 'bo khrid gras chung bdag gis bgro gleng de tshugs dgos don skor gyi ngo sprod gtam bshad thung tsam zhig byed skabs/ rgya skad lnga ga gi krung shin zhes par ad shin zhes sgra gdangs shig ce ra 'khrul lha ra nas lab par mi tshang ma gad mo yang chen lnga shor/nyin de'i rang mos gtam bshad dang po de skabs de'i lha sa skud yod rgyang bsgrags babs tshugs kyi gsar 'god pa wun sku/na zhes pa'i rgya mi zhig gis byas// de yang 〈snas/ nga ni rgya nag dbus gzhung gi 1965 'o/ra bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung dngos su tshugs skabs/ pe cing rlung 'phrin khang nas bod nang btang ste bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes lha sa'i skud med rlung 'phrin shodad mkhan ang dang po de yin/yin na'ang / ngas da bar gnas tshul ngo ma gsar 'god byed rgyu gtso 'dodan byas pa las/ 'go khrid la sprel las 'khrab shes kyi med cing /183

1da 4 gan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nga rang skyong ljongs rim pa'i las khrungs shig nas rdzong rim pa'i skud yod rgyang bsgrags bab tshugs shig la gnas sgos btang ba ltar/ da lta'ang gsar 'god pa'i las ka byed kyi yod/ ces rang gis rang ngo sprod byas rjes/ mu mthud/ 1965 lo'i dpyid khar rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyis go sgrig byas te tshugs pa'i ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom sgob sbyong byed mkhan sngon bskyod mi sna khag cig gi tshogs 'du dbu 'byed kyi mdzad sgor/ rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci ko shi lan yong nas 'tshams zhu'i gtam bshad cig byas/gtam bshad ga re byas song zhe na/ deng sang mi ha cang mang po zhig gis ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom slob sbyong byed kyi yod pa red/ de sdon bod nang du'ang mi ha cang mang po zhig gis nang pa'i ston pa shākya thub pa'i dpe char sgob sbyong byed kyi yod pa red/ ngas bltas na/ dpe cha de gnyis sgob sbyong byed mkhan gye mi mi 'dra ba khag gnyis po 'di dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang / mi so sos slob sbyong byas pa'i dpe cha des don dngos thog rang nyid la phan thogs che chung ga tshod tsam zhig thob kyi yod pa 'gran bsdur byas na/ gzhi nas dpe cha'i rigs rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi mtshan nyid rigs pa dang / rang nyid 'cho ba'i mtshan nyid rigs pa gnyis kyi khyad chos de gas la por mtshon gyi red ces bshad/184

1da 4 rgan lnga'ire ma bce sa drang gtam/nga rang skyong jongs rim pa'i las khungs shig nas rdzong rim pa'i skud yod rgyang bsgrags bab tshugs shig la gnas 1—sa btang ba ltar/ da lta'ang gsar 'god pa'i las ka byed kyi lo da/ ces rang gis rang ngo sprodad byas rjes/ mu mthud/ 1965 lo'i dpyid khar rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyis go sgrig byas te tshugs pa'i ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom slob spyong byed mkhan sngon bskyod mi sna khag cig gi chodags 'du dbu 'byed kyi mdzad sgor/ rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci bo shi lan sku nga nas 'tshams zhu'i gtam bshad cig byas/gtam bshad ga re byas song zhe na/ deng sang mi ha cang mang ngo zhig gis ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom slob spyong byed kyi sku da pa red/ de sngon bod nang du'ang mi ha cang mang wa zhig gis nang pa'i ston pa shākya thub pa'i dpe char slob spyong byed kyi yod pa red/ ngas bltas na/ dpe cha de gnyis slob phyu nga byed mkhan gyi mi mi 'dra ba khag gnyis lnga 'di dacadas yod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang / mi so sos slob spyong byas pa'i dpe cha des don dngos thog rang nyid la phan sgyu gas che chung ga cho da tsam zhig thodab kyi sku da pa 'gran bsdur byas na/ gzhi nas dpe cha'i rigs rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba'i 'thab snyu da kyi mtshan nyid rigs pa dang / rang nyid 'cho ba'i mtshan nyid rigs pa gnyis kyi khyad chos de gas la lnga ra mchodan gyi red ces bshad/184

gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 185skabs der ngas ko shi lan gyi gtam der skyon 'dug bsam nas/skabs 'phral rang skyong ldongs tang ud la gsang yig bris nas bskur ba yin/ 'on kyang dus yur zla ba kha shas phyin na'ang / ngas bris pa'i gsang yig zu'i nang rdo g.yugs pa bzhin ya lan rtsa ba nas sprad ma byung / rjes la zhib rtsad byed skabs/ rang skyong ljongs tang ud rtsa 'dzugs pu'u las khungs kyis nga'i gsang yig nang bris pa'i gnad don la mthong chung btang ste bdag sgod byas mi 'dug blo mthun tsho dgongs pa bzhes dang / ko shi lan kho bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang ud kyi tru'u ci zhig yin na'ang khos nga tsho'i rlabs chen gye gtso 'dzin/ rlabs chen gyi slob dpon ma'o kru'u zhi'i rlabs chen gyi dgongs pa 'di/ rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi bsam blor dug skyon gtong mkhan rmongs dad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i shākya mu ne'i chos dang gcig pa red/ ces bshad pa de ni ha las pa'i nag nyes chen po red ces bshad de rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi tshogs mi'i gras shig yin pa'iko shi lan (skabs der rang skyong ljongs tang ud nang las bgos gzhir bzung bod kyi zhing 'grog thon skyed skor gye 'gan khur byed mkhan gtso bo de red )ma'o tse tung la ngo rgol byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i nyes ming dang po de btsugs/ de rjes bod rang skyong ljongs spyi bde thing las khungs mabong sna sa kyi gsang las pa rgya mi lis cun zhes pa zhig gis gtam bshad byas/ kho pa'i gtam bshad kyi nang don gtso bo ni/ bod rang skyong 185

gyen 'o/ga dang go nga ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu the na pa/ 185skabs der ngas spo shi lan gyi gtam der skyon 'dug bsam nas/skabs 'phral rang skyong ljongs tang ༷/da la gsang yig bris nas bskur ba yin/ 'on kyang dus ༷/na/ zla ba kha shas phyin na'ang / ngas bris pa'i gsang yig chu'i nang shod g.yugs pa bzhin ya lan rtsa ba nas sprad ma byung / rjes la zhib rtsad byed skabs/ rang skyong ljongs tang ud rtsa 'dzugs pu'u las khungs kyis nga'i gsang yig nang bris pa'i gnad dodan la mthodang chung btang ste bdag sprod byas mi 'dug blo mthun dza dgongs pa bzhes dang / bo shi lan kho bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang ud kyi hru'u ci zhig yin na'ang khos nga tsho'i rlabs chen gyi gathe 'dzin/ rlabs chen gyi slob dathe na macad kru'u zhi'i rlabs chen gyi dbo ngas pa 'di/ rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi bsam blo ra dug khyodan gtong mkhan sna ngas dad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i shākya mu ne+e'i chodas dang gcig pa red/ ces bshad pa de ni ha las pa'i nag nyes chen po red ces bshad de rang skyong jongs tang ༷/da kyi cho gas mi'i gras shig yin pa'iskad shi lan (skabs der rang skyong ljongs tang ud nang las bgos gzhir bzung bod kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed skor gyi 'gan khur byed mkhan gtso bo de red )ma'o tse tung la lnga rgol byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i nyes ming dang po de btsugs/ de rjes bod rang skyong jongs spyi bde thing las khu ngas ma〈sna sna sa kyi gsang las pa rgya mi lis cun zhes pa zhig gis gtam bshad byas/ kho pa'i gtam bshad kyi nang don gtso bo ni/ bod rang skyong 185

186 rgan mo'i ma bcetes drang gtam/ljongs tang ud kyi 'go khrid gtso gras krang cing u dang krang go twa/ then skadan san gsum gyis rgyal khab la rgyab galta da byed mkhan tu la'i bla ma dang de'i rjes 'brangs pa tshor mu mthud 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa'i skyon brjod byas pa dang / chabs cig 'brel ba de gang 'dra byed kyi yod ce na/ de ni gung khran tang nang khul gyi gsang ba chen po zhig red/ yin na'ang de ring ngas rgya che'i mang chodags kyi mdun la tang nang gi gsang ba de phyir ther 'don byed kyi yin/krang cing ༷/ dang krang sku dwa/ then skadan san gsum gyis mes rgyal la rgyab gasnodad byed mkhan tā la'i bla mar mu mthud 'brel ba byed pa'i dodan du/ bod kyi zhing bran bdag po yin pa'i de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdod spyi dang sa dbang yin pa'i nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gsang ba'i thodag gung phran tang mi'i nang bcug nas kho pa'i khang pa'i nang du tar 'phrin btsugs te/ khong tsho gsum gyi bkod byus 'og nga phod dang twa la'i bla ma gnyis rtag tu phan tshun tar 'phrin lnga ga nas 'brel ba dang skad cha bshad kyi yod/ nga 'o/da gung phran tang mi'i nang 'dzul zhugs byed skabs/ ngo sprod byed mkhan mi gnyis dbo sa kyi yod pa krang cin ༷/ dang krang bo twa nas ngo sprod byas pa ma zad/ then bo na san gyis rgyab skyor yang byas pa red/nga sgyu da gung khran tang gi gsang ba'i tang mi red ces kho pa'i gtam 186

186 gan mo ma bcos drang gtam/ljongs tang ud kyi 'go khrid gtso gras krang cing u dang krang go twa/ then kon san gsum gyis rgyal khab la rgyab gtod byed mkhan tā la'i bla ma dang de'i rjes 'brangs pa tshor mu mthud 'brel ba byed kyi yod pa'i skyon brjod byas pa dang / chabs cig 'brel ba de gang 'dra byed kyi yod ce na/ de ni gung khran tang nang khul gyi gsang ba chen po zhig red/ yin na'ang de ring ngas rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi mdun la tang nang gi gsang ba de phyir ther 'don byed kyi yin/krang cing u dang krang go dwa/ then kon san gsum gyis mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed mkhan tā la'i bla mar mu mthud 'brel ba byed pa'i don du/ bod kyi zhing bran bdag po yin pa'i de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdo spyi dang sa dbang yin pa'i nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gsang ba'i thog gung phran tang mi'i nang bcug nas kho pa'i khang pa'i nang du tar 'phrin btsugs te/ khong tsho gsum gyi bkod byus 'og nga phod dang tā la'i bla ma gnyis rtag tu phan tshun tar 'phrin thog nas 'brel ba dang skad cha bshad kyi yod/ nga phod gung phran tang mi'i nang 'dzul zhugs byed skabs/ ngo sprod byed mkhan mi gnyis dgos kyi yod pa krang cin u dang krang go twa nas ngo sgod byas pa ma zad/ then kon san gyis rgyab skyor yang byas pa red/nga phod gung khran tang gi gsang ba'i tang mi red ces kho pa'i gtam 186

gyen 'o/ga dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu sgyu na pa/ 187bshad mjug ma 'gril gong / bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi thad gtogs las khungs khag cig gi las byed mang sngo zhig yar langs nas sdings cha'i steng du ro/ra nas/ gtam bshad/ byed bzhin pa'i lis cun gyi lag nas kha par 'phrog rtsis byas pa ma zad/ gung khran tang gi gsang ba srung skyob byed dgos/ da gin lis cun zhes pa'i mi de'i skad cha de dag dkrog gtam red/rgya che'i las byed pa dang / mang tshogs/ lhag par du dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung chung chos kho'i skad char yid ches byed rgyu yod ma red ces bshad par/ mang chodags kyi nang dang lhag par du rgya gzhung gi las byed dang sdudas gar chortags pa mo gas mi khag cig gis gung khran tang gi gsang ba phyir 'don byed mkhan 'dzin bzung byed dgos zhes skad 'bod byas/'o/na kyang rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag dang / lha sar yod pa'i dmar srung dmag de bzhin las byed dang mang tshogs khag cig gis/ lis cun gyis bshad pa'i gnad don de bod rang skyong ljongs tang ༷/da kyis da phan gsang rgya chen sngo byas pa'i gnad wa na zhig yin pas/ de'i thog nas rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi skyon dang nor 'khrul gang yod pa ther bton byed dbo sa pa las/ de dag srung skyodab byas na rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi da phan gyi las kar zhib 'jug ji ltar byed thub kyi red/ rgya che'i las byed pa tsho dang mi mang rnams gnad don de 'dra 187

gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu bon pa/ 187bshad mjug ma 'gril gong / bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi thad gtogs las khungs khag cig gi las byed mang po zhig yar langs nas sdings cha'i steng du sgyu ra nas/ gtam bshad byed bzhin pa'i lis cun gyi lag nas kha par 'phrog rtsis byas pa ma zad/ gung khran tang gi gsang ba srung skyob byed dgos/ da gin lis cun zhes pa'i mi de'i skad cha de dag dkrog gtam red/rgya che'i las byed pa dang / mang chogs/ lhag par du dmar srung dmag dpa' bo chung rbung chos kho'i skad char yid ches byed rgyu yod ma red ces bshad par/ mang tshogs kyi nang dang lhag par du rgya gzhung gi las byed dang cho sa gar spyodags pa sodags mi khag cig gis gung khran tang gi gsang ba phyir 'don byed mkhan 'dzin bzung byed dgos zhes skad 'bod byas/'on kyang rgya nag nas yong ba'i dmar srung dmag dang / lha sar yod pa'i dmar srung dmag de bzhin las byed dang mang chogs khag cig gis/ lis cun gyis bshad pa'i gnad don de bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyis da phan gsang rgya chen po byas pa'i gnad don zhig yin pas/ de'i thog nas rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi skyon dang nor 'khrul gang yod pa zer bton byed dgos pa las/ de dag srung skyob byas na rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis bod rang spyong ljongs tang ud kyi da phan gyi las shar zhib 'jug ji ltar byed thub kye red/ rgya che'i las byed pa tsho dang mi mang rnams gnad don de 'dra 187

188 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/zheg la ha las rgyu med/ deng sang rgya nag nang li'u hra'o chi dang ting sha'o phing / de min rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon kra'u en lan la'ang skyon brjod byed pa'i yig chen tshags par sbyar dang sbyor bzhin pa red/ ces bshad de/ skabs de'i bgro gleng gi rnam pa zang zing dang / no ngar rnyog 'dzings kyi ngar shugs de phran bu'i thung du btang yang / bgro gleng gi gas 'dzin sdings cha'i thog gtam bshad byed mkhan mang thag chod de mtshams re kha par 'phrog res byas pa yang thengs mang byung /de nyin snga dro'i zu tshod 10 tsam nas phyi dro'i rgyod 5 tsam bar bgro gleng tshugs te mi khag cig gis rang skyong ljongs tang ud la skyon dang nor 'khrul chen po yod ces bshad pa dang / yang khag cig gis gzhi rtsa'i las don byed stangs 'grig min gyi nor 'khrul yod kyang / bod bcings bkrol btang ba nas/ ngo log zing 'khrug lhing 'jags btang ba / sa zhing bcos sgyur dang dmangs gatsho'i bcos bsgyur byas te/ bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su btsugs thub pa sogs grub 'bras chen po yin tshul shod mkhan khag cig byung /bgro gleng tshogs 'du de'i thog dmar srung dmag gtso gyur las byed dang gsar 'gyur las rigs/ de bzhin bzo grwa khag gi las bzo pa dang / mang tshogs khag cig gis rang skyong ljongs tang ud la skyon 188

188 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/zhig la ha las rgyu med/ deng sang rgya nag nang li'u hra'o chi dang ting sha'o phing / de min rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blo na kra'u en lan la'ang skyon brdzod byed pa'i yig chen tshags par sbyar dang sbyor bzhin pa red/ ces bshad de/ skabs de'i bgro gleng gi rnam pa zang zing dang / rno ngar rnyog 'dzings kyi ngar shugs de phran bu'i chung du btang yang / bgro gleng gi gtso 'dzin sdings cha'i thodag gtam bshad byed mkhan mang thag chodad de mtshams re kha par 'phredag res byas pa yang thengs mang byung /de nyin snga dro'i chu tshod 10 tsam nas phyi dro'i rgyod 5 tsam bar balha gleng tshugs te mi khag cig gis rang skyodang jongs tang ud la skyodan dang ce ra 'khrul chen wa yodad ces bshad pa dang / yang khag cig gis gzhi rtsa'i las don byed stangs 'grig min gyi nor 'khrul mo da kyang / bod bcings bskadal btang ba nas/ cad 'o/ga zing 'khrug lhing 'jags btang ba / sa zhing bcos sgyur dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas te/ bod rang skyong ljongs dasngags su btsugs thub pa sku/gas grub 'bras chen 11 yin tshul cadad mkhan khag cig byung /babo gleng tsho gas 'du de'i thog dmar srung dmag gce gyur las byed dang gsar 'gyur las rigs/ de bzhin bakhrod grwa khag gi las bakhrod pa dang / mang zogs khag cig gis rang skyong ljongs tang ud la skyon 188

gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 189gco che ba yod par brten/ me sbyogs brgyab nas mer bsregs gtong dgos zhes brjod de gyen log byed mkhan gyi lta ba dang shog khag gcig dang / yang rang skyong lngongs tang ud kyi las khungs khag gi las byed gras yin pa'i mi khag cig dang khong tsho mnyam zlos gar tshogs pa mang che ba / mi mang nang nam rgyun 'go khrid las byed dang 'grig po yod mkhan dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis rang srung brtan po byed rgyu'i don du rang skyong ljongs la grub 'bras che ba yod pa'i lta ba bzung ba dang / de dang phyogs gtogs gong ma srung mkhan phyogs khag cig chags te bod nang rig gsar gyi las 'gul nang / sa gnas dbang 'dzin mi sna nang khul khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab rtsod byed bzhin pa de rim pas mang tshogs kyi nang la'ang gyen log dang / gong ma srung mkhan zhes phyogs khag gnyis sgog mar bgro gleng tshogs 'du de'i thog khungs so so'i lta tshul mi 'dra ba spebs pa de gzhi rtsar bzung nas phyogs khag gnyis su gyes/rjes su rim pas phyogs khag de gnyis gzhi rgya je cher phyin nas lha sa slob 'bring gi dge rgan tha'o grang srung gis 'go khrid pa'i lha sa gsar brje gyen log spyi khyab pu'u zhes pa'i gyen log shog khag dang / rang skyong ljongs las khungs kyi las byed pa li'u hra'o ming gis 'go khrid pa'i bod kyi 'byor med gral rim gsar brje'i mnyam 'brel chen po gyen log spyi khyab bka' 189

gyen lo ga dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 189gtso che ba yod par brten/ me sgyogs brgyab nas mer bsregs gto/nga dgos zhes brjodad de gyen 'o/ga byed mkhan gyi lta ba dang r+shageg khag gcig dang / yang rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi las khungs khag gi las byed gras yin pa'i mi khag cig dang khong dza mnyam chodas gar cerags pa mang che ba / mi mang nang nam rgyun 'bo khrid las byed dang 'grig ngo skungad mkhan dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis rang srung brtan po byed rgyu'i don du rang skyong ljongs la grub 'bras che ba yod pa'i lta ba bzung ba dang / de dang phyogs galta gas bo nga ma srung mkhan phyogs khag cig chags te nge da nang rig gsar gyi las 'gul nang / sa gnas dbang 'dzin mi sna nang khul khyodad shi nga gamo na gyi 'thab rtsodad byed bzhin pa de rim pas mang chodags kyi nang la'ang gyen 'othog dang / gothong ma srung mkhan zhes phyogs khag gnyis thodag mar bsku gleng sags 'du de'i thog khungs so so'i lta tshul mi 'dra ba slebs pa de gzhi rtsar bzung nas phyogs khag gnyis su gyes/rjes su rim pas phyogs khag de gnyis gzhi rgya je cher phyin nas lha sa slob 'bring gi dge rgan thacad grang srung gis 'bo khrid pa'i lha sa gsar brje gyen log spyi khyab pu'u zhes pa'i gyen log shog khag dang / rang skyong ljongs las khungs kyi las byed pa li'u hraso/ ming gis 'go khrid pa'i wa da kyi 'byedar med gral rim gsar brje'i mnyam 'brel chen po'i gyen 'o/ga spyi khyab bka' 189

190 rgan lngatware ma bcos drang gtam/bkod pu'u zhes pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud la srung skyob byed mkhan gyi bo nga ma srung skyodab shog khag ces sna ga khag gnyis la gyur/gyen 'o/ga sna ga khag la skabs de'i wa da dmag khul khang gi dmar shog drung che dang po dang dmag spyi tseng yung ya yis rgyab skyor byed tshul dang /mnyam 'brel la wa da dmag khul khang gi chab srid gi yon ran rung dang /dmag khul khang chab srid las khang gi 'gan 'dzin dbyin pha thang / lha sa'i nyen rtog dmag mi'i dmag spyi hre phan byacod bcas kyi rgyab skyor byed tshul tsam ma zad/ bod nang sku da pa'i dmag sde ang 53 pa dang / bod dmag khul khang gi sku srung ru cadag des kyang mnyam 'brel la mngon gsal dod sngo sa rgyab skyor byas te/ me mda' dang lag 'phra ma/ tha na me sgyogs tshun chad lkog nas sprad yod cing gyen 'o/ga la bod nang yod pa'i dmag sde ang 11 pas rgyab skyor dang rjes la drag po'i 'thab ce da skabs me mda' dang go mchodan sprad yod/rig gnas gnas brje'i las 'gul nang snga rjes su bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi 'go khrid gtso gras krang cin u dang / krang go hwa/ zi khron zhing chen du gnas spos rjes glo bur tshe las 'das pa/ wang 'chi med sogs 1949 'o/ra ngo da nang dmag khrid de btsan 'dzul byed mkhan gyi rgya dpon gasgu lnga de dag mang tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod btang ste mthar rgya nag 190

190 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/bkod pu'u zhes pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud la srung skyob byed mkhan gyi gong ma srung skyob shog khag ces shog khag gnyis la gyur/gyen log shog khag la skabs de'i bod dmag khul khang gi dmar shog drung che dang po dang dmag spyi tseng yung ya yis rgyab skyor byed tshul dang /mnyam 'brel la bod dmag khul khang gi chab ched u yon ran rung dang /dmag khul khang chab srid las khang gi 'gan 'dzin dbyin pha thang / lha sa'i nyen rtog dmag mi'i dmag spyi tre phan bya'o bcas kyi rgyab skyor byed tshul tsam ma zad/ bod nang yod pa'i dmag sde ang 53 pa dang / bod dmag khul khang gi sku srung ru shog des kyang mnyam 'brel la mngon gsal dod pos rgyab sgor byas te/ me mda' dang lag 'bom/ tha na me sgogs tshun chad lkog nas sprad yod cing gyen log la bod nang yod pa'i dmag sde ang 11 pas rgyab skyor dang rjes la drag po 'thab rtsod skabs me mda' dang go mchon sprad yod/rig gnas gnas brje'i las 'gul nang snga rjes su bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi 'go khrid gco gras krang cin u dang / krang go twa/ zi khron zhing chen du gnas sgos rjes slo bur tshe las 'das pa/ wang 'chi med sogs 1949 lor bod nang dmag khrid de btsan 'dzul byed mkhan gyi rgya dpon gco bo de dag mang tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod btang ste mthar rgya nag 190

gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 191tu mi spyod las 'das pa'i sdug sgong mnar gcod 'og las ngan mgo thog lhung ste shi ba red/phal cher 1966 lo lo mjug tu bod nang shog khag gnyis thog mar chags rjes kyi nyin zhig rang skyong lngongs rig gsar tshogs zung gis lha sa slob 'bring (po tā la'i rgyab tu yod )gi slob phrug dmar srung dmag la brda tho zhig 'byor/ de ma thag dmar srung dmag rnams rang skyong ljongs mi mang srid gzhung nang bskyod ma thag bzhugs khri gling kha'i phyi nang yongs su rdzogs par lha sa grong khyer nang gi bod mi mang tshogs khri phrag mang po 'ur yong ba ma zad/ mang po zhig gis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po gung khran tang nang g.yo 'dzul byed mkhan nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi rdzun pags bshus te mi mang gi lag tu rtsis sprod byed dgos zer ba'i skad 'bod byas/bud med mang po zhig gis pang gdan brdabs pa dang rkub gos slog pa sogs shin tu mi dga' ba'i spyod tshul bstan pa dang / chabs cig mi ngan mgo gnis ma kho da lta rang nga tsho mi mang gi lag tu rtsis sprod byed dgos/nga tshos kho la 'thab rtsod btang nas dri ngan kha ba bzo rgyu yin zhes brjod bzhin rang skyong ljongs mi mang srid gzhung gi rgyal sgo'i nang nas las khungs yod sar shor yong gi yod stabs/ mi mang srid gzhung zhes pa'i las byed yongs 191

gyen log dang sgo nga ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 191tu mi spyod las 'das pa'i sdug sbyong mnar gcod 'og las ngan mgo thog lhung ste shi ba red/phal cher 1966 lo'i 'o/ mjug tu wa da nang shodag khag gnyis thog mar chags rjes kyi nyin zhig rang skyong ljongs rig gsar tshogs chung gis lha sa 〈geb 'bring (po twa la'i rgyab tu yod )gi phru ba phrug dmar srung dmag la brda tho zhig 'gyor/ de ma thag dmar srung dmag rnams rang skyong ljongs mi mang srid gzhung nang bskyodad ma thag bzhugs khri gling kha'i phyi nang yongs su rdzogs par lha sa grong khyer nang gi bod mi mang tshogs khri phrag mang po 'ur yong ba ma zad/ mang wa zhig gis bkas bskadad rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po gung khran tang nang g.yo 'dzul byed mkhan nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi rdzun pags bshus te mi mang gi lag tu rtsis sprodad byed dbo sa zer ba'i skad 'awa da byas/bud med mang wa zhig gis pang gdan brdabs pa dang rkub bo sa cadag pa sogs shin tu mi dga' ba'i spyodad tshul bstan pa dang / chabs cig mi ngan mgo gnis ma kho da lta rang nga tsho mi mang gi lag tu rtsis sprod byed dgos/nga cho sa kho la 'thab snyungad btang nas dri ngan kha ba bas rgyu yin zhes bathegad bzhin rang skyong jongs mi mang srid gzhung gi rgyal sgo'i nang nas las khungs yod sar cadar sku nga gi sku da stabs/ mi mang srid gzhung zhes pa'i las byed sku ngas 191

192 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/dang / de bzhin sku srung dmag mi phon chen zhig gi thog lha sa slob 'bring gi phru ba phrug khag cig bcas khyedan mi grangs lha nga ma zin tsam zhig gis lag gdang dpung bsgrigs kyis ru star gsum bsgrigs nas mang tsho gas kyi mdun bkag ste sgyu da bcugaphal cher dus yun chu tsho da phyed tsam ma song ba'i mtshams 'dir bod dmag khul khang nas rgya dpon kha shas shig mnyam nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med khrid slebs shing / de nyin nga sgyu da kyis rgya dmag gi chas spras 'dug pas/ lnga ga mar mang chosags la rgya danyugen zhig gis rgyang bsgrags 〈snag nas mang cho gas rnams phran tsam khu sim bzhugs mo gas gnang / da lta nga 'o/da la ngospes len zhu 'jug gi yin/ zhes bshad rjes nga 〈snad kyis dmag gos kyi dpung par yod pa'i rgya dmag gi dpung rtags dmar po de gnyis dang /zhwa mo'i lnga ga la yod pa'i rgya'i dmag rtags de bskadag nas am phrag nang bcug ste mang chodags kyi mdun sar mgo sgur sgur byas te / nga ni mang tsho gas rnams kyis gsal po mkhyen rtogs sku da pa'i de snga'i bod zhing bran lam lugs kyi zhing bran bdag wa zhig yin pa ma zad/ nga dang nga'i mi thog rim pas rgya che'i mang chosags la gnya' gasnadzin bshu gazlothog btang yod stabs rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis nga la skyon brjod dang rogs ram gang gnang yang /ngas der dga' bsu zhu rgyu las gang yang med ces bshad ma thagam nga 192

19da rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/dang / de bzhin sku srung dmag mi phon chen zhig gi thog lha sa slob 'bring gi slob phrug khag cig bcas khyon mi grangs stong ma zin tsam zhig gis lag gdang dpung bsgrigs kyis ru star gsum bsgrigs nas mang tshogs kyi mdun bkag ste sdod bcugaphal cher dus yun zu tshod phyed tsam ma song ba'i mtshams 'dir bod dmag khul khang nas rgya dpon kha shas shig mnyam nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med khrid spebs shing / de nyin nga phod kyis rgya dmag gi chas spras 'dug pas/ thog mar mang chogs la rgya dpon zhig gis rgyang bsgrags thog nas mang tshogs rnams phran tsam khu sem bzhugs rogs gnang / da lta nga phod la ngos len zhu 'jug gi yin/ zhes bshad rjes nga phod kyis dmag gos kyi dpung par yod pa'i rgya dmag gi dpung rtags dmar po de gnyis dang /zhwa mo'i thog la yod pa'i rgya'i dmag rtags de bkog nas am phrag nang bcug ste mang tshogs kyi mdun sar mgo sgur sgur byas te / nga ni mang tshogs rnams kyis gsal po mkhyen rtogs yod pa'i de snga'i bod zhing bran lam lugs kyi zhing bran bdag po zhig yin pa ma zad/ nga dang nga'i mi thog rim pas rgya che'i mang tshogs la gnya' gnon bshu gzhog btang yod stabs rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis nga la skyon brjod dang rogs ram gang gnang yang /ngas der dga' bsu zhu rgyu las gang yang med ces bshad ma thagam nga 192

gyen log dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 193tshogs kyi nang nas zhing bran bdag po nga phod kho rtsa med gtong dgos/ kho mi mang la rtsis sgod byed dgos zhes skad 'bod byed pa'i skabs der/ rgya dpon de dag gis nga phod gsang thabs kyis khrid de bod dmag khul khang du phyir log byas/go thos la nyin de gar nga phod kyi nang mi dang bcas tshang ma rgya nag tu gnas skabs ring gnas spos byas pa red zer bshad kyi 'dug la/ de nyin bzhugs khri gling kha'i nang mi mang mang chogs nyin gang nga phod gang du yib bsdad pa 'tshol zhib byas te mthar/ nga phod rgya nag tu nyen g.yol du 'khrid pa'i gnas tshul thos phral mang tshogs rnams rim pas rang gnas su phyir log byas/skabs der mang tshogs kyi nang nas go thos la mi mang gis nga phod la 'khon 'dzin de tsam byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gco bo ni/ nga phod kyis de snga chab mdo bskyal nas kho pa rgya nag tu chings mol du bskyod de zhi ba'i chings yig don tshan 17 la sa yig brgyab par ma zad/ 1959 lor bod rang dbang sger langs skabs nga phod rgya'i dmag khul khang du bsdad pa dang /rjes su rgya'i gsang ba'i tang mi red ces pa'i gnas tshul mang chogs kyis shes rtogs byung mtshams nga phod rtsa gtor gtong gi yin/ zhes mi mang srid gzhung nang shor ba red ces bshad kyi 'dug193

gyen lo ga dang gong ma srung mkhan dus gcig tu thon pa/ 193phogs kyi nang nas zhing bran bdag po nga phod kho rtsa med gtong dgos/ kho mi mang la rtsis sgrod byed dgos zhes skad 'bod byed pa'i skabs der/ rgya dpon de dag gis nga phod gsang thabs kyis khrid de bod dmag khul khang du phyir 'o/ga byas/go thos la nyin de gar nga phod kyi nang mi dang bcas tshang ma rgya nag tu gnas skabs ring gnas spos byas pa red zer bshad kyi 'dug la/ de nyin bzhugs khri gling kha'i nang mi mang mang tshadags nyin gang nga 'o/da gang du yib bsdad pa 'cho la zhib byas te mthar/ nga pho da rgya nag tu nyen gasku la du 'khrid pa'i gnas tshul thodas phral mang chodags rnams rim pas rang gnas su phyir log byas/skabs der mang chogegs kyi nang nas go thodas la mi mang gis nga sgyu da la 'khon 'dzin de tsam byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ nga phod kyis de snga chab mawa bskyal nas 〈sna pa rgya nag tu chings mostel du bskyo/da de zhi ba'i chings yig dodan tshan 17 la sa yig brgyab par ma zad/ 1959 'e ra wa da rang dbang sger langs skabs nga phod rgya'i dmag khul khang du bsdad pa dang /rjes su rgya'i gsang ba'i tang mi red ces pa'i gnas tshul mang chosags kyis shes rtogs byung mtshams nga 'o/da rtsa galta ra galta nga gi yin/ zhes mi mang srid gzhung nang shodar ba red ces bshad kyi 'dug193
