222 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nas ma ṇi yig drug 'dren gye yond la bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zhes 'don zhing / lha 'dre dang skye ba snga phyi yod par yid ches byed rkyang byed kyi yod/ gung khran tang gis me mda'i sding sgra grags pa nas lha 'dre dang skye ba snga phyi med cing / yar langs zhing bran rnams la dpe med yag po byed kyi yin/ zhes gsungs pas gung khran tang gis rgyobs ce na brgyag rgyu dang mdzadangs she na mchosangs pa yin/ 'odan kyang dga' ldan dgon pa stor bar rtsa ba nas 'gro rgyu ma byung / zhes gleng bslangs pas de nas tshang mas mnyam rub kyis rgan bstan pas gsungs pa da ga rang yin zhes bshad pa lha sa'i nang sbir grags byung /sku tshab rnams phyi log byas te yun ring ma song bar tshe ring lha mo lho phyogs don khang gi mngags gtong khang nas 'dzin bzung byas pa ma zad/da dung gsung chos rwa bar mi mang tshogs 'du bskongs nas tshe ring lha mor 'thab 'dzings btang ba dang / bod rang btsan zhes skad 'bod rgyag mkhan gyi ngan rogs su yod/ sus skad rgyag dgos pa'i ngan skul byas byung sogs sa khul dang don khang gi las byed pa nas 'dri rtsad byas kyang su gang med/ nga rang rang gis skad brgyab pa yin zhes u tshugs mthar skyel byas rkyen de nyin che ring lha mor deng dus kyi gsar brjer ngo log gi nyes ming btsugs te/222

222 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nas ma ṇi yig drug 'dren gyi yod la bla ma la skyabs su mchicad/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zhes 'don zhing / lha 'dre dang skye ba snga phyi mo da par yid ches byed rkyang byed kyi yod/ gung khran tang gis me mda'i ljing sgra grags pa nas lha 'dre dang skye ba snga phyi med cing / yar langs zhing bran rnams la dpe med yag po byed kyi yin/ zhes gsungs pas gung khran tang gis khyodabs ce na brgyag rgyu dang macerdzongs she na mchodangs pa yin/ cadan kyang dga' ldan dgon pa stor bar rtsa ba nas 'gro rgyu ma byung / zhes gleng bslangs pas de nas tshang mas mnyam rub kyis rgan bstan pas gsungs pa da ga rang yin zhes bshad pa lha sa'i nang sbir grags byung /sku tshab rnams phyi log byas te yun ring ma song bar tshe ring lha mo lho phyogs ro/na khang gi mngags gtong khang nas 'dzin bzung byas pa ma zad/da dung gsung chos rwa bar mi mang tshogs 'du bskongs nas tshe ring lha mor 'thab 'dzings btang ba dang / bod rang btsan zhes skad 'awa da rgyag mkhan gyi ngan rogs su sku da/ sus skad rgyag dgos pa'i ngan skul byas byung sogs sa khul dang don khang gi las byed pa nas 'dri rtsad byas kyang su gang med/ nga rang rang gis skad brgyab pa yin zhes u tshugs mthar skyel byas rkyen de nyin tshe ring lha mor deng dus kyi gsar brjer ngo log gi nyes ming btsugs te/222

sku tshab tshogs pa dang / bod rang btsan gyi skad 'bod/ 22 dus bkag bcon 'jug lo gsum bzos te de nyin rang rgu tsha brtsan khang du bskyal/gzhi rtsa'i tshe ring lha mo rgyun du kha bde po dang spyod pa gyong tsam yod par mi khag cig rna bar 'gro yi med kyang / bod rtsa don thad spebs skabs ze tshom som nyi med par rgyag gcig mchongs gcig byed mkhan zhig red/gong gsal nor gling du bod rang btsan zhes skad 'bod bya rgyu'i skor dang po mi 'ga' shas mnyam 'dzoms kyis nang mol byung skor tshe ring lha mo rjes su rgya gar nang spebs skabs bshad/ gang ltar tshe ring lha mo dang bza' zla mchod mdzad/ bu rgan pa zlo bzang chos grags bcas nas bod kyi rtsa don slad dka' las brgyab nas tshang ma rgya'i btson khang nang dka' sdug chen po spyad yod stabs/ bod mi mang gis che bstod tshul du rang btsan ya ma zhes snyan pa'i mtshan snyan phul ba don la'ang gnas yod/223

sku tshab tshogs pa dang / bod rang btsan gyi skad 'bod/ 223dus bkag bce na 'jug 'o/ gsum bzos te de nyin rang rgu tsha btson khang du bskyal/gzhi rtsa'i tshe ring lha mo rgyun du kha bde po dang spyod pa gyong tsam yod par mi khag cig rna bar 'gro yi med kyang / bod rtsa don thad slebs skabs the tshom so/ma nyi med par rgyag gcig mdzadangs gcig byed mkhan zhig red/gong gsal nor gling du bod rang btsan zhes skad 'bod bya rgyu'i lha ra dang po mi 'ga' shas mnyam 'alnga mas kyis nang mol byung stodar tshe ring lha mo rjes su rgya gar nang slebs skabs bshad/ gang ltar tshe ring lha mo dang bza' zla mchodad mdzad/ bu rgan pa blo bzang chodas grags bcas nas phra da kyi rtsa dodan slad dka' las brgyab nas tshang ma rgya'i btson khang nang dka' sdug chen po spyad yod stabs/ nge da mi mang gis che bstod tshul du rang btsan ya ma zhes snyan pa'i mtshan snyan phul ba don la'ang gnas yod/223

224 gan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nyer gnyis /nyin nyer gcig gi dze+e tshe/bod rab byung sa lug 1979 zla 2 tshes 16 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs srid khrims las khungs nas spyi pho 1959 lo'i ngo log zing sgong / zhes nyes ming btags pa'i btson pa mtha' dag slod bkrol gtong rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas te/ de snga'i sku drag khag gcig gu yangs slod bkrol btang nas khong tsho'i nang mi khag cig dga' ngu shor nas gung khran tang bka' drin chen po yin tshul lha sa'i rgyang bsgrags nang nyin ma rtag par bshad kyang /nga'i bza' zla 'bri gung bsod ga mas bag gro btson srung 'go dpon gyes nyin zhig las khungs nang 'bod de/ khyed rang chu sgang ngo log jag dpon gu yangs slod bkrol gtong gi red/yin na'ang / khyed rang gis gung khran tang gis gu yangs slod bkro' btang bar thugs rje che zhu dgos pa ma zad/ phyi rgyal la yod pa'i mi de dag 224

224 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nyer gahais /hain nyer gcig gi mi tshe/bod rab byung sa lug 1979 zla 2 tshes 16 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs srid khrims las khungs nas spyi lo 1959 lo'i ngo log zing slong / zhes nyes ming btags pa'i btso na pa mtha' dag glo da bamo la gto/nga rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas te/ de snga'i sku drag khag gcig gu yangs glod bskadal btang nas khong tsho'i nang mi khag cig dga' ngu sna ra nas gung khran tang bka' drin chen dze yin tshul lha sa'i rgyang bsgrags nang nyin ma rtag par bshad kyang /nga'i bza' zla 'bri gung bsod nams bag gro btson srung 'go dpon gyis nyin zhig las khungs nang 'bod de/ khyed rang chu sgang ngo log jag dpon gu yangs glod bkrol gtong gi red/yin na'ang / khyed rang gis gung khran tang gis gu yangs glod bkrol btang bar thugs rje che zhu dgos pa ma zad/ phyi rgyal la mo da pa'i mi de dag 224

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 225tshur mes rgyal gyi pang du log dgos zhes rlung 'phrin nang gtam bshad byed dgos lugs bshad par/ bza' zlas da bar mi lo nyi shu lhag bcon lang nang bsdad de mi rgas nad gcong chags zin pas brtsan khang nang sdod rgyu las gzhan sa cha gang du 'gro 'dod med/ brtsan khang du sdod bcug rogs 'es u tshugs kyis bshad par brten/ slod bkrol gtong rgyu bzhag nas gra bzhi btson khang nas snye thang sa phag rgyag sa'i ngal rtsol sgyur bkod ru bar gnas spos btang 'dug ces nga'i bu gza' nyi mar thug par 'gro skabs las mi rogs pa tshos bshad 'dugade nas rim pas bod yongs la srid jus lhug tu phyin te brtsan pa rnams rem pas bcon nas slod bkrol btang ba go thos byung /nyin gung zhig nga nang la kha lag bzo bzhin skabs skas 'dzegs thob/ nas nga'i bza' zla mi bzhis bkyag nas dbor yong / sems nang slod 'grol thob pa red snyam ste ha cang dga' ba skyes/ mar phyin te da slod dam/ zhes dres pas slod pa red ces brjod/ khyim du bsus nas tshang mar ja blugs te sne len byas/ bza' zlas bshad par/ grwa bzhi bcon khang du 'dam bag gzim khang gi sku ngo mkhan po dang / dge bshes shig bza' zla bsod nams bag gro bcas la de ga'i las byed pas 7gong sa mchog la skur ba gdabs bcug skabs 'dam bag gzim khang mkhan pos/ nga rgad po gsad kyang skur 225

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 225tshur mes rgyal gyi pang du log dgos zhes rlung 'phrin nang gtam bshad byed dgos lugs bshad par/ bza' zlas da bar mi lo nyi shu lhag btson ba/ nga nang bsdad de mi rgas nad gcong chags zin pas btson khang nang sdod rgyu las gzhan sa cha gang du 'gro 'dod med/ btson khang du sdod bcug rogs 'es u tshugs kyis bshad par brten/ slod bkrol gtong rgyu bzhag nas gra bzhi btson khang nas snye thang sa phag rgyag sa'i ngal rtsol sgyur bkod ru bar gnas spos btang 'dug ces nga'i bu gza' nyi mar thug par 'gro skabs las mi rogs pa tshos bshad 'dugade nas rim pas bod yongs la srid jus lhag tu phyin te btson pa rnams rim pas btson nas spyodad bkre la btang ba go thos byung /nyin gung zhig nga nang la kha lag bzo bzhin skabs skas 'dzegs thos/ na/sa nga'i bza' zla mi bzhis bkyag nas dngo ra yong / sems nang spyodad 'grol thob pa red snyam ste ha cang dga' ba skyes/ mar phyin te da slod dam/ zhes dris pas slod pa red ces brjod/ khyim du bsus nas tshang mar ja blugs te sne len byas/ bza' zlas bshad par/ grwa bzhi btson khang du 'dam bag gzim khang gi sku ngo mkhan po dang / dge bshes shig bza' zla bsod nams bag gro bcas la de ga'i las byed pas 7gong sa mchog la skur ba gdabs bcug skabs 'dam bag gzim khang mkhan pos/ nga rgad po gsad kyang skur 225

226 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ba mi 'debs thag chodad yin/ 'chi la khad la skur ba gdabs nas ci byed/ces kho nga gnyis la yang bskul ma gnang bas gsum kas mtha' gcig tu skur ba ma btab rkyen kho chod snye thang la tshe btso na bskyal/ mjug tu bza' zla bsod nams bag bo nad gzhi lci lnga sa 'chi la nye skabs khyed kyi sku ga twa la'i bla mar bcol yod pas shi na nga chodas ro/ bskyal gyi min/ zhes de sngon bod gzhung gi dmag mi dang skabs de'i bco na cadags mi bzhi bskyal bar btang byung / zhes bshad/bza' zla'i nad ha cang lci bas chab gsang gtong bar yang go mi 'pher bas ngas khyed rang gi nad gzhi lci po 'di'i rkyen gang yin nam/ rjes su nga la sdug bsngal bgrang sa zhig yong srid pas gsal rngeger bshad rogs/zhes brjodad pas/ bza' zlas nga grwa bzhi btso na khang du bcug skabs dri ba 'dra min bskadad nas bsun 'tsher bajo sa byung / ngas ro da rang btsan yin pa ni rdo ring la brkos yod pa bzhin rgya rgya yul dang / bod bod yul du skyid ces pa nas ra 'a'o/da tshul sogs ba1—da pas kho pa dza sa 'khyag pa chags pa'i sa steng nyin ltar chu cho da gnyis re bzhag pas/ gathe bo mkhal ma skyon can du gyur nas sked pa sgur ra chags zhes brjod/ bza' zla'i spun mched 'bri gung rmang pa 'brog bdag stod chung bsam gtan nga tsho'i khyim du 'gyor te 226

da26 gon mo ma bcos drang gtam/ba mi 'debs thag chod yin/ 'chi la khad la skur ba gdabs nas ci byed/ces khong gnyis la yang bskul ma gnang bas gsum gas mtha' gcig tu skur ba ma btab rkyen kho tsho snye thang la tshe bcon bskyal/ mjug tu bza' zla bsod nams bag gro nad gzhi lci pos 'chi la nye skabs khyed kyi srog tā la'i bla mar bcol yod pas shi na nga tshos ro bskyal gyi min/ zhes de sngon bod gzhung gi dmag mi dang skabs de'i bcon grogs mi bzhi bskyal bar btang byung / zhes bshad/bza' zla'i nad ha cang lci bas chab gsang gtong bar yang go mi 'pher bas ngas khyed rang gi nad gzhi lci po 'di'i rkyen gang yin nam/ rjes su nga la sdug bsngal bgrang sa zhig yong srid pas gsal por bshad rogs/zhes brjod pas/ bza' zlas nga grwa bzhi brtsan khang du bcug skabs dri ba 'dra min bkod nas bsun 'tsher bzos byung / ngas bod rang btsan yin pa ni rdo ring la brkos yod pa bzhin rgya rgya yul dang / bod bod yul du skyid ces pa nas ra 'phrod tshul sogs brjod pas kho pa tshos 'khyag pa chags pa'i sa steng nyin ltar chu chod gnyis re bzhag pas/ gtso bo mkhal ma skyon can du gyur nas sked pa sgur ra chags zhes brjod/ bza' zla'i spun mched 'bri gung rmang pa 'brog bdag stod chung bsam gtan nga tsho'i khyim du 'byor te 226

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ na27bza' zla dang gleng mol byas/ rjes su bza' zlas nga la stod chung bsam gtan la de sngon bcol ba'i ca dngos mar 'khyer yong ba yo/da ces brjod byung /bza' zla bsod nams bag gro brtsan nas slod nas nyin nyi shu 'das pa'i nyin zhig nad gzhi je ltod dang / ngag kyang ldab sdib gyur/ rang nyid 'tsho mi thub pa rtogs te nga'i lag nas 'jus te/ nga shi rjes phrug gu 'di rgya mi'i rkub g.yogs rgyugs bcug nas 'phrog brlag khyon nas ma gtong /bu mo mdun thabs su btson pa nas las mir bsgyur ba'i 'bri gung gtsang pa tshang gi bu bsu dgos zhes dang / gdan 'og nas rgya sgor nyis brgya tsam bton nas 'di dag btso na khang nang gi zla re'i khrus rdzas nyo ched kyi sgor gnyes de yin/ da bar bsags nas bla mchod tshogs shing zhig bzhengs/ dgos bsams byung zhes brjod/ ngas khyed rang med pa chags na bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs shing ngas bzhengs chog sems khral mi dgos zhes bshad de yud tsam khu sim ngang bsdad/sems nang don tshan gnyis de khas blang par las sla po ga la yod/7rgyal ba rin po che mjal ma thub pa dang / da dung gtsang pa tshang ge bu dang bu mo gnyis bar lo khyad bcu bdun yod rkyen bu mo 'dun thabs su khas blang 'dod med pad yud tsam sdod skabs/ spun nye ye shes sgrol mas sgol chos khas longs zer/ mtha' mar bza' zla 'chi khar sems mi pham ched 227

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ na27bza' zla dang gleng mo la byas/ rjes su bza' zlas nga la lha da chung bsam gtan la de sngon bcol ba'i ca dngos mar 'khyer yong ba ngo/da ces brdzod byung /bza' zla bamo da nams bag gro batho na nas spyodad nas nyin nyi shu 'das pa'i nyin zhig nad gzhi je lhod dang / ngag kyang ldab sdib gyur/ rang nyid 'tsho mi thub pa rtogs te nga'i lag nas 'jus te/ nga shi rjes phrug gu 'di rgya mi'i rkub gasku gas rgyugs bcug nas 'a'o/ga brlag khyodan nas ma galta nga /bu mo'i mdun thabs su batho na pa nas las mir bsgyur ba'i 'bri gung gtsang pa tshang gi bu bsu dgo sa zhes dang / gdan so/ga nas rgya lha ra nyis brgya tsam bton nas 'di dag btso na khang nang gi zla re'i khrus rdzas nyo ched kyi cadar gnyis de yin/ da bar bsags nas bla mdzadad cerags shing zhig bzhengs/ dbo sa bsams byung zhes bsnyu da// ngas khyed rang med pa chags na bla ma mchod pa'i cho gas shing ngas bzhengs chodag sems khral mi dbo sa zhes bshad de yud tsam khu sim ngang bsdad/sems nang don tshan gnyis de khas blang par las sla po ga la sku da/7rgyal ba rin po che mjal ma thub pa dang / da dung gtsang pa tshang gi bu dang bu mo gnyis bar 'o/ khyad bcu bdun sku da rkyen bu mo'i 'dun thabs su khas blang 'dod med par yud tsam sdod skabs/ spun nye ye shes sgrol mas sgrol dzadas khas sku1ngas zer/ mtha' mar bza' zla 'chi khar sems mi pham ched 227

22/ rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ngas ci thub kyis 7rgyal ba rin po che'i zhabs 'og zin thub pa zhig bya rgyu dang / 'bri gung gtsang pa tshang gi bu bu mo'i 'dun thabs su bsu rgyur khas blangs/da dung yang rang ngos nas 'tsho ched bla sman pa zhig la lham sgog phul te brtag pa zhus pa dang / sde drug rin po cher thugs dam brtag pa zhus pas sman bla sde brgyad cig gtong gsungs kyang khyim du 7rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par bshams shing brgya ma chod phul/ rgan rin chen mgon po dang / 'od zer rin po che'i yongs 'dzin rgan bstan pa / chos kyi blo gros rin po che/ dge 'dun pa mchog ldan bcas dge 'dun bzhi grwa gdan drangs te brgya mchod dang rnam rgyal tshe mchog btang / 'bras spungs rgan lam rim rin po ches bza' zla bsod nams bag gror rin chen ril bu lnga gnang son byung /dgong mo de nged ma bu gsum gyes blta rtog 'og sdod skabs ha cang nad tshabs cher gyur pas ngas khyim mtshes kyi khang pa nas phar spo rgyu'i re ba bton yang 'dod pa mi byed/ de nas mgrin nas hur sgra 'don zhing dbugs kyi rgyu ba myur bas ngas 7rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par chen po gnyis mig la bstan te rgya gzhung gis rang thag rang gcod sprad nas 7rgyal dbang rin po che tshur phebs nas 7rgyal dbang yab sras mjal 228

228 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ngas ci thub kyis 7rgyal ba rin wa che'i zhabs codag zin thub pa zhig bya rgyu dang / 'bri gung gtsang pa tshang gi bu bu mo'i 'dun thabs su bsu rgyur khas blangs/da dung yang rang ngos nas 'chod ched bla sman pa zhig la lham sgro ga phul te brtag pa zhus pa dang / sde drug rin wa cher thugs dam brtag pa zhus pas sman bla sde brgyad cig gto/nga gsungs kyang khyim du 7rgyal mchog yab sras gnyis kyi sku par bshams shing brgya ma chodad phul/ rgan rin chen mgon po dang / 'od zer rin po che'i yodangs 'dzin rgan bstan pa / cos kyi slo kros rin po che/ dge 'dun pa mchog ldan bcas dge 'dun bzhi grwa gdan drangs te brgya mchodad dang rnam rgyal tshe mchodag btang / 'bras spungs rgan lam rim rin wa ches bza' zla bso/da nams bag gror rin chen ril bu lnga gnang son byung /dgong mo de nged ma bu gsum gyis blta rtog 'og sdod skabs ha cang nad tshabs cher gyur pas ngas khyim mtshes kyi khang pa nas phar spo rgyu'i re ba bto/na yang 'dodad pa mi byed/ de nas mgrin nas hūr sgra 'dodan zhing dbugs kyi rgyu ba myur bas ngas 7rgyal mchodzig yab sras gnyis kyi sku par chen wa go/nyis mig la bstan te rgya gzhung gis rang thag rang gcod sprad nas 7rgyal dbang rin po che tshur phebs nas 7rgyal dbang yab sras mjal 228

230 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nga tshos rjes 'jug zhu sgo gang cir 'thus tshang zhus shing sku phung se ra shar gyi dur khrod du gdan drangs skabs mi nyag zhabs drung gis gtsos/ lha sar yod pa'i bla sprul bcu bdun dang dga' nye blo dkar dang grong pa khyim mtshes mi grangs brgya skor zhig gis sgos sne khyer nas gdan drangs/ de rjes 'das po'i lo mchod ma zin tsam la stod zung bsam gtan 'byor te gser dang ga'u lung pa de'i dpon pos 'phrog tshul bshad byung bas/ ngas ca dngos gzhan ma byung yang pad+ma ra ga nga la sprad rogs bshad kyang / 'go khrid der tshur sprad rogs lab na sprad mi yong ngam/ zhes brjod pa las rjes su sprad ma byung bas cung slo pham byung /bod rab byung lcags sbrel 1980 lo zla ba lnga pa'i nang btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab gnyis pa a ri don gcod bkras mthong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang / gzhon nu'i tshogs gtso slo bzang sbyin pa/ yu rob don gcod phun chogs dbang rgyal/ 'jar pan dang shar e she ya'i don gcod rgya ri pad+ma rgyal po bcas gzhon nu lnga lha sar phebs te thog mar gtsug lag khang du gnas gzigs phebs kyi yond pa lha sa'i mang tshonags nas shes rtogs byung 'phral/ mi mang brgya phrag mang po gtsug lag khang gi sgo 'gram du 'byor yang rgya las pas mang tshogs sgo 'gram nas yar ma/ btang bar bkag nas bzhag skabs mang tshogs rim pas mang du phyin nas 'ur mchongs 230

23༷ rgan mo'i ma bcodas drang gtam/nga tshos rjes 'jug zhu sgo gang cir 'thus tshang zhus shing sku phung se ra shar gyi dur khyodad du gdan drangs skabs mi nyag zhabs drung gis gtsos/ lha sar yod pa'i bla sprul bcu bdun dang dga' nye slo dkar dang grong pa khyim mtshes mi grangs brgya stodar zhig gis lha sa sne khyer nas gdan drangs/ de rjes 'das po'i lo mdzadad ma zin tsam la stod chung bsam gtan 'gyor te gser dang ga'u lung pa de'i dpon pos 'phrog tshul bshad byung bas/ ngas ca dngos gzhan ma byung yang pad+ma ra ga nga la sprad mo gas bshad kyang / 'go khrid der tshur sprad rogs lab na sprad mi yong ngam/ zhes brjod pa las rjes su sprad ma byung bas cung slo pham byung /bod rab byung lcags sbrel 1980 lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i nang btsan byedal bod gzhung gi sku tshab gnyis pa a ri don gtso da bkras mthong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang / gzhe na nu'i chodags gtso slo bzang sbyin pa/ yu rob don gcod phun zogs dbang rgyal/ 'jar pan dang shar e she ya'i don gathodad rgya ri pad+ma rgyal sngo bcas gachodan nu lnga lha sar phebs te thodag mar gtsug lag khang du gnas gzigs phebs kyi spongad pa lha sa'i mang chosags nas shes shodags byung 'phral/ mi mang brgya phrag mang sngo gtsug lag khang gi lha 'gram du 'byedar yang rgya las pas mang chogags sgo 'gram nas yar ma btang bar bkag nas bzhag skabs mang snu gas rim pas mang du phyin nas 'ur mchodangs 230

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ da31byas te 'khyam ru'i nang slebs/ sku tshab rnams bod rang skyong ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi khru'u krang gachogen pa bod mi las byed gcig gis gtsos/las byed 'asa' shas mnyam gtsug lag khang gi bar thodag gzim chung gi sge khung 'og phebs te/ bkras mthodang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal mchodag bi/sa mi mang la bkra shis bde legs kyi 'tshams 'dri gnang ba dang chabs cig sku tshab rnams re re bzhin ngo sprod gnang rjes/ sku tshab phun tshogs dbang rgyal mche ga nas mi mang la 7gong sa 7skyabs ma bodzin chen ngo mchodag sku khams gsal thang thodag bstan srid kyi mdzad 'phrin rgyas bzhin sku da pa dang / btsan gyol bod gzhung bzhugs sgar rda sar yod pa sogs ngo sgod gnang skabs mang chodags nas 7go nga sa 7skyabs mabo na chen wa mchodag sku tshe khri 'o/ra brtan pa shog bod rang btsan yin zhes skad 'bod lan mang byas rkyen sku tshab rnams rgya las pas gsang thabs kyis gtsug lag khang nas bzhugs gnas bod rang skyong ljongs mgron khang gnyis par phebs skyel zhus/nyin der nga'i bu dang rgan lam rim gyi dge phrug gras yin pa'i mi gnyis/ rang btsan a ma tshe ring lha mo'i bza' zla mchod mdzad/ shing bzo ba phur bu/ byams pa por kyog sogs/ paṇa chen 'os sprul gyi gsol dpon yin rma 'i chab ma〈sna ba bstan rnam gyi nang du 'dzoms nas de nyin skad 'bod byas pa dang / sku tshab rnam pas gsungs pa'i gnas tshul rnams yig 231

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 233bskur skabs kho nga gis deng skabs bud med rnams kyi skye lha bkag pa so/gas byed spyod ngan pas phyi ma mi lus kyang 'thob sa ma red/ de las mchod 'bul byas te so so'i phyi ma'i lam btsal na legs zhes bcadad/ kha 'e bas khyed phebs mkhan yin nam zhes dris so/nga ba nga rjes su sku nga gi yin/ 'di dag khyod kyis dga' ldan dgon par phul te ming dang gang yang bris mi dgos zhes bshad/nga yang bu mo khrid de bskyod nas dbang skur ri la bsang gtong ba'i skabs sku tshab gazlosgon nu rnams gsham nas phebs/ de ma thag mi mang rnams 'ur te sku tshab rnams kyi mtha' bstodar zhing phebs bsu zhus te bya g.yab nang gdan drangs/ dbul wa lha sa ba sprod gasnyadan byams pa ngo ra kye ga gis mi mang dbus tā la'i bla ma khri lor brtan pa shog ces skad 'bod dang po byas/ de nas rim pas dga' ldan gyi ri shur skad kyis khengs/ nga rang dang po gra sgrig ci yang med kyang mi mang dang mnyam tā la'i bla ma khri 'edzi brtan pa cadag ces skad 'awa da byas pas/ nga blta ho ga byed mi zhang lags kyis kyang skad 'bod mnyam du byed kyang nga la sha tshas rgyab nas 'then nas mdun du ma thon zhes pa'i brda gtong / gang mtshams nas bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzodams kyis chu btung zhes ba〈snad kyi 'dug pa rang ngo sa nas ga chodad rgyugs min mi shes par lus rngul nag gis chodas shing / bsang khug dang kha dkris/ zhwa mo bcas 233

nyin nyer gcig ge mi tshe/ 233bsgur skabs khong gis deng skabs bud med rnams kyi skye sgo bkag pa sogs byed spyod ngan pas phyi ma mi lus kyang 'thob sa ma red/ de las mchod 'bul byas te so so phyi ma'i lam btsal na legs zhes brjod/ kha lo bas khyed phebs mkhan yin nam zhes dris song ba nga rjes su yong gi yin/ 'di dag khyod kyis dga' ldan dgon par phul te ming dang gang yang bris mi dgos zhes bshad/ nga yang bu mo khrid de bskyod nas dbang sgur ri la bsang gtong ba'i skabs sku tshab gzhon nu rnams gsham nas phebs/ de ma thag mi mang rnams 'ur te sku tshab rnams kyi mtha' bskor zhing phebs bsu zhus te bya g.yab nang gdan drangs/ dbul po lha sa ba pho gzhon byams pa por kyog gis mi mang dbus tā la'i bla ma khri lor brtan pa shog ces skad 'bod dang po byas/ de nas rim pas dga' ldan gyi ri shur skad kyis khengs/ nga rang dang po gra sgrig ci yang med kyang mi mang dang mnyam tā la'i bla ma khri lo brtan pa shog ces skad 'bod byas pas/ nga blta rtog byed mi zhang lags kyis kyang skad 'bod mnyam du byed kyang nga la sha tshas rgyab nas 'azen nas mdun du ma thon zhes pa'i brda gtong / gang mtshams nas bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms kyis thu btung zhes brjod kyi 'dug pa rang ngos nas ga chod rgyugs min mi shes par lus rngul nag gis chos shing / bsang khug dang kha dkris/ zhwa mo bcas 233

na34 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/brlags/ ngas bu mo ra bsang khug gang du 'dug gam/ dris pas/ bu mo sa a ma smyo ba bzhin gang sar rgyug gi 'dug bsang khug ga par yod min ma shes zer/ de nyin skad 'bod de tsam la mtshams chod nas dgong dro bod rigs bza' tsho gnyis kyi rlangs 'khor nang bskyod/nga mo gtsang mdog tu slebs dus rgya gzhung nyen rtog pa ser thing nger bkrams shing rlangs 'khosgor tshang ma bkag nas zhib bsher dang dri zhib nan ngo byed/ nga tsho'i rlangs 'kho ra gyi kha 'o/ ba mar bab bcug ste gang nas yin min dang dga' ldan la don gang gi phyir bskyodad min bcas dris pa kha mo bas kong po nas yin tshul dang / dga' ldan si'u thang mjal bar phyin tshul bcas bshad/ nyen rtog pas rlangs 'kho ra btang chodag pa'i lag khyer 'alngo ga gi yin/ zhes bshad pa kha 'o/ ba'i bza' zla tre+e lha ra khams mo zhig 'dug pa des nga nad kyis zin pa sa bza' zlar lha sa mjal bar 'khrid sngagags byedas bshad yin/ gung khran tang gis snu sa dad rang mo sa sprad pas dga' ldan 'a khrid mkhan nga yin// rlangs 'khor gyi lag 'khyer ga re byas nas 'phredag gi yin nam/ zhes ce da gleng shugs che byas/ nyen rtewag pas khyed ga'i lag nas lag 'khyer 'phrog pa dang chung ma des tshur 'phyog res yud tsam byas te/ rlangs 'kho ra gyi lag 'khyer 'phrog dgos na kong ngo ra shodag ces mtha' mar khyo ga de'i ming dang kha byang bris nas btang tsam byung /234

da3༄ rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/brlags/ ngas bu mor bsang khug gang du 'dug gam/ dris pas/ bu mos a ma spyo ba bzhin gang sar rgyug gi 'dug bsang khug ga par yod min ma shes zer/ de nyin skad 'bod de tsam la mtshams chod nas dgong dro bod rigs bza' tsho gnyis kyi rlangs 'khor nang bskyod/nga tsho gtsang mdog tu slebs dus rgya gzhung nyen rtog pa ser thing nger bkrams shing rlangs 'khor tshang ma bkag nas zhib bsher dang dri zhib nan po byed/ nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor gyi kha lo ba mar bab bcug ste gang nas yin min dang dga' ldan la don gang gi phyir bskyod min bcas dris pa kha lo bas kong po nas yin tshul dang / dga' ldan si'u thang mjal bar phyin tshul bcas bshad/ nyen rtog pas rlangs 'khor btang chog pa'i lag khyer 'phrog gi yin/ zhes bshad pa kha lo ba'i bza' zla tre+e tor khams mo zhig 'dug pa des nga nad kyis zin pa sa bza' zlar lha sa mjal bar 'khrid rogs byos bshad yin/ gung khran tang gis chos dad rang mos sprad pas dga' ldan 'a khrid mkhan nga yin/ rlangs 'khor gyi lag 'khyer ga re byas nas 'phrog gi yin nam/ zhes rtsod gleng shugs che byas/ nyen rtog pas khyo ga'i lag nas lag 'khyer 'phrog pa dang zung ma des tshur 'phrog res yud tsam byas te/ rlangs 'khor gyi lag 'khyer 'phrog dgos na kong por shog ces mtha' mar khyo ga de'i meng dang kha byang bris nas btang tsam byung /234

nyin nyer gcis bi mi tshe/ 235ku ru zam par 'gyor skabs rgyu mtshan shod yukru ci yang med par rlangs 'khor tshang ma 'phrog pas gom pa spos nas nang du bskyod dgos byung /de nyin dga' ldan dgon par mo ḍa che chung bsdoms nyis brgya lhag slebs 'dug pas/ yar mar 'gro dus/ mo ḍa tshang mar mis khengs nas ru bsgrigs nas bskyod skabs mi mang gis mo ḍa 'i lnga ga nas rngarme lha na stad 'bod byas tshul rgya'i nyen rtog pas bshad pa rjes la go thos byung /dgong mo de nga tsho hrūgs 'dur bskongs nas rang rang gi bsam tshul shod bcug skabs nga la bsam tshul ci byung dri byung ba/ ngas mi tshang ma dang mnyam du tā la'i bla ma khri 'o/ra brtan pa sna ga ces skad brgyab pa yin/zhes bshad/ de nas nga'i spun nye pa sangs 'dzin bzung byas tshul dang bka' zur mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyi bza' zla sngon ma skal bzang sgrol ma 'khrid nas khyod gas ci zhig bskur ba dang / mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyi gcung po pa sangs ci zhig byed min/ dris pas/ skal bzang sgro la mas sgyu na gyi bza' zlas rgya gar nas phyu pa dang chu tshod bskur ba dang pa sangs dang lhan du rgyun nas gleng mo la tsam yang med ces gsal bshad byas/ tshogs 'du grol rjes nang du phyin pas bu slebs te a ma stabs legasdo// rgya gzhung gis btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab gnyis pa phud pas 'dzam bu gling la zhabs 'dren bzhag pa red ces lab/235

nyin nyer gcib gi mi tshe/ 235ku ru zam par 'byor skabs rgyu mtshan shod yu' ci yang med par rlangs 'khor tshang ma 'phrog pas gom pa sgos nas nang du bskyod dgos byung /de nyin dga' ldan dgon par mo ḍa che zung bsdoms nyis brgya lhag slebs 'dug pas/ yar mar 'gro dus/ mo ḍa tshang mar mis khengs nas ru bsgrigs nas bskyod skabs mi mang gis mo ḍa 'i thog nas rngam ston skad 'bod byas tshul rgya'i nyen rtog pas bshad pa rjes la go thos byung /dgong mo de nga tsho tshogs 'dur bskongs nas rang rang gi bsam tshul shod bcug skabs nga la bsam tshul ci byung dri byung ba/ ngas mi tshang ma dang mnyam du tā la'i bla ma khri 'o/ra brtan pa sna ga ces skad brgyab pa yin/zhes bshad/ de nas nga'i spun nye pa sangs 'dzin bzung byas tshul dang bka' zur mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyi bza' zla sngon ma skal bzang sgol ma 'khrid nas khyo gas ci zhig bskur ba dang / mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyi gcung po pa sangs ci zhig byed min/ dris pas/ skal bzang sgrol mas spyodan gyi bza' zlas rgya gar nas phyu pa dang chu tshod bsgur ba dang pa sangs dang lhan du rgyun nas gleng mol tsam yang med ces gsal bshad byas/ tshogs 'du grol rjes nang du phyin pas bu slebs te a ma stabs legab// rgya gzhung gis btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab gnyis pa phud pas 'dzam bu gling la zhabs 'dren bzhag pa red ces lab/235

23snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/sang nyin zhogs pa/ nga tshong khang gi sgo phye skabs sde drug rin po che'i gse la dalnga na ye shes bamo da nams sku nga ste/ a cag dpe bsags sku nga /sku tshab bod nas phud 'dug zer/ ngas/ bus sku tshab phud pa rgya mi'i zhabs 'dren red bshad kyi 'dug bshad pas/ bu de spyo ba min nam brjod bzhin pa'i skabs/ bu rkang 'kho ra btang nas yong / gsol dngo na gyis khyed ga re bshad dam zhes ngar ngar byed/ bus ngar ngar ma byed bod lam 'gro rgyug gi sku da red ces lan btab/nyin gung yol tsam la sde drug rin po che phebs nas bu la sku tshab chodags pa phud pa legs pa red ces bshad 'dug ci'i phyir legs sam/zhes gsungs song ba bus rgya gzhung gi byed stangs de rang gasna ngas sngun bsus kyi byed stangs shig yin pas/ nges par du ce ra 'khrul yin pa khas len bya dbo sa kyi red/ ces lan phul/ nyin de rgya gzhung gis sku tshab snu gas pa dawa na wa bye brog pa zhig gis phud pa las gzhung gis phud med tshul khyab bsgrags byas sa//236

235 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/sang nyin zhogs pa/ nga chong khang gi sgo phye skabs sde drug rin po che'i gsol dpon ye shes bsod nams yonang ste/ a cag dpe bsags song /sku tshab bod nas phud 'dug zer/ ngas/ bus sku tshab phud pa rgya mi'i zhabs 'dren red bshad kyi 'dug bshad pas/ bu de spyo ba min nam brjod bzhin pa'i skabs/ bu rkang 'khor btang nas yong / gsol dngo/na gyis khyed ga re bshad dam zhes ngar ngar byed/ bus ngar ngar ma byed bod lam 'gro rgyug gi yond red ces lan btab/nyin gung yol tsam la sde drug rin po che phebs nas bu la sku tshab chogs pa phud pa legs pa red ces bshad 'dug ci'i phyir legs sam/zhes gsungs song ba bus rgya gzhung gi byed stangs de rang gnongs sngun bsus kyi byed stangs shig yin pas/ nges par du nor 'khrul yin pa khas len bya dgos kyi red/ ces lan phul/ nyin de rgya gzhung gis sku tshab tshogs pa dpon po bye brag pa zhig gis phud pa las gzhung gis phud med tshul khyab bsgrags byas so //236

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 237nyer gsum/mi drag gcig gi mtha' mardugaspyi 'o/ 1980 zla 5 pa'i nang rgya nag gzhung gi spyi khyab sru'u ci hu ya'o phang bod du lta skor du slebs te lha sa'i bar skor sprang po ji yod blta bar yong skabs/ lha sa'i bar lha ra nang phyo gas mtha' nas slebs pa dang nye 'khor 'i/nga khul nas slebs pa'i sprang po rnams ru bsgrigs nas bar skor nang lto slong nas bsdad pa mthong skabs/ hū ya'o phang ha las te bod mi rnams dka' ngal chen lnga byung 'dug ces bshad/de nas yun ring ma song bar skabs de'i bod kyi dmar shog hru'u ci ren rung zhes pa rgya nag tu 'khrid de kho'i tshab dbyin pha thang zhes pa bslos nga/ dang / rgya nag gzhung gis phraged la 'o/ gnyis dbugs galta nga ngal gso zhes pa'i khral bsdu chags yang gi gu yangs srid byus lag bstar bya rgyu/ ting zha'o phing gis kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin ngo che dang mjal mo la gnang ste 237

nyin nyer gcig gi mi tshe/ 237nyer gsum/dze+e drag gcig gi mtha' mjugaspyi lo 1980 zla 5 pa'i nang rgya nag gzhung gi spyi khyab hru'u ci hu ya'o phang bod du lta skor du spebs te lha sa'i bar skor sprang po ji yod blta bar yong skabs/ lha sa'i bar sgor nang phyogs mtha' nas spebs pa dang nye 'khor 'ing khul nas spebs pa'i sprang po rnams ru bsgrigs nas bar skor nang lto slong nas bsdad pa mthong skabs/ hu ya'o phang ha las te bod mi rnams dka' ngal chen po byung 'dug ces bshad/de nas yun ring ma song bar skabs de'i bod kyi dmar shog hru'u ci ren rung zhes pa rgya nag tu 'khrid de kho tshab dbyen pha thang zhes pa bskos pa/ dang / rgya nag gzhung gis bod la lo gnyis dbugs gtong ngal gso zhes pa'i khral bsdu chags yang gi gu yangs srid byus lag bstar bya rgyu/ ting zha'o phing gis kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che dang mjal mol gnang ste 237

2 da rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/༷ nga ni rgyal gces pa yag shos yin pa bshad pa mo gas lha sa'i rgyang bsgrags nang nyin ltar bshad/yun ring ma song ba'i nyin zhig rta nag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi bu 'jigs med dbang 'dus spebs nas sru mo lags/ pa lags (rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med )gsang yib nas mi mang sman khang du bskyal skor bshad/ nga rang spyi tshogs brtsan pa yin pas lam seng 'gro mi thub rkyen sang nyin yonang gi yin zhes lan btab/ sang nyin ngas thabs shes kyis ja thang gar po phor pa gnyis btung pas gzugs yongs 'dar shig shig byed/ ngas nga'i blta rtog byed mkhan bud med rgyag yod dang dngos grub la nga sman khang du gtang rogs zhes bshad pas dngos grub kyang nga mnyam du yonang / sman pa rgya mo zhig gis snying 'phar gyi 'dug pa las ka bskul mi chog ces dngos grub log bcugasman pa der ngas spun mched nad pa zhig thug par yud tsam gtong rogs zhus te nyal khang nang yar 'dzul skabs/ 'khor ldan rkub stegs shig sgog kha che'i mi rgan 'dra ba zhig mthong / mi der skad cha dri rtsis byed skabs sngon gyi rdzig nyams che zhing snying stobs can gyi sgu ngo de yin pa ngo shes nas/ ngas bde sdug dris pa las skad cha zhib lhod ma byung / rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med mchog stod sgur zhing lus 'dar ba dang 238

238 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khenang ni rgyal gces pa yag ro/sa yin pa bshad pa sdunags lha sa'i rgyang bsgrags nang nyin ltar bshad/yun ring ma song ba'i nyin zhig rta nag bkras mthong cis 'jigs med kyi bu 'jigs med dbang 'dus slebs nas sru mo lags/ pa lags (rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med )gsang yib nas mi mang sman khang du bskyal skor bshad/ nga rang spyi chodags btson pa yin pas lam seng 'gro mi thub rkyen sang nyin sku nga gi yin zhes lan btab/ sang nyin ngas thabs shes kyis ja thang gar ngo 'o/ra pa gnyis btung pas gzugs sku ngas 'dar shig shig byed/ ngas nga'i blta rtog byed mkhan bud med rgyag lod dang dngos grub la nga sman khang du gtang mo gas zhes bshad pas dacadas grub kyang nga mnyam du sku nga / sman pa rgya mo zhig gis snying 'phar gyi 'dug pa las ka bskul mi ce ga ces dasngags grub 'o/ga bcugasman pa der ngas spun mched nad pa zhig thug par yud tsam gtong mo gas zhus te nyal khang nang yar 'dzul skabs/ 'kho ra ldan rkub stegs shig thodag kha che'i mi rgan 'dra ba zhig mthong / mi der skad cha dri rtsis byed skabs sngon gyi rdzig nyams che zhing snying stobs can gyi sku ngo de yin pa ngo shes nas/ ngas bde sdug dris pa las skad cha zhib lho da ma byung / rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med mchog stod sgur zhing lus 'dar ba dang 238

mi drag gcig gi mtha' cha/jug 339skad cha shod skabs ngag kyang dab dib byed/ ngas yon krang sman par nga spyi tshogs btson pa yin pa dang nad pa yin yang las ka mang sngo bskul gyi 'dug pas sman khang la yong chog pa'i lag 'khyer bzo rogs bshad pas sprad/ go skabs de dang bstun rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med thengs 'ga' mjal bar phyin pas gzugs 'khor ldan rkub stegs nas bzhengs mi thub kyang sems stobs sngar bzhin 'gyur med ngang gnas/ khong btson khang du lo bcu bzhi bcug pa dang gsang yib btson khang du zha la'i thog chu bshos nas 'khya/ ga bag steng sdod bcug pa dang / de rjes sman pas na tsha blta khul khab cig cung brgyab skabs khong gis dug khab yin pa shes pas/ khab lam seng 'then te lkog gsod gtong mi dgos/ mi mang dbus gsad rogs zhes dang / sge'u khung phyogs nas gung khran tang gis mi lkog gsod gtong gi 'dug ces skad 'a〈snad byas pa yin/ sman pas dug khab yin pa khas mi len yang de nas dug gis nus pas gzugs langs mi thub par gyur zhes nga la 'grel brjod sa/nang / bkra shis sna nag ma dang lhan cig gnas pa'i dpe ltar rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med sman khang du bzhugs ring lha smon ye shes tshul khrims kyang sman khang du slebs/ lha smon lce bskum mi thub pa'i nad cig 'phog pa mis bshad par 7paṇa chen rin po cher bskur ba btab pa'i ngan 'bras red zer/ lha smon yar thon yin yang sman khang 239

mi drag gcig gi mtha' /jug 239skad cha shod skabs ngag kyang dab dib byed/ ngas yon krang sman par nga spyi tsho gas btson pa yin pa dang nad pa yin yang las ka mang po bskul gyi 'dug pas sman khang la yong chog pa'i lag 'khyer bzo rogs bshad pas sprad/ go skabs de dang bstun rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med thengs 'ga' mjal bar phyin pas gzugs 'khodar ldan rkub stegs nas bzhengs mi thub kyang sems stobs sngar bzhin 'gyur med ngang gnas/ khong btson khang du lo bcu bzhi bcug pa dang gsang yib bcon khang du zha la'i sgog khru bshos nas 'khya/ ga bag steng sdod bcug pa dang / de rjes sman pas na tsha blta khul khab cig cung brgyab skabs khodang gis dug khab yin pa shes/ pas/ khab lam seng 'then te lkog gsod gtong mi dgos/ mi mang dbus gsad rogs zhes dang / sge'u khung phyogs nas gung khran tang gis mi lkog gsod gtong gi 'dug ces skad 'bo/da byas pa yin/ sman pas dug khab yin pa khas mi len yang de nas dug gis nus pas gzugs langs mi thub par gyur zhes nga la 'grel brjod gnang / bkra shis sna nag ma dang lhan cig gnas pa'i dpe ltar rta nag bkras mthong dza sag cis 'jigs med sman khang du bzhugs ring lha smon ye shes tshupa khrims kyang sman khang du slebs/ lha smon lce bskum mi thub pa'i nad cig 'phog pa mis bshad par 7paṇa chen rin po cher bskur ba btab pa'i ngan 'bras red zer/ lha smon yar thon yin yang sman khang 239

240 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/nang blta mkhan nyung ngu las mi 'dug cing dza sag cis 'jigs med la blta rtog byed mkhan ha cang mang /cis 'jigs med khong mi mang sman khang du sman bcos lo gcig lhag byas kyang rkang par drag skyes yong thabs med stabs/ khong gis nga'i rkang pa drag tu 'gro yi ma red/ gang yin zer na/ nga dang po btson bcug byed skabs bcon khang nang dgun khar sa 'khyag pa'i steng nyin mang po pus mo btsugs bcug ste 'thab rtsod dang dgag pa brgyab pa sogs mnar gcod mang po btang rkyen/ rkang pa'i pus mo snga sa nas skyon shor tshar ba dang skabs der khong tshos bdag med bzhag pa red/ deng sang nga la sman bcos byed pa phyi tshul tsam las don du phan thogs med gsungs te/ mtha' ma khong gi thub/sa re bzhin sman khang nas khong gi bu 'bring ba 'jigs dbang gi nang sgos nas yun ring ma song bar dus shig la skad grags che zhing snying stobs can gyi skye bo de'i sku tshe'i mjug bsdus pa red/khong 'das grong she 'gro skabs phung po dbor 'dren gyi ched mo ḍa zheg dgos pa rgyu gzhung 'brel yod sde tshan la zhu skabs mo ḍa yod ma red zer bshad par/ nga'i bus kho rang gi las ka byed sa nas rgya mi mo ḍa gtong mkhan ngo shes shig 'khrid de phung po gdan 'dren zhus/ khong grongs nas lo gcig lhag tsam song rjes nyin zhig rgya mis mya ngan zhu ba'i tshogs 'du 240

240 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/nang blta mkhan nyung ngu las mi 'dug cing dza sag cis 'jigs med la blta rtog byed mkhan ha cang mang /cis 'jigs med kho nga mi mang sman khang du sman bcadas 'e gcig lhag byas kyang rkang par drag skyes yong thabs med stabs/ kho nga gis nga'i rkang pa drag tu 'gro yi ma red/ gang yin zer na/ nga dang po btson bcug byed skabs btson khang nang dgun khar sa 'khyag pa'i steng nyin mang wa pus mo btsugs bcug ste 'thab rtsod dang dgag pa brgyab pa so/gas mnar gasgu da mang po btang rkyen/ rkang pa'i pus mo snga sa nas skyodan cadar tshar ba dang skabs der khong tshos bdag med bzhag pa red/ deng sang nga la sman bcos byed pa phyi tshul tsam las lnga na du phan the gas med gsungs te/ mtha' ma kho nga gi thus/sa re bzhin sman khang nas khong gi bu 'bring ba 'jigs dbang gi nang spos nas yun ring ma mo nga bar dus shig la skad grags che zhing snying stobs can gyi skye bo de'i sku tshe'i mjug bsdus pa red/khong 'das grongarngasmu 'gro skabs phung po dbor 'dren gyi ched mo ḍa zhig dgo sa pa rgyu gzhung 'brel yodad sde tshan la zhu skabs mo ḍa yod ma red zer bshad par/ nga'i bus kho rang gi las ka byed sa nas rgya mi mo ḍa gtong mkhan ngo shes shig 'khrid de phung khrod gdan 'dren zhus/ kho nga grongs nas lo gcig lhag tsam song rjes nyin zhig rgya mis mya ngan zhu ba'i cho gas 'du 240

mi drag gcig gi mtha' mjug 241'tshog gi red/ nga tsho spun mched tsho yong dgos zhes lan 'byor ba ltar nga yang phyin/ ngas de ni phyi tshul tsam red/ mi ni grongs tshar ba red zer bshad dus/ cis 'jigs med kyi bu mo rgan pas nga la nga tsho rjes shul bu brug bu dang bu mo khyon bco lnga yod pa'i mdun lam la phan gyi red zer/ bod rab byung lcags bya 1982 zla 8 tshes 31 nyin nga tsho lha sa lto phyogs don gcod khru'u khongs kyi zhwa yod mi grangs sum bcu so lnga yod pa rnams/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi gsung chos ra bar mi mang tshogs chen du 'khrid de nga cho tshang ma'i 1959 lo'i ngo log zing sgong sogs nyes ming bkal ba'i chab srid kyi zhwa mo nyin gcig la phud/ rjes su go sgos la kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che sku gong ma btson khang nas gu yangs thob ste/ pe cin du zhugs ring nyin ma zhig rgya nag rgyal yongs srid gros tshogs 'du'i tshogs zung bgro gleng sar/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches rgya nag rgyal yongasanang rig gsar skabs don med nyes ming bkal ba'i chab srid btson pa yod tshad sdon 'gro'i cha rkyen gang yang med par gu yangs gtong dgos skor/ dgongs 'char gnang bar der yod rig gsar gyi rdung rdeg phog pa'i rgya dpon tshang mas rgyab skyor byas rkyen ting zha'o phing gis btson pa rnams gu yangs btang bar grags/ nga'i zhwa mo phud de lta rtogs tshogs zung la dgongs pa zhu mi dgos par sems pa lhod shig shig ngang bar sgor du 'gro 241

mi drag gcig gi mtha' mjug 241'chodag gi red/ nga mo sprun mched chod yong dgos zhes lan 'gyor ba ltar nga yang phyin/ ngas de ni phyi tshul tsam red/ mi ni grongs tshar ba red zer bshad dus/ cis 'jigs med kyi bu mo rgan pas nga la nga chod rjes shul bu phrug bu dang bu mo khyon bco lnga yod pa'i mdun lam la phan gyi red zer/ bod rab byung lcags bya 1982 zla 8 tshes 31 nyin nga cho lha sa lho phyogs don gcod khru'u khongs kyi zhwa sku da mi grangs sum bcu so lnga yod pa rnams/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi gsung dzadas rwa bar mi mang snu gas chen du 'khrid de nga cho tshang ma'i 1959 lo'i ngo log zing slong sogs nyes ming bkal ba'i chab srid kyi zhwa mo nyin gcig la phud/ rjes su bo thodas la kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin sngo che sku lha nga ma batho na khang nas gu yangs lnga ba ste/ pe cin du zhugs ring nyin ma zhig rgya nag rgyal sku ngas srid gros chosags 'du'i tshajags chung bgro gleng sar/ 7paṇa chen rin sngo ches rgya nag rgyal yongasatang rig gsar skabs wa na med nyes ming bkal ba'i chab srid btson pa yod tshad sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gang yang med par gu yangs gtong dgos slor/ dgongs 'char gnang bar der yod rig gsar gyi rdung rdeg phog pa'i rgya dasngo na tshang mas rgyab skyodar byas rkyen ting zhaso/ phing gis bathongan pa rnams gu yangs btang bar grags/ nga'i zhwa mo phud de lta rtogs chodags chung la dpo ngas pa zhu mi dgos par sems pa ltod shig shig ngang bar skor du 'bo 241

na42 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/skabs gzig rgyab tshang gi a sgyu dge legs thug byung / nga tsho de spyodan thengs mang thug kyang gnyis ka chab srid kyi rostegs gnas casnag gnas rkyen skad cha nod pa'i go skabs med/ nyin der khyim du skad btang nas spyi lo 1958lor dang blangs dmag la phyin pa'i gcung po bu 'byug g.yong (slo bzang tshe ring )gi stodar dris/ a 'o/ dge legs kyis bshad par gcung lnga a 'brug mgon po bkra shis kyi sku srung byas nas gtsang shangs dga' ldan chodas 'khoter nas go tshon bton nas mtsho mo rag dang / byang lha ri'i phyogs dbra bo zhes pa'i g.yas g.yon la chu dang mdun 'dzing rag nas rgya dmag gis tshur lha la byas pas rang dmag thar sa med rkyen/ gcung po dang grwa pa bzhis 'bar rdzas lus (smu btags te 'dzing rag tu mchodangs nas srog slos btang ba dang /yang 'ga' res lha bo spra mosnag tu rgya dmag mdun mchodangs nas sku ga cadar ba so/gas mi snyan pa'i gtam 'dra min thos byung bas de ma thag zhwa mo phud pa'i dga' snang yal nas sems ma skyid pa zhig byung / lam seng gtsug las/ khang nyams gasku( zhu bzhin pa'i skabs 'khel bas jozung shakyu mu ṇi'i mdun gser kong zhig brjes pa dang mnyam/ 'das po rnams sdig ltung byang zhing dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa'i smon lam btab pa yin/242

242 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/skabs gzig rgyab tshang gi a pho dge legs thug byung / nga tsho de sngon thengs mang thug kyang gnyis ka chab srid kyi dogs gnas 'og gnas rkyen skad cha shod pa'i go skabs med/ nyin der khyim du skad btang nas spyi lo 1958lor dang blangs dmag la phyen pa'i gcung po bu 'byug g.yong (blo bzang tshe ring )gi sgor dris/ a pho dge legs kyis bshad par gcung po a 'brug mgon po bkra shis kyi sku srung byas nas gtsang shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor nas go tshon bton nas mtsho mo rag dang / byang lha ri'i phyogs dbra bo zhes pa'i g.yas g.yon la chu dang mdun 'dzing rag nas rgya dmag gis tshur rgol byas pas rang dmag thar sa med rkyen/ gcung po dang grwa pa bzhis 'bar rdzas lus ma btags te 'dzing rag tu mchongs nas srog zlos btang ba dang / mang 'ga' res spo bo spra mog tu rgya dmag mdun mchongs nas srog shor ba sogs mi snyan pa'i gtam 'dra min thos byung bas de ma thag zhwa mo phud pa'i dga' snang yal nas sems ma skyid pa zhig byung / lam seng gtsug lab/ khang nyams gso zhu bzhin pa'i skabs 'khel bas jom shakyu mu ṇi'i mdun gser kong zhig brjes pa dang mnyam/ 'das po rnams sdig lhung byang zhing dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa'i spon lam btab pa yin/242

mi drag gcig gi mtha' mjug 243nyer bzhi/'phags pa'i yul du bskyod/spyi lo 1979 nas bzung bod phyi nang gnyis su 'gro bskyod rang dbang cung thob pa nas bzung bod nas rgya gar du gnyen 'phrad dang / gnas sgor 'gro mkhan bod mi mang po zhig bskyod de 7gong sa mchog mjal tshul dang / rang gi gnyen nye rnams thug tshul bcas kyi gnas tshul thos/ nga cho ma bu gsum yang lha sa grong khyer phye rgyal pas thu/ ngas la thong mchan lag 'byer zhus te sgon rgyur re ba'i ngang gnas/spyi lo 1980 lor nga'i bu lha sa rdzas bsgyur bzo gra nas bod rang skyong ljongs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs su yig rgyugs gtong mkhan mi 30 yod khongs nas yig rgyugs lon pa mi lnga'i khongs su yod par brten/ lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang bod ljongs mi mang kun khyab rlung 'phrin bas khungs nang las sgyur byung ba ltar las bcar zhus/243

mi drag gcig gi mtha' mjug 243nyer bzhi/'phags pa'i ༷/la du bskyod/spyi lo 1979 nas bzung bod phyi nang gnyis su 'gro bskyod rang dbang cung jo ba pa nas bzung cadad nas rgya gar du gnyen 'phrad dang / gnas skor 'gro mkhan ngo da mi mang wa zhig bskyod de 7go nga sa mchodag mjal tshul dang / rang gi gnyen nye rnams thug tshul bcas kyi gnas tshul thodas/ nga tsho ma bu gsum yang lha sa spong khyer phyi rgyal ras khu/ ngas la thong mchan lag 'khye/ ra zhus te thon rgyur re ba'i ngang gnas/spyi lo 1980 lor nga'i bu lha sa rdzas bsgyur bzo gra nas bod rang skyodang jongs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs su yig rgyugs gto/nga mkhan mi 30 sku da kho ngas nas yig rgyugs 'i na pa mi lnga'i kho ngas su yod par brten/ lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang bod ljongs mi mang kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs nang las sgyur byung ba ltar las bcar zhus/243

245 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nyin zhig a pho bstan pa dang rgan rin chen mgon po/ mkhan pa lung dgon gyi grwa log blo bzang tshul khrims/ 'od zer dgon pa'i rgarma pa sangs bcas lha mo bla mtshor mtsho gzigs la phebs/ tshur 'byor ba dang phran la mtsho nang sgo 'gram khyi dkar po chen po zhig btags pa'i khang pa chen po zhig nang a pho ngag dbang skal bzang bsdad pa zhig mthong byung / khyed rgya gar la 'gro thub pa 'dug zer/ phran gyis a pho khyed tsho mtsho gzigs gang gi don du yin nam zhes/ dris kyang / don dag chen po ci yang med ces gsang ba byas/zla ba bzhi tsam rjes phru gu zung ngu zhig lha sar bsus/ ngas a phor 'grul pa chung ngu 'di su red dam dris pas snyal mgo dgon pa'i bla chung red brjod kyang / nyin zhig nga'i tsha bo 'jigs med kyis nga la bu thung de 'od zer rin po che yin sgor bshad/ ngas nyin zhig bla chung khyim du gdan drangs te sger mjal zhus te nga rgya gar la spebs sam/ a pho ngag dbang skal bzang thug pa 'dug gam/ mo cig thobs dang zhus pas/ yā yā gsungs nas ske la gyon pa'i phreng ba ser po phud de mo btab cing rgya gar la bskyod nas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang thug pa 'dug ces lan btab/ phyan ra bskyod lag 'khyer thad nga thengs 'ga' grong khyer phyi rgyal las khungs su —bskyod kyang ma spra da par lo gnyis bkag pas/ mtha' mar ngas phyi rgyal las 244

244 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nyin zhig a 〈sna bstan pa dang rgan rin chen mabo na 〈sna/ mkhan pa lung dgon gyi grwa log slo bzang tshul khrims/ 'od zer dgon pa'i rganu/ pa sangs bcas lha mo'i bla mtsho ra mcho gzigs la phebs/ tshur 'byedar ba dang phran la mchod nang snyad 'gram khyi dkar wa chen sngo zhig btags pa'i khang pa chen ngo zhig nang a sgyu ngag dbang skal bzang bsdad pa zhig mthodang byung / khyed rgya gar la 'gro thub pa 'dug zer/ phran gyis a 'o/ khyed chod mchos gzigs gang gi dodan du yin nam zhes/ dris kyang / don dag chen po ci yang med ces gsang ba byas/zla ba bzhi tsam rjes phru gu chung ngu zhig lha sar bsus/ ngas a 'o/ra 'grul pa chung ngu 'di su red dam dris pas snyal mgo dgon pa'i bla chung red brjod kyang / nyin zhig nga'i tsha bo 'jigs med kyis nga la bu chung de 'od zer rin po che yin slor bshad/ ngas nyin zhig bla chung khyim du gdan drangs te sger mjal zhus te nga rgya gar la slebs sam/ a 'o/ ngag dbang skal bzang thug pa 'dug gam/ mo cig sgyu bas dang zhus pas/ yā yā gsungs nas ske la gyon pa'i phreng ba ser po phud de mo btab cing rgya gar la bskyod nas a pho ngag dbang skal bzang thug pa 'dug ces lan btab/ phyane ra bskyod lag 'khyer thad nga thengs 'ga' bo nga khyer phyi rgyal las khungs su bskyodad kyang ma spra da par 'o/ gnyis bkag pas/ mtha' mar ngas phyi— rgyal las 244

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 245khungs kyi las byed der nga la lag 'khyer mi sgod pa gang yin nam/ da bar skad grags yod pa'i gung khran tang yon gyi nang mi dang / sde pa gzhung gi sku drag mi mang dkyus ma rnams kyang phyin song / sku mkhyen/ nga gtang rogs byos bshad pas/ dang po khyed rang so so'i sa khul nas dgag bya yod me/da dris/ de nas 'dir shog ces brjod/ de'i bar nga'i bu las khungs nas drag 'dems kyis rgya nag pe cin mtho slob kyi rlung 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi slob sbyong du rogs pa bzhi dang mnyam du bskyod/ bu rgya nag tu slob sbyong rjes si khron dang / kud kra'u/ yun nan sogs sa khul 'ga' shas kyi rlung 'brin las khungs nang sbyong brdar dang lta sgor stabs gcig tu lo gcig ma zin tsam 'gor/rgya nag nas phyir 'bo/ ra mtshams las khungs nas sgob sgong sbyang 'bras legs po byung 'dug ces bsngags brjod dang sbrags gla cha spar 'dug ces dga' sgo'i ngang bshad par/ ngas phyi rgyal las khungs nas lo gnyis phyin kyang 'a/ga 'khyer sprad kyi mi 'dug ces bshad/ bus nga la ngo shes 'go khrid las byed nga cho rig gsar skabs shog khag gcig yin pa zhig yod pa/kho deng sang phyi rgyal las khungs la yod brjod kyi 'dug ngas phyin chog khong la sngon ma dka' ngal 'phrad dus ngas rogs pa byed myong bas don dag yod na khong 'tshol bar shog zer gyis/ zhes lab nas bu phyin nas yun ring ma 245

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 245khungs kyi las byed der nga la lag 'khyer mi sprodad pa gang yin nam/ da bar skad grags yod pa'i gung khran tang yodan gyi nang mi dang / sde pa gzhung gi sku drag mi mang dkyus ma rnams kyang phyin song / sku mkhyen/ nga gtang rogs byos bshad pas/ dang po khyed rang so so'i sa khul nas dgag bya yodad re/da dris/ de nas 'dir shog ces brdzod/ de'i bar nga'i bu las khungs nas drag 'dems kyis rgya nag pe cin malnga slob kyi rlung 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi slob sbyong du rogs pa bzhi dang mnyam du bskyod/ bu rgya nag tu slob sbyong rjes si kho na dang / kud kra'u/ yun nan mo gas sa khul 'ga' shas kyi rlung 'phrin las khungs nang sbyong brdar dang lta stodar stabs gcig tu lo gcig ma zin tsam 'gor/rgya nag nas phyir 'alo/ ra mtshams las khungs nas sbedab sbyong sbyang 'bras legs lnga byung 'dug ces bsngags brjod dang sbrags gla cha spar 'dug ces dga' spro'i ngang bshad par/ ngas phyi rgyal las khungs nas 'o/ gnyis phyin kyang 'a/ga 'khyer sprad kyi mi 'dug ces bshad/ bus nga la ngo shes 'go khrid las byed nga dza rig gsar skabs casnag khag gcig yin pa zhig sku da pa/kho deng sang phyi rgyal las khungs la sku da bcadad kyi 'dug ngas phyin chog khong la sngon ma dka' ngal 'phrad dus ngas rogs pa byed myong bas don dag yodad na kho nga 'cho la bar cadag zer gyis/ zhes lab nas bu phyin nas yun ring ma 245

da46 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/song bar nga'i nang la 'go khrid kho rang slebs nas phyi rgyal la spun mched su yod dang / phar tshur 'brel ba yod dam/ zhes skad cha dris/ de nas nga'i bus phyir bskyod lag 'khyer zhu ched bod jongs rlung 'phrin las khungs la dgo ngas pa zhus skabs 'go khrid kyis khyed rang gi a ma ga dus sprodan na'ang sprad lcesgrog ces khas blangs/rjes su 'go 'khrid des tshe ring dbang phyug la pe cin mtho slob nas yi ge slebs pa rgya nag tu yang bskyar 'o/ gnyis cadab sbyodang la 'bo 'am/ zhes dris par/ a ma mig thang wa med thodag sding gi na tsha sku/da pas rogs pa dbo sa stabs rgya nag tu gnas skabs 'a〈sna yi min zhes lan btab/ ngas bu la yang bskyar rgya nag la slob sbyong 'gro dgos gang red dam zhes dris skabs/ bus nga yun nan du sdod skabs pe cin mtho slob kyi 'go khrid cig dang ngo shes kyis 'bre'/ ba yag po byung bas/ khong gis nga yang bskyar slob spyong byas na rjes ma mdun lam yag po yodad red ces bshad stabs bus khong la rogs pa byed rogs zhes bshad pa ltar kho nga gis las khungs brgyud yig ge bskur ba red zer/ nyin zhig lag 'khyer las khungs kyi 'go 'khrid cig gis mi gnyis las/ nang mi gsum kar lag 'khyer sprad rgyu min skor brjodad rkyen/bu mo sgrum ma yin pas bzhag rgyu byas pa yin/ rlung 'phricha/ las khungs kyi 'bo 'khrid kyis phar phyin nas tshur mgyordzogs 〈sna slebs sam zhes 246

245 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/song bar nga'i nang la 'go khrid kho rang spebs nas phyi rgyal la sprun mched su yod dang / phar tshur 'brel ba yod dam/ zhes skad cha dris/ de nas nga'i bus phyir bskyod lag 'khyer zhu ched bod ljongs rlung 'phrin las khungs la dgongs pa zhus skabs 'go khrid kyis khyed rang gi a ma ga dus thon na'ang sprad che ga ces khas blangs/rjes su 'go 'khrid des tshe ring dbang phyug la pe cin mtho slob nas yi ge spebs pa rgya nag tu yang bskyar lo gnyis slob spyong la 'gro 'am/ zhes dris par/ a ma mig thang po med thog snying gi na tsha yod pas rogs pa dgos stabs rgya nag tu gnas skabs 'gro yi min zhes lan btab/ ngas bu la yang bskyar rgya nag la slob sbyong 'gro dgos gang red dam zhes dris skabs/ bus nga yun nan du sdod skabs pe cin mtho sgob kyi 'go khrid cig dang ngo shes kyis 'bre'/ ba yag po byung bas/ khong gis nga yang bskyar slob spyong byas na rjes ma mdun lam yag po yod red ces bshad stabs bus khong la rogs pa byed rogs zhes bshad pa ltar khong gis las khungs brgyud yig ge bskur ba red zer/ nyin zhig lag 'khyer las khungs kyi 'go 'khrid cig gis mi gnyis las/ nang mi gsum gar lag 'khyer sprad rgyu min skor brjod rkyen/bu mo sgrum ma yin pas bzhag rgyu byas pa yin/ rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi 'go 'khrid kyis phar phyin nas tshur mgyogs po slebs sam zhes 246

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 247dris 'dug pa bus nga'i a mar snying gi na tsha tshabs chen sku da pas/ nga rogs par ma phyin na 'grig thabs med tshul bajo da nas/ rgya dpon zhig dang las mo gas slob grongags gnyis kyis khas rgyag byas te bu yang nga dang mnyam dgongs 'khrodal byung /nga gnyis thon khar rwa sgreng rin po che rgya nag nas phebs te gsol tshigs shig la mahron 'bod gnang byung / grogs po tshe ring dbang phyug da res rgya gar du phebs na 7skyabs mgon rin po ches nyar gyi red ces gsungs pa dang / chabs cig kho nga gis rgya nag nang bstan chodas chosags shig gis khong la phul ba'i gser gyi rtags ma chen po gcig yod pa 'di 7skyabs mgon rin po cher 'bul rgyu mngags shing / de nas gzim chung sbug nas gos chen ser po zhig gis btums pa'i deb chen po zhig kha phye ste/ 'ji/ ni bla skrul dang dge bshes khag gcig gis gdan sa khag dang rngo brang nas lo mang sku ngal bdag gir bzhes te bzhengs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i dkyil 'kho ra 〈snags/ dkyil 'khor gasgur gras khag gcig gi rdul dza na dkyil 'khor gyi ma dpe sha stag yin/rgya gar nang dgos mkho chen po yod stabs da bar nga mos phar bskur thabs thengs mang byas kyang chodas 'khel ba zhig ma byung bas/ da res khyed rang phebs skabs nges par du ma dpe 'di dag thabs shes gang drag gis 247

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 247dris 'dug pa bus nga'i a mar snying gi na tsha tshabs chen yod pas/ nga rogs par ma phyin na 'grig thabs med tshul brjod nas/ rgya dpon zhig dang las rogs sa ba grogs gnyis kyis khas rgyag byas te bu yang nga dang mnyam dgongs 'khrol byung /nga gnyis thon khar rwa sgreng rin po che rgya nag nas phebs te gsol tshigs shig la mgron 'bod gnang byung / grogs po tshe ring dbang phyug da res rgya gar du phebs na 7skyabs mgon rin po ches nyar gyi red ces gsungs pa dang / chabs cig khong gis rgya nag nang bstan tsho sa tshonags shig gis khong la phul ba'i gser gyi rtags ma chen po gcig yod pa 'di 7skyabs mgon rin po cher 'bul rgyu mngags shing / de nas gzim thung sbug nas gos chen ser po zhig gis btums pa'i deb chen po zhig kha phye ste/ 'angi ni bla sprul dang dge bshes khag gcig gis gdan sa khag dang pho brang nas lo mang sku ngal bdag gir bzhes te bzhengs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor sogs/ da kyil 'khor gtso gras khag gcig gi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor gyi ma dpe sha stag yin/rgya gar nang dgos mkho chen po yod stabs da bar nga tshos phar bskur thabs thengs mang byas kyang blos 'khel ba zhig ma byung bas/ da res khyed rang phebs skabs nges par du ma dpe 'di dag thabs shes gang drag gis 247

248 gon mo ma bcos drang gtam/rakhyer rogs gnang / lam bar du dka' ngal med pa ngas mo lung brtag pas snang dogs mi 'dug khyed rang gzhung gi gsar 'god pa yin dus lus bsher btang gi ma red ces gsungs/ nga'i bus snang dogs mi dgos thabs shes gang yond kyis phar 'khyol ba byed kyi yin zhes zhus/ de 'dra'i skabs shig la rwa sgreng rin po che'i zhabs phyi gra rgan zhig yod pa des yar yong nas / rin po cher nga la rgya sgor 100 tham pa zhig g.yar rogs zhus te/ nga'i bu la dngul de dag 7skyabs mgon rin po cher phul nas sku zhabs rwa sgreng da lo dgung skeg yin pas brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan gnang rogs/ zhes bshad song bas/ ra sgreng rin po ches nga'i dngul g.yar nas nga la zhabs brtan byed rogs zer mkhan 'di 'dra ga par yod red ces zhal shob gnang /de nas nga tsho mnyam du gung tshigs grub rjes rin po ches nga dang nga'i bu la rten 'byung mjal dar dang phyag rtags sogs gnang ste rin po che dang zhal gyes (1sa/khyim du spebs stabs ngas bu'i lto phad nang nas par slog brgyab pa'i rgya yig gi yig cha 'ga' zhig mabong byung bas/ ngas de ma thag bu la de tshong ga re red/ sus sprad byung ngam zhes 'dri skabs bus a ma lags skad ma bkyon dang de tsho da gin nga tsho 'gro sa de nas gnang byung / phar 'khyer dgos yod ces bshad byung bas nga'i sems nang lam bar du rnyog dra byung mi yong 248

248 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/(sprukhyer rogs gnang / lam bar du dka' ngal med pa ngas mo lung brtag pas snang ro/gas mi 'dug khyed rang gzhung gi gsar 'bo da pa yin dus lus bsher btang gi ma red ces gsungs/ nga'i bus snang ro/gas mi dbo sa thabs shes gang yod kyis phar 'khyodal ba byed kyi yin zhes zhus/ de 'dra'i skabs shig la rwa sgreng rin wa che'i zhabs phyi grwa rgan zhig sku da pa des yar sku nga nasdo / rin po cher nga la rgya stodar 100 tham pa zhig g.yar rogs zhus te/ nga'i bu la dngul de dag 7skyabs mgon rin po cher phul nas sku zhabs rwa sgreng da lo dgung skeg yin pas brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan gnang phrangags/ zhes bshad song bas/ rwa sgreng rin po ches nga'i dngul g.yar nas nga la zhabs brtan byed mo gas zer mkhan 'di 'dra ga par sku da red ces zhal cadab gnang /de nas nga chod mnyam du gung tshigs grub rjes rin po ches nga dang nga'i bu la rtem/ 'byung mjal dar dang phyag rtags sogs gnang ste rin wa che dang zhal gyes sdo/sa/khyim du slebs stabs ngas bu'i lto phad nang nas par spyodag brgyab pa'i rgya yig gi yig cha 'ga' zhig malnga nga byung bas/ ngas de ma thag bu la de tsho ga re red/ sus sprad byung ngam zhes 'dri skabs bus a ma lags skad ma bkyon dang de tsho da gin nga tsho 'gro sa de nas gnang byung / phar 'khyer dgos mo da ces bshad byung bas nga'i sems nang lam bar du rnyedag dra byung mi yong 248

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 249ngam snyam sems 'tshab chen po byung / nyin shas rjes a pho bstan pas nga gnyis la 7gong sa mchog la 'od zer rin po che'i yang srid thugs brtag zhu rgyu bskur byung bas/ de sngon nga la ma bshad pa der ngas a phor sgog kha rgya che na'ang 'gro sa skas 'dzegs red/ da bar gsang yang da lta'i nga gnyis la mi re thabs med chags 'dug ces bshad/ a phos ha ha ha zhes bgad/nga tshur yong khar 7rgyal ba rin po che dgung grangs re gcig gi dgung skeg zin pas de'i zhabs rim ched a pho bstan pa dang / rgan rin chen mgon po/ rgan 'jam dbyangs/ chos kyi blo gros sogs bla ma du ma zhig sku mtshams la bzhugs/phyi rgyal ba'i rlangs 'khor 'gram du 'gro mkhan zhig la bus thabs shes byas te/ rgya gar du mkho gnad che ba'i bya spu'i stod thung dang phur khebs rgyab sha sogs bsdo mas ca dngos do po bcu gcig tsam dang / bod gnas yig cha shing sgam zhig bcas yond/spyi lo 1983 zla 6 tshes 8 nyin bus thabs shes byas pa bzhin rgya gzhung sne len khang gi 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor zhig 'gram bar 'gro mkhan yod pa de'i lag 'khyer nyos te/ de nyin snga dror nga dang bu/ dga' gnyen blo dkar dang grong pa khyim mtshes kyis ja chang dang mjal dar g.yogs te phebs skyel zhu bzhin par/ khyim du prug gu skyes nas zla ba gcig lhag 249

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 249ngam snyam sems 'tshab chen ngo byung / nyin shas rjes a sgyu bstan pas nga gnyis la 7gong sa mchog la 'od zer rin po che'i yang srid thugs brtag zhu rgyu bskur byung bas/ de sngon nga la ma bshad pa der ngas a phor thog kha rgya che na'ang 'gro sa skas 'dzegs red/ da bar gsang yang da lta'i nga gnyis la mi re thabs med chags 'dug ces bshad/ a 11sa ha ha ha zhes bgad/nga tshur yong khar 7rgyal ba rin po che dgung grangs re gcig gi dgung skeg zin pas de'i zhabs rim ched a sgyu bstan pa dang / rgan rin chen mgon po/ rgan 'jam dbyangs/ chodas kyi 〈sna spyodas mo gas bla ma du ma zhig sku mtshams la bsdokyigs/phyi rgyal ba'i rlangs 'khoter 'gram du 'gro mkhan zhig la bus thabs shes byas te/ rgya gar du mkho gnad che ba'i bya spu'i stod thung dang phur khebs rgyab sha sogs bsngo mas ca dngos do po bcu gcig tsam dang / bod gnas yig cha shing sgam zhig bcas yod/spyi 'e 1983 zla 6 tshes 8 nyin bus thabs shes byas pa bzhin rgya gzhung sne len khang gi 'grul skyel rlangs 'kho ra zhig 'gram bar 'gro mkhan yod pa de'i lag 'khyer nyos te/ de nyin snga dror nga dang bu/ dga' gnyen blo dkar dang grong pa khyim mtshes kyis ja chang dang mjal dar g.yogs te phebs skyel zhu bzhin par/ khyim du phrug gu skyes nas zla ba gcig lhag 249

250 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/ma phyin pa'i bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms dang / khong gi bza' zla dngos grub don ldan gnyis bzhag nas bral mi phod pa'i ngang tshul ngang bar skor brgyud gtsug lag khang sgo 'gram du sbebs skabs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal mjal gsung gas dang / nang mi spun mched yang bskyar 'dzoms shing lha ldan jo bo rin po che yang yang mjal rgyu'i spon lam btab nas mkhar rnga rdung rlangs 'khor bab tshugs bar bskyod/de gar ca dngos rnams mo ḍa'i nang blugs rjes slar yang dga' gnyen zlo dkar dang spun mched tshos ja chang dang rten 'byung mjal dar g.yogs te rgya gar dang bal yul nas gnyen 'phrad du spebs te phar log mkhan bod mi khag cig mnyam mo ḍa'i nang thon 'go tshugs/pho brang pho tā la brgyud mo ḍa dal bur bskyod skabs slar yang lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas smon lam btab/ de nyin nga tsho 'grul pa rnams myang stod rgyal rtse rdzong du 'byor ma thag bus sdod khang g.yar rjes lam seng dpal 'khor chos sde sogs dgon pa khag tu mchod mjal du bskyod/ phyi nyin nyin dgung mtshams su myang smad gzhis rtser 'byor skabs kha lo bar re ba bton te gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun po dgon par mchod mjal zhus te de nyin dgong mo lha rtser bsdad/ de'i phyi nyin dgong dro phyi po zhig la 'gram du 'byor nas de gar rgya bal nas phar bod la log mkhan mang po mo ḍa sgug nas bsdad 250

250 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/ma phyin pa'i bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms dang / khong gi bza' zla dngos grub don ldan gnyis bzhag nas bral mi phod pa'i ngang tshul ngang bar skor brgyud gtsug lag khang sgo 'gram du sbebs skabs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal mjal gsung thodas dang / nang mi spun mched yang bskyar 'dzoms shing lha ldan jo bo rin po che yang yang mjal rgyu'i smon lam btab nas mkhar rnga rdung rlangs 'kho ra bab tshugs bar bskyod/de gar ca dngos rnams mo ḍa'i nang glugs rjes slar yang dga' gnyen slo dkar dang sprun mched tshos ja chang dang rten 'byung mjal dar gasku/gas te rgya gar dang bal ༷/la nas gnyen 'phrad du slebs te phar sku/ga mkhan lnga da mi khag cig mnyam mo ḍa'i nang the na 'bo tshugs/pho brang pho tā la brgyud mo ḍa dal bur bskyod skabs slar yang lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas spyodan lam btab/ de nyin nga cho 'grul pa rnams myang stod rgyal rtse rdzong du 'gyor ma thag bus sdod khang g.yar rjes lam seng dpal 'kho ra chodas sde so/gas dgo na pa khag tu mchod mjal du bskyod/ phyi nyin nyin dgung mtshams su myang smad gzhis rtser 'byedar skabs kha 'o/ bar re ba blta na te gdan sa chen wa bkra shis lhun ngo dbo na par mchodad mjal zhus te de nyin dgong mo lha rtser bsdad/ de'i phyi nyin dgong dro phyi po zhig la 'gram du 'byor nas de gar rgya bal nas phar lnga da la 'ostog mkhan mang 〈sna mo ḍa sgug nas bsdad 250

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ da51yod stabs/ sne len khang gi khang pa mis khengs nas nyal sa med par lha 'gram dang bar 'khyam du nga chog 'grul pa rnams bzhag byung yang / stabs legs pa zhig la nga'i bu dang sne len khang gi 'go khrid de lha sa nas cad shes kyi yod par brten sne len khang gi khang pa the ga rtseg gsum par khang mig gcig yod pa de bu nga gnyis la sprad byung / 'gram 'gag sgor nyin mtshan gnyis bsdad de dngul brje rgyag rgyu sogs las ka tshar rjes phyi nyin snga dro bal bod sa mtshams su sku nga skabs/ de gar bal yul gyi dodas skyel ku li zhes mi nag po gyon chas rnying rul dang rtsab ral gyon zhing lag tu thag pa 'khyer ba 'ga' sku1da pa nas ya nga ba'i skyod ba brgyad bdams pa yin/'gram 'gag sbed nas lha ra bi se bar char chus lam 'e ga yod stabs mo ḍa med par 'grul pa rnams nyin gnyis ring ca dngos rgyab tu 'khyer nas bo ma pa spos te 'bo dasku sa kyi 'dug 'gram 'gag lha/ nas thon skabs rgya mi'i 'gag sgo'i las byed kyis mi re re bzhin lag 'khyer dang ca dngos la brtag dpyad byed kyi 'dug pas/ nga'i bus rdul hrūn dkyil 'khor gyi ma dpe'i deb bya spru'i ltod thung gi bar tshang du blugs nas de'i sgang kor gyi stod gos chen po zhig gyon yod stabs/ deb 'di mngon gsal ma byung bar thar yang / 7gong sa mchog la 'bul ched rang dang gzhan gyis bskur ba'i rda yang dang / ḍam dkar bcu grangs bzhi/251

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ da51yod stabs/ sne len khang gi khang pa mis khengs nas nyal sa med par sgo 'gram dang bar 'khyam du nga cho 'grul pa rnams bzhag byung yang / stabs legs pa zhig la nga'i bu dang sne len khang gi 'go khrid de lha sa nas ngo shes kyi yod par brten sde len khang gi khang pa thog rtseg gsum par khang mig gcig yod pa de bu nga gnyis la sprad byung / 'gram 'gag sgor nyin mtshan gnyis bsdad de dngul brje rgyag rgyu sogs las ka tshar rjes phyi nyin snga dro bal bod sa mtshams su yong skabs/ de gar bal yul gyi dos skyel ku li zhes mi nag po gyon chas rnying rul dang rtsab ral gyon zhing lag tu thag pa 'khyer ba 'ga' yond pa nas ya nga ba'i skyo ba brgyad bdams pa yin/'gram 'gag sgo nas bha ra bi se bar char zus lam log yod stabs mo ḍa med par 'grul pa rnams nyin gnyis ring ca dngos rgyab tu 'khyer nas gom pa dza/sa te 'gro dgos kyi 'dug 'gram 'gag sgo nas thon skabs rgya mi'i 'gag sgo'i las byed kyis mi re re bzhin lag 'khyer dang ca dngos la brtag dpyad byed kyi 'dug pas/ nga'i bus rdul tshon dkyil 'khor gyi ma dpe'i deb bya spu'i stod thung gi bar tshang du blugs nas de'i sgang kor gyi stod gos chen po zhig gyon yod stabs/ deb 'di mngon gsal ma byung bar thar yang / 7gong sa mchog la 'bul ched rang dang gzhan gyis bskur ba'i rda yang dang / ḍam dkar bcu grangs bzhi/251

252 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/rgya nag gong ma'i sras rnams kyi ske rgyan rdzus shig bcas yond pa rgya dmag gis khyed gnyis bod du log yong skabs sprad chog ces nyar/ phyi rgyal nas bod du gnyen 'phrad du phebs pa'i rnying ma'i bla ma zhig gis gal che'i par gyi spyin shog gcig nga gnyis la bskur ba/ rgya dmag mdun bu'i lus nas zags kyang rgya dmag dngos por zhen chags che bas bu'i gser gyi mdzub dkris la mig g.yeng bas do snang ma byung ba dang stabs bsnyun/bus mdzub dkris 'di gung khran tang gis nga spra nga po bzos med pa'i dpang rtags yin zhes shod bzhin spyin shog rdog pas phar g.yugs/ de nas gsang ba'i thog bsgrugs te bal sa brgal thub pa byung nas nga tsho rta tha pa ṇi la ngal gso skabs/ nga tsho mnyam yong mkhan kha tsha ra tshong pa chos da res khyed rang gi bus byab bskyal song zhes bshad/ngas/ nga'i bus byab ga re bskyal song zhes dris par khong tshos da gin rdzus kyi ske rgyan de bal yul du btsong na ḍo lar stong phrag rag gi red zer/ de 'dras yin na da gin khyed tshos lab dgos kyang da tshar ba red/ nga tshor za skal yod ma red ces bshad pa yin yang / don du nga'i bu'i lus nas rdul tshon gyi ma dpe'i deb dang de min gyi yig cha dang spyin shog bcas rgya lag tu ma 'thebs par thar ba der dga' ba chen po skyes byung / nga gnyis bal yul bod gzhung don gcod du gnas tshang g.yar te bsdad skabs nyin 252

da52 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/rgya nag bo nga ma'i sras rnams kyi ske rgyan rdzus shig bcas sku/da pa rgya dmag gis khyed gnyis wa da du sna ga yong skabs sprad chodag ces nyar/ phyi rgyal nas bod du gnyen 'phrad du phebs pa'i rnying ma'i bla ma zhig gis gal che'i par gyi spyin shodag gcig nga gnyis la bskur ba/ rgya dmag mdun bu'i lus nas zags kyang rgya dmag dngo sa po ra zhen chags che bas bu'i gser gyi mdzub dkris la mig g.yeng bas do snang ma byung ba dang stabs bstun/bus mdzub dkris 'di gung khran tang gis nga spra nga po bzos med pa'i dpang rtags yin zhes sna da bzhin spyin sna ga rdo ga pas phar g.yugs/ de nas gsang ba'i sgyu ga bsgrugs te bal sa brgal thub pa byung nas nga chos rta tha pa rje la ngal gamo skabs/ nga snur mnyam yong mkhan kha tsha ra chogang pa tsharas da res khyed rang gi bus byab bskyal song zhes bshad/ngas/ nga'i bus byab ga re bskyal mo nga zhes dris par khong chodas da gin rdzus kyi ske rgyan de bal yul du btsong na ḍo lar stong phrag rag gi red zer/ de 'dras yin na da gin khyed tshos lab dgo sa kyang da tshar ba red/ nga tshor za skal yod ma red ces bshad pa yin yang / don du nga'i bu'i lus nas rdul cho na gyi ma dpe'i deb dang de min gyi yig cha dang spyin thodag bcas rgya lag tu ma 'thebs par thar ba der dga' ba chen lnga skyes byung / nga gnyis bal yul bod gzhung don gcod du gnas tshang g.yar te bsdad skabs nyin 252

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ na (3gsum tsam nas bal yul du gnas sgyu da pha yul gcig pa pad+ma tshe dbang gis sne len byas/bal yul du zla ba gnyis tsam sdod ring stag mo lus sbyin dang sgol ma gsung byedan ma sogs yod pa'i gnas tshang ma bskor rjes/ don gcod rin chen dar 'o/ lags dang / bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyis snga da gzhung la 'bul rgyu'i ca dngos ji yod khyed tshos 'bul mi thub pas nga tshos phul cog ces gsungs kyang / rgya mi'i dngul longari steng bod yig bak+ṣiṃs med pa zhig yod pa de bod rang btsan khungs skyel la phan skor bkra rnam nas gsungs pa ltar/ nga'i bus de 'dras yin na khyed rang gis bod gzhung la 'bul rogs zhes dngul lor de bkra rnam la sprad cing / de min nga la sgam gcig dang sgra 'dzin 'khor 'o/ gcig las med/ de gal srid rgya gar sa mtshams su 'anyugeg na/ de gar me sreg gtang gi yin zhes bshad/bal yul nas rgya gar bar wa da pa kha tsha ra tshong pa mnyam sku nga ste lam bar kar kor sna tshogs kyis sdi lir 'gyor thub tsam byung / lji lir slebs rjes la dwags rda ram sa'i rgyud smad grwa tshang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rdo rje mchog gi drung du nyin gnyis bsdad/ skabs de dus nga tsho mnyam bal yul nas rgya gar nang mo ḍa'i nang mnyam du sku nga mkhan sku zhabs gcig 'dug pas kho nga dpe mjo da khang du phyag las gnang gi yod gsungs shing /253

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 2 gsum tsam nas bal yul du gnas sdod pha yul gcig pa pad+ma tshe dbang gis ste len byas/bal yul du zla ba gnyis tsam sdod ring stag mo lus sbyin dang sgol ma gsung byon ma sogs yod pa'i gnas tshang ma bsgor rjes/ don gcod rin chen dar lo lags dang / bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyis bod gzhung la 'bul rgyu'i ca dngos ji yod khyed tshos 'bul mi thub pas nga tshos phul chog ces gsungs kyang / rgya mi'i dngul lor steng bod yig bskos med pa zhig yod pa de bod rang btsan khungs skyel la phan sgor bkra rnam nas gsungs pa ltar/ nga'i bus de 'dras yin na khyed rang gis bod gzhung la 'bul rogs zhes dngul lor de bkra rnam la sprad cing / de min nga la sgam gcig dang sgra 'dzin 'khor lo gcig las med/ de gal srid rgya gar sa mtshams su 'a11ga na/ de gar me sreg gtang gi yin zhes bshad/bal yul nas rgya gar bar bod pa kha tsha ra tshong pa mnyam yong ste lam bar gar kor sna tshogs kyis sdi lir 'byor thub tsam byung / lji lir spebs rjes la dwags rda ram sa'i rgyud smad grwa tshang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rdo rje mchog gi drung du nyin gnyis bsdad/ skabs de dus nga tsho mnyam bal yul nas rgya gar nang mo ḍa'i nang mnyam du yodang mkhan sgu zhabs gcig 'dug pas khong dpe mdzod khang du phyag las gnang gi yod gsungs shing /253

255 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/khong gis nga'i bu la khyed kyis deb mang po 'khyer yod gsungs kyi 'dub/ pes gal te deb yag po de 'dra yod na a ri'i dpe mdzod khang gis gong tshad mtho pa'i thog blu yon zhu yi red/ ngas 'brel ba bya rgyu'i thad rogs pa byas chog ces gsungs kyang nga'i bus deb 'di rnams bde srung drung che byams pa skal ldan la sprad rgyu yin/ zhes bshad song bas sku zhabs des yang bskyar gleng slong ma gnang /nga cho ldi li nas rda sar 'byor skabs phal cher spyi zla 7 pa'i nang yin pas 7gong sa mchog rgyud stod grwa tshang yod sa bstan 'dzin sgang ba/zhis sgar du phebs zin pa red zer/ nga tsho rda sar zhogs pa snga po zhig la 'byor te bod gzhung gi sne len ba bstan pa lags kyis rgyud smad grwa tshang gi mgron khang du 'jog gnang / rda sar zla ba gcig lhag bsdad ring bod gzhung sne len khang dang bde srung las khungs kyi skabs de'i drung che byams pa skal ldan lags sogs kyi sne len 'tshams 'dri gnang /de rjes nga dang pha yul gcig pa'i mnyam las khang gi 'gan 'dzin a pho rab rgyas kyis las shag yond sa'i smar khams pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi las shag tu nga gnyis sgo dgos brjod pa ltar/ sgos te sdod ring nyin zhig gi phyi dro dril bsgrags las khungs kyi drung che brag g.yab mdzes bcu chang bsod nams stobs rgyas lags nga tsho sdod sa'i khang pa'i nang phebs te/254

254 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/khong gis nga'i bu la khyed kyis deb mang po 'khyer yod gsungs kyi 'dus/ mes gal te deb yag po de 'dra yod na a ri'i dpe mdzod khang gis gong tshad mtho pa'i thog blu sku na zhu yi red/ ngas 'brel ba bya rgyu'i thad rogs pa byas chog ces gsungs kyang nga'i bus deb 'di rnams bde srung drung che byams pa skal ldan la sprad rgyu yin/ zhes bshad song bas sku zhabs des yang bskyar gleng khyodang ma gnang /nga tsho ldi li nas rda sar 'gyor skabs phal cher spyi zla 7 pa'i nang yin pas 7gong sa mchog rgyud stod grwa tshang yodad sa bstan 'dzin sgang sa/zhis sgar du phebs zin pa red zer/ nga hrū rda sar zhogs pa snga po zhig la 'byor te bod gzhung gi sne len ba bstan pa lags kyis rgyud smad grwa tshang gi mahron khang du 'jog gnang / rda sar zla ba gcig lhag bsdad ring bod gzhung sne len khang dang bde srung las khungs kyi skabs de'i drung che byams pa skal ldan lags sogs kyi sne len 'tshams 'dri gnang /de rjes nga dang pha yul gcig pa'i mnyam las khang gi 'gan 'dzin a pho rab rgyas kyis las shag yod sa'i smar khams pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi las shag tu nga gnyis spo dgos brjod pa ltar/ spos te sdod ring nyin zhig gi phyi dro dril bsgrags las khungs kyi drung che brag g.yab mdzes bcu chang bsod nams stobs rgyas lags nga tsho sdod sa'i khang pa'i nang phebs te/254

'phags pa'i yul du bskyod pa/ 255'tshams 'gidang 'brel bod nang gi gnas stangs slor gleng mol gnang ste yud tsam bzhugs te phebs khar/ nga'i bu la khyed rang rgya yig yag po mkhyen gyi yod ces thos byung bas/ nga tshor rogs pa zhig gnang thub bam/ zhes gsungs byung bas nga'i bus rogs pa ga re zhu dbo sa sam/ zhes zhus/ khong gis nye sngon 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 'jar pan du chibs sgyur skabs rgya nag nas slebs pa'i rgya mi'i shes skusgon can dang phyogeb phrug mang po zhig gis mjal kha zhu skabs/ sku mdun gyis bod nang yud tsam phebs 'dod yod skor bka' gnang dus khong tshos bod nang phebs rgyu med lugs kyi mdza na/ rgya nag nang gi gnas tshul mang dzege zhig 'kho da pa'i rgya yig deb chung zhig phul 'dug pa de khyed kyis bod yig nang bsgyur thub na nga tshos deb 'di par skrun bya 'char yod ces gsungs pa dang / chabs cig yig phad nang nas rgya yig/ deb chung gcig nga'i bu la gnang song bas bus shog grangs mang po mi 'dug ngas nge da bsgyur zhus chog ces zhus song bas kho nga gis thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin gsungs te phyir phebs/ngas bu la deb de'i skor dri skabs bus 〈〈dpyid kyi 'byug sgra 〉〉zhes pa'i rgya mi'i shes yon can chodas rgya nag gzhung la skyon bcadad byas pa'i deb chung red ces bshad byung bas/ nga'i sems nang rgya mi'i shes sku na can chodas rgya nag gzhung la dngos su skyon bcadad byed pa blo stobs che ba la snyam 255
