2snyo2 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/masnuran byed lha rgyal ri khri chen la bsko gzhag gnang na / gcig nas khong chodas rgyal gyi gdung rgyud yin/gnyis nas bsgu na khang nang langs phyogs brtan wa sku da dus mi tshang mas kho nga la rgyab skyodar byed kyi red snyam/ bo thodas la rgya gar mang gtso'i rgyal khab yin yang / lung pa chung chung de tsho'i rgyal por chab srid kyi dbang cha med kyang go ming sprad de lo re'i rgyal po'i dus dran la'ang srung brtsi zhu yi yod pa bo rgyu 'dug ces zhus par/ sku mdun nas rang dngos gnas gsar 'god pa rang red bzhag gnas tshul rtogs po 'dug ces bka' gnang /nga gnyis la 7gong sa mchodag gis bod nang gi gnas tshul mang po zhig bka' 'dri gnang ba dang bstun gzim chung nas gsol ja bstsal byung bas/ ha cang 'tsher po byung / gzim chung mjal kha grub mtshams nga gnyis pho brang nas mar thon yong skabs snga sa nas sgug pa'i nga tsho'i dga' gnyen tsā dkar a masnga byams pa lags kyis khyed gnyis mjal kha yag po byung ngam/phal cher chu tshod gnyirma tsam 'gor song / ga re zhus nas bsdad dam// zhes dris byung bas/ ngas bu la wa da nang gi gnas tshul mang po zhig bka' dri gnang song zhes bshad/ khong gis da yag po byung ba red/ ngas sha mog bzos yod pas nga'i las shag tu phebs zhes nga gnyis khote rang gi bzhugs gnas rnam rgyal gra tshang gi rme hron khang nang 'khrid byung /262

262 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/mtshon byed lha rgyal ri khri chen la bsgo gzhag gnang na / gcig nas khong chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud yin/gnyis nas btson khang nang langs phyogs brtan po yod dus mi tshang mas khong la rgyab skyor byed kyi red snyam/ go sgos la rgya gar mang gatsho'i rgyal khab yin yang / lung pa chung zung de tsho'i rgyal por chab sred kyi dbang cha med kyang go ming sprad de lo re'i rgyal po'i dus dran la'ang srung brtsi zhu yi yod pa go rgyu 'dug ces zhus par/ sku mdun nas rang dngos gnas gsar 'god pa rang red bzhag gnas tshul rtogs po 'dug ces bka' gnang /nga gnyis la 7gong sa mchog gis bod nang gi gnas tshul mang po zhig bka' 'dri gnang ba dang bstun gzim zung nas gsol ja bstsal byung bas/ ha cang 'tsher po byung / gzim zung mjal kha grub mtshams nga gnyis pho brang nas mar thon yong skabs snga sa nas sgug pa'i nga tsho'i dga' gnyen blo dkar a mdo byams pa lags kyis khyed gnyis mjal kha yag po byung ngam/phal cher thu tshod gnyis tsam 'gor song / ga re zhus nas bsdad dam// zhes dris byung bas/ ngas bu la bod nang gi gnas tshul mang po zhig bka' dri gnang song zhes bshad/ khong gis da yag po byung ba red/ ngas sha mog bzos yod pas nga'i las shag tu phebs zhes nga gnyis kho rang gi bzhugs gnas rnam rgyal gra tshang gi ma gron khang nang 'khrid byung /262

srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 2snyo3a mdo byams pa lags rgya gar nang gnyen 'phrad du phebs rjes khong sku thang bzhengs pa'i phyag rtsal phul du byung ba zhig yin pas/ rnam rgyal gra tshang dbu 'dzin gyis gtsug lag khang gi 'du khang nang chos rgyal mes dawa na rnam gsum gyi sku thang chen po zhig gsar bzhengs dgos pa zhus pa ltar/ khong gis bris gnang ba'i skabs red/ a mdo byams pa lags kyis bshad don la da gin khyed ma bu gnyis kyi sngon du mjal kha zhu mkhan de lha rgyal ri khri chen red/ khong rgya gar du gnyen 'phrad phebs nas ra ji pur zhugs nas da res thon mjal zhu bar bcar ba yin zhes da gin nga la gsungs byung zhes bshad byung /bu nga gnyis a mawa byams pa lags kyi sdod gnas nas meg ghan bud med mnyam las kyi khang par log yong skabs/ de gar yang pha yul smar khams nas yin pa'i rgyud smad gra tshang gi rgan chos dbyangs dang thub bstan yar 'phel gnyis sgo 'gram du yun ring sgugs pa yin zhes bsdad 'dug sgo lcags phye nas nang la 'dzul ma thag rgan cho sa dbyangs kyis mjal kha yag po byung ngam/ dus/ tshod ring po 'gor song / mjal kha zhu mkhan mang lnga 'dug gam zhes dris/ ngas mjal kha yag po byung / yin na'ang nga gnas tshul mang po zhig dran yong nas sa/ re zhu dgos min mi shes par mid pa 'gags nas ci yang zhu ma thub/ bu la bka' dri mang po gnang bas 263

srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 263a mdo byams pa lags rgya gar nang gnyen 'phrad du phebs rjes khong sgu thang bzhengs pa'i phyag rtsal phul du byung ba zhig yin pas/ rnam rgyal gra tshang dbu 'dzin gyis gtsug lag khang gi 'du khang nang chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku thang chen po zhig gsar bzhengs dgos pa zhus pa ltar/ khong gis bris gnang ba'i skabs red/ a mdo byams pa lags kyis bshad don la da gin khyed ma bu gnyis kyi sngon du mjal kha zhu mkhan de lha rgyal ri khri chen red/ khong rgya gar du gnyen 'phrad phebs nas ra ji pur zhugs nas da res thon mjal zhu bar bcar ba yin zhes da gin nga la gsungs byung zhes bshad byung /bu nga gnyis a mdo byams pa lags kyi sdod gnas nas meg ghan bud med mnyam las kyi khang par log yonang skabs/ de gar yang pha yul smar khams nas yin pa'i rgyud smad gra tshang gi rgan chos dbyangs dang thub bstan yar 'phel gnyis sgo 'gram du yun ring sgugs pa yin zhes bsdad 'dug sgo lcags phye nas nang la 'dzul ma thag rgan chos dbyangs kyis mjal kha yag po byung ngam/ dus/ tshod ring po 'gor song / mjal kha zhu mkhan mang po 'dug gam zhes dris/ ngas mjal kha yag po byung / yin na'ang nga gnas tshul mang po zhig dran yong nas sa re zhu dgos min mi shes par mid pa 'gags nas ci yang zhu ma thub/ bu la bka' dri mang po naganang bas 263

265 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bus gnas tshul ci yod zhus song zhes bshad skabs/ rgan chos dbyangs nas sku zhabs 'od zer gyi skor zhu rgyu byung ngam/ zhes dri dus gzhi nas nga'i kha nas a kha/ da gin 'di'i skor rtsa ba nas zhu rgyu dran ma byung / 'on kyang sku mdun nas yang bskyar rjes la khyed gnyis thug yong zhes bka' phebs song bas/ nyin shas rjes yang bskyar mjal kha gnang skabs tan tan zhu gi yin zhes bshad/ skabs der rgan khong gnyis kyis nga tshor rgyun du mjal kha rags rgyu khag po red/ khyed ma bu gnyis bod nas yong bas gzim zung mjal kha thob pa skal pa bzang po red ces lab dus nga'i sems nang cung ma bde ba zhig byung /yun ring ma song bar nyin zhig gi snga dro'i chu tshod 10 tsam la sne len las byed bstan pa lags kyis nga gnyis ma bu gnyis sar yong nas khyed gnyis nyin rgyab chu tshod 3 par mjal kha yod bsungs kyi 'dug bu rang la yig cha dang par yod pa rnams 'khyer rgyu ma brjed pa byos shig ces brda lan zhig gnang byung bas/ de ma thag ngas bu la yig ge dang par de cho ma lus byed dgos zhes lab nas gung tshigs stabs bde zhig zas te gyon gos gtsang ma gyon nas pho brang du bcar/nyin rgyab chu tshod 2/30 tsam la sku sger drung gzhon dge legs dar rgyas lags dang sku ngo skal 'gram lags nas nga gnyis pho brang nang 264

264 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/bus gnas tshul ci sku da zhus mo nga zhes bshad skabs/ rgan choges dbyangs nas sku zhabs cadad zer gyi stodar zhu rgyu byung ngam/ zhes dri dus gzhi nas nga'i kha nas a kha/ da gin 'di'i skor rtsa ba nas zhu rgyu dran ma byung / 'on kyang sku mdun nas yang bskyar rjes la khyed gnyis thug sku nga zhes bka' phebs so/nga bas/ nyin shas rjes yang bskyar mjal kha gnang skabs tan tan zhu gi yin zhes bshad/ skabs der rgan khodzing gnyis kyis nga ra rgyun du mjal kha rags rgyu khag po red/ khyed ma bu gnyis bod nas yong bas gzim chung mjal kha thodab pa skal pa bzang po red ces lab dus nga'i sems nang cung ma bde ba zhig byung /yun ring ma song bar nyin zhig gi snga dro'i chu tshod 10 tsam la sne len las byed bstan pa lags kyis nga gnyis ma bu gnyis sar sku nga nas khyed gnyis nyin rgyab chu tshod 3 par mjal kha yod sa/sungs kyi 'dug bu rang la yig cha dang par yod pa rnams 'khyer rgyu ma brjed pa gyos shig ces brda lan zhig gnang byung bas/ de ma thag ngas bu la yig ge dang par de cho ma lus byed dbo sa zhes lab nas gung tshigs stabs bde zhig zas te khyedan gos gtsang ma gyon nas pho brang du bcar/nyin rgyab chu tshod 2/30 tsam la sku sger drung gzhon dge legs dar rgyas lags dang sku lnga skal 'gram lags nas nga gnyis pho brang nang 264

srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 265'khrid de/ sku mgron khang du yud tsam bsgug rjes/ sngon du mjal zhur bcar ba'i mi gnyis phyir thon mtshams nga gnyis yar bcar nas sku phyag phul/ sku mdun nas gsol lcog sgang bzhag gnang ba'i bod nang gi par 'ga' shas shig yod pa rnams nga'i bu la ston gnang ste/ rang rgya gzhung gi gsar 'god pa yin pas mi 'di dag su dang su red ces bka' 'dri gnang bar bus mi de dag gi ming dang go gnas/ las 'gan ci zhig yin pa bcas gsal 11 zhus/ngo sgod zhus rjes bus rgya yig deb gcig sku mdun gyi phyag tu phul nas 'di ni bod nang rgya mi'i dmag mi dang / dpon rigs tshor slob sbyong sgod byed bod kyi sa khams chags tshul dang rang 'byung gter kha ji yod/bod kyi lo rgyus dang 1950 lo na sa 1979 bar rgya dmag gis bod nang las 'gul ci zhig spel ba/ rgya gar du btsan byol bod gzhung btsugs tshul sogs 'khod pa'i nang khul yig cha gal chen po red/ ces yar phul ba dang chabs cig bod nang dga' ldan dgon pa sogs stor shul gyang ro zing nger bzos pa'i par tshon khra can mang po zhig kyang phul/ 7gong sa mchog gis par de dag la gzigs te yud tsam ring thugs pham chen po'i ngang bzhugs te de nas rang la par de cho gang nas rags byung zhes bka' dri gnang skabs/ bus dga' ldan dgon pa gtor shul gyi par khag cig bod 265

srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 265'khrid de/ sku mgron khang du yud tsam bskug rjes/ sngon du mjal zhur bcar ba'i mi gnyis phyir thodan mtshams nga gnyis yar bcar nas sku phyag phul/ sku mdun nas gsol lcog sgang bzhag gnang ba'i wa da nang gi par 'ga' shas shig sku da pa rnams nga'i bu la stodan gnang ste/ rang rgya gzhung gi gsar 'god pa yin pas mi 'di dag su dang su red ces bka' 'dri gnang bar bus mi de dag gi ming dang boste gnas/ las 'gan ci zhig yin pa bcas gsal 11 sdokyis/sngo sprodzid zhus rjes bus rgya yig deb gcig sku mdun gyi phyag tu phul nas 'di ni bod nang rgya mi'i dmag mi dang / dpon rigs tshor slob sbyong sprod byed nge da kyi sa khams chags tshul dang rang 'byung gter kha ji yod/bod kyi 'o( rgyus dang 1950 'o/ na sa 1979 bar rgya dmag gis phra da nang las 'gul ci zhig spel ba/ rgya gar du btsan 〈snal the da gzhung btsugs tshul sku gas 'kho da pa'i nang khul yig cha gal chen wa red/ ces yar phul ba dang chabs cig bod nang dga' ldan dgon pa sogs stor shul gyang ro zing nger bakhrodas pa'i par chodan khra can mang wa zhig kyang phul/ 7go nga sa mchodag gis par de dag la gzigs te yud tsam ring thugs pham chen po'i ngang bzhugs te de nas rang la par de chod gang nas rags byung zhes bka' dri gnang skabs/ bus dga' ldan dbo na pa gto/ra shul gyi par khag cig bod 265

2snyosnyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nang mi 'gas bskur ba dang / mang che ba phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i ning ma'i bla ma zhig bod nang phebs skabs/ kho nga gis par brgyab pa dang khab/ cig mi gzhan gyis khong la phul ba'i spyin sna ga rnams gus gnyis rgya gar nang yong skabs bskur byung bas/ nye char rda sar 'gyor rjes bde srung drung che byams pa skal ldan lags kyis wa da nas 'khyer ba'i deb rnams mig stodan rogs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khong la phul skabs spyin shog skor 'phros mol byung ba/ khong gis spyin shog mang po 'dug pas de dag bshu bar 'gro song che rkyen/ kho nga gis mosnags pa gnang rgyu gsungs pa bzhin bshus nas tshur gnang skabs gzhi nas dbo na pa gto/ra shul gyi par yin pa shes/ par de tsho'i spyin phyosnag kha sngon 'gram 'gag sgor ngas gzab gzab ma byas par sa la zags kyang / rgya mi'i 'gag sgo'i las byed pas nga'i gser gyi mdzub dkris dang rda yang sogegs la mgo g.yeng nas dod snang ma byung ba ma gasnodags/ gal te khong chodas shes na/ gus dang a ma gnyis yang bskyar btson khang du 'aspro dbo sa chags rgyu yin kyang / daskadan mchodag gi bka' drin gyis kho nga chodas dod snang byung ma song zhes zhus/bar der 7bo nga sa mchodag nas gus mor/ a ma rang sa chu 'a'o/da kyi 'dug gam/ zhes bka' dri gnang byung bar ngas/ gus mo 'o/ rgan par sa chu ma 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal ma byung yang lo chung ba nga'i bu la rkang pa 266

266 gon mo ma bcos drang gtam/nang mi 'gas bskur ba dang / mang che ba phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i rnying ma'i bla ma zhig bod nang phebs skabs/ khong gis par brgyab pa dang khab/ cig mi gzhan gyis khong la phul ba'i spyin shog rnams gus gnyis rgya gar nang yong skabs bskur byung bas/ nye char rda sar rabyor rjes bde srung drung che byams pa skal ldan lags kyis bod nas 'khyer ba'i deb rnams mig ston rogs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khong la phul skabs spyin shog skor 'phros mol byung ba/ khong gis spyin shog mang po 'dug pas de dag bshu bar 'gro song che rkyen/ khong gis rogs pa gnang rgyu gsungs pa bzhin bshus nas tshur gnang skabs gzhi nas dgon pa gtor shul gyi par yin pa shes/ par de tsho'i spyin shog kha sngon 'gram 'gag sgor ngas gzab gzab ma byas par sa la zags kyang / rgya mi'i 'gag sgo'i las byed pas nga'i gser gyi mdzub dkris dang rda yang sogs la mgo g.yeng nas do snang ma byung ba ma gtogs/ gal te khong tshos shes na/ gus dang a ma gnyis yang bskyar bcon khang du 'gro dgos chags rgyu yin kyang / dkon mchog gi bka' drin gyis khong tshos do snang byung ma song zhes zhus/bar der 7gong sa mchog nas gus mor/ a ma rang sa zu 'phrod kyi 'dug gam/ zhes bka' dri gnang byung bar ngas/ gus mo lo rgan par sa khru ma 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal ma byung yang lo zung ba nga'i bu la rkang pa 266

srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 2snyo7skrangs pa dang 'bus so brgyab ste rma bzos pa sogs yong gi 'dugaces zhus par sku mdun nas lo rgan pas dka' ngal du ma spyad pas mkhregs po yod red/ ces ku re gnang byung /ngas glo bur 'od zer rin po che'i yang srid rtsad gcod slor skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu dran te snyan gseng zhus par/ sku mdun nas thus/sa brtag sa bon zhig bris nas rjes su nga chod thug skabs yar 'khyer thodagade ring mtshams 'dir bzhag gi yin/ zhes bka' phebs te mjal kha grub/dgon pa gshe/ra shul gyi par de rnams rjes su dril bsgrags las khungs nas dus deb dang gsar 〈snag nang khyab spel gnang ste/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod nang dgon pa gtor nas chos dang rig gzhung rtsa med bzos pa'i gdong ris ther bton gang legs gnang 'duganang la slebs pa'i rjes su ngas rgyud smad rgan chodas dbyangs dang thub bstan yar 'phel gnyis yar skad btang ste/ thugs brtag sa bon 'bri rgyu'i skor gros byas nas de snga lnga da nas bskur ba'i yi ge 'ga' yod pa rnams bsngogs pa dang / de'i the ga a pho bstan pas gsungs pa'i 'od zer rin po che sku phreng rim pa'i rnam thar bcas tshur bsdus te nga'i bu la thugasabartag sa nge na zhig bzhengs bcug pa yin/ bus bzhengs pa'i thugs brtag sa bo na ni/267

sprid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 267skrangs pa dang 'bus so brgyab ste rma bzos pa sogs yong gi 'dugaces zhus par sku mdun nas lo rgan pas dka' ngal du ma spyad pas mkhregs po yod red/ ces ku re gnang byung /ngas slo bur 'od zer rin po che'i yang srid rtsad gcod sgor skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu dran te snyan gseng zhus par/ sku mdun nas thubs brtag sa bon zhig bris nas rjes su nga tsho thug skabs yar 'khyer shogade ring mtshams 'dir bzhag gi yin/ zhes bka' phebs te mjal kha grub/dgon pa gtor shul gyi par de rnams rjes su dril bsgrags las khungs nas dus deb dang gsar shog nang khyab spel gnang ste/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod nang dgon pa gtor nas chos dang rig gzhung rtsa med bzos pa'i gdong ris zer bton gang legs gnang 'duganang la slebs pa'i rjes su ngas rgyud smad rgan chos dbyangs dang thub bstan yar 'phel gnyis yar skad btang ste/ thugs brtag sa bon 'bri rgyu'i skor gros byas nas de snga bod nas bskur ba'i yi ge 'ga' yod pa rnams bsdogs pa dang / de'i sgog a pho bstan pas gsungs pa'i 'od zer rin po che sku breng rim pa'i rnam thar bcas tshur bsdus te nga'i bu la thugasabartag sa bon zhig bzhengs bcug pa yin/ bus bzhengs pa'i thugs brtag sa bon ni/267

268 na mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/༄ rgya/ /7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po mchog gi zhabs pad mngon mabo'i drung du/gus 'bangs smar khams pa bu rdzong lha mo tshang sgol chos dang bu tshe ring dbang phyug nas gsol ba 'debs snying / mkhas grub bye ba'i gling gi 'byung gnas kun mkhyen 'od zer gling zhes grags pa'i dgon bdag kun mkhyen byang zub 'bum pa/ 'od zer sprul sku sku phreng rim byung gi mdzad rnam mdo tsam dgos dbang gi slad du snyan gsan zhus na/ dam pa de yi thog ma'i lo rgyus kyang srong btsan sgam po 'od zer las sprul ba'i tsan dan sbrul gye snying po bzhes mkhan dge slong a ka ra zhes bya ba der grags/ rnying ma'i chos rgyud 'dzin mkhan phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gye bstan 'dzin ma nor ba zhig kyang byung zhing / bka' brgyud pa'i ral pa can sku phreng re zung yang byung tshul 'dug de nas rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dngos slob sgang ri rgyal mtshan bzang po'i sras kyi thu bo mkhan po byang khrub 'od zer zhes su grags pa des garma rig pa'i rdo rje'i dbu bla gnang zhing / bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen gras byang sems shes rab bzang po la mkhan po khyod kyi gdul bya khams la yod ces bka' lung gnang yang / khong mkhas pa chen po'i thugs ma dgyes pa min nam/ nga yi bla ma dga' ldan du bzhugs yod/ rgyal tshab 268

268 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/ra༅༅/ /7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen lnga mchodag gi zhabs pad malnga na mtho'i drung du/gus 'bangs smar khams pa bu rdzong lha mo tshang sgrol chos dang bu tshe ring dbang phyug nas gsol ba 'debs snying / mkhas grub bye ba'i gling gi 'byung gnas kun mkhyen so/da zer gling zhes grags pa'i dgo na bdag kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pa/ 'od zer sprul sku sku phreng rim byung gi mdzad rnam mawa tsam dbo sa dbang gi slad du snyan gsan zhus na/ dam pa de yi lnga ga ma'i lo rgyus kyang sku nga btsan sgam po'i cadad zer las sprul ba'i tsan dan sgrul gyi snying wa bzhes mkhan dge lho nga a ka ra zhes bya ba der grags/ rnying ma'i chodas rgyud 'dzin mkhan phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi bstan 'dzin ma codar ba zhig kyang byung zhing / bka' brgyud pa'i ral pa can sku phreng re zung yang byung tshul 'dug de nas rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dngos slob sgang ri rgyal mtshan bzang po'i sras kyi thu bo mkhan po byang chub 'od zer zhes su grags pa des karma rig pa'i rdo rje'i dbu bla gnang zhing / bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen gras byang sems shes rab bzang wa la mkhan wa khyedad kyi gdul bya khams la sku da ces bka' lung gnang yang / khong mkhas pa chen po'i thugs ma dgyes pa min nam/ nga yi bla ma dga' ldan du bzhugs sku da/ rgyal tshab 268

srid na rnyed dka'i mjal kha dang / 'od zer rin po che ngos 'dzin/ 2snyo9rin po che'i mdun du zhu 'gro dgongs te dga' ldan la phebs skabs/ mkhan po byang chub 'od zer gyis bka' lung de 'dra zhig phebs byung bas 'di bden dang mi bden zhes bka' 'dri zhus par/ rgyal tshab rin wa ches khyedad b.ro/la 'dod pa ni lta ci spyodas khams la 'bo rgyu de phyis pa ma gto/gas snga mi 'dug pas/ 'phral du khams ri cad che'i nye 'dabs su khyed kyi gdul bya yod pas der phebs zhes gsungs te dbu zhwa rdzong mda' gnang /de nas byang sems khams la phebs te dbo na 108 bzhengs te gdul bya skar chomags ltar byung ste mdzad 'phrin nyi zla bzhin rgyas pa'i skabs der mkhan po byang chub 'od zer gyis sngar gsungs pa la yid ches te/ khong ni ma cadangs 〈snan gzigs mkhyen pa'i dam pa zhig yin par mo sa nas kun mkhyen ye shes byang chub chen po'i lam/ zhes pa'i gsol 'debs cad 'o/ ka gcig brtsams te dus da lta yang chodas ra bla mchodad nang du gsungs bzhin yod/ de nas sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bar phebs zin pas de dag si/ lo rgyus shin tu lnga mtshar che yang 'bri chodags che bas 'dir ma smos kyang / dam pa des gasgu ngo bram ze spyi 'dul ril bu la brten nas smad rgya nag yan chad la bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad de gong ma'i dbu bla gnang zhing / hu tho thu nyi ma han gyi mtshan snyan rgya nag tu shin tu grags/bod du yang sku phreng rim byung gis snga rjes su gdan sa ser smad 269

270 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/phyag btab cing / brag yer par byams pa'i sku gsar bzhengs skabs sku smad bzhengs zin mtshams sku stod rang byung gi 'khrungs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi lo rgyus dang / smar khams su yang 'od zer dgon gyis gcos dgon lhag grangs 21 dar spel byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin 'in tu rgya che ba byung ba bcas mtshams zhu/ da lan gyi zhu don gtso bo ste/ 'od sprul sku phreng bcu bzhi pa lo mang sngon du bal yul nang dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa de nyid kyi yang srid sku breng bco lnga pa de gzhi rkang byes 'byor ser smad grwa tshang dang / 'od dgon gye gra pas gco gyur smar khams ser skya spyi nas snga rjes su skyabs rje gling rin po che dang / khri byang rin po che/ gnas zung bcas khag so sor skyabs zhu lan mang zhus don/ sprul sku bod nang sku bltams pa'i bka' lung phebs pa bod nang go thos byung 'phral 'od dgon gyi grwa ming bstan pas yang srid rtsad gcod kyi 'khur dang bas blangs te/ spyi lo 1982 zla 6 nang lha mo'i bla mchor mjal zhu skabs thog mar yul khug kyog cig la mi tshang gnyis las med pa der phru gu mang po zhig gis rtsed mo rtse ba mthong / de'i nang phru gu lo 14 'am 15 min nam snyam pa zhig gis rgyab tu yul lha rong btsan dba' bo khro 'bar yis dbu skra g.yugs shing 'cham brgyab nas 'gro zhing / skabs 'gar grwa ming bstan par yang phyir blta byed pa dngos su mthong / de dang chabs cig sngar 'od 270

a po sgrug 'phrad dang su mo slebs pa/ na75srung khyi che chung gnyis nas khyi nag po che ba des dus rgyun mi la rmugs rkyang byed tshul grags kyang / nga gnyis sgo rar 'dzul nas ca dngos rnams bar 'khyam du bzhag ste ngal gsos nas bsdad skabs khyis lnga shes ltar/ nga gnyis kyi 'gram du nyal nas bsdad/yun ring ma song bar rgya gar zhwa mo gyon pa'i mi rgan zhig sgo rwa'i nang yar 'dzul sku nga ste/ bkra shis bde legs khyed chod snga sa nas nang la slebs 'dug ces bshad par ngas khyed su yin nam zhes dris/ mi des nga ngag dbang skal bzang yin/ sring mo khyed kyis nga cad mi shes sam zhes bshad byung / ngas a sgyu zhes 〈snang gi lag nas 'jus te a 〈sna rang zhe drag rgas 'dug ces bshad dus/ a pho sems chung bas de ma thag ngu skad rgyag gin dga' ngu shor song bas/ nga yang rang dbang med par de sngon 'dra chags pa'i ser mo ba de da cha skya cad mi rgan 'di 'dras shig chags 'dug bsams te mig chu shor bzhin ngus/a sngo sa gang mtshams shig nas blo bur dran sos pa lta bus nang gi lha lcags phye nas masgyu gas wa nang la yar sdod dang / da gin nas nga dga' thag chod de sgo phye rgyu ma dran pa red zer bshad de mgyogs po thab tshang nang phyin nas zlo dkar sku la gnyis 'khyer sku nga nas 10na la khyed gnyis zlo 'thung dang / sa cha der tsha ba chen po red/ ngas rgya gar ba rdzir rgyud smad du bza' 275

27snyo rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/zla dang phrug gu ce mkhyedags lnga cadag tses lan btang bar phyin go zhes bshad de nang nas phyir thon/ ring po ma 'gor bar a pho slebs pa dang nga'i bu la bltas nas 'di bu dbang phyug red dam/ da mi rgan chags 'dug sngon ma'i bzo la bsdad mi 'dus/ brjod cing a pho slar yang mig chu btang /nga gnyis spyi 'o/ 1959 zla 3 pa/'i nang ngo da kyi rgyal sa lha sa nas 'chi gson ji yin ma shes par kha bral ba nas bzung gi/ snga rgyus da rgyus bshad de yun ring song ba ma tshor bar de'i bar phrug gu bu gsum dang bu mo gcig bcas nang la cadar sku nga nas a zhe dang lnga lags bkra shis bde legs zhes 'awa da byung bas/ a sgyu sa bu rgan pa dodan grub dang 'bring ba tshe ring chos 'phel/ chung ba slo bzang dang chung shos bu mo tshe ring sgrol dkar red/ bu rgan shos bstan 'dzin da lta dang slob dmag sgar du dmag zhabs la sku da ces re re bzhin ngo sprod byed bzhin pa'i skabs/ 'o/ sum bcu sku la tsam gyi bud med khams gshis dwangs shing gzugs po ring po zhig ngo gdong dmar wa ra gyur nas nang la slebs pa dang / a ni dang bu lags bkra shis bde legs zhes/ lab bzhin par thab tshang nang du bskyodad/ a lnga sa bud med de kho rang gi bza' zla ang lha mo yin pa'i ngo sprod byas rjes ngas a phor phrug gu mang ngo 'dug 'tsho rten ga re mo da dam zhes dris dus/ a phos de sgyu na nga gnyis bza' cho gnyis bal yul dang / rgya gar bo la ka tar/ mum 276

275 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/zla dang phrug gu tsho mgyogs po shog tses lan btang bar phyin go zhes bshad de nang nas phyir sgon/ ring po ma 'gor bar a pho slebs pa dang nga'i bu la bltas nas 'di bu dbang phyug red dam/ da mi rgan chags 'dug sngon ma'i bzo la bsdad mi 'dus/ brjod cing a pho slar yang mig zu btang /nga gnyis spyi lo 1959 zla 3 pa 'i nang bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa nas 'chi gson ji yin ma shes par kha bral ba nas bzung gi/ snga rgyus da rgyus bshad de yun ring song ba ma tshor bar de'i bar phrug gu bu gsum dang bu mo gcig bcas nang la shor yong nas a ne+e dang jo lags bkra shis bde legs zhes 'bod byung bas/ a phos bu rgan pa don grub dang 'bring ba tshe ring chos 'phel/ thung ba blo bzang dang chung shos bu mo tshe ring sgol dkar red/ bu rgan shos bstan 'dzin da lta dang slob dmag sgar du dmag zhabs la yod ces re re bzhin ngo sgod byed bzhin pa'i skabs/ lo sum bcu yol tsam gyi bud med khams gshis dwangs shing gzugs po ring po zhig ngo gdong dmar por gyur nas nang la slebs pa dang / a ni dang bu lags bkra shis bde legs zhes/ lab bzhin par thab tshang nang du bskyod/ a phos bud med de kho rang gi bza' zla ang lha mo yin pa'i ngo sprod byas rjes ngas a phor prug gu mang po 'dug 'cho rten ga re yod dam zhes dris dus/ a phos de sdon nga gnyis bza' tsho gnyis bal yul dang / rgya gar kol ka tar/ mum 276

a po thug 'phrad dang bu mo slebs pa/ 277spel sogs la phyin nas tshong mang po brgyab cing / de nas ku lur za khang zin pa 〈snags kyis chosang lam 'a〈sna che yang mo'i a ma'i kha la nyan nas phyi rgyal la 'a〈sna dbo sa red ces/ mthar phyi rgyal la ma slebs bar gzhis chags de'i nang slebs te sote so'i sa zhing gi thodag rgya gar gyi sa zhing cadags ma blangs nas rma kan 'debs las byas pas lo gsum bsnyud mar ston nyes byung ba dang / 'o/ gcig lo legs kyang go nga tshad 'phar gyi red ces mi gzhan gyi ngag la nyan nas yun/ ring bcug ste bzhag pas/ tha ma rma kan la 'bu brgyab nas pham mong shor/ de nas dngul lhag gi slar yang sud chong brgyab nas 'o/ shas a'u tsam byung yang mtha' mar cho nga g.yog gis dngul brkus nas ma rtsa ma lon pa gyur te gang ltar bkra shis pa zhig ma byung bas/ su/da tshong bzhag pa yin/da cha nga la phrug gu mang lnga sku da pas sa zhing rgya che tsam sku da pa 'di dag yag po btab par brten/ anyu tsam mo nga gi 'dug pa dang / de'i thog ba phyugs sring rda ra a ma zhig sku da pa des be'u mo sha stag byung ste da cha ba phyugs bdun yodad pa de'i 'o ma btsongs nas nga tsho'i lo re'i zas gron 'phyid tsam 'dug khang pa lnga khang zhig dang / khang chung gcig yod dus mi sdod sa dka' ngal med/ de min mis 'asdu na mosnags byas na khang pa'i rgyab mdun sa zhing dang shing 'bras am ru dang pa pi ya sogs mang po yod kyang nga tshos 277

a po thug 'phrad dang bu mo spebs pa/ 277sbel sogs la phyin nas tshong mang po brgyab cing / de nas ku lur za khang zin pa sogs kyis tshong lam 'gro che yang mo'i a ma'i kha la nyan nas phyi rgyal la 'gro dgos red ces/ mthar phyi rgyal la ma slebs bar gzhis chags de'i nang spebs te so so'i sa zhing gi thog rgya gar gyi sa zhing bogs ma blangs nas rma gan 'debs las byas pas lo gsum bsnyud mar ston nyes byung ba dang / lo gcig lo legs kyang gong tshad 'phar gyi red ces mi gzhan gye ngag la nyan nas yur ring bcug ste bzhag pas/ tha ma rma gan la 'bu brgyab nas pham tshong shor/ de nas dngul lhag gi slar yang sud chong brgyab nas lo shas a'u tsam byung yang mtha' mar tshong g.yog gis dngul brkus nas ma rtsa ma lon pa gyur te gang ltar bkra shis pa zhig ma byung bas/ gu/da tshong bzhag pa yin/da cha nga la phrug gu mang po yod pas sa zhing rgya che tsam yod pa 'di dag yag po btab par brten/ mdu tsam yong gi 'dug pa dang / de'i thog ba phyugs sring rda ra a ma zhig yod pa der/ be'u mo sha stag byung ste da cha ba phyugs bdun yod pa de'i 'o ma btsongs nas nga tsho'i lo re'i zas gron 'phyid tsam 'dug khang pa lnga khang zhig dang / khang zung gcig yod dus mi sdod sa dka' ngal med/ de min mis 'byon rogs byas na khang pa'i rgyab mdun sa zhing dang shing 'bras am ru dang pa pi ya sogs mang po yod kyang nga tshos 277

278 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/g.yodag rgyugs thub kyi mi 'dug ces bshad de yud tsam mno bsams ngang gnas/ cung nas yang bskyar a phos/ sring mo khyed lo de dag nang dka' ngal chen po 'phrad yod kyi red/ gnas stangs gang 'dra yod dam zhes 'dri skabs ngas btson khang du bsdad pa dang lo nyi shu'i ring spyi tshogs btson pa zhes de snga'i tshe g.yog bran gaskusnag las dka' sdug che ba myangs ba dang /bza' zla btson khang nang 'das pa sogs sdug bsngal ji byung rnams bshad rjes nye ba'i lo gnyis gsum nang gzhi nas gu yangs srid byus cadag chodang las cung gnyer bar lam 'ahro byung lugs dang / gal che shos phrug gu gnyis na so/na nas las ka byed thub kyi yodad pas/ da res rgya gar du thug 'phrad du sku nga thub tsam byung / gal te a pho khyed la dka' ngal yod na/ ngas rogs pa byed thub kyi red ces shod skabs/ a pho dga' ngu shor nas sngon ma dang bsdur na nga 'tsho ba skyo yang / gzhis chags nang nas nga tsho 'tsho gos yag cadas brtsi yi yodad/ sku mdun gzhis chags su chibs sgyur gnang ste rgyud smad grwa tshang du bzhugs skabs gaskudal chas bzhes sa'i khra rgyan khra bkyag se gas kyis mtshongan ser chas dngul chas tshang ma nga'i nang nas g.yar gyi sku da ces bshad mtshams/ a pho'i bza' zla ang lha mo sa zhal lag mchodad gro gas zhes/ 'bras dang bag leb/ sha spongad tshal sne kha 'ga' shas/ co blugs 278

278 na mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/g.yog rgyugs thub kyi mi 'dug ces bshad de yud tsam mno bsams ngang gnas/ cung nas yang bskyar a phos/ sring mo khyed lo de dag nang dka' ngal chen po 'phrad yod kyi red/ gnas stangs gang 'dra yod dam zhes 'dri skabs ngas btson khang du bsdad pa dang lo nyi shu'i ring spyi tshogs btson pa zhes de snga'i tshe g.yog bran g.yog las dka' sdug che ba myangs ba dang /bza' zla bcon khang nang 'das pa sogs sdug bsngal ji byung rnams bshad rjes nye ba'i lo gnyis gsum nang gzhi nas gu yangs srid byus 'og tshong las cung gnyer bar lam 'gro byung lugs dang / gal che shos phrug gu gnyis na son nas las ka byed thub kyi yod pas/ da res rgya gar du thug 'phrad du yong thub tsam byung / gal te a pho khyed la dka' ngal yod na/ ngas rogs pa byed thub kyi red ces shod skabs/ a pho dga' ngu shor nas sngon ma dang bsdur na nga 'tsho ba skyo yang / gzhis chags nang nas nga tsho 'tsho gos yag shos brtsi yi yod/ sku mdun gzhis chags su chibs sgyur gnang ste rgyud smad gra tshang du bzhugs skabs gso/la chas bzhes sa'i khra rgyan khra bkyag sogs kyis mtshon ser chas dngul chas tshang ma nga'i nang nas g.yar gye yod ces bshad mtshams/ a pho bza' zla ang lha mos zhal lag mchod rogs zhes/ 'bras dang bag leb/ sha yond tshal sne kha 'ga' shas/ zho blugs 278

a po thug 'phrad dang ngu mo webs pa/ 279pa'i grang tshal bcas bsgrigs/ zhal lag mjug ma 'gril bo nga du ja dang sgo nga / chang pa yi bcas 'khyer ba'i grong pa gcig mjug gnyis mthud ngang yong ste nga gnyis la 'tshams zhu byas shing / de tsam ma zad nyin shas ring gzhis sgar de'i lnga khang dang bcu khang tshang mas dgong mo 'char can nged ma bu gnyis dang a pho bcas mahron 'bod byas te/ za btung gi sna drangs gzhas dang zhabs 1sna 'khrab nas sne len zhus par nga gnyis kyis kyang lha sa nas 'khyer ba'i ja leb chung dang / ja dkar cha re/ 'ga' shas la ghan ci dang nyal khebs mo gas stong min tshul du lag rtags sprad cing / a pho'i khyim la hin snyadar khri gsum tsam gyi rngan pa rgya nom pa sprad/de nas rgyud smad grwa tshang gi pha yul gcig pa'i grwa mang gis malha na 'bod ltar bcar te dgon pa'i grwa mang la sku 'gyed dang / bod lugs ltar bag tsha mar khu'i zhal lag bkyag par bla rgan chos thugs dgyes rung / rgya gar nang 'tshar longs byung ba'i gra gasno/na rnams mar khu mang bas nyung ngu las ma bzhes/ de nas cadang dkar cho sa sde dang / sngags pa grwa tshang / spel kob tu sku da pa'i gdan sa ser ra theg chen gling bcas la mchodad mjal dang /pha yul gcig par thug 'phrad byas te tshur hun sur la 'byedar mtshams spyod bur rgyud smad gra tshang brgyud/ bal yul nas nga'i bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms lha sa nas 'gyor te ring min sdi lir yong 'char gyi lan 'gyor 279

a po thug 'phrad dang bu mo spebs pa/ 279pa'i grang tshal bcas bsgrigs/ zhal lag mjug ma 'gril gong du ja dang sgo nga / chang pa yi bcas 'khyer ba'i grong pa gcig mjug gnyis mthud ngang yong ste nga gnyis la 'tshams zhu byas shing / de tsam ma zad nyin shas ring gzhis sgar de'i lnga khang dang bcu khang tshang mas dgong mo 'char can nged ma bu gnyis dang a pho bcas mgron 'bod byas te/ za btung gi sna drangs gzhas dang zhabs 1 1'khrab nas sne len zhus par nga gnyis kyis kyang lha sa nas 'khyer ba'i ja leb zung dang / ja dkar cha re/ 'ga' shas la ghan ci dang nyal khebs sogs stong min tshul du lag rtags sprad cing / a pho khyim la hin sgor khri gsum tsam gyi rngan pa rgya nom pa sprad/de nas rgyud smad gra tshang gi pha yul gcig pa'i gra mang gis ma1 na 'bod ltar bcar te dgon pa'i gra mang la sku 'gyed dang / bod lugs ltar bag tsha mar khu'i zhal lag bkyag par bla rgan tshos thugs dgyes rung / rgya gar nang 'tshar longs byung ba'i gra gachon rnams mar khu mang bas nyung ngu las ma bzhes/ de nas rdzong dkar chos sde dang / sngags pa gra tshang / spel kob tu yod pa'i gdan sa ser ra zeg chen gling bcas la mchod mjal dang /pha yul gcig par thug 'phrad byas te tshur hun sur la 'byor mtshams slo bur rgyud smad gra tshang brgyud/ bal yul nas nga'i bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms lha sa nas 'byor te ring min sdi lir yong 'char gyi lan 'byor 279

280 rganacimo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/rjes/ a pho dang nang gros skabs a phos bal yul bar bu mo bsu bar khong gi bza' zla ang lha mo phyin na legs tshul bshad/ gang yin zhe na/ kho nga bal skad dang hin skad gnyis ha cang bde bas lam bar du dka' ngal mi mo nga bas ngas de ltar mo sa mthun dang lam bo na cha tshang u tshugs kyis sprad/ ang lha mo thon nas nyim/ bco lnga las ma 'gor bar bu mo khrid de nang du 'gyor/bu mos bshad par a ma dang gcen lnga gnyis rgya gar du jo na pa nas bzung grong pa dang spun mched tshos nga la ya ma byas par nga rang gcig pur lus pa'i snang ba shar nas yud po byung bas/ nga'i bu mo mal 'byar gyis ga dus ngus kyang / ngas rtag par mo la kha btsum/ khyed ra'i don du nga la lag 'khyer the ba kyang 'alha thub ma se nga / zhes gshe gshe btang gi yod/stabs legs pa zhig la a ma khyed gnyis nas nga phar mgyodags rngo( thertog ces lan bskur ba 'byedar ma thag nga sdod 〈snas ma bcadad par sems 'tshab 'tshub tu gyur nas/ lam seng tsho nga khang nang ca dngo sa drag pa rnams lda ga bsgril nas dngul yodad tshad 'khyer te sru mo chodas g.yang la bu mo bcadal te/ bza' zla dngos gyub dodan ldan la khyim yag po srungs zhes ngo shes brgyud sne len khang du mo ḍa btsal nas yong ba yin/ bal yul la slebs dus lam bar dngul 'phrog mkhan mang po yod rkyen/ rgya gar bar dngul gyi ma 'dang dogs kyis gser gyi ske rgyan dkyil sku da pa'i gzi mig gsum pa ba4pangs nas bo nga 280

280 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/rjes/ a pho dang nang gros skabs a phos bal yul bar bu mo bsu bar khong gi bza' zla ang lha mo phyin na legs tshul bshad/ gang yin zhe na/ khong bal skad dang tin skad gnyis ha cang bde bas lam bar du dka' ngal mi yong bas ngas de ltar mos mthun dang lam gron cha tshang u tshugs kyis sprad/ ang lha mo thon nas nyir bco lnga las ma 'gor bar bu mo khrid de nang du 'byor/bu mos bshad par a ma dang gcen po gnyis rgya gar du thon pa nas bzung grong pa dang spun mched tshos nga la ya ma byas par nga rang gcig pur lus pa'i snang ba shar nas yud po byung bas/ nga'i bu mo mal 'byar gyis ga dus ngus kyang / ngas rtag par mo la kha btsum/ khyed ra'i don du nga la lag 'khyer thob kyang 'gro thub ma song / zhes gshe gshe btang gi yod/stabs legs pa zhig la a ma khyed gnyis nas nga phar mabyedags po nashog ces lan bskur ba 'byor ma thag nga sdod slos ma bzod par sems 'tshab 'tshub tu gyur nas/ lam seng tshong khang nang ca dngos drag pa rnams rdog bsgril nas dngul yod tshad 'khyer te sru mo chos g.yang la bu mo bcol te/ bza' zla dngos grub don ldan la khyim yag po srungs zhes ngo shes brgyud sne len khang du mo ḍa btsal nas yong ba yin/ bal yul la spebs dus lam bar dngul 'phrog mkhan mang po yod rkyen/ rgya gar bar dngul gyi ma 'dang dogs kyis gser gyi ske rgyan dkyil yod pa'i gzi mig gsum pa btsongs nas gong 280

a po thug 'phrad dang bu mo spebs pa/ 281yag po thob byung / lam seng a pho chos dbyangs la a mar lan gtong rogs zhes lab nas mo ḍa btsal te sdi lir yong ba dang / 7gong sa mchog sdi lir phebs pa dang dus mnyam red/ nga gcen po tshe ring dbang phyug gi gcung mo yin pa shes pas bde srung drung che byams pa skal ldan lags kyis lam seng gsar 'byor mnyam mjal kha btang gnang byung /mjal kha grub nas man 'ju kre la'i za khang nang 'gro dus a cag ang lha mo lags kyis nga rtsad gcod pa dang dus 'grig pas/ nga gnyis sdi lir nyin gnyis las ma bsdad par yong ba yin zhes bshad/ bu mo dngos su spebs skabs nga'i sems nang kha sdon sku mdun nas thugs smon gnang gi yin zhes bkar bzang phebs pa bzhin khong gi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyi bu mo bde thang ngang 'byor bar snying dbus dad gus chen po skyes byung / nyin shas rjes sku sger yig tshang nas gzhis las khang la nga'i bu mgyogs po rda sar yong thub na/ yag po 'dug ces zhal par gnang 'dug pas/ nga tsho ma bu gsum gzhis chags la lo gsar gtong 'char yang med pa bzos te/mgyogs po mon lto 'dod dgu gling la bskyod de gdan sa dga' ldan dang 'bras spungs sogs gnas mjal zhus te hun sur du phyir 'khor mtshams/a pho dang nang mi bu phrug lhan nyin shas dga' 'dzoms byas rjes sdi lir thon/bzhugs sgar du 'byor nas sku sger drung gzhon dge dar lags 281

a po sgrug 'phrad dang bu sa webs pa/ 281yag wa thodab byung / lam seng a pho chodas dbyangs la a mar lan gto/nga rogs zhes lab nas mo ḍa btsal te ldi lir yong ba dang / 7gong sa mchog sdi lir phebs pa dang dus mnyam red/ nga gcen po tshe ring dbang phyug gi gcung mo/ yin pa shes pas bde srung drung che byams pa skal ldan lags kyis lam seng gsar 'byedar mnyam mjal kha btang gnang byung /mjal kha grub nas man 'ju kre la'i za khang nang 'aspyod dus a cag ang lha mo lags kyis nga rtsad gcod pa dang dus 'grig pas/ nga gnyis lji lir nyin gnyis las ma bsdad par yong ba yin zhes bshad/ bu mo dngos su slebs skabs nga'i sems nang kha sngon sku mdun nas thugs smon sa/nang gi yin zhes bkasna bzang phebs pa bzhin kho nga gi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyi bu mo bde thang ngang 'gyor bar snying dbus dad gus chen po skyes byung / nyin shas rjes sku sger yig tshang nas gzhis las khang la nga'iñcabu mkhyedags lnga rda sar sku nga thub na/ yag wa 'dug ces zhal par gnang 'dug pas/ nga chog ma bu gsum gzhis chags la 'o/ gsar galho nga 'char yang med pa bakhrodas te/mgyogs po mon bho 'dod dgu gling la bskyod de gdan sa dga' ldan dang 'bras spungs sku gas gnas mjal zhus te hun sur du phyir 'kho ra mtshams/a pho dang nang mi bu phrug lhan nyin shas dga' 'dzoms byas rjes sdi lir thon/bzhugs sgar du 'gyor nas sku sger drung gzhon dge dar lags 281

28na rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/brgyud yig tshang la bu 'gyor yod ces snyan gseng zhus te nyin shas mjug slar yang nga zo ma bu gsum mjal kha zhig gnang ba'i skabs/ nga'i bu la gcung mo slebs song ba/ da khyed rang skyag rdzun ga re gra sgrig byed kyi yodad dam/ zhes gsung skabs nga dang nga'i bu gnyis kas 7rgyal ba rin po ches bka' gsung ci bsgrub zhu yi yin/ zhes zhus par/ yag waste 'dug bu la rang sang nyin nas gangs skyid dril bsgrags las khungs su 'brel ba byed shogangs yig tshang brgyud mar yig chung gtang gi yin/ da gzhung gi las byed chags grabs sku da/ yag po byed shog byab bskyal rgyu sku da ma red/ ces bka' phebs shing / nga'i bu la sku mdun nas smyug gu'i steng la slog gi chu phod sku da pa zhig gsol ras bstsal te mjal kha grub/ sang snga dro bu dril bsgrags las khungs su bskyod nas bshad don/ drung che mdzes bcu tshang bsod nams stobs rgyas lags mjal bcar du bskyod skabs khyed rang gang myur las bcar zhu dgo sa/ gang yin zhe na/ nye char the wan gyi gsar 'bo da pa gnyis sku mdun mjal kha dang gzhis chags khag la lta 〈snar du bskyod de gnas tshul ring wa zhig rgya yig nang bris nas bskur 'dug pas/ 'di bod bsgyur byed dgos kyi 'dug kha sngon khyed rang gis bsgyur b.li〈〈dpyid kyi 'grug sgra zerazerazhes pa bde srung bka' zur stag lhas gzigs dus yag po zhe drag bsgyur 'dug ces bsngags brjod gnang gi 'dug 'gro stangs 282

282 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/brgyud yig tshang la bu 'byor yod ces snyan gseng zhus te nyin shas mjug slar yang nga tsho ma bu gsum mjal kha zhig gnang ba'i skabs/ nga'i bu la gcung mo spebs song ba/ da khyed rang skyag rdzun ga re gra sgrig byed kyi yod dam/ zhes gsung skabs nga dang nga'i bu gnyis gas 7rgyal ba rin po ches bka' gsung ci bsgrub zhu yi yin/ zhes zhus par/ yag po 'dug bu la rang sang nyin nas gangs skyid dril bsgrags las khungs su 'brel ba byed shogangs yig tshang brgyud mar yig chung gtang gi yin/ da gzhung gi las byed chags grabs yod/ yag po byed shog byab bskyal rgyu yod ma red/ ces bka' phebs shing / nga'i bu la sku mdun nas smyug gu'i steng la slog gi zu tshod yod pa zhig gsol ras bstsal te mjal kha grub/ sang snga dro bu dril bsgrags las khungs su bskyod nas bshad don/ drung che mdzes bcu tshang bsod nams stobs rgyas lags mjal bcar du bskyod skabs khyed rang gang myur las bcar zhu dgos/ gang yin zhe na/ nye char the wan gyi gsar 'god pa gnyis sku mdun mjal kha dang gzhis chags khag la lta sgor du bskyod de gnas tshul ring po zhig rgya yig nang bris nas bskur 'dug pas/ 'di bod bsgyur byed dgos kyi 'dug kha sdon khyed rang gis bsgyur b.li〈〈daphyid kyi 'byug sgra ze ze zhes pa bde srung bka' zur stag lhas gzigs dus yag po zhe drag bsgyur 'dug ces bsngags brjod gnang gi 'dug 'gro stangs 282

ya po thug 'phrad dang bu po spebs pa/ 28 ltar khyed rang sngon la bka' drung yig tshang du bka' drung ngag dbang chos bzang lags thug par phegs rogs zhes zhal par gnang byung / zhes gsungs/ bus lam seng bka' drung yig tshang la bcar skabs bka' drung nas bu'i lo rgyus mdo tsam zhig bka' dri gnang ste bka' shag la snyan gseng zhus te lan gnang rgyu gsungs/bar der bde srung las byed ngag dbang chos ldan lags kyis nga'i bu la rgya gar 'brel mo da las khungs nas gnas tshul 'dri rgyu yond ces/ nyin grangs mang ོ zhig rda shod du 'jib 'khor nang 'khrid pa nga cung blo mi bde ba byung ste/ bu la khong tshos ga re dris kyi 'dug ces bshad pas/ spyir btang gi bond nang gi gnas tshul dris kyi 'dug a ma sems khral ma byed/rgya gar ba de tshos nga la ja dang zhal tog bkyag nas sku mgron bzhin byed/rgya mi'i byed stangs bzhin ma red ces bshad byung ba gzhi nas nga blo bde tsam byung / nyin zhig nga'i spun nye nang srid drung che mdo sngags lags kyis nged ma bu gsum mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar bskyod de nyin shas sdod ring / dril bsgrags drung che bsod nams stobs rgyas lags nga tsho'i mdun phebs te nga'i bu sang nyin nas dril bsgrags las khungs kyi las byed par bsko gzhag gnang ba/ bka' drung yig tshang nas da gin yig chung gnang rjes yar lan phul skabs rnam pa tsho nang srid drung che'i gzim shag tu phebs so zhes a pho rab 283

rdza po sgrug 'phrad dang bu sa webs pa/ 283ltar khyed rang sngon la bka' drung yig tshang du bka' drung ngag dbang chos bzang lags thug par phegs mothogs zhes zhal par gnang byung / zhes gsungs/ bus lam seng bka' drung yig tshang la bcar skabs bka' drung nas bu'i 'o/ rgyus mdod tsam zhig bka' dri gnang ste bka' shag la snyan gseng zhus te lan gnang rgyu gsungs/bar der bde srung las byed ngag dbang chos ldan lags kyis nga'i bu la rgya gar 'brel sku da las khungs nas gnas tshul 'dri rgyu sku da ces/ nyin grangs mang po zhig rda shod du 'jib 'khor nang 'khrid pa nga cung slo mi bde ba byung ste/ bu la khong tshos ga re dris kyi 'dug ces bshad pas/ spyir btang gi 〈snad nang gi gnas tshul dris kyi 'dug a ma sems khral ma byed/rgya gar ba de cho sa nga la ja dang zhal tog bkyag nas sku mgron bzhin byed/rgya mi'i byed stangs bzhin ma red ces bshad byung ba gzhi nas nga blo bde tsam byung / nyin zhig nga'i spun nye nang srid drung che mdo sngags lags kyis nged ma bu gsum mahron 'bod gnang ba ltar bskyod de nyin shas sdod ring / dril bsgrags drung che ba〈sted nams 〉wabs rgyas lags nga tsho'i mdun phebs te nga'i bu sang nyin nas dril bsgrags las khungs kyi las byed par bstod gzhag gnang ba/ bka' drung yig tshang nas da gin yig chung gnang rjes yar lan phul skabs rnam pa cho nang srid drung che'i gzim shag tu phebs sku zhes a 'o/ rab 283

284 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/rgyas kyis kha par gnang byung bas/ ngas thad kar lan phul bar mo nga ba yin/gsungs te yud tsam ring bzhugs nas phebs/phyi nyin snga po nas bu dril bsgrags las khungs su las bcar zhu skabs drung che bsku da nams skosnabs rgyas lags nas drung che las 'phar rgya ri rin po ches dbus/ las byed rnams ngo sgod gnang rjes rgya'i yig cha mang po zhig yodad pa rnams bod sgyur bya rgyus mchodan/ rgyun du drung che gnyis kyi lam stodan gzhir bzung las ka byed dgo sa pa'i bka' slob phebs rjes/bus rten 'byung tshul du spyi thab tu dmigs bsal gso/la ja ma ngags te zhal to/ga dang bcas 'degs 'bul zhu skabs/ drung che bso/da nams stostobs rgyas lags kyis zhal cadab dang sbrags nam rgyun spyi thab kyi ja de tsam yag khrod baXsna yi med kyang de ring ja yag po bzos 'dug pas/ khyed rang lam 'ahro yag lnga rgyugs pa 'dug ces gsungs tshul so/gas bu nang la 'o/ga sku nga nas dga' spro dang bcas te bshad/ de dang dus mtshungs lha rgya ri khri chen la 7gong sa rngoskyabs mabo na chen lnga mchothog nas skabs dgu pa'i ngo da mi mang spyi 'thus khongs thad bskos bsko gzhag sul skor dang / de min wa da nang rgya mi'i btson nas btson grol byung ba'i de snga'i gzhung zhabs rnying pa'i khongs zhe bo blo dar lags su bka' chodan bstod gzhag dang de min khag cig la wa da gzhung gi las byed bsko gzhag stsal skor bosto 1sgos byung / skabs der byes la sku(da 284

284 gan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/rgyas kyis kha par gnang byung bas/ ngas thad gar lan phul bar yong ba yin/gsungs te yud tsam ring bzhugs nas phebs/phyi nyin snga po nas bu dril bsgrags las khungs su las bcar zhu skabs drung che bsod nams stobs rgyas lags nas drung che las 'phar rgya ri rin po ches dbus/ las byed rnams ngo sgod gnang rjes rgya'i yig cha mang po zhig yod pa rnams bod sgyur bya rgyus mtshon/ rgyun du drung che gnyis kyi lam ston gzhir bzung las ka byed dgos pa'i bka' sgob phebs rjes/bus rten 'byung tshul du spyi thab tu dmigs bsal gsol ja ma ngags te zhal tog dang bcas 'degs 'bul zhu skabs/ drung che bsod nams stobs rgyas lags kyis zhal shob dang sbrags nam rgyun spyi thab kyi ja de tsam yag po bzo yi med kyang de ring ja yag po bzos 'dug pas/ khyed rang lam 'gro yag po rgyugs pa 'dug ces gsungs tshul sogs bu nang la log yong nas dga' sgo dang bcas te bshad/ de dang dus mtshungs lha rgya ri khri chen la 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas skabs dgu pa'i bod mi mang spyi 'thus khongs thad bsgos bsko gzhag stsal sgor dang / de min bod nang rgya mi'i bcon nas brtsan grol byung ba'i de snga'i gzhung zhabs rnyeng pa'i khongs zhe bo blo dar lags su bka' blon bsko gzhag dang de min khag cig la bod gzhung gi las byed bsgo gzhag stsal skor go thos byung / skabs der byes la yod 284

a po thug 'phrad dang su mo slebs pa/ na85pa'i mi 'ga' re dang chodags pa 'gas de'i thad mi 'dodad pa'i gtam gleng byung bar nga tsho dang shod res kyang byed dgos byung /smras pa/bden pa'i las kyi dpang dze sa//dka' ba spyad pa'i mi la//dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu//tshe mjug 'di la smin no//285

a po thug 'phrad dang bu mo spebs pa/ da85pa'i mi 'ga' re dang chogs pa 'gas de'i thad mi 'dod pa'i gtam gleng byung bar nga tsho dang shod res kyang byed dgos byung /smras pa/bden pa'i las kyi dpang pos//dka' ba spyad pa'i mi la//dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu//tshe mjug 'di la smin no//285

2 rgan /de ma bcos drang gtam/nyer bdun/dze+e che don ldan gyi tshe mjugaspyi lo 984 /de zla nang gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i 〈〈byangajab pemasadalo rma papa/deg pa 〉〉sogs bka' 'khrid dang dbang lung bka' drin ba/de gyi yod pa dang / mjug tu mdo stod zu sgang tshogs pas brtan bzhugs 'bul 'char yod pa'i gnas tshul thos 'phral/nged ma bu gsum yang rgya gar nang gnas mjal 'gro myong meng stabs da res kyi dus skabs 'di dang bstun/gnas mjal 'gro rgyu thag bcad de bu zla ba gcig las khungs nas dgongs pa zhus te/bzhugs sgar rda sa nas dmag zhabs zur pa mal gro bu lags nang mi dang mnyam nga tsho mi grangs bco lnga lto tshang byas nas pa ḍan goḍa brgyud me 'khor nang /gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du spebs mtshams gsung chos dang brtan bzhugs sogs 286

2 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/nyer bdun/rma tshe don ldan gyi tshe mardugaspyi lo 984 lo'i zla nang gnas mchodag ra rje gdan du 7bothong sa 7skyabs mgon chen 〈sna mchodag nas rgyal sras chen wa zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i 〈〈byangatwab semasadapo'i spyod pawā'ajug pa 〉〉sogs bka' 'khrid dang dbang lung bka' drin bstsal gyi yod pa dang / mjug tu mdo stod chu sgang chodags pas brtan bzhugs 'bul 'char sku da pa'i gnas tshul thos 'phral/nged ma bu gsum yang rgya gar nang gnas mjal 'bo myong meng stabs da res kyi dus skabs 'di dang bstun/gnas mjal 'gro rgyu thag bcad de bu zla ba gcig las khungs nas dgongs pa zhus te/bzhugs sgar rda sa nas dmag zhabs zur pa mal 〈sna bu lags nang mi dang mnyam nga cho mi grangs bco lnga lto tshang byas nas pa ḍan koḍa brgyud me 'khor nang /gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du slebs mtshamaX ༷sung chos dang brtan bzhugs sogs

mi tshe don ldan gyi tshe 'jug 287'e gas bsgrubs/ mjug bya rgod phung po ri dang / na lan ḍa/ lo drug dka' ba spyad yul sogs de /khul gyi gnas sku ngas rdzogs mjal te/ de nas wa ra na sir bskyod de khul de'i gnas yongs su rdzogs pa dang / chu mo gaṅga bcas 'e/gas par mjal nas bzhugs sgar du phyi 'o/ga gis thodad kyi 'o/ gsar btang ba dang / tshes gnyis nyin sku mdun mjal kha zhu rgyu sogs skal pa ha cang bzang /yun ring ma song bar nga'i bu mo ngo da nas mo nga skabs nas mngal du phrug gu chags yod pas skyes zla 'char te stabs legs pa zhig la bde les/sa sman khang dang / nga tsho sdod gnas thas/ nye yod dus dka' ngal ma 'phrad par phrug gu btsas kyang / phrug gu yang bskyar bu mo red/ zla gcig tsam nas sgo thon chose mjal dang 'brel/ sku sger yig tshang du bu mo'i ming zhus par bstan 'dzin mkha' 'alha zhes bcinga'i//nga'i tsha mo chung ba skyes nas zla ba bdun sku nga mtshams bod nas yig ge zhis/ 'byor ba'i nang lo gnyis la son pa'i nga'icabu mo'i bu mo sgrol dkar bde min gyis mkhyodags myur 'o/ga dbo sa lugs 'kho da yod stabs/ bu mo phar los/ rgyu dang zla ba bdun las ma phyin pa'i tsha mo bstan 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dir bzhag rgyu byas kyang / tsha mo bstan 'dzin mkha' 'bo bde legs sman khang du skyes par brten skabs de'i 'brel yod las byed bsod nams tshe ring 287

mi che don ldan gyi tshe 'jug 287'e gas bsgrubs/ mjug bya rgod phung po ri dang / na lan ḍa/ lo drug dka' ba spyad yul sogs de /khrul gyi gnas yongs rdzogs mjal te/ de nas wa ra na sir bskyod de khul de'i gnas yongs su rdzogs pa dang / zu mo gaṅga bcas 'e/gas par mjal nas bzhugs sgar du phyi log gis bod kyi lo gsar btang ba dang / tshes gnyis nyin sku mdun mjal kha zhu rgyu sogs skal pa ha cang bzang /yun ring ma song bar nga'i bu mo bod nas yong skabs nas mngal du phrug gu chags yod pas skyes zla 'char te stabs legs pa zhig la bde legs sman khang dang / nga tsho sdod gnas thas nye yod dus dka' ngal ma 'phrad par phrug gu btsas kyang / phrug gu yang bskyar bu mo red/ zla gcig tsam nas sgo sgon tshose mjal dang 'brel/ sku sger yig tshang du bu mo'i ming zhus par bstan 'dzin mkha' 'gro zhes bas /nga'i tsha mo chung ba skyes nas zla ba bdun song mtshams bod nas yig ge zhig 'byor ba'i nang lo gnyis la son pa'i nga'i bu mo'i bu mo sgol dkar bde min gyis mgyogs myur log dgos lugs 'khod yod stabs/ bu mo phar los rgyu dang zla ba bdun las ma phyen pa'i tsha mo bstan 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dir bzhag rgyu byas kyang / tsha mo bstan 'dzin mkha' 'gro bde legs sman khang du sgyes par brten skabs de'i 'brel yod las byed bsod nams tshe ring 287

288 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/nas slob 'jug ched sngo sa sbyor len skabs/ gsar 'byedar yin min gyis lha ga gleng mang wa bshad kyang dril bsgrags las khungs kyi las byed lha bzang tshe ring nas gsal bshad gro gas ram gnang rjes/ lha sku rje btsun pad+ma mchodag nas rda steng ro/da khyim byis gso khang du bzhes gnang ba mo gas/ de'i skor nga dang bus rjes su ma gtogs shes rtogs ma byung / nga dang nga'i bu mo gnyis rda sa nas bal yul du thon pa dang bu mo nyin shas rjes gsar 'khyodar ba khag cig mnyam bal yul nas lha sar 'o/ga ste bde 'byedar dang / bu mo chung ngu drag skyes byung ba'i yig ge 'gyor yang / ring po ma phyin par nga'i bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms la bu'i las khungs nas bu btsan gyol gzhung gi las byed nang zhugs pa shes rtewags byung ste/ nyin grangs mang wa bu mo ra bsun 'tsher che ba'i 'dri rtsad byas te/ mjug tu bu las khungs nas phyir 'bud byas skor rang skyong ljongs las khungs tshang ma'i nang khyab bsgrags byas/da dung de sngon nga'i lta rtogs tshogs mi yin pa'i grong mi u yodan lhan khang gi bde 'jags u yodan bud med rgyag lo da dang dngos grub gnyis kyis nga'i bu mor/ nga dang nga'i bu ga dus log yong gi red ces dri rtsad thengs mang byas par/ bu mo 'u thug nas/ khyed gnyis 'gyon ngo yod na rgya gar du bskyodad de a ma dang gcen wa 'khrid cadag ces khra log brgyab rkyen/ kho gnyis kyis lag pa bkyag pa ma zad/ bu mo ra lda ga rgyag 288

288 na mo ma bcos drang gtam/nas sgob 'jug ched ngos sbyor len skabs/ gsar 'byor yin min gyis rnyog gleng mang po bshad kyang dril bsgrags las khungs kyi las byed lha bzang tshe ring nas gsal bshad rogs ram gnang rjes/ lha sku rje btsun pad+ma mchog nas rda steng bod khyim byis gso khang du bzhes gnang ba sogs/ de'i skor nga dang bus rjes su ma gtogs shes rtogs ma byung / nga dang nga'i bu mo gnyis rda sa nas bal yul du thon pa dang bu mo nyin shas rjes gsar 'byor ba khag cig mnyam bal yul nas lha sar log ste bde 'byor dang / bu mo thung ngu drag skyes byung ba'i yig ge 'byor yang / ring po ma phyin par nga'i bu mo tshe ring g.yang 'dzoms la bu'i las khungs nas bu btsan byol gzhung gi las byed nang zhugs pa shes rtogs byung ste/ nyin grangs mang po bu mor bsun 'tsher che ba'i 'dri rtsad byas te/ mjug tu bu las khungs nas khrur 'bud byas skor rang skyong ljongs las khungs tshang ma'i nang khyab bsgrags byas/da dung de sngon nga'i lta rtogs tshogs mi yin pa'i grong mi u yon lhan khang gi bde 'jags u yon bud med rgyag lod dang dngos grub gnyis kyis nga'i bu mor/ nga dang nga'i bu ga dus log yong gi red ces dri rtsad thengs mang byas par/ bu mo 'u thug nas/ khyed gnyis 'byon po yod na rgya gar du bskyod de a ma dang gcen po 'khrid shog ces khra log brgyab rkyen/ kho gnyis kyis lag pa bkyag pa ma zad/ bu mor rdog rgyag 288

me tshe don ldan gyi tshe 'jug 289zhus te mkhal mar skyon cadar te sman khang du bskyal nas nyin grangs bcu tsam rjes 'das gro ngas phyin/ bu mo 'das/ gro ngas phyin nas bdun tshigs bzhi par nga'i bu la lan 'gyor 'dug kyang / bu dang sprun mched tshos nga la bu mo nad mnar byung ste sman khang du lus pa las grongs pa gsang nas ma bshad par// kho nga tsho sa gtsug ‘sprug khang dbus dgo na sde khag la mchod 'bul dang sku sger yig tshang la baṇ+ḍa rten phul ba mo gas byed skabs /tha ma ngas shes te sems pham chen po byung / skabs der sku nga pa khyim mtshes dang / dril bsgrags/ bde srung las khungs so/gas nas sems gso'i 'tshams 'dri gang legs gnang byung /'o/ der 1985 zla ba dang po'i nang 7bo nga sa mchodag nas gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen bka' drin bstsal gacha/nga gi yod pa/ dang dus bsnyun/ ngas rang gi gser dngul rgyan cha dang gzi byu ru sogs pham cho nga brgyab ste dngul gang rag gis cho gas yongs la sku 'gyed dang mchod 'bul gang sku nga byas te/ bu mo7 'das grongs phyin rkyen gyi kho nga khe nga rgyal zhi thabs dang blo pham yal thabs byed khul byas pa yin/lo gnyis 'das rjes ngo da nang ser skya mi mang nas rgya nag gzhung la ngo sgo la gyi las 'gul gcig rjes gnyis mthud byung ba'i gnas tshul thodas pa dang / chabs cig sku zhabs 'od zer rin po che gdan sa ser rar chodas zhugs 289

me tshe don ldan gyi tshe 'jug 289zhus te mkhal mar skyon shor te sman khang du bskyal nas nyin grangs bcu tsam rjes 'das grongs phyin/ bu mo 'das/ grongs phyin nas bdun tshigs bzhi par nga'i bu la lan 'byor 'dug kyang / bu dang spun mched tshos ri la bu mo nad mnar byung ste sman khang du lus pa las grongs pa gsang nas ma bshad par khong tshos gtsug ‘pag khang dbus dgon sde khag la mchod 'bul dang sku sger yig tshang la bsngo rten phul ba sogs byed skabs /tha ma ngas shes te sems pham chen po byung / skabs der grong ba khyim mtshes dang / dril bsgrags/ bde srung las khungs sogs nas sem sa gso'i 'tshams 'dri gang legs gnang byung /lo der 1985 zla ba dang po'i nang 7gong sa mchog nas gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dbang chen bka' drin bstsal gachang gi yod pa/ dang dus bsnyun/ ngas rang gi gser dngul rgyan cha dang gzi byu ru sogs pham tshong brgyab ste dngul gang rag gis tshogs yongs la sku 'gyed dang mchod 'bul gang yong byas te/ bu mo 'das grongs phyin rkyen gyi khong khro nga rgyal zhi thabs dang slo pham yal thabs byed khul byas pa yin/lo gnyis 'das rjes bod nang ser skya mi mang nas rgya nag gzhung la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul gcig rjes gnyis mthud byung ba'i gnas tshul sgos pa dang / chabs cig sgu zhabs 'od zer rin ngo che gdan sa ser rar chos zhugs 289

290 rgan mo'i ma bcodas drang gtam/gnang ste dpe cha gzigs nas rig chung bar phebs kyang / bod du bstan pa nyag phra ba'i rkyen gyis spyi 'e1 1987 zla 10 tshes 1 nyin lha rngaṭar rgya dmar gzhung la dngos su gdong len gyis gzhi rgya che ba'i ngo rgol ska da 'bod las 'gul nang zhugs stabs/ da/ma pa der rgya gzhung nas zing slong ngan bskul gyi nyes ming btags nas bathe na 'jug byas te 'o/ gcis/ tsam la bce na khang nang spyodag rgyug gi gtso sa pa'i khrems gcod sna tshogs btang rkyen sku gzugs la rma shu' mang po mthong rgyu 'dugade rjes slar yang spyi 'o/ 1988 lo dang 1989 'o/ khag so sor bod nang bod mi'i rang dbang dang bstan pa slar gso'i ched grwa btsun ser skya khag cig sne 'khrid kyis rgya dmar la lnga lha la las 'gu'4 mu mthud brtsams rkyen/ bskyar du khrims cadag tu 'tshud nyen la mo nga / bod rgyal 'o/ 2117 zla 6 tshes 13 dang spyi 'o( 1990 zla 9 nang lha sa nas/ gsang thabs kyis stod brgyud bal yul dang de nas rgya gar nang btsan byol la phebs thub pa byung /yun ring ma mo nga ba'i nyin zhig a 'o/ bstan pa yang lha sa nas bal yul brgyud phebs byung bas ngas phebs tshul dri skabs rgya nag gzhung la gnas skor 'gro tshul gyis mgo bstodar g.yog thub tsam byung zhes/ skabs de'i gnas tshul nga la zhib phra gsungs/ de yang / 'od zer rin rngo/ che se rar 290

mi tshe don ldan gyi tshe 'jug na9 )slob gnyer gnang mus su 1988 lo'i zla ba gsum par lha sar se ra rwa'i gra dam/ngas mnyam ju+o lha la la phebs 'dug pa rgya dmag nyen swā gas pa'i 'dzin bzung nang 'tshud/ rin po che 1989 zla ba 4 btson nas glod 'grol rjes a pho bstan pa dang rin po che gsang gros gnang ste rin po ches se ra dbo na par a pho bstan pa bsnyun pas nyin bdun dbo ngas pa zhus te/ zhabs phyi smar khams cadad dbo na grwa pa gnyis dang lhan du lha sa khul nas 〉wad khul rgyud rgya gar nang spradas byedal la phebs/nyin bdun tsam rjes a pho bstan pas mkhar rgyug r+bhag ste se rar phebs te nga rgad po na yang bla ma gtug tu slebs ma byung / da lta ga par yod dam/ zhes rtsad bcad/ se ra nas bla ma khyed rang la nad g.yog rgyug dathodas zhes nyin bdun dbo ngas pa zhus skor bshad/ a pho sa da yag ngo ma byung /gung khran tang gisdo/ bla ma btson khang la bcug pa red ces btson khang tshang mar rtsad gcadad par phebs khul dang / stabs cig thabs shes gang dras/ gis phyir bskyosted lag 'khyer thodab thabs gnang ste bal yul bar mkha' lam brgyud slebs/ bal yul nas a 11 bstan pa gsar 'dredar ba khag cig mnyam rgya gar du phebs te nga'i nang lo gcig ring bzhugs/ de'i ring 'od zer rin ngo che spyi sna ra 7bo nga sa chen wa mchodag gi bka' dgo ngas lam stodan bzhin rgya gar lho phyogs spel skardzob 'u/gas bsam bsam gling gzhis sār kho ngas 291

292 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/gdan sa ser smad tsha khang tshan nang gdan 'dren dang / chos zhugs sogs gnang rgyur a pho bstan pas thugs 'gan gtso bo bzhes te byes la yod pa'i 'od dgon gra pa dang smar khams pa/ sogs nas phyar gru mnyam 'debs nus a pho bstan pa bod nang log rjes pha yul du rig gsar nang rtsa gtor phyin pa'i 'od zer dgon gsar bzhengs nyams gso zhu rgyus mtshon /dge ba'i las ka mang po bsgrubs rgyur ngal ba dang du blangs rkyen/ gcig nas lo na mtho ba dang gnyis nas de snga btson khang nang lo mang bzhugaru/ pa sogs kyis sku gzugs kyi ma bzod par sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul lha sa nas nga'i bu la kha par spebs ma thag yig tshang brgyud 7gong sa mchog la thugs spon skyabs zhu dang / rgya gar lho phyogs gdan sa se rar bzhugs pa'i 'od zer rin po cher zha' par phul ba dang / chabs cig gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos ris med dgon sde khag dang bla sprul dge bshes khag so sor thugs smon bsdo rten dang mtshad 'bul rgya che zhus/ring po ma song bar nga yang sems nad dang sa chu ma 'phros pa sogs gang ltar pho ba'i nad kyis bzung ste/ lo gcig lhag mal sar lus skabs bod gzhung sman rtsis khang gi bla sman pa gnyis kyis dbus sman pa tshang mas sman rin mi dgos par gang drag sman bcos gnang yang de tsam drag skyes ma byung stabs/ ma lan ma 'gyod kyi tshul du rgya sman bsten gtugs skabs 292

mi tshe don ldan gyi tshe 'jug 293kyang bde legs sman khang gi dbu 'dzin bsam mkhar g.yang skyid lags dang /sman pa sa 'du tshang tshe brtan la sogs tshang mas sman rin mi dgos par sman bcos bka' drin chen po gnang byung yang / rang nyid tshe sngon las kyi myangs dasos la brten da dung yang drag skyes ma byung bar sha skam lpags skam gyis de ring 'tsho dang sang nyin shi ba'i gnas su gyar skabs/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mdzadab/ nas thugs brtse ba chen pos dmigs bsal mjal kha dang rin chen ril bu sogs bka' drin bla na ma mchiru/ pa bstsal ba nas bzung / nad ngo phran bu'i chod 'go tshugs/de'i thog nga'i bus skyabs rje rwa stod rin po cher ji dge'i thugs brtag zhus don tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sngags grangs gsog dgos lugs phebs par/ nga'i bus ti lo phug tu yod pa'i bka' rgyud btsun dgon dang rgyud smad gra tshang khag so sor sgol ma 'bum gsog byas pa dang bod sman dang phyi lugs zung sbrel gyis sman bcos byas pa bcas kyis mthar/ nga nad las grol thub pa nas bzung / ngas 'cho ba'i ched tshong las gnyer ba spangs te nga rang yig ngo chod tsam thog khyim mtshes drung yig blo bstan lags su dpe cha slob khrid zhus te dus chod nam byung la kha 'don dge sbyor la 'bad cing /gco che shos bzhugs sgar khul du 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i zhal mnga' nas dbang lung bka' khrid dang gsung chos yang yang bka' drin bstsal 293

306 rgan mo'i ma bsgu sa drangagatam/skor la slob spyong byas na 'grig khyod tshos ltos dang shakyu mu rje dang / tsong kha pa/ twa la rim byedan bcas kyis chodzis lugs kyi gsar brje byas yod pa red/ snu sa lugs ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyis ngal snyu la mi mang la gamo gas pa'i lcags sgrog dang / ngal rtsol mi mang la klad skyon gtong ba'i sbir sman yin pas de gnyis khyesgod cenas khas len dboges/ kho cheras chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha rtsab ral de 'khyer nas mi dmangs dang mes rgyal la ngo sgo la byas pa der dgag pa brgyab dbo sa/ gung khran tang ni ma le ring lugs kyi srid tang dang / dngos gtso smra ba'i tang lha med smra ba zhig yin pas/ lha 'dre/ dmyal ba/ lha yul bcas khas len gyi ma red/zhes dang / trī la paṇa chen la dgag pa brgyag rgyu de chodas lugs dang dbye ba gsal wa phye dbo sa/ twa la dang paṇa chen gnyis ni mi gso/da lag dmar ba red dam/ bla ma sangs rgyas red dam/ yang na byas rjes yod dam nag nyes yod/ yag po red dam sdug po red/ mi rigs kyi gtso 'dzin red dam mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren red/ bsam slo yag po gtong dgos/1) tā paṇa gnyis ni bkas bgo da brgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag po'i spyi'i las tshab red/2) zing 'khrug gi byed gcad/3) chodas lugs dang mi rigs kyi 'bag bshu dbo sa/306

bso/da nams bag gros btsan gyol gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ skuX74) slad phyin khyed snums dgag rgyag zung sbrel byed dgo sa/de snga mnga' bdag che gsum ni mi 'awa ra brgya cha 5 red/ brgya cha 95 mi mang red/ mnga' bdag che sa/sum nas de snga wa da kyi sa zhing phyugs rigs btsan bdag byas pa ma zad/ zhing bran rnams kyang bdag pa red/ ngal rtsodal byas 'bras brgya cha 70 mnga' bdag gi red/tā la nas bshu gazlothog che lha sa khyim gzhis 27 zhing bran mi grangs 40 'o/ rer zhing bran na/sa 'bru khal khri 2 lhag tsam bshu gasnyadag btang /tā la rang gi bshu gzhog btang ba'i rgyu nor 'bor chen bsags pa'i rin 'bab mo ba rtsis byas na gser gser nyag khri 160300 yod/rgya dngul nyag khri 9500 bud med kyi rgyan cha sna tsho gas/ mu tig gaX/ byur sogs khri 203000 〈snan chas ༷/sa ldan 14000gong gsal dngo sa wa cha sko mas byas na wa da kyi zhing bran gyi khyim rer chu ra 400 bshu gachodag btang ba mo gas khyodad cho bsam chod gcig gto/nga dang / ngal cu la mi dmangs mang sngo ltogs shi thebs yod/kho pa mi gcig la ngal rtsol ma byas par rgyu dngos 'di 'dra yodang ba gang yin nam/ kho ni khrag 'jib dug sgrul red/paṇa chen yang zhing bran che shos red/ rdzong 4 'brog thang 30dgon khag nas gser sku 100 tsam rku nyar byas pa/ lha rtse/ phum/ gling /307

308 rgan mo'i ma bce sa drang gtam/ngam ring sogs kyi mi dmangs kyi gso/ dbo sa mi 'dug gam/ rnam gling gzhis la mi ser them grangs snyo58 nas bun 'o/na them grangs snyo006yodad/ 'bras spungs dgon par zhing bran khri 2 yod/ der cha snyoms byas na bu lon 'byu khal 500 dang / dngul ḍam rdo re 200 re 'jal dbo sa/zhing bran bsad pa grangs med/ lnga tā la'i mdun la bce na khang /sdig tshang / rtsig ldebs khrag gi chosas pa bcas 'o/ rgyus kyi dpang rtags red/kho nga chodas dbang bsgyur byed chu gas gcig ni chab srid dang wa da dmag gi lag tu yodad pa'i me mda' de red/ bod rnying khrims yig nang mi rim pa gnyis la dbye ba/ dbo na khag gi bca' yig na mgar ba/ bshan pa / rdza bajo bcas dgo na par bcug mi chodag zer ba dang / ri klung rtsa tshig bkrams nas zhing bran bcings pa red/nyes med zhing bran bsad nas sku ga skyel rtsathag cadad pa der bltas nas khong tsho shi skabs de ltar red dam/ tā la 13 pa'i skabs dngos po ga tshod 'a'o/ga brlags gtang sku da pa ma red dam/ tā la lnga pa nas bcu bzhi bar rimyo/ byung gis bod mi dmangs la phan pa'i bya ba sne gcig byas sku da dam/ bod rnying spyi chosags nang mi gso/na po'i rnying rtsa ga3 da pa/ lpags bshu byed pa'i kla spyod bzhi ldan khrims ngan de dag 'dzam gling thog yod pa ma red/308

bso/da nams bag gro sa btsan byedal gzhung gi sku tshab la 5la ba'i yig cha/ 3091952 nas 1958 bar mi grangs 72 dmar gse da btang ba de sngo ga nas khyodad kyi mdzes rgyan sprodad pa der rgyu mtshan med/ rkang pa btsugs sa med/ 1948 'e tā las mi bsad pa ma red dam/ lug bsad na kha la byin rten glugs kyi red/ mi gsod dus ga 'dra red dam/rta lcag bzhus pa'i sa cha khrag gis chosas pa dang / khrag 'jib khyi sdi/ga sdod pa bcas kyis bod ni chab srid/ dpal 'byedar/ rig gzhung / mi 'bor bcas gang 'thad nas rjes lus su gyar dgos byung ba red/ der rten tā paṇa dang bceran khang nang nyes can kha shas kyis gtam 'chal la dgag pa rgyag dbosnas/twa paṇa ni mes rgyal mi dmangs la rgyab galta da rgyal snumang gi byed gte red/ khyodad tsho'i nang gi mi 'ga' res mi rigs bcings 'bo la rgyal khab rang btsan tshags par nang bkodad 'dug pas/ nge da rang btsan yin zer mkhan mo da pa de ni dkrog gtam red/ 1942 lor me'i go'i sku tshab ha le mas zer ba lha sar slebs pa dang / ma'e bo srid gzhung gis tā lar sprodad yig dang dngos po khyer yod/ 1949 zla 8 la a dang / se mu'u bod la ma'e bosgos btang nas trī la dang ngan 'brel bya ngan byas yod/1947 'e ra hin rdur ya gling gi tsho gas 'du chosags pa der bod kyi sku tshab btang nas phra da rang btsan yin pa'i skad ngan brgyab ste gangs seng 309

bsod nams bag gros btsan byol gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ 091952 nas 1958 bar mi grangs 72 dmar gsod btang ba de thog nas khyod kyi mdzes rgyan sgod pa der rgyu mtshan med/ rkang pa btsugs sa med/ 1948 lo tā las mi bsad pa ma red dam/ lug bsad na kha la byin rten blugs kyi red/ mi gsod dus ga 'dra red dam/rta lcag bzhus pa'i sa cha khrag gis chos pa dang / khrag 'jib khyi sgug sdod pa bcas kyis bod ni chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / mi 'bor bcas gang 'thad nas rjes lus su gyar dgos byung ba red/ der rten tā paṇa dang btson khang nang nyes can kha shas kyis gtam 'chal la dgag pa rgyag dbo sa/tā paṇa ni mes rgyal mi dmangs la rgyab gtod rgyal tshong gi byed gte red/ khyod tsho'i nang gi mi 'ga' res mi rigs bcings 'grol rgyal khab rang btsan tshags par nang bkod 'dug pas/ bod rang btsan yin zer mkhan yod pa de ni dkrog gtam red/ 1942 lor me'i go'i sku tshab ha le mas zer ba lha sar spebs pa dang / ma'e go srid gzhung gis tā lar sgod yig dang dngos po khyer yod/ 1949 zla 8 la a dang / se mu'u bod la ma'e gos btang nas tā la dang ngan 'brel bya ngan byas yod/1947 lor hin rdur ya gling gi chogs 'du tshogs pa der bod kyi sku tshab btang nas bod rang btsan yin pa'i skad ngan brgyab ste gangs seng 309

310 rgan mo ma bcos drang gtam/rigs ldan gyi dar cha bka'/ ba/ 1949 lor rgya bod kha bral gis lha sar dus zing bslangs nas rgya mi phyir skrod btang ba/ 1947 lo zhwa gab pa dang sgom mda' gnyis bod tshong don rtogs zhib tshogs pa zer ba btang nas ha hreng tun dang ci'u cing hran sogs la bod rang btsan yin pa'i dkrog gtam mang po bshad pa red/ de rjes slar yang ma'i gos bod la gsang nyul mang po tā lar ngan sbrel gyes mes bod kha bral gye bya ba tshang ma phyi btsan dang / tā las gcos mtho rim log spyod pa'i bya ngan zhe gcig red/ 1950 lor bod dmag chab mdor bzhag pa de ma'i go'i ha me mes bkod jus byas pa red/ de ni bod mi dmangs la thob bzhin yod pa'i bcings bkrol bkag 'gog byas pa sogs nga tshos tā la ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyug khyi dang rgyal tshong zer ba der rgyu mtshan yod pa red/da dung klu khang pas gtsos mtho rim mi snas mes bod kha bral gtong rgyu'i bya ngan byas pa/ krung gung spyi khyab bzhugs yul du mtha' bskor ba/1955 lo tā las dkar mdzes sa khul du phyin nas khri byang sogs btang nas zing 'khrugs bslangs pa/ 1959 lor nor gling du gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi bka' bkod pu'u btsugs pa sogs jus ngan tshang ma tā las bkod bsdoms byas pa zhe gcig red/ rgya dmar mthar sgrod gtong dgos bco brgyad drug cu'i dmag bskul brgyab pa/310

310 rgan mo'i ma bcodas drang gtam/rigs ldan gyi dar cha bka'/ ba/ 1949 'o/ra rgya wasted kha bral gis lha sar dus zing bslangs nas rgya mi phyir skyod btang ba/ 1947 lo zhwa gab pa dang spom mda' gnyis ngo da cho nga dodan lta gas zhib chogags pa zer ba btang nas ha hreng tun dang ci'u cing hran so/gas la wa da rang btsan yin pa'i dar+sha ga gtam mang po bshad pa red/ de rjes slar yang ma'e gos bod la gsang nyul mang wa twa lar ngan sbrel gyis mes 〈snad kha bral gyi bya ba tshang ma phyi btsan dang / tā las gtso sa mthod rim 'o/ga spyodad pa'i bya ngan zhe gcig red/ 1950 'o/ra phra da dmag chab mdodar bzhag pa de ma'e go'i ha me mes bgo da jus byas pa red/ de ni wa da mi dmangs la thodab bzhin sku da pa'i bcings bskru la bkag 'bo ga byas pa mo gas nga chosas tā la ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyug khyi dang rgyal tsho nga zer ba der rgyu mtshan sku da pa red/da dung klu khang pas gasgu sa mjo rim mi snas mes ngo da kha bral galta nga rgyu'i bya ngan byas pa/ krung gung spyi khyab bzhugs yul du mtha' bskor ba/1955 'otho twa las dkar mdzes sa khul du phyin nas khri byang mo gas btang nas zing 'khrugs bslangs pa/ 1959 lor nor gling du gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi bka' bkod pu'u btsugs pa sogs jus ngan tshang ma tā las babo da bsdoms byas pa zhe gcig red/ rgya dmar mthar skyod gtong dgos bco brgyad drug cu'i dmag bskul brgyab pa/310

bse da nams bag gro sa btsan byedal gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ 311skabs der ka sbug tu zhwa sgab par tar btang nas bod rang btsan yin pa'i khyab bsgrags byed dbo sa pa'i bskadad 'aro/mas byas pa red/ spyi 'o/ 1959 zla 3 tshes 19 nyin dalnga sa su zing 'khrug bslangs nas phyir khyodas byas pa/ phyi rgyal du don gce da khang btsugs pa/ 19snyo2 lo krung hin 'khrugs skabs gser rgya ma 34 hin rdu srid gzhung la sprad pa de thodag nas rgyal dza nga jag pa yin pa mchodan pa red/ paṇa chen gyis mes rgyal la rgyab gasnodad bya ngan lha ra/ bcos bsgyur ma byas go nga nas hin rdu'i gsang nyul 'gebs srung dang jus ngan byas pa/zing 'khrugs rjes phyi rgyal du bskyal ba red/ paṇa chen gyis nag nyes/ 1)mes bod kha phral/ 2jini wa da mi dmangs nang khul kha phral/ nang blon khang du gsar brjer ngo rgol bkod 'doms byed rgyu sogs rtsa 'dzin 13 bzos pa red/ 1957 dang / 1958 'o/ra ta paṇa ngan 'brel gyis mes bod kha phral dang / ru chosags gnyis ngan 'brel bya rgyu'i yid mthun dam bca' bzhag nas zur khang dang paṇa chen thug 'phrad byas pa red/gzhis rtser 'phrul 'kho ra slob grwa btsugs nas tā las ma 'grub pa'i bya ba paṇa chen gyis bsgrub rgyu byas pa red/ 1962 lor cang jag gis skam sa chen ngo ra tshur rgol byed rgyu'i skad cor brgyab pa/ krung hin zing cha'i go skabs dang bsnyun nas yig 'bru khri/ bdun gyi snyan zhu zer ba 311

bsod nams bag gros btsan gyol gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ 311skabs der ka sbug tu zhwa sgab par tar btang nas bod rang btsan yin pa'i khyab bsgrags byed dgos pa'i bkod 'doms byas pa red/ spyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 19 nyin dngos su zing 'khrug bslangs nas phyir bros byas pa/ phye rgyal du don gcod khang btsugs pa/ 1962 lo krung hin 'khrugs skabs gser rgya ma 34 lhan rdu srid gzhung la sprad pa de sgog nas rgyal tshong jag pa yin pa mtshon pa red/ baṇa chen gyis mes rgyal la rgyab gtod bya ngan skor/ bcos bsgyur ma byas gong nas hin rdu'i gsang nyul 'gebs srung dang jus ngan byas pa/zing 'khrugs rjes phyi rgyal du bskyal ba red/ paṇa chen gyis nag nyes/ 1)mes bod kha phral/ 2 ) bod mi dmangs nang khul kha phral/ nang zlon khang du gsar brjer ngo rgol bkod 'doms byed rgyu sogs rtsa 'dzin 13 bzos pa red/ 1957 dang / 1958 lor ta paṇa ngan 'brel gyis mes bod kha phral dang / ru tshogs gnyis ngan 'brel bya rgyu'i yid mthun dam bca' bzhag nas zur khang dang paṇa chen thug 'phrad byas pa red/gzhis rtser 'phrul 'khor slob grwa btsugs nas tā las ma 'grub pa'i bya ba paṇa chen gyis bsgrub rgyu byas pa red/ 1962 lor cang jag gis skam sa chen por tshur rgol byed rgyu'i skad cor brgyab pa/ krung hin zing cha'i go skabs dang bsnyun nas yig 'bru khri/ bdun gyi snyan zhu zer ba 311

312 rgan mo'i ma bcos drang gtam/gsar brjer ngo rgol gye bya ngan spel ba red/ kho pa'i ngos len ltar bya ngan 'grub na tā las tsung thung dang kho pas tsung li byed rgyu zer ba de sgog nas ham sems mthong gi red/'grems ston khang la blta skor nang gsal grwa pa slog brnyan blta bar bkag 'gog byas pa dang / bod la gral rim 'thab rtsod rgya mis bzos skor/ 'bras rtsam za mkhan dbye ba phye dgos pa/ chos lugs dad pa yod med dbye nas mthun sgril byas na 'grig gi ma red ces bshad/ khyod tsho nyung shas nas bshad pa'i skad cha tshang ma bod mi dmangs kyi g.yugs zin pa'i tā paṇa gyi skad cha dang gcig pa red/ khyod kyis gsar gtod byas pa gang yang ma red/ da dung paṇa chen gyis bcos sgyur bkag 'gog byed pa'i dgon khag skul slong dang bod mi dmangs kyi bcos sgyur byed rgyu'i re ba byed kyi mi 'dug ces bshad pa red/ ma dgos pa ma red/ de snga dmangs gtso gyen log byung yang srid tang med pas ma 'grub pa red/1962 lor paṇa chen gyis gnya' gnon bshu gzhog ngo rgol tshogs par/ hur brtson pa khyod tsho mi tshe ring po med zer ba de thog nas kho pa'i ham sems mtshon pa red/ 1957 lor nor gling tā la'i pho brang la rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang zhes ming btags pa/ paṇa chen sdod gnas la rdo rje pho brang zhes ming btags pa/ nyes can khos rdo rje gnyis nyar ba kho pa gnyis 312

312 rgan mo'i ma bcadas drang gtam/gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi bya ngan spel ba red/ kho pa'i ngos len ltar bya ngan 'grub na tā las tsung thung dang kho pas tsung li byed rgyu zer ba de thog nas ham sems malnga nga gi red/'grems ston khang la blta skor nang gsal grwa pa 1—ga brnyan blta bar bkag 'gog byas pa dang / bod la gral rim 'thab rtsod rgya mis bakhrodas skor/ 'bras rtsam za mkhan dbye ba phye dgotes pa/ chodas lugs dad pa yod med dbye nas mthun sgril byas na 'grig gi ma red ces bshad/ khyodad cho nyung shas nas bshad pa'i skad cha tshang ma phraged mi dmangs kyi g.yugs zin pa'i tā paṇa gyi skad cha dang gcig pa red/ khyod kyis gsar gto/da byas pa gang yang ma red/ da dung paṇa chen gyis bcadas sgyur bkag 'go ga byed pa'i dgon khag skul slong dang bod mi dmangs kyi bcos sgyur byed rgyu'i re ba byed kyi mi 'dug ces bshad pa red/ ma dgos pa ma red/ de snga dmangs gtso gyen 'o/ga byung yang srid tang med pas ma 'grub pa red/1962 'o/ra paṇa chen gyis gnya' gcadan bshu gazlosgog cad lhagal cesags par/ hur brtson pa khyod tsho mi tshe ring po med zer ba de thog nas kho pa'i ham sems mtsho na pa red/ 1957 lor nor gling twa la'i pho brang la rtag brtan mi 'gyur 'o/ brang zhes ming btags pa/ paṇa chen sdod gnas la sna rje sgyu brang zhes ming btags pa/ nyes can kho sa the rje gnyis nyar ba kho pa gnyis 312

bso da nams bag hros btsan byodal gzhung gi sku tshab la phul ba'i yig cha/ 313ro langs rgyag rgyu'i ngan sems ma shi ba zhing bran bdag po'i gral rim yun gnas yong ched du red/1958 'o/ra paṇa chen gyis tā lar yi ge btang dodan/ 7kun gzigs lha mi'i rnam 'dren zhes yod pa dang / tā las paṇa chen la btang yig nang 7kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog zer 'khod pa de thog phan tshun bkur bzod byas pa red/ de ni gnya' bshu byas par rgyu mtshan sku da dang / kho pa gnyis nas wa da kha 'o/ sgyur mkhan mngon shes mngon rtog yod khul byas pa red/ 1963 lor paṇa chen gyis nga ni kun gyi pha ma kun gyi mabosgon yin zhes bris pa/ 1963 lor twa las yul gyar srid gzhung btsugs skabs nga ni gangs stodangs kyi lha yin zer hin rdur bshad pas ma tshad/ da dung bod kyi rtsa khrims kyi mdun du bod mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam red ze bshad pa red/ 'dra mnyam ma red/ ru khag lnga pa'i mis tā la'i chu spre zhal 'dams gleng gi yodad/ 1932 lo bris pa red/ skabs der rgyal nang gsar brje langs yod pa red/ zhal 'dams ni dmar po'i srid dbang bkag 'go ga mi dmangs la ngo sga la gyi bsgrags gtam zhig las gzhan gang yang ma red/tā paṇa gnyis mnga' bang/ga mnga' tshab kyi khe phan tshab byed red/ mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren rgyal chodang jag pa yin pas phra da mi dmangs kyi gtso 313
